# FILE: apps/backend/app/api/router.py
################################################################################
from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.domains.admin.router import router as admin_router
from app.domains.ai_assistant.router import router as ai_router
from app.domains.community.router import router as community_router
from app.domains.events.router import router as events_router
from app.domains.identity.router import router as auth_router
from app.domains.heritage.router import router as heritage_router
from app.domains.genealogy.router import router as genealogy_router
from app.domains.directory.router import router as directory_router
from app.domains.notifications.router import router as notifications_router

api_router = APIRouter()
api_router.include_router(auth_router)
api_router.include_router(admin_router)
api_router.include_router(ai_router)
api_router.include_router(community_router)
api_router.include_router(events_router)
api_router.include_router(heritage_router)
api_router.include_router(genealogy_router)
api_router.include_router(directory_router)
api_router.include_router(notifications_router)

################################################################################
# FILE: apps/backend/app/core/config.py
################################################################################
import os
from pathlib import Path

try:
    from dotenv import load_dotenv

    parents = Path(__file__).resolve().parents
    repo_env = parents[4] / ".env" if len(parents) > 4 else None
    if repo_env is not None and repo_env.exists():
        load_dotenv(repo_env)
    else:
        load_dotenv()
except ImportError:
    pass

MSSQL_USER = os.getenv("MSSQL_USER", "sa")
MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD = os.getenv("MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD", "")
MSSQL_HOST = os.getenv("MSSQL_HOST", "localhost")
MSSQL_PORT = int(os.getenv("MSSQL_PORT", "1433"))
MSSQL_DB = os.getenv("MSSQL_DB", "FamilyConnect")
MSSQL_TRUSTED_CONNECTION = os.getenv("MSSQL_TRUSTED_CONNECTION", "no").strip().lower() in {"1", "true", "yes"}

JWT_SECRET_KEY = os.getenv("JWT_SECRET_KEY")
if not JWT_SECRET_KEY:
    raise RuntimeError("Thiếu JWT_SECRET_KEY. Hãy cấu hình biến môi trường trước khi chạy backend.")

ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES = int(os.getenv("ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES", "60"))

GEMINI_API_KEY = os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY", "").strip()
GEMINI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = os.getenv("GEMINI_EMBEDDING_MODEL", "gemini-embedding-001")
GEMINI_EMBEDDING_DIM = int(os.getenv("GEMINI_EMBEDDING_DIM", "256"))
GEMINI_CHAT_MODEL = os.getenv("GEMINI_CHAT_MODEL", "gemini-2.5-flash")

################################################################################
# FILE: apps/backend/app/core/database.py
################################################################################
from collections.abc import Generator

from sqlalchemy import URL, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session, sessionmaker

from app.core.config import (
    MSSQL_DB,
    MSSQL_HOST,
    MSSQL_PORT,
    MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD,
    MSSQL_TRUSTED_CONNECTION,
    MSSQL_USER,
)
from app.shared.base_model import Base

_query: dict[str, str] = {"TrustServerCertificate": "yes"}
if MSSQL_TRUSTED_CONNECTION:
    _query["Trusted_Connection"] = "yes"

database_url = URL.create(
    drivername="mssql+mssqlpython",
    username=None if MSSQL_TRUSTED_CONNECTION else MSSQL_USER,
    password=None if MSSQL_TRUSTED_CONNECTION else MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD,
    host=MSSQL_HOST,
    port=MSSQL_PORT,
    database=MSSQL_DB,
    query=_query,
)

engine = create_engine(database_url, pool_pre_ping=True)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, autoflush=False, autocommit=False)


def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()


__all__ = ["Base", "SessionLocal", "database_url", "engine", "get_db"]

# FILE: apps/backend/app/core/dependencies.py

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status

from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.security import get_current_user
from app.domains.identity.models import User


def require_role(*allowed_roles: str) -> Callable[[User], User]:
    """Dependency kiểm tra quyền RBAC (ví dụ: admin, family_head, member)."""

    def role_checker(current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)]) -> User:
        if allowed_roles and current_user.role not in allowed_roles:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.",
            )
        return current_user

    return role_checker


__all__ = ["get_current_user", "get_db", "require_role"]

from fastapi import HTTPException, status


class DomainError(Exception):
    """Ngoại lệ tầng miền nghiệp vụ (Domain Layer)."""

    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message


class NotFoundError(HTTPException):
    def __init__(self, detail: str = "Không tìm thấy tài nguyên yêu cầu.") -> None:
        super().__init__(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=detail)


class ConflictError(HTTPException):
    def __init__(self, detail: str = "Dữ liệu bị trùng lặp hoặc xung đột.") -> None:
        super().__init__(status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, detail=detail)

# FILE: apps/backend/app/core/family_access.py

from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.domains.identity.models import User


def require_family_access(db: Session, actor: User, family_id: UUID, *, manage: bool = False) -> None:
    if actor.role not in ("admin", "family_head", "member") or (manage and actor.role == "member"):
        raise HTTPException(403, "Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.")
    row = db.execute(text("""
        SELECT f.Id, CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members m
            WHERE m.UserId=:actor_id AND m.FamilyId=f.Id
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsMember
        FROM core.Families f WHERE f.Id=:family_id
    """), {"actor_id": str(actor.id), "family_id": str(family_id)}).mappings().one_or_none()
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Không tìm thấy gia đình.")
    if actor.role != "admin" and not row["IsMember"]:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Bạn không có quyền truy cập gia đình này.")

# FILE: apps/backend/app/core/security.py

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Annotated
from uuid import UUID

import jwt
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import HTTPAuthorizationCredentials, HTTPBearer
from jwt.exceptions import InvalidTokenError
from pwdlib import PasswordHash
from sqlalchemy import select, true
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.config import ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES, ALGORITHM, JWT_SECRET_KEY
from app.core.database import get_db
from app.domains.identity.models import User

secret_key = JWT_SECRET_KEY
password_hash = PasswordHash.recommended()
dummy_password_hash = password_hash.hash("familyconnect-invalid-user-password")
bearer_scheme = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    return password_hash.hash(password)


def verify_password(password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    return password_hash.verify(password, hashed_password)


def create_access_token(user: User) -> str:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    payload = {
        "sub": str(user.id),
        "iat": now,
        "exp": now + timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_MINUTES),
    }
    return jwt.encode(payload, secret_key, algorithm=ALGORITHM)


def get_current_user(
    credentials: Annotated[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials | None, Depends(bearer_scheme)],
    db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)],
) -> User:
    unauthorized = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Phiên đăng nhập không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn.",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    if credentials is None:
        raise unauthorized

    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(credentials.credentials, secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        user_id = UUID(payload["sub"])
    except (InvalidTokenError, KeyError, ValueError):
        raise unauthorized from None

    user = db.scalar(select(User).where(User.id == user_id, User.is_active == true()))
    if user is None:
        raise unauthorized
    return user

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy.sql.elements import TextClause


def _procedure_sql(statement: str) -> TextClause:
    # Some mssql-python versions omit the native error number from exceptions.
    # Preserve ERROR_NUMBER in a stable marker; statement is an internal SQL
    # literal and every request value remains a bound parameter.
    return text(f"""
        BEGIN TRY
            {statement}
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            DECLARE @ApiError NVARCHAR(2048) = CONCAT(N'[FC_SQL:', ERROR_NUMBER(), N'] ', ERROR_MESSAGE());
            THROW 50000, @ApiError, 1;
        END CATCH
    """)


def list_configs(db: Session, *, limit: int, offset: int) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    return list(db.execute(text("""
        SELECT ConfigKey, ConfigValue, Description, UpdatedAt
        FROM core.SystemConfigs
        ORDER BY ConfigKey
        OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY
    """), {"limit": limit, "offset": offset}).mappings().all())


def get_config(db: Session, config_key: str) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    return db.execute(text("""
        SELECT ConfigKey, ConfigValue, Description, UpdatedAt
        FROM core.SystemConfigs WHERE ConfigKey = :config_key
    """), {"config_key": config_key}).mappings().one_or_none()


def create_config(db: Session, *, actor_id: UUID, config_key: str, config_value: str,
                  description: str | None) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    return db.execute(_procedure_sql("""
        EXEC core.usp_CreateSystemConfig
            @ActorUserId = :actor_id, @ConfigKey = :config_key,
            @ConfigValue = :config_value, @Description = :description
    """), {"actor_id": str(actor_id), "config_key": config_key,
           "config_value": config_value, "description": description}).mappings().one()


def update_config(db: Session, *, actor_id: UUID, config_key: str, config_value: str,
                  description: str | None) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    return db.execute(_procedure_sql("""
        EXEC core.usp_UpdateSystemConfig
            @ActorUserId = :actor_id, @ConfigKey = :config_key,
            @ConfigValue = :config_value, @Description = :description
    """), {"actor_id": str(actor_id), "config_key": config_key,
           "config_value": config_value, "description": description}).mappings().one()


def delete_config(db: Session, *, actor_id: UUID, config_key: str) -> None:
    db.execute(_procedure_sql("""
        EXEC core.usp_DeleteSystemConfig
            @ActorUserId = :actor_id, @ConfigKey = :config_key
    """), {"actor_id": str(actor_id), "config_key": config_key}).close()


def list_pending_verifications(db: Session, *, reviewer_id: UUID, limit: int,
                               offset: int) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    return list(db.execute(_procedure_sql("""
        EXEC core.usp_GetPendingVerifications
            @ReviewerUserId = :reviewer_id, @Limit = :limit, @Offset = :offset
    """), {"reviewer_id": str(reviewer_id), "limit": limit, "offset": offset}).mappings().all())


def review_verification(db: Session, *, reviewer_id: UUID, verification_id: UUID,
                        decision: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    return db.execute(_procedure_sql("""
        EXEC core.usp_ReviewMemberVerification
            @VerificationId = :verification_id,
            @ReviewerUserId = :reviewer_id, @Decision = :decision
    """), {"verification_id": str(verification_id), "reviewer_id": str(reviewer_id),
           "decision": decision}).mappings().one()


def get_statistics(db: Session, actor_id: UUID) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    return list(db.execute(_procedure_sql("""
        EXEC reports.usp_GetDashboardStatistics @ActorUserId = :actor_id
    """), {"actor_id": str(actor_id)}).mappings().all())


def list_reported_contents(db: Session, *, status: str, limit: int, offset: int) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    return list(db.execute(text("""
        SELECT report.Id AS ReportId, report.TargetId, report.TargetType,
               reporter.FullName AS ReporterName, report.Reason, report.Status, report.CreatedAt,
               family.Name AS FamilyName,
               CASE report.TargetType WHEN N'post' THEN post.Content
                    WHEN N'comment' THEN comment.Content WHEN N'photo' THEN media.MediaUrl END AS TargetContent,
               CAST(CASE WHEN post.Id IS NOT NULL OR comment.Id IS NOT NULL
                         OR (media.Id IS NOT NULL AND (media.MediaType = N'image' OR media.MediaType LIKE N'image/%'))
                         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS CanResolve
        FROM community.ReportedContents AS report
        INNER JOIN core.Users AS reporter ON reporter.UserId = report.ReportedBy
        LEFT JOIN community.Posts AS post ON report.TargetType = N'post' AND post.Id = report.TargetId
        LEFT JOIN community.Comments AS comment ON report.TargetType = N'comment' AND comment.Id = report.TargetId
        LEFT JOIN community.PostMedia AS media ON report.TargetType = N'photo' AND media.Id = report.TargetId
        LEFT JOIN community.Posts AS parent ON parent.Id = COALESCE(comment.PostId, media.PostId)
        LEFT JOIN core.Families AS family ON family.Id = COALESCE(post.FamilyId, parent.FamilyId)
        WHERE report.Status = :status
        ORDER BY report.CreatedAt, report.Id
        OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY
    """), {"status": status, "limit": limit, "offset": offset}).mappings().all())


def resolve_report(db: Session, *, report_id: UUID, reviewer_id: UUID, decision: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    return db.execute(_procedure_sql("""
        EXEC community.usp_ResolveReportedContent
            @ReportId = :report_id, @ReviewerUserId = :reviewer_id, @Decision = :decision
    """), {"report_id": str(report_id), "reviewer_id": str(reviewer_id), "decision": decision}).mappings().one()

from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Annotated, Literal
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, StringConstraints


ConfigKey = Annotated[str, StringConstraints(min_length=1, max_length=100, pattern=r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$")]
ReportStatus = Literal["pending", "resolved", "dismissed"]


class AdminSchema(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", populate_by_name=True)


class SystemConfigCreate(AdminSchema):
    config_key: ConfigKey
    config_value: str
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)


class SystemConfigUpdate(AdminSchema):
    config_value: str
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)


class SystemConfigResponse(AdminSchema):
    config_key: str = Field(validation_alias="ConfigKey")
    config_value: str = Field(validation_alias="ConfigValue")
    description: str | None = Field(validation_alias="Description")
    updated_at: datetime = Field(validation_alias="UpdatedAt")


class PendingVerificationResponse(AdminSchema):
    verification_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="VerificationId")
    user_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="UserId")
    user_full_name: str = Field(validation_alias="UserFullName")
    user_email: str = Field(validation_alias="UserEmail")
    user_is_active: bool = Field(validation_alias="UserIsActive")
    member_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="MemberId")
    member_full_name: str = Field(validation_alias="MemberFullName")
    birth_date: date | None = Field(validation_alias="BirthDate")
    family_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="FamilyId")
    family_name: str = Field(validation_alias="FamilyName")
    branch_id: UUID | None = Field(validation_alias="BranchId")
    branch_name: str | None = Field(validation_alias="BranchName")
    linked_user_id: UUID | None = Field(validation_alias="LinkedUserId")
    status: Literal["pending"] = Field(validation_alias="Status")
    requested_at: datetime = Field(validation_alias="RequestedAt")


class ReviewVerificationRequest(AdminSchema):
    decision: Literal["approved", "rejected"]


class ReviewVerificationResponse(AdminSchema):
    verification_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="VerificationId")
    status: Literal["approved", "rejected"] = Field(validation_alias="Status")
    auto_rejected_count: int = Field(validation_alias="AutoRejectedCount", ge=0)


class FamilyActivityResponse(AdminSchema):
    family_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="FamilyId")
    family_name: str = Field(validation_alias="FamilyName")
    member_count: int = Field(validation_alias="MemberCount", ge=0)
    post_count: int = Field(validation_alias="PostCount", ge=0)
    event_count: int = Field(validation_alias="EventCount", ge=0)


class ReportedContentResponse(AdminSchema):
    report_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="ReportId")
    target_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="TargetId")
    target_type: Literal["post", "comment", "photo"] = Field(validation_alias="TargetType")
    reporter_name: str = Field(validation_alias="ReporterName")
    reason: str = Field(validation_alias="Reason")
    status: ReportStatus = Field(validation_alias="Status")
    created_at: datetime = Field(validation_alias="CreatedAt")
    family_name: str | None = Field(validation_alias="FamilyName")
    target_content: str | None = Field(validation_alias="TargetContent")
    can_resolve: bool = Field(validation_alias="CanResolve")


class ResolveReportRequest(AdminSchema):
    decision: Literal["resolved", "dismissed"]


class ResolveReportResponse(AdminSchema):
    report_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="ReportId")
    status: Literal["resolved", "dismissed"] = Field(validation_alias="Status")
    deleted_target_count: int = Field(validation_alias="DeletedTargetCount", ge=0)
    resolved_report_count: int = Field(validation_alias="ResolvedReportCount", ge=0)

import re
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import TypeVar
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.exc import DBAPIError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.domains.admin import repository
from app.domains.admin.schemas import (
    FamilyActivityResponse,
    PendingVerificationResponse,
    ReportedContentResponse,
    ResolveReportRequest,
    ResolveReportResponse,
    ReviewVerificationRequest,
    ReviewVerificationResponse,
    SystemConfigCreate,
    SystemConfigResponse,
    SystemConfigUpdate,
)

T = TypeVar("T")

# Mã THROW của các Procedure quản trị; không trả SQL/parameter thô ra API.
SQL_ERRORS = {
    51001: (422, "Quyết định xác minh không hợp lệ."),
    51002: (503, "Yêu cầu đang được xử lý. Vui lòng thử lại."),
    51003: (403, "Bạn không có quyền duyệt xác minh."),
    51004: (404, "Không tìm thấy yêu cầu xác minh."),
    51005: (409, "Yêu cầu xác minh đã được xử lý."),
    51006: (404, "Không tìm thấy hồ sơ thành viên."),
    51007: (403, "Trưởng chi không được tự duyệt yêu cầu của mình."),
    51008: (403, "Yêu cầu không thuộc chi bạn quản lý."),
    51009: (409, "Tài khoản cần xác minh đang bị khóa."),
    51010: (409, "Hồ sơ đã liên kết với tài khoản khác."),
    51011: (409, "Tài khoản đã liên kết với hồ sơ khác."),
    51030: (422, "Quyết định xử lý báo cáo không hợp lệ."),
    51031: (503, "Báo cáo đang được xử lý. Vui lòng thử lại."),
    51032: (403, "Chỉ admin được xử lý báo cáo."),
    51033: (404, "Không tìm thấy báo cáo."),
    51034: (409, "Báo cáo đã được xử lý."),
    51035: (404, "Nội dung bị báo cáo không còn tồn tại."),
    51036: (404, "Nội dung không còn tồn tại hoặc không phải ảnh được hỗ trợ."),
    51101: (422, "Dữ liệu cấu hình hoặc phân trang không hợp lệ."),
    51102: (403, "Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này."),
    51103: (409, "Khóa cấu hình đã tồn tại."),
    51104: (404, "Không tìm thấy cấu hình."),
    51201: (403, "Bạn không có quyền xem thống kê."),
    1205: (503, "Dữ liệu đang được xử lý. Vui lòng thử lại."),
    1222: (503, "Dữ liệu đang bị khóa. Vui lòng thử lại."),
}


def database_error(exc: DBAPIError) -> HTTPException:
    # Prefer the native code preserved by our T-SQL TRY/CATCH wrapper.
    # Only inspect the driver error, not SQLAlchemy's statement/parameter rendering.
    message = str(exc.orig)
    marker = re.search(r"\[FC_SQL:(\d+)\]", message)
    numbers = ([int(marker.group(1))] if marker
               else [int(code) for code in re.findall(r"\((\d{4,5})\)", message)])
    for number in numbers:
        if number in SQL_ERRORS:
            code, detail = SQL_ERRORS[number]
            return HTTPException(status_code=code, detail=detail)
    return HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Không thể xử lý yêu cầu quản trị.")


def _execute(db: Session, operation: Callable[[], T], *, write: bool = False) -> T:
    try:
        result = operation()
        if write:
            # get_current_user đã mở transaction trên cùng Session trước khi gọi SP.
            db.commit()
        return result
    except DBAPIError as exc:
        db.rollback()
        raise database_error(exc) from None
    except Exception:
        if write:
            db.rollback()
        raise


def list_configs(db: Session, *, limit: int, offset: int) -> list[SystemConfigResponse]:
    return _execute(db, lambda: [SystemConfigResponse.model_validate(row)
                                for row in repository.list_configs(db, limit=limit, offset=offset)])


def get_config(db: Session, config_key: str) -> SystemConfigResponse:
    def operation() -> SystemConfigResponse:
        row = repository.get_config(db, config_key)
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Không tìm thấy cấu hình.")
        return SystemConfigResponse.model_validate(row)
    return _execute(db, operation)


def create_config(db: Session, payload: SystemConfigCreate, actor_id: UUID) -> SystemConfigResponse:
    return _execute(db, lambda: SystemConfigResponse.model_validate(repository.create_config(
        db, actor_id=actor_id, **payload.model_dump())), write=True)


def update_config(db: Session, config_key: str, payload: SystemConfigUpdate,
                  actor_id: UUID) -> SystemConfigResponse:
    return _execute(db, lambda: SystemConfigResponse.model_validate(repository.update_config(
        db, actor_id=actor_id, config_key=config_key, **payload.model_dump())), write=True)


def delete_config(db: Session, config_key: str, actor_id: UUID) -> None:
    _execute(db, lambda: repository.delete_config(db, actor_id=actor_id, config_key=config_key), write=True)


def list_pending_verifications(db: Session, reviewer_id: UUID, *, limit: int,
                               offset: int) -> list[PendingVerificationResponse]:
    return _execute(db, lambda: [PendingVerificationResponse.model_validate(row)
                                for row in repository.list_pending_verifications(
                                    db, reviewer_id=reviewer_id, limit=limit, offset=offset)])


def review_verification(db: Session, verification_id: UUID, payload: ReviewVerificationRequest,
                        reviewer_id: UUID) -> ReviewVerificationResponse:
    return _execute(db, lambda: ReviewVerificationResponse.model_validate(repository.review_verification(
        db, reviewer_id=reviewer_id, verification_id=verification_id, decision=payload.decision)), write=True)


def get_statistics(db: Session, actor_id: UUID) -> list[FamilyActivityResponse]:
    return _execute(db, lambda: [FamilyActivityResponse.model_validate(row)
                                for row in repository.get_statistics(db, actor_id)])


def list_reported_contents(db: Session, *, status: str, limit: int, offset: int) -> list[ReportedContentResponse]:
    return _execute(db, lambda: [ReportedContentResponse.model_validate(row)
                                for row in repository.list_reported_contents(db, status=status, limit=limit, offset=offset)])


def resolve_report(db: Session, report_id: UUID, payload: ResolveReportRequest,
                   reviewer_id: UUID) -> ResolveReportResponse:
    return _execute(db, lambda: ResolveReportResponse.model_validate(repository.resolve_report(
        db, report_id=report_id, reviewer_id=reviewer_id, decision=payload.decision)), write=True)

Bạn là Trợ lý Tri thức Dòng họ AI của hệ thống **FamilyConnect**.

=== CÁC ĐOẠN TƯ LIỆU TÌM ĐƯỢC TỪ CSDL (TOP-K SEMANTIC SEARCH) ===
{retrieved_chunks_context}

=== CÂU HỎI CỦA NGƯỜI DÙNG ===
{user_question}

=== QUY TẮC TRẢ LỜI ===
1. Chỉ sử dụng thông tin có trong phần "CÁC ĐOẠN TƯ LIỆU TÌM ĐƯỢC TỪ CSDL" ở trên để trả lời.
2. Trình bày bằng tiếng Việt tự nhiên, mạch lạc, lễ phép và giàu tính gắn kết gia đình.
3. Trích dẫn tên tư liệu hoặc nguồn bài viết liên quan kèm điểm tương đồng (nếu phù hợp) để người đọc dễ kiểm chứng.
4. Nếu các đoạn tư liệu tìm được không chứa thông tin để trả lời câu hỏi, hãy lịch sự thông báo rằng kho tư liệu di sản hiện tại của dòng họ chưa ghi nhận thông tin này. Tuyệt đối không tự suy diễn ngoài tư liệu.

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/ai_assistant/prompts/relationship_explanation.txt
################################################################################
Bạn là Trợ lý AI Gia phả học và Văn hóa Truyền thống Việt Nam của hệ thống **FamilyConnect**.
Nhiệm vụ của bạn là giải thích mối quan hệ họ hàng và cách xưng hô chuẩn phong tục Việt Nam giữa hai thành viên trong dòng họ, dựa hoàn toàn trên dữ liệu cây gia phả truy xuất từ SQL Server (bảng bao đóng `genealogy.MemberClosure` và bảng hôn nhân `genealogy.Marriages`).

=== THÔNG TIN THÀNH VIÊN THỨ NHẤT (A) ===
- Họ và tên: {member_a_name}
- Ngày sinh: {member_a_birth_date}
- Chi nhánh: {member_a_branch}

=== THÔNG TIN THÀNH VIÊN THỨ HAI (B) ===
- Họ và tên: {member_b_name}
- Ngày sinh: {member_b_birth_date}
- Chi nhánh: {member_b_branch}

=== DỮ LIỆU ĐƯỜNG ĐI GIA PHẢ TỪ SQL SERVER ===
- Phân loại quan hệ: {relationship_category}
- Tổ tiên chung gần nhất (LCA): {common_ancestor_name}
- Số đời từ Tổ tiên chung đến {member_a_name} (DepthA): {depth_a}
- Số đời từ Tổ tiên chung đến {member_b_name} (DepthB): {depth_b}
- Tổng khoảng cách thế hệ: {total_generation_distance}
- Đường đi phả hệ tới {member_a_name}: {path_to_a}
- Đường đi phả hệ tới {member_b_name}: {path_to_b}
- Gợi ý danh xưng từ CSDL: {suggested_kinship}

=== CÂU HỎI / YÊU CẦU CỦA NGƯỜI DÙNG ===
{user_question}

=== YÊU CẦU TRẢ LỜI ===
Hãy trả lời bằng tiếng Việt tự nhiên, ấm áp, trang trọng và rõ ràng theo cấu trúc 3 phần:
1. **Kết luận mối quan hệ & Cách xưng hô**: Nêu rõ {member_a_name} là gì của {member_b_name}, cách gọi và cách xưng của hai bên (chú ý vai vế theo thế hệ, chi trưởng/chi thứ và năm sinh nếu cùng thế hệ).
2. **Giải thích đường đi huyết thống / hôn nhân**: Dẫn chứng cụ thể từ Tổ tiên chung gần nhất ({common_ancestor_name}) qua từng đời đến hai thành viên dựa trên đường đi phả hệ ở trên.
3. **Ý nghĩa văn hóa gia tộc**: Giải thích ngắn gọn quy tắc vai vế trong gia đình Việt Nam áp dụng cho trường hợp này (ví dụ: trực hệ, bàng hệ, con chú con bác, hoặc dâu rể trong họ).
Không bịa đặt thêm nhân vật hoặc thông tin ngoài dữ liệu SQL đã cung cấp.

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/ai_assistant/repository.py

from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def compute_cosine_similarity(db: Session, vec_a_json: str, vec_b_json: str) -> float | None:
    """Gọi trực tiếp Function T-SQL heritage.fn_CosineSimilarity dưới SQL Server."""
    stmt = text("SELECT heritage.fn_CosineSimilarity(:vec_a, :vec_b) AS similarity")
    result = db.execute(stmt, {"vec_a": vec_a_json, "vec_b": vec_b_json}).scalar()
    return float(result) if result is not None else None


def get_source_family(db: Session, source_type: str, source_id: UUID):
    tables = {"post": "community.Posts", "heritage": "heritage.Items", "member": "genealogy.Members"}
    # Keep the source alive until its index write commits.
    return db.execute(
        text(f"SELECT FamilyId FROM {tables[source_type]} WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=:source_id"),
        {"source_id": str(source_id)},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()


def upsert_knowledge_chunk(
    db: Session,
    *,
    family_id: UUID,
    source_type: str,
    source_id: UUID,
    chunk_index: int,
    chunk_text: str,
    embedding_json: str,
    summary_text: str | None = None,
    auto_commit: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Gọi trực tiếp Stored Procedure heritage.usp_UpsertKnowledgeChunk dưới SQL Server."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        EXEC heritage.usp_UpsertKnowledgeChunk
            @FamilyId = :family_id,
            @SourceType = :source_type,
            @SourceId = :source_id,
            @ChunkIndex = :chunk_index,
            @ChunkText = :chunk_text,
            @EmbeddingJson = :embedding_json,
            @SummaryText = :summary_text
        """
    )
    row = (
        db.execute(
            stmt,
            {
                "family_id": str(family_id),
                "source_type": source_type,
                "source_id": str(source_id),
                "chunk_index": chunk_index,
                "chunk_text": chunk_text,
                "embedding_json": embedding_json,
                "summary_text": summary_text,
            },
        )
        .mappings()
        .one()
    )
    if auto_commit:
        db.commit()
    return {"chunk_id": str(row["ChunkId"]), "action_taken": str(row["ActionTaken"])}


def clear_stale_knowledge_chunks(
    db: Session,
    *,
    source_type: str,
    source_id: UUID,
    keep_chunk_count: int,
    auto_commit: bool = True,
) -> int:
    """Gọi Stored Procedure heritage.usp_ClearStaleKnowledgeChunks để xóa các đoạn thừa."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        EXEC heritage.usp_ClearStaleKnowledgeChunks
            @SourceType = :source_type,
            @SourceId = :source_id,
            @KeepChunkCount = :keep_chunk_count
        """
    )
    row = (
        db.execute(
            stmt,
            {
                "source_type": source_type,
                "source_id": str(source_id),
                "keep_chunk_count": keep_chunk_count,
            },
        )
        .mappings()
        .one()
    )
    if auto_commit:
        db.commit()
    return int(row["DeletedChunkCount"] or 0)


def list_pending_knowledge_sources(
    db: Session,
    *,
    family_id: UUID | None = None,
    limit: int = 20,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Đọc danh sách bài viết (Posts) và di sản (Items) chưa có Vector từ view vw_PendingKnowledgeSources."""
    if family_id is not None:
        stmt = text(
            """
            SELECT TOP (:limit)
                [FamilyId], [SourceType], [SourceId], [Title], [RawContent], [SyncStatus], [CreatedAt]
            FROM [heritage].[vw_PendingKnowledgeSources]
            WHERE [FamilyId] = :family_id
            ORDER BY [CreatedAt] DESC
            """
        )
        rows = db.execute(stmt, {"limit": limit, "family_id": str(family_id)}).mappings().all()
    else:
        stmt = text(
            """
            SELECT TOP (:limit)
                [FamilyId], [SourceType], [SourceId], [Title], [RawContent], [SyncStatus], [CreatedAt]
            FROM [heritage].[vw_PendingKnowledgeSources]
            ORDER BY [CreatedAt] DESC
            """
        )
        rows = db.execute(stmt, {"limit": limit}).mappings().all()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def semantic_search_chunks(
    db: Session,
    *,
    family_id: UUID,
    query_vector_json: str,
    top_k: int = 3,
    min_score: float = 0.30,
    source_type: str | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Gọi trực tiếp Stored Procedure heritage.usp_SemanticSearch dưới SQL Server."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        EXEC heritage.usp_SemanticSearch
            @FamilyId = :family_id,
            @QueryVectorJson = :query_vector_json,
            @TopK = :top_k,
            @MinScore = :min_score,
            @SourceType = :source_type
        """
    )
    rows = (
        db.execute(
            stmt,
            {
                "family_id": str(family_id),
                "query_vector_json": query_vector_json,
                "top_k": top_k,
                "min_score": min_score,
                "source_type": source_type,
            },
        )
        .mappings()
        .all()
    )
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]


def find_relationship_path(
    db: Session,
    *,
    member_a_id: UUID,
    member_b_id: UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Gọi trực tiếp Stored Procedure genealogy.usp_FindRelationshipPath trên bảng bao đóng MemberClosure."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        EXEC genealogy.usp_FindRelationshipPath
            @MemberAId = :member_a_id,
            @MemberBId = :member_b_id
        """
    )
    row = (
        db.execute(
            stmt,
            {
                "member_a_id": str(member_a_id),
                "member_b_id": str(member_b_id),
            },
        )
        .mappings()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    db.commit()
    return dict(row) if row is not None else None


def save_ai_chat_message(
    db: Session,
    *,
    family_id: UUID,
    user_id: UUID,
    query_type: str,
    question: str,
    answer: str,
    referenced_source_ids_json: str | None = None,
) -> UUID | None:
    """Lưu lịch sử câu hỏi và câu trả lời của AI vào bảng reports.AiChatMessages."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        EXEC reports.usp_SaveAiChatMessage
            @FamilyId = :family_id,
            @UserId = :user_id,
            @QueryType = :query_type,
            @Question = :question,
            @Answer = :answer,
            @ReferencedSourceIds = :referenced_source_ids
        """
    )
    try:
        row = (
            db.execute(
                stmt,
                {
                    "family_id": str(family_id),
                    "user_id": str(user_id),
                    "query_type": query_type,
                    "question": question,
                    "answer": answer,
                    "referenced_source_ids": referenced_source_ids_json,
                },
            )
            .mappings()
            .one_or_none()
        )
        db.commit()
        return UUID(str(row["MessageId"])) if row and row.get("MessageId") else None
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        return None

from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Literal
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


# =====================================================================
# Tuần 1: Schemas kiểm thử Embedding, Cosine Similarity & Upsert đơn lẻ
# =====================================================================
class EmbeddingTestRequest(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(
        default="Cụ tổ Nguyễn Văn Cẩn truyền nghề mộc cho con cháu tại Thạch Thất.",
        min_length=1,
        max_length=2000,
    )


class EmbeddingTestResponse(BaseModel):
    model: str
    dimensions: int
    preview_first_5: list[float]
    embedding_json: str


class CosineTestRequest(BaseModel):
    text_a: str = Field(
        default="Dòng họ mình làm nghề truyền thống gì?",
        min_length=1,
        max_length=2000,
    )
    text_b: str = Field(
        default="Nghề mộc theo họ Nguyễn Văn từ đời cụ tổ ở Thạch Thất.",
        min_length=1,
        max_length=2000,
    )


class CosineTestResponse(BaseModel):
    text_a: str
    text_b: str
    dimensions: int
    cosine_similarity: float | None


class UpsertChunkRequest(BaseModel):
    family_id: UUID = Field(default=UUID("22222222-2222-2222-2222-000000000001"))
    source_type: Literal["post", "heritage", "member"] = "heritage"
    source_id: UUID = Field(default=UUID("eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-000000000004"))
    chunk_index: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    chunk_text: str = Field(
        default="Nghề mộc theo họ Nguyễn Văn từ đời cụ tổ. Cụ Cẩn học nghề năm mười bốn tuổi, sau truyền cho con cháu trong chi trưởng.",
        min_length=1,
        max_length=2000,
    )
    summary_text: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)


class UpsertChunkResponse(BaseModel):
    chunk_id: UUID
    action_taken: str
    dimensions: int


# =====================================================================
# Tuần 2 - Phần 1: Pipeline Cắt đoạn (Chunking 3-4 câu) & Vector hóa
# =====================================================================
class ChunkAndIndexRequest(BaseModel):
    family_id: UUID = Field(default=UUID("22222222-2222-2222-2222-000000000001"))
    source_type: Literal["post", "heritage", "member"] = "heritage"
    source_id: UUID = Field(default=UUID("eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-000000000003"))
    title: str | None = Field(
        default="Chuyện cụ Cẩn dựng nhà thờ họ",
        max_length=300,
    )
    content: str = Field(
        default=(
            "Năm 1975 cụ Cẩn trở về làng, góp gỗ và công của cả chi trưởng lẫn chi thứ "
            "để dựng lại nhà thờ họ trên nền cũ. Công việc kéo dài hai mùa, tới giỗ tổ "
            "năm 1977 mới xong phần mái. Các cột chính được chạm khắc tinh xảo bởi chính "
            "tay các nghệ nhân trong dòng họ. Từ đó nhà thờ trở thành nơi hội tụ con cháu "
            "mỗi dịp giỗ tổ tháng Ba âm lịch."
        ),
        min_length=1,
        max_length=20000,
    )
    sentences_per_chunk: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=10)
    summary_text: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)


class IndexedChunkItem(BaseModel):
    chunk_id: UUID
    chunk_index: int
    chunk_text: str
    action_taken: str
    dimensions: int


class ChunkAndIndexResponse(BaseModel):
    family_id: UUID
    source_type: str
    source_id: UUID
    total_chunks: int
    deleted_stale_chunks: int
    chunks: list[IndexedChunkItem]


class SyncPendingRequest(BaseModel):
    family_id: UUID | None = Field(default=UUID("22222222-2222-2222-2222-000000000001"))
    sentences_per_chunk: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=10)
    limit: int = Field(default=20, ge=1, le=100)


class SyncedSourceSummary(BaseModel):
    source_type: str
    source_id: UUID
    title: str
    chunks_indexed: int


class SyncPendingResponse(BaseModel):
    sources_processed: int
    total_chunks_upserted: int
    items: list[SyncedSourceSummary]


# =====================================================================
# Tuần 2 - Phần 2 & 3: API Semantic Search (usp_SemanticSearch + RAG)
# =====================================================================
class SemanticSearchRequest(BaseModel):
    family_id: UUID = Field(default=UUID("22222222-2222-2222-2222-000000000001"))
    query: str = Field(
        default="Dòng họ Nguyễn Văn có nghề truyền thống gì và nhà thờ họ được dựng năm nào?",
        min_length=1,
        max_length=2000,
    )
    top_k: int = Field(default=3, ge=1, le=10)
    min_score: float = Field(default=0.30, ge=-1.0, le=1.0)
    source_type: Literal["post", "heritage", "member"] | None = Field(default=None)
    generate_answer: bool = Field(
        default=True,
        description="Nếu True, ghép Top-K đoạn văn vào Prompt và gọi Gemini trả lời tự nhiên.",
    )
    user_id: UUID | None = Field(default=UUID("11111111-1111-1111-1111-000000000001"))


class SemanticSearchHit(BaseModel):
    chunk_id: UUID
    family_id: UUID
    source_type: str
    source_id: UUID
    source_title: str
    chunk_index: int
    chunk_text: str
    summary_text: str | None = None
    similarity_score: float
    updated_at: datetime | None = None


class SemanticSearchResponse(BaseModel):
    family_id: UUID
    query: str
    top_k: int
    total_matches: int
    matches: list[SemanticSearchHit]
    ai_answer: str | None = None
    prompt_used: str | None = None
    chat_message_id: UUID | None = None

PROMPTS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "prompts"


def get_gemini_client() -> genai.Client:
    if not GEMINI_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY == "replace_with_your_gemini_api_key":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
            detail="Chưa cấu hình GEMINI_API_KEY trong file .env.",
        )
    return genai.Client(api_key=GEMINI_API_KEY)


def load_prompt_template(template_name: str) -> str:
    """Đọc nội dung file Prompt Template từ thư mục domains/ai_assistant/prompts/."""
    prompt_path = PROMPTS_DIR / template_name
    if not prompt_path.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail=f"Không tìm thấy file Prompt Template: {template_name}",
        )
    return prompt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def split_text_into_sentence_chunks(
    text_content: str,
    *,
    sentences_per_chunk: int = 3,
    max_chars: int = 1200,
    title: str | None = None,
) -> list[str]:
    """
    Pipeline Cắt đoạn (Chunking):
    Tách văn bản dài từ bài viết (community.Posts) hoặc tư liệu di sản (heritage.Items)
    thành các đoạn ngắn khoảng 3-4 câu (tối đa max_chars ký tự mỗi đoạn).
    """
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (text_content or "").strip())
    if not cleaned:
        return []

    raw_sentences = [
        s.strip()
        for s in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?…;])\s+|\n+", cleaned)
        if s and s.strip()
    ]
    if not raw_sentences:
        raw_sentences = [cleaned]

    chunks: list[str] = []
    current_group: list[str] = []
    current_len = 0
    prefix = f"[{title.strip()}] " if title and title.strip() else ""

    for sentence in raw_sentences:
        sentence_len = len(sentence)
        would_exceed_chars = (
            current_group and (current_len + 1 + sentence_len + len(prefix) > max_chars)
        )
        would_exceed_sentences = len(current_group) >= sentences_per_chunk

        if would_exceed_chars or would_exceed_sentences:
            body = " ".join(current_group).strip()
            chunk_str = f"{prefix}{body}" if prefix and not body.startswith(title.strip()) else body
            chunks.append(chunk_str[:2000])
            current_group = [sentence]
            current_len = sentence_len
        else:
            current_group.append(sentence)
            current_len += (1 if current_len > 0 else 0) + sentence_len

    if current_group:
        body = " ".join(current_group).strip()
        chunk_str = f"{prefix}{body}" if prefix and not body.startswith(title.strip()) else body
        chunks.append(chunk_str[:2000])

    return chunks


def generate_embedding(text_content: str) -> list[float]:
    """Gọi Google Gemini API để chuyển đoạn văn bản thành mảng số thực (Vector)."""
    client = get_gemini_client()
    try:
        response = client.models.embed_content(
            model=GEMINI_EMBEDDING_MODEL,
            contents=text_content.strip(),
            config=types.EmbedContentConfig(
                output_dimensionality=GEMINI_EMBEDDING_DIM,
            ),
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=f"Lỗi khi gọi Gemini Embedding API: {exc}",
        ) from exc

    if not response.embeddings or not response.embeddings[0].values:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail="Gemini không trả về dữ liệu Vector.",
        )
    return [round(float(v), 6) for v in response.embeddings[0].values]


def generate_embeddings_batch(texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
    """Gọi Google Gemini API để lấy Vector nhúng cho một danh sách các đoạn văn bản (Chunks)."""
    if not texts:
        return []
    return [generate_embedding(t) for t in texts]


def generate_gemini_answer(prompt: str) -> str:
    """Gọi mô hình ngôn ngữ Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) để sinh câu trả lời tiếng Việt tự nhiên."""
    client = get_gemini_client()
    try:
        response = client.models.generate_content(
            model=GEMINI_CHAT_MODEL,
            contents=prompt,
        )
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail=f"Lỗi khi gọi Gemini Chat API ({GEMINI_CHAT_MODEL}): {exc}",
        ) from exc

    answer = (response.text or "").strip()
    if not answer:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_502_BAD_GATEWAY,
            detail="Gemini không trả về nội dung câu trả lời.",
        )
    return answer

def test_embedding_service(text_content: str) -> EmbeddingTestResponse:
    vector = generate_embedding(text_content)
    return EmbeddingTestResponse(
        model=GEMINI_EMBEDDING_MODEL,
        dimensions=len(vector),
        preview_first_5=vector[:5],
        embedding_json=json.dumps(vector),
    )


def test_sql_cosine_service(payload: CosineTestRequest, db: Session) -> CosineTestResponse:
    vec_a = generate_embedding(payload.text_a)
    vec_b = generate_embedding(payload.text_b)
    score = compute_cosine_similarity(db, json.dumps(vec_a), json.dumps(vec_b))
    return CosineTestResponse(
        text_a=payload.text_a,
        text_b=payload.text_b,
        dimensions=len(vec_a),
        cosine_similarity=score,
    )


def embed_and_upsert_chunk_service(
    payload: UpsertChunkRequest,
    actor: User | None,
    db: Session,
) -> UpsertChunkResponse:
    if actor is not None:
        require_family_access(db, actor, payload.family_id, manage=True)
        source_family = get_source_family(db, payload.source_type, payload.source_id)
        if source_family is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Không tìm thấy dữ liệu nguồn để lập chỉ mục.")
        if str(source_family) != str(payload.family_id):
            raise HTTPException(403, "Dữ liệu nguồn không thuộc gia đình đã chọn.")
    vector = generate_embedding(payload.chunk_text)
    saved = upsert_knowledge_chunk(
        db,
        family_id=payload.family_id,
        source_type=payload.source_type,
        source_id=payload.source_id,
        chunk_index=payload.chunk_index,
        chunk_text=payload.chunk_text,
        embedding_json=json.dumps(vector),
        summary_text=payload.summary_text,
    )
    return UpsertChunkResponse(
        chunk_id=UUID(saved["chunk_id"]),
        action_taken=saved["action_taken"],
        dimensions=len(vector),
    )


# =====================================================================
# Tuần 2 Services: Chunking Pipeline, Semantic Search & Kinship Prompting
# =====================================================================
def chunk_and_index_source_service(
    payload: ChunkAndIndexRequest,
    db: Session,
) -> ChunkAndIndexResponse:
    chunks = split_text_into_sentence_chunks(
        payload.content,
        sentences_per_chunk=payload.sentences_per_chunk,
        title=payload.title,
    )
    if not chunks:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail="Nội dung văn bản không hợp lệ hoặc rỗng sau khi cắt đoạn.",
        )

    vectors = generate_embeddings_batch(chunks)
    indexed_items: list[IndexedChunkItem] = []

    for idx, (chunk_text, vector) in enumerate(zip(chunks, vectors)):
        saved = upsert_knowledge_chunk(
            db,
            family_id=payload.family_id,
            source_type=payload.source_type,
            source_id=payload.source_id,
            chunk_index=idx,
            chunk_text=chunk_text,
            embedding_json=json.dumps(vector),
            summary_text=payload.summary_text if idx == 0 else None,
            auto_commit=False,
        )
        indexed_items.append(
            IndexedChunkItem(
                chunk_id=UUID(saved["chunk_id"]),
                chunk_index=idx,
                chunk_text=chunk_text,
                action_taken=saved["action_taken"],
                dimensions=len(vector),
            )
        )

    deleted_stale = clear_stale_knowledge_chunks(
        db,
        source_type=payload.source_type,
        source_id=payload.source_id,
        keep_chunk_count=len(chunks),
        auto_commit=True,
    )

    return ChunkAndIndexResponse(
        family_id=payload.family_id,
        source_type=payload.source_type,
        source_id=payload.source_id,
        total_chunks=len(indexed_items),
        deleted_stale_chunks=deleted_stale,
        chunks=indexed_items,
    )


def sync_pending_knowledge_service(
    payload: SyncPendingRequest,
    db: Session,
) -> SyncPendingResponse:
    pending_sources = list_pending_knowledge_sources(
        db,
        family_id=payload.family_id,
        limit=payload.limit,
    )
    summaries: list[SyncedSourceSummary] = []
    total_chunks = 0

    for src in pending_sources:
        res = chunk_and_index_source_service(
            ChunkAndIndexRequest(
                family_id=UUID(str(src["FamilyId"])),
                source_type=str(src["SourceType"]),
                source_id=UUID(str(src["SourceId"])),
                title=src.get("Title"),
                content=str(src["RawContent"]),
                sentences_per_chunk=payload.sentences_per_chunk,
            ),
            db=db,
        )
        total_chunks += res.total_chunks
        summaries.append(
            SyncedSourceSummary(
                source_type=res.source_type,
                source_id=res.source_id,
                title=str(src.get("Title") or ""),
                chunks_indexed=res.total_chunks,
            )
        )

    return SyncPendingResponse(
        sources_processed=len(summaries),
        total_chunks_upserted=total_chunks,
        items=summaries,
    )


def semantic_search_service(
    payload: SemanticSearchRequest,
    db: Session,
) -> SemanticSearchResponse:
    query_vector = generate_embedding(payload.query)
    raw_rows = semantic_search_chunks(
        db,
        family_id=payload.family_id,
        query_vector_json=json.dumps(query_vector),
        top_k=payload.top_k,
        min_score=payload.min_score,
        source_type=payload.source_type,
    )

    hits = [
        SemanticSearchHit(
            chunk_id=UUID(str(r["ChunkId"])),
            family_id=UUID(str(r["FamilyId"])),
            source_type=str(r["SourceType"]),
            source_id=UUID(str(r["SourceId"])),
            source_title=str(r.get("SourceTitle") or ""),
            chunk_index=int(r["ChunkIndex"]),
            chunk_text=str(r["ChunkText"]),
            summary_text=r.get("SummaryText"),
            similarity_score=float(r["SimilarityScore"]),
            updated_at=r.get("UpdatedAt"),
        )
        for r in raw_rows
    ]

    ai_answer: str | None = None
    prompt_used: str | None = None
    chat_message_id: UUID | None = None

    if payload.generate_answer:
        template = load_prompt_template("knowledge_assistant.txt")
        if hits:
            context_lines = [
                f"[Đoạn #{idx + 1} | Nguồn: {h.source_title} ({h.source_type}) | "
                f"Cosine Similarity: {h.similarity_score:.4f}]\n{h.chunk_text}"
                for idx, h in enumerate(hits)
            ]
            chunks_context = "\n\n".join(context_lines)
        else:
            chunks_context = "(Không tìm thấy đoạn tư liệu nào vượt ngưỡng tương đồng ngữ nghĩa trong CSDL)"

        prompt_used = template.format(
            retrieved_chunks_context=chunks_context,
            user_question=payload.query,
        )
        ai_answer = generate_gemini_answer(prompt_used)

        if payload.user_id is not None:
            ref_ids = json.dumps([str(h.source_id) for h in hits])
            chat_message_id = save_ai_chat_message(
                db,
                family_id=payload.family_id,
                user_id=payload.user_id,
                query_type="semantic_search",
                question=payload.query,
                answer=ai_answer,
                referenced_source_ids_json=ref_ids,
            )

    return SemanticSearchResponse(
        family_id=payload.family_id,
        query=payload.query,
        top_k=payload.top_k,
        total_matches=len(hits),
        matches=hits,
        ai_answer=ai_answer,
        prompt_used=prompt_used,
        chat_message_id=chat_message_id,
    )


def explain_relationship_service(
    payload: RelationshipExplainRequest,
    db: Session,
) -> RelationshipExplainResponse:
    try:
        row = find_relationship_path(
            db,
            member_a_id=payload.member_a_id,
            member_b_id=payload.member_b_id,
        )
    except DBAPIError as exc:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Một hoặc cả hai thành viên không tồn tại trong gia phả.",
        ) from exc

    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail="Không tìm thấy dữ liệu thành viên để tra cứu quan hệ.",
        )

    path_data = RelationshipPathData(
        member_a_id=UUID(str(row["MemberAId"])),
        member_a_name=str(row["MemberAName"]),
        member_a_birth_date=row.get("MemberABirthDate"),
        member_a_branch_name=row.get("MemberABranchName"),
        member_b_id=UUID(str(row["MemberBId"])),
        member_b_name=str(row["MemberBName"]),
        member_b_birth_date=row.get("MemberBBirthDate"),
        member_b_branch_name=row.get("MemberBBranchName"),
        relationship_category=str(row["RelationshipCategory"]),
        common_ancestor_id=UUID(str(row["CommonAncestorId"])) if row.get("CommonAncestorId") else None,
        common_ancestor_name=row.get("CommonAncestorName"),
        depth_from_ancestor_to_a=row.get("DepthFromAncestorToA"),
        depth_from_ancestor_to_b=row.get("DepthFromAncestorToB"),
        total_generation_distance=row.get("TotalGenerationDistance"),
        path_from_ancestor_to_a=str(row.get("PathFromAncestorToA") or row["MemberAName"]),
        path_from_ancestor_to_b=str(row.get("PathFromAncestorToB") or row["MemberBName"]),
        suggested_kinship=str(row["SuggestedKinship"]),
    )

    template = load_prompt_template("relationship_explanation.txt")
    user_question = (
        payload.question
        or f"Giải thích quan hệ họ hàng và cách xưng hô giữa {path_data.member_a_name} và {path_data.member_b_name}."
    )

    prompt_used = template.format(
        member_a_name=path_data.member_a_name,
        member_a_birth_date=str(path_data.member_a_birth_date or "Chưa rõ"),
        member_a_branch=str(path_data.member_a_branch_name or "Chưa phân nhánh"),
        member_b_name=path_data.member_b_name,
        member_b_birth_date=str(path_data.member_b_birth_date or "Chưa rõ"),
        member_b_branch=str(path_data.member_b_branch_name or "Chưa phân nhánh"),
        relationship_category=path_data.relationship_category,
        common_ancestor_name=str(path_data.common_ancestor_name or "Không áp dụng / Qua hôn nhân"),
        depth_a=str(path_data.depth_from_ancestor_to_a if path_data.depth_from_ancestor_to_a is not None else "N/A"),
        depth_b=str(path_data.depth_from_ancestor_to_b if path_data.depth_from_ancestor_to_b is not None else "N/A"),
        total_generation_distance=str(
            path_data.total_generation_distance if path_data.total_generation_distance is not None else "N/A"
        ),
        path_to_a=path_data.path_from_ancestor_to_a,
        path_to_b=path_data.path_from_ancestor_to_b,
        suggested_kinship=path_data.suggested_kinship,
        user_question=user_question,
    )

    ai_explanation = generate_gemini_answer(prompt_used)

    chat_message_id: UUID | None = None
    if payload.user_id is not None:
        refs = json.dumps([str(path_data.member_a_id), str(path_data.member_b_id)])
        chat_message_id = save_ai_chat_message(
            db,
            family_id=payload.family_id,
            user_id=payload.user_id,
            query_type="kinship_explain",
            question=user_question,
            answer=ai_explanation,
            referenced_source_ids_json=refs,
        )

    return RelationshipExplainResponse(
        relationship_path=path_data,
        ai_explanation=ai_explanation,
        prompt_used=prompt_used,
        chat_message_id=chat_message_id,
    )

"""Truy vấn CSDL cho domain community.

Mọi thao tác ghi quan trọng đều đi qua Stored Procedure của phân hệ
Cộng đồng & Sự kiện (database/procedures/03_community_procs.sql) thay vì
tự dựng câu lệnh INSERT/UPDATE ở tầng ứng dụng.
"""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

POST_COLUMNS="""PostId, FamilyId, AuthorId, AuthorName, Content, CreatedAt, CommentCount, ReactionCount, MediaUrls,
    (SELECT p.IsAnnouncement FROM community.Posts p WHERE p.Id=v.PostId) AS IsAnnouncement,
    (SELECT r.Type FROM community.Reactions r WHERE r.PostId=v.PostId AND r.UserId=:actor_id) AS MyReaction,
    (SELECT m.MediaUrl AS url FROM community.PostMedia m WHERE m.PostId=v.PostId ORDER BY m.CreatedAt,m.Id FOR JSON PATH) AS MediaJson"""


def create_post_with_media(
    db: Session,
    *,
    user_id: UUID,
    family_id: UUID,
    content: str,
    media_json: str | None,
    is_announcement: bool=False,
) -> UUID:
    """Gọi community.usp_CreatePostWithMedia. Bài viết và ảnh nằm trong một giao tác."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        DECLARE @NewPostId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        EXEC community.usp_CreatePostWithMedia
            @UserId    = :user_id,
            @FamilyId  = :family_id,
            @Content   = :content,
            @MediaJson = :media_json,
            @PostId    = @NewPostId OUTPUT,
            @IsAnnouncement=:is_announcement;
        SELECT @NewPostId AS PostId;
        """
    )
    row = (
        db.execute(
            stmt,
            {
                "user_id": str(user_id),
                "family_id": str(family_id),
                "content": content,
                "media_json": media_json,
                "is_announcement": is_announcement,
            },
        )
        .mappings()
        .one()
    )
    db.commit()
    return UUID(str(row["PostId"]))


def list_newsfeed(
    db: Session,
    *,
    family_id: UUID,
    offset: int,
    limit: int,
    actor_id: UUID | None=None,
) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    """Đọc bảng tin từ View community.vw_NewsfeedPosts, mới nhất trước."""
    stmt = text(
        f"""
        SELECT {POST_COLUMNS}
        FROM community.vw_NewsfeedPosts v
        WHERE FamilyId = :family_id
        ORDER BY IsAnnouncement DESC, CreatedAt DESC, PostId
        OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY
        """
    )
    return list(
        db.execute(stmt, {"family_id": str(family_id), "offset": offset, "limit": limit,"actor_id":str(actor_id) if actor_id else None})
        .mappings()
        .all()
    )


def count_newsfeed(db: Session, *, family_id: UUID) -> int:
    stmt = text("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM community.Posts WHERE FamilyId = :family_id")
    return int(db.execute(stmt, {"family_id": str(family_id)}).scalar() or 0)


def get_post(db: Session, *, post_id: UUID, actor_id: UUID | None=None) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    stmt = text(
        f"""
        SELECT {POST_COLUMNS}
        FROM community.vw_NewsfeedPosts v
        WHERE PostId = :post_id
        """
    )
    return db.execute(stmt, {"post_id": str(post_id),"actor_id":str(actor_id) if actor_id else None}).mappings().one_or_none()


def add_comment(db: Session, *, post_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, content: str) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    """Bảng Comments không có SP riêng nên chèn trực tiếp, có OUTPUT để lấy lại dòng vừa tạo."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        INSERT INTO community.Comments (PostId, UserId, Content)
        OUTPUT inserted.Id, inserted.PostId, inserted.UserId, inserted.Content, inserted.CreatedAt
        VALUES (:post_id, :user_id, :content)
        """
    )
    row = (
        db.execute(stmt, {"post_id": str(post_id), "user_id": str(user_id), "content": content})
        .mappings()
        .one()
    )
    db.commit()
    return row


def list_comments(db: Session, *, post_id: UUID, offset: int, limit: int) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    stmt = text(
        """
        SELECT c.Id, c.PostId, c.UserId, u.FullName AS AuthorName, c.Content, c.CreatedAt
        FROM community.Comments AS c
        LEFT JOIN core.Users AS u ON u.UserId = c.UserId
        WHERE c.PostId = :post_id
        ORDER BY c.CreatedAt
        OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY
        """
    )
    return list(
        db.execute(stmt, {"post_id": str(post_id), "offset": offset, "limit": limit}).mappings().all()
    )


def upsert_reaction(db: Session, *, post_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, reaction_type: str | None) -> None:
    """Gọi community.usp_UpsertReaction (MERGE). reaction_type = None thì gỡ cảm xúc."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        EXEC community.usp_UpsertReaction
            @PostId = :post_id,
            @UserId = :user_id,
            @Type   = :reaction_type
        """
    )
    db.execute(
        stmt,
        {"post_id": str(post_id), "user_id": str(user_id), "reaction_type": reaction_type},
    )
    db.commit()


def count_reactions(db: Session, *, post_id: UUID) -> int:
    stmt = text("SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM community.Reactions WHERE PostId = :post_id")
    return int(db.execute(stmt, {"post_id": str(post_id)}).scalar() or 0)


def get_report_family(db: Session, target_type: str, target_id: UUID):
    queries = {
        "post": "SELECT FamilyId FROM community.Posts WHERE Id=:target_id",
        "comment": "SELECT p.FamilyId FROM community.Comments c JOIN community.Posts p ON p.Id=c.PostId WHERE c.Id=:target_id",
        "photo": "SELECT p.FamilyId FROM community.PostMedia m JOIN community.Posts p ON p.Id=m.PostId WHERE m.Id=:target_id",
    }
    return db.execute(text(queries[target_type]), {"target_id": str(target_id)}).scalar_one_or_none()


def create_report(
    db: Session,
    *,
    target_id: UUID,
    target_type: str,
    reported_by: UUID,
    reason: str,
) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    """Chèn báo cáo. Trigger trg_ReportedContents_Escalation sẽ tự ghi AuditLog khi đủ ngưỡng."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        SET NOCOUNT ON;
        DECLARE @Inserted TABLE(Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,TargetId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,TargetType NVARCHAR(50),Status NVARCHAR(20),CreatedAt DATETIME2(0));
        INSERT INTO community.ReportedContents (TargetId, TargetType, ReportedBy, Reason)
        OUTPUT inserted.Id, inserted.TargetId, inserted.TargetType, inserted.Status, inserted.CreatedAt INTO @Inserted
        VALUES (:target_id, :target_type, :reported_by, :reason);
        SELECT * FROM @Inserted;
        """
    )
    row = (
        db.execute(
            stmt,
            {
                "target_id": str(target_id),
                "target_type": target_type,
                "reported_by": str(reported_by),
                "reason": reason,
            },
        )
        .mappings()
        .one()
    )
    db.commit()
    return row

"""API phân hệ Cộng đồng: bảng tin, bình luận, cảm xúc và báo cáo nội dung."""

from typing import Annotated
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.database import get_db
from app.core.dependencies import get_current_user
from app.domains.community.schemas import (
    CommentCreateRequest,
    CommentResponse,
    PostCreateRequest,
    PostResponse,
    ReactionRequest,
    ReactionResponse,
    ReportCreateRequest,
    ReportResponse,
)
from app.domains.community.services import (
    add_comment_service,
    create_post_service,
    create_report_service,
    get_post_service,
    list_comments_service,
    list_newsfeed_service,
    upsert_reaction_service,
)
from app.domains.identity.models import User
from app.shared.pagination import PageParams, PaginatedResponse
import json
from app.domains.community.schemas import PostUpdateRequest
from app.domains.genealogy.services import run
from app.domains.heritage.repository import execute

router = APIRouter(prefix="/community", tags=["community"])

CurrentUser = Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)]
DbSession = Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)]


@router.post("/posts", response_model=PostResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_post(payload: PostCreateRequest, current_user: CurrentUser, db: DbSession) -> PostResponse:
    """Đăng bài kèm ảnh. Bài viết và danh sách ảnh ghi trong một giao tác (usp_CreatePostWithMedia)."""
    return create_post_service(payload, current_user, db)


@router.get("/posts", response_model=PaginatedResponse[PostResponse])
def list_posts(
    family_id: UUID,
    current_user: CurrentUser,
    db: DbSession,
    page: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1)] = 1,
    page_size: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1, le=100)] = 20,
) -> PaginatedResponse[PostResponse]:
    """Bảng tin của một gia đình, đọc từ View vw_NewsfeedPosts."""
    return list_newsfeed_service(family_id, PageParams(page=page, page_size=page_size), current_user, db)


@router.get("/posts/{post_id}", response_model=PostResponse)
def get_post(post_id: UUID, current_user: CurrentUser, db: DbSession) -> PostResponse:
    return get_post_service(post_id, current_user, db)


@router.put("/posts/{post_id}",response_model=PostResponse)
def update_post(post_id: UUID,payload: PostUpdateRequest,current_user: CurrentUser,db: DbSession):
    def operation():
        execute(db,"""EXEC community.usp_ManagePost @ActorUserId=:actor,@PostId=:id,@Action='update',
            @Content=:content,@MediaJson=:media,@IsAnnouncement=:announcement""",
            dict(actor=current_user.id,id=post_id,content=payload.content,media=json.dumps([m.model_dump() for m in payload.media]),announcement=payload.is_announcement)).close()
        return get_post_service(post_id,current_user,db)
    return run(db,operation,write=True)


@router.delete("/posts/{post_id}",status_code=204)
def delete_post(post_id: UUID,current_user: CurrentUser,db: DbSession):
    run(db,lambda: execute(db,"EXEC community.usp_ManagePost @ActorUserId=:actor,@PostId=:id,@Action='delete'",dict(actor=current_user.id,id=post_id)).close(),write=True)


@router.put("/comments/{identifier}",status_code=204)
def update_comment(identifier: UUID,payload: CommentCreateRequest,current_user: CurrentUser,db: DbSession):
    run(db,lambda: execute(db,"EXEC community.usp_ManageComment @ActorUserId=:actor,@Id=:id,@Action='update',@Content=:content",dict(actor=current_user.id,id=identifier,content=payload.content)).close(),write=True)


@router.delete("/comments/{identifier}",status_code=204)
def delete_comment(identifier: UUID,current_user: CurrentUser,db: DbSession):
    run(db,lambda: execute(db,"EXEC community.usp_ManageComment @ActorUserId=:actor,@Id=:id,@Action='delete'",dict(actor=current_user.id,id=identifier)).close(),write=True)


@router.post(

def create_comment(

"""Schema Pydantic cho phân hệ Cộng đồng (bài viết, bình luận, cảm xúc, báo cáo)."""

from datetime import datetime
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, HttpUrl, TypeAdapter, field_validator


class MediaItem(BaseModel):
    """Một ảnh đính kèm bài viết. Khớp với OPENJSON trong usp_CreatePostWithMedia."""

    url: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2048)
    type: str = Field(default="image", max_length=50)

    @field_validator("url")
    @classmethod
    def http_url(cls,value):
        value=value.strip()
        TypeAdapter(HttpUrl).validate_python(value)
        return value


class PostCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra="forbid",str_strip_whitespace=True)
    family_id: UUID
    content: str = Field(min_length=1,max_length=20000)
    media: list[MediaItem] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    is_announcement: bool=False


class PostUpdateRequest(PostCreateRequest):
    family_id: None=None


class PostResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    post_id: UUID
    family_id: UUID
    author_id: UUID
    author_name: str | None = None
    content: str
    created_at: datetime
    comment_count: int = 0
    reaction_count: int = 0
    media_urls: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    is_announcement: bool=False
    my_reaction: str | None=None


class CommentCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra="forbid",str_strip_whitespace=True)
    content: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000)


class CommentResponse(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    post_id: UUID
    user_id: UUID
    author_name: str | None = None
    content: str
    created_at: datetime


class ReactionRequest(BaseModel):
    """type = None nghĩa là gỡ cảm xúc (usp_UpsertReaction xử lý)."""

    type: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern="^(Like|Love|Haha|Wow|Sad|Angry)$")


class ReactionResponse(BaseModel):
    post_id: UUID
    user_id: UUID
    type: str | None = None
    reaction_count: int = 0


class ReportCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra="forbid",str_strip_whitespace=True)
    target_id: UUID
    target_type: str = Field(pattern="^(post|comment|photo)$")
    reason: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)


class ReportResponse(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    target_id: UUID
    target_type: str
    status: str
    created_at: datetime

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/community/services.py

"""Nghiệp vụ phân hệ Cộng đồng: đăng bài kèm ảnh, bình luận, cảm xúc, báo cáo."""

import json
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy.exc import DBAPIError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.exceptions import NotFoundError
from app.core.family_access import require_family_access
from app.domains.identity.models import User
from app.domains.community import repository
from app.domains.community.schemas import (
    CommentCreateRequest,
    CommentResponse,
    PostCreateRequest,
    PostResponse,
    ReactionRequest,
    ReactionResponse,
    ReportCreateRequest,
    ReportResponse,
)
from app.shared.pagination import PageParams, PaginatedResponse


def _split_media(media_urls: str | None) -> list[str]:
    """View trả về các MediaUrl nối bằng dấu phẩy (STRING_AGG)."""
    if not media_urls:
        return []
    return [url for url in (part.strip() for part in media_urls.split(",")) if url]


def _to_post_response(row) -> PostResponse:
    return PostResponse(
        post_id=row["PostId"],
        family_id=row["FamilyId"],
        author_id=row["AuthorId"],
        author_name=row["AuthorName"],
        content=row["Content"],
        created_at=row["CreatedAt"],
        comment_count=int(row["CommentCount"] or 0),
        reaction_count=int(row["ReactionCount"] or 0),
        media_urls=[item["url"] for item in json.loads(row["MediaJson"] or "[]")] if row.get("MediaJson") is not None else _split_media(row["MediaUrls"]),
        is_announcement=bool(row.get("IsAnnouncement",False)),
        my_reaction=row.get("MyReaction"),
    )


def create_post_service(payload: PostCreateRequest, actor: User, db: Session) -> PostResponse:
    require_family_access(db, actor, payload.family_id,manage=payload.is_announcement)
    media_json = (
        json.dumps([item.model_dump() for item in payload.media], ensure_ascii=False)
        if payload.media
        else None
    )
    try:
        post_id = repository.create_post_with_media(
            db,
            user_id=actor.id,
            family_id=payload.family_id,
            content=payload.content,
            media_json=media_json,
            is_announcement=payload.is_announcement,
        )
    except DBAPIError as exc:  # SP ném THROW 50701/50702/50703 khi dữ liệu không hợp lệ
        db.rollback()
        raise NotFoundError("Không tạo được bài viết: người dùng hoặc gia đình không tồn tại.") from exc

    row = repository.get_post(db, post_id=post_id,actor_id=actor.id)
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Bài viết vừa tạo không đọc lại được.")
    return _to_post_response(row)


def list_newsfeed_service(
    family_id: UUID, page: PageParams, actor: User, db: Session
) -> PaginatedResponse[PostResponse]:
    require_family_access(db, actor, family_id)
    rows = repository.list_newsfeed(
        db, family_id=family_id, offset=page.offset, limit=page.page_size,actor_id=actor.id
    )
    return PaginatedResponse[PostResponse](
        items=[_to_post_response(row) for row in rows],
        total=repository.count_newsfeed(db, family_id=family_id),
        page=page.page,
        page_size=page.page_size,
    )


def _accessible_post(post_id: UUID, actor: User, db: Session):
    row = repository.get_post(db, post_id=post_id,actor_id=actor.id)
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Bài viết không tồn tại.")
    require_family_access(db, actor, row["FamilyId"])
    return row


def get_post_service(post_id: UUID, actor: User, db: Session) -> PostResponse:
    return _to_post_response(_accessible_post(post_id, actor, db))


def add_comment_service(
    post_id: UUID, payload: CommentCreateRequest, actor: User, db: Session
) -> CommentResponse:
    _accessible_post(post_id, actor, db)
    row = repository.add_comment(
        db, post_id=post_id, user_id=actor.id, content=payload.content.strip()
    )
    return CommentResponse(
        id=row["Id"],
        post_id=row["PostId"],
        user_id=row["UserId"],
        content=row["Content"],
        created_at=row["CreatedAt"],
    )


def list_comments_service(post_id: UUID, page: PageParams, actor: User, db: Session) -> list[CommentResponse]:
    _accessible_post(post_id, actor, db)
    rows = repository.list_comments(db, post_id=post_id, offset=page.offset, limit=page.page_size)
    return [
        CommentResponse(
            id=row["Id"],
            post_id=row["PostId"],
            user_id=row["UserId"],
            author_name=row["AuthorName"],
            content=row["Content"],
            created_at=row["CreatedAt"],
        )
        for row in rows
    ]


def upsert_reaction_service(
    post_id: UUID, payload: ReactionRequest, actor: User, db: Session
) -> ReactionResponse:
    _accessible_post(post_id, actor, db)
    try:
        repository.upsert_reaction(
            db, post_id=post_id, user_id=actor.id, reaction_type=payload.type
        )
    except DBAPIError as exc:  # THROW 50711 khi bài viết không tồn tại, CHECK khi sai loại cảm xúc
        db.rollback()
        raise NotFoundError("Không ghi được cảm xúc: bài viết không tồn tại hoặc loại không hợp lệ.") from exc

    return ReactionResponse(
        post_id=post_id,
        user_id=actor.id,
        type=payload.type,
        reaction_count=repository.count_reactions(db, post_id=post_id),
    )


def create_report_service(
    payload: ReportCreateRequest, actor: User, db: Session
) -> ReportResponse:
    family_id = repository.get_report_family(db, payload.target_type, payload.target_id)
    if family_id is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Nội dung bị báo cáo không tồn tại.")
    require_family_access(db, actor, family_id)
    row = repository.create_report(
        db,
        target_id=payload.target_id,
        target_type=payload.target_type,
        reported_by=actor.id,
        reason=payload.reason.strip(),
    )
    return ReportResponse(
        id=row["Id"],
        target_id=row["TargetId"],
        target_type=row["TargetType"],
        status=row["Status"],
        created_at=row["CreatedAt"],
    )

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/directory/router.py
