from datetime import date
from typing import Annotated, Literal
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.dependencies import get_current_user, get_db
from app.domains.genealogy.repository import rows, scope
from app.domains.genealogy.services import run
from app.domains.heritage.repository import assert_access, execute
from app.domains.identity.models import User

router=APIRouter(prefix="/directory",tags=["directory"])
DB=Annotated[Session,Depends(get_db)]
Actor=Annotated[User,Depends(get_current_user)]
Resource=Literal["educations","work"]


class HistoryFields(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra="forbid",str_strip_whitespace=True)
    institution: str | None=Field(default=None,max_length=200)
    degree: str | None=Field(default=None,max_length=200)
    company: str | None=Field(default=None,max_length=200)
    position: str | None=Field(default=None,max_length=200)
    start_date: date | None=None
    end_date: date | None=None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def dates(self):
        if self.start_date and self.end_date and self.end_date<self.start_date:
            raise ValueError("Ngày kết thúc phải sau ngày bắt đầu.")
        return self


@router.get("")
def search(family_id: UUID,db: DB,actor: Actor,q: str=Query(default="",max_length=200),
           occupation: str=Query(default="",max_length=200),education: str=Query(default="",max_length=200),
           location: str=Query(default="",max_length=300),branch_id: UUID | None=None,
           generation: int | None=Query(default=None,ge=1,le=1000),current_job: bool=False,
           page: int=Query(default=1,ge=1),page_size: int=Query(default=12,ge=1,le=200)):
    def operation():
        assert_access(db,actor.id,family_id)
        params=dict(family=family_id,q=q,occupation=occupation,education=education,location=location,
                    branch=branch_id,generation=generation,current=current_job,page=page,limit=page_size)
        statement="""EXEC genealogy.usp_SearchDirectory @FamilyId=:family,@Keyword=:q,
            @Occupation=:occupation,@Education=:education,@Location=:location,@BranchId=:branch,
            @Generation=:generation,@OnlyCurrentJob=:current,@PageNumber=:page,@PageSize=:limit"""
        result=rows(db,statement,**params)
        total=result[0]["TotalCount"] if result else 0
        if not result and page>1:
            first=rows(db,statement,**dict(params,page=1,limit=1))
            total=first[0]["TotalCount"] if first else 0
        names=dict(Id="id",FullName="name",BirthDate="birth_date",Location="location",FamilyId="family_id",
                   BranchId="branch_id",Generation="generation",LatestPosition="position",LatestCompany="company",
                   LatestInstitution="institution",LatestDegree="degree")
        return dict(items=[{alias:row[key] for key,alias in names.items()} for row in result],total=total,page=page,page_size=page_size)
    return run(db,operation)


@router.get("/{member_id}")
def detail(member_id: UUID,family_id: UUID,db: DB,actor: Actor):
    def operation():
        assert_access(db,actor.id,family_id)
        found=rows(db,"""SELECT m.Id AS id,m.FullName AS name,m.BirthDate AS birth_date,m.Location AS location,
            m.BranchId AS branch_id,m.UserId AS user_id,b.Name AS branch_name
            FROM genealogy.Members m LEFT JOIN core.Branches b ON b.Id=m.BranchId
            WHERE m.Id=:id AND m.FamilyId=:family""",id=member_id,family=family_id)
        if not found: raise HTTPException(404,"Không tìm thấy thành viên trong gia đình này.")
        member=found[0]
        own_scope=scope(db,actor.id,family_id)
        member["can_edit"]=own_scope["Role"]=="admin" or str(member["user_id"])==str(actor.id) or (
            own_scope["Role"]=="family_head" and own_scope["BranchId"] is not None and member["branch_id"]==own_scope["BranchId"])
        member.pop("user_id")
        member["educations"]=rows(db,"""SELECT Id AS id,Institution AS institution,Degree AS degree,StartDate AS start_date,EndDate AS end_date
            FROM genealogy.Educations WHERE MemberId=:id ORDER BY StartDate DESC,Id""",id=member_id)
        member["work"]=rows(db,"""SELECT Id AS id,Company AS company,Position AS position,StartDate AS start_date,EndDate AS end_date
            FROM genealogy.WorkHistories WHERE MemberId=:id ORDER BY StartDate DESC,Id""",id=member_id)
        return member
    return run(db,operation)


def save_history(db,actor,member_id,resource,action,identifier=None,payload=None):
    values=payload.model_dump() if payload else {}
    names=dict(institution="Institution",degree="Degree",company="Company",position="Position",start_date="StartDate",end_date="EndDate")
    statement="EXEC genealogy.usp_ManageHistory @ActorUserId=:actor,@MemberId=:member,@Resource=:resource,@Action=:action,@Id=:id"
    statement+="".join(f",@{names[key]}=:{key}" for key in values)
    return run(db,lambda: dict(execute(db,statement,dict(actor=actor.id,member=member_id,resource=resource,action=action,id=identifier,**values)).mappings().one()),write=True)


@router.post("/{member_id}/{resource}",status_code=201)
def create(member_id: UUID,resource: Resource,payload: HistoryFields,db: DB,actor: Actor):
    return save_history(db,actor,member_id,resource,"create",payload=payload)


@router.put("/{member_id}/{resource}/{identifier}")
def update(member_id: UUID,resource: Resource,identifier: UUID,payload: HistoryFields,db: DB,actor: Actor):
    return save_history(db,actor,member_id,resource,"update",identifier,payload)


@router.delete("/{member_id}/{resource}/{identifier}",status_code=204)
def remove(member_id: UUID,resource: Resource,identifier: UUID,db: DB,actor: Actor):
    save_history(db,actor,member_id,resource,"delete",identifier)

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/events/repository.py

"""Truy vấn CSDL cho domain events.

Lịch tháng đọc qua Function community.fn_GetMonthlyEvents, RSVP ghi qua
Stored Procedure community.usp_UpsertEventRsvp.
"""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def list_monthly_events(
    db: Session, *, family_id: UUID, year: int, month: int,tz_offset: int=0
) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    """Gọi Function community.fn_GetMonthlyEvents để dựng lịch tháng."""
    if tz_offset:
        stmt=text("""SELECT e.Id AS EventId,e.FamilyId,e.Title,e.EventDate,e.Location,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community.EventParticipants p WHERE p.EventId=e.Id AND p.RsvpStatus='Going') AS GoingCount
            FROM community.Events e WHERE FamilyId=:family_id
            AND EventDate>=DATEADD(MINUTE,-:tz_offset,CAST(DATEFROMPARTS(:year,:month,1) AS DATETIME2))
            AND EventDate<DATEADD(MINUTE,-:tz_offset,DATEADD(MONTH,1,CAST(DATEFROMPARTS(:year,:month,1) AS DATETIME2)))
            ORDER BY EventDate,e.Id""")
        return list(db.execute(stmt,dict(family_id=str(family_id),year=year,month=month,tz_offset=tz_offset)).mappings().all())
    stmt = text(
        """
        SELECT EventId, FamilyId, Title, EventDate, Location, GoingCount
        FROM community.fn_GetMonthlyEvents(:family_id, :year, :month)
        ORDER BY EventDate
        """
    )
    return list(
        db.execute(stmt, {"family_id": str(family_id), "year": year, "month": month})
        .mappings()
        .all()
    )


def get_event(db: Session, *, event_id: UUID,actor_id: UUID | None=None,for_update: bool=False) -> Mapping[str, Any] | None:
    stmt = text(
        f"""
        SELECT e.Id AS EventId, e.FamilyId, e.Title, e.EventDate, e.Location,
               (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM community.EventParticipants AS ep
                WHERE ep.EventId = e.Id AND ep.RsvpStatus = N'Going') AS GoingCount,
               (SELECT ep.RsvpStatus FROM community.EventParticipants ep JOIN genealogy.Members m ON m.Id=ep.MemberId
                WHERE ep.EventId=e.Id AND m.UserId=:actor_id) AS MyRsvp
        FROM community.Events AS e {"WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)" if for_update else ""}
        WHERE e.Id = :event_id
        """
    )
    return db.execute(stmt, {"event_id": str(event_id),"actor_id":str(actor_id) if actor_id else None}).mappings().one_or_none()


def create_event(
    db: Session,
    *,
    family_id: UUID,
    title: str,
    event_date: datetime,
    location: str | None,
) -> UUID:
    stmt = text(
        """
        INSERT INTO community.Events (FamilyId, Title, EventDate, Location)
        OUTPUT inserted.Id
        VALUES (:family_id, :title, :event_date, :location)
        """
    )
    event_id = db.execute(
        stmt,
        {
            "family_id": str(family_id),
            "title": title,
            "event_date": event_date,
            "location": location,
        },
    ).scalar_one()
    db.commit()
    return UUID(str(event_id))


def owns_member(db: Session, member_id: UUID, actor_id: UUID, family_id: UUID) -> bool:
    return db.execute(text("""
        SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members
        WHERE Id=:member_id AND UserId=:actor_id AND FamilyId=:family_id
    """), {"member_id": str(member_id), "actor_id": str(actor_id), "family_id": str(family_id)}).scalar_one_or_none() is not None


def upsert_rsvp(db: Session, *, event_id: UUID, member_id: UUID, rsvp_status: str) -> None:
    """Gọi community.usp_UpsertEventRsvp (MERGE): chưa trả lời thì thêm, đã có thì cập nhật."""
    stmt = text(
        """
        EXEC community.usp_UpsertEventRsvp
            @EventId    = :event_id,
            @MemberId   = :member_id,
            @RsvpStatus = :rsvp_status
        """
    )
    db.execute(
        stmt,
        {"event_id": str(event_id), "member_id": str(member_id), "rsvp_status": rsvp_status},
    )
    db.commit()


def add_gallery_item(
    db: Session, *, event_id: UUID, media_url: str, uploaded_by: UUID
) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    stmt = text(
        """
        INSERT INTO community.EventGalleries (EventId, MediaUrl, UploadedBy)
        OUTPUT inserted.Id, inserted.EventId, inserted.MediaUrl, inserted.UploadedBy, inserted.CreatedAt
        VALUES (:event_id, :media_url, :uploaded_by)
        """
    )
    row = (
        db.execute(
            stmt,
            {"event_id": str(event_id), "media_url": media_url, "uploaded_by": str(uploaded_by)},
        )
        .mappings()
        .one()
    )
    db.commit()
    return row


def list_gallery(db: Session, *, event_id: UUID, offset: int, limit: int) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    stmt = text(
        """
        SELECT Id, EventId, MediaUrl, UploadedBy, CreatedAt
        FROM community.EventGalleries
        WHERE EventId = :event_id
        ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC
        OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY
        """
    )
    return list(
        db.execute(stmt, {"event_id": str(event_id), "offset": offset, "limit": limit})
        .mappings()
        .all()
    )


def create_reminder(db: Session, *, event_id: UUID, reminder_time: datetime,user_id: UUID | None=None) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    stmt = text(
        """
        INSERT INTO community.EventReminders (EventId, ReminderTime,UserId)
        OUTPUT inserted.Id, inserted.EventId, inserted.ReminderTime, inserted.Status,inserted.UserId
        VALUES (:event_id, :reminder_time,:user_id)
        """
    )
    row = (
        db.execute(stmt, {"event_id": str(event_id), "reminder_time": reminder_time,"user_id":str(user_id) if user_id else None})
        .mappings()
        .one()
    )
    db.commit()
    return row

        execute(db,"""EXEC community.usp_ManageEvent @ActorUserId=:actor,@EventId=:id,@Action='update',
            @Title=:title,@EventDate=:event_date,@Location=:location""",dict(actor=current_user.id,id=event_id,**payload.model_dump(exclude={"family_id"}))).close()
        return get_event_service(event_id,current_user,db)
    return run(db,operation,write=True)

@router.get("/{event_id}/participants")
def participants(event_id: UUID,current_user: CurrentUser,db: DbSession,page: int=Query(default=1,ge=1),page_size: int=Query(default=30,ge=1,le=100)):
    def operation():
        _accessible_event(event_id,current_user,db)
        items=rows(db,"""SELECT ep.MemberId AS member_id,m.FullName AS name,ep.RsvpStatus AS rsvp_status,b.Name AS branch_name
            FROM community.EventParticipants ep JOIN genealogy.Members m ON m.Id=ep.MemberId LEFT JOIN core.Branches b ON b.Id=m.BranchId
            WHERE ep.EventId=:id ORDER BY m.FullName,m.Id OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY""",id=event_id,offset=(page-1)*page_size,limit=page_size)
        counts=rows(db,"SELECT RsvpStatus AS status,COUNT(*) AS total FROM community.EventParticipants WHERE EventId=:id GROUP BY RsvpStatus",id=event_id)
        return dict(items=items,total=sum(row["total"] for row in counts),counts={row["status"]:row["total"] for row in counts})
    return run(db,operation)

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/events/schemas.py

"""Schema Pydantic cho phân hệ Sự kiện (lịch, RSVP, thư viện ảnh, nhắc nhở)."""

from datetime import datetime,timezone
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel,ConfigDict, Field, HttpUrl, TypeAdapter,field_validator


class EventCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra="forbid",str_strip_whitespace=True)
    family_id: UUID
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    event_date: datetime
    location: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)

    @field_validator("event_date")
    @classmethod
    def utc_date(cls,value):
        value=value.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None) if value.tzinfo else value
        if not 1900<=value.year<=2200:
            raise ValueError("Thời gian sự kiện cần nằm trong năm 1900–2200.")
        return value


class EventUpdateRequest(EventCreateRequest):
    family_id: None=None


class EventResponse(BaseModel):
    event_id: UUID
    family_id: UUID
    title: str
    event_date: datetime
    location: str | None = None
    going_count: int = 0
    my_rsvp: str | None=None


class RsvpRequest(BaseModel):
    member_id: UUID
    rsvp_status: str = Field(pattern="^(Pending|Going|Maybe|Declined)$")


class RsvpResponse(BaseModel):
    event_id: UUID
    member_id: UUID
    rsvp_status: str
    going_count: int = 0


class GalleryCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    media_url: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=2048)

    @field_validator("media_url")
    @classmethod
    def http_url(cls,value):
        value=value.strip()
        TypeAdapter(HttpUrl).validate_python(value)
        return value


class GalleryItemResponse(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    event_id: UUID
    media_url: str
    uploaded_by: UUID
    created_at: datetime


class ReminderCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    reminder_time: datetime
    for_family: bool=False

    @field_validator("reminder_time")
    @classmethod
    def utc_date(cls,value):
        return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None) if value.tzinfo else value


class ReminderResponse(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    event_id: UUID
    reminder_time: datetime
    status: str
    user_id: UUID | None=None

################################################################################
# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/events/services.py
################################################################################
"""Nghiệp vụ phân hệ Sự kiện: lịch tháng, RSVP, thư viện ảnh, nhắc nhở."""

from uuid import UUID
from datetime import datetime,timezone

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.exc import DBAPIError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.exceptions import NotFoundError
from app.core.family_access import require_family_access
from app.domains.identity.models import User
from app.domains.events import repository
from app.domains.events.schemas import (
    EventCreateRequest,
    EventResponse,
    GalleryCreateRequest,
    GalleryItemResponse,
    ReminderCreateRequest,
    ReminderResponse,
    RsvpRequest,
    RsvpResponse,
)
from app.shared.pagination import PageParams


def _to_event_response(row) -> EventResponse:
    return EventResponse(
        event_id=row["EventId"],
        family_id=row["FamilyId"],
        title=row["Title"],
        event_date=row["EventDate"],
        location=row["Location"],
        going_count=int(row["GoingCount"] or 0),
        my_rsvp=row.get("MyRsvp"),
    )


def list_monthly_events_service(
    family_id: UUID, year: int, month: int, actor: User, db: Session,tz_offset: int=0
) -> list[EventResponse]:
    require_family_access(db, actor, family_id)
    rows = repository.list_monthly_events(db, family_id=family_id, year=year, month=month,tz_offset=tz_offset)
    return [_to_event_response(row) for row in rows]


def _accessible_event(event_id: UUID, actor: User, db: Session, *, for_update: bool=False):
    row = repository.get_event(db, event_id=event_id,actor_id=actor.id,for_update=for_update)
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("Sự kiện không tồn tại.")
    require_family_access(db, actor, row["FamilyId"])
    return row


def get_event_service(event_id: UUID, actor: User, db: Session) -> EventResponse:
    return _to_event_response(_accessible_event(event_id, actor, db))


def create_event_service(payload: EventCreateRequest, actor: User, db: Session) -> EventResponse:
    require_family_access(db, actor, payload.family_id, manage=True)
    try:
        event_id = repository.create_event(
            db,
            family_id=payload.family_id,
            title=payload.title.strip(),
            event_date=payload.event_date,
            location=payload.location,
        )
    except DBAPIError as exc:
        db.rollback()
        raise NotFoundError("Không tạo được sự kiện: gia đình không tồn tại.") from exc
    return get_event_service(event_id, actor, db)


def upsert_rsvp_service(event_id: UUID, payload: RsvpRequest, actor: User, db: Session) -> RsvpResponse:
    event = _accessible_event(event_id, actor, db)
    if not repository.owns_member(db, payload.member_id, actor.id, event["FamilyId"]):
        raise HTTPException(403, "Chỉ được phản hồi tham dự cho hồ sơ của chính bạn trong gia đình này.")
    try:
        repository.upsert_rsvp(
            db,
            event_id=event_id,
            member_id=payload.member_id,
            rsvp_status=payload.rsvp_status,
        )
    except DBAPIError as exc:  # THROW 50721 khi sự kiện không tồn tại
        db.rollback()
        raise NotFoundError("Không ghi được RSVP: sự kiện hoặc thành viên không hợp lệ.") from exc

    event = repository.get_event(db, event_id=event_id)
    return RsvpResponse(
        event_id=event_id,
        member_id=payload.member_id,
        rsvp_status=payload.rsvp_status,
        going_count=int(event["GoingCount"] or 0) if event else 0,
    )


def add_gallery_item_service(
    event_id: UUID, payload: GalleryCreateRequest, actor: User, db: Session
) -> GalleryItemResponse:
    _accessible_event(event_id, actor, db)
    row = repository.add_gallery_item(
        db, event_id=event_id, media_url=payload.media_url, uploaded_by=actor.id
    )
    return GalleryItemResponse(
        id=row["Id"],
        event_id=row["EventId"],
        media_url=row["MediaUrl"],
        uploaded_by=row["UploadedBy"],
        created_at=row["CreatedAt"],
    )


def list_gallery_service(
    event_id: UUID, page: PageParams, actor: User, db: Session
) -> list[GalleryItemResponse]:
    _accessible_event(event_id, actor, db)
    rows = repository.list_gallery(db, event_id=event_id, offset=page.offset, limit=page.page_size)
    return [
        GalleryItemResponse(
            id=row["Id"],
            event_id=row["EventId"],
            media_url=row["MediaUrl"],
            uploaded_by=row["UploadedBy"],
            created_at=row["CreatedAt"],
        )
        for row in rows
    ]


def create_reminder_service(
    event_id: UUID, payload: ReminderCreateRequest, actor: User, db: Session
) -> ReminderResponse:
    event=_accessible_event(event_id, actor, db,for_update=True)
    if payload.for_family:
        require_family_access(db,actor,event["FamilyId"],manage=True)
    event_date=event["EventDate"]
    if event_date.tzinfo:
        event_date=event_date.astimezone(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None)
    if payload.reminder_time<=datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(tzinfo=None) or payload.reminder_time>event_date:
        raise HTTPException(422,"Nhắc lịch phải ở tương lai và không sau thời gian sự kiện.")
    row = repository.create_reminder(
        db, event_id=event_id, reminder_time=payload.reminder_time,user_id=None if payload.for_family else actor.id
    )
    return ReminderResponse(
        id=row["Id"],
        event_id=row["EventId"],
        reminder_time=row["ReminderTime"],
        status=row["Status"],
        user_id=row.get("UserId"),
    )

################################################################################
# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/genealogy/repository.py
################################################################################
from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.domains.heritage.repository import assert_access, execute


def rows(db, statement, **params):
    return [dict(row) for row in execute(db, statement, params).mappings().all()]


def scope(db, actor, family_id):
    return rows(
        db,
        """SELECT u.Role,m.BranchId FROM core.Users u
        LEFT JOIN genealogy.Members m ON m.UserId=u.UserId AND m.FamilyId=:family
        WHERE u.UserId=:actor""",
        family=family_id,
        actor=actor,
    )[0]


def profile(db, actor):
    user = rows(
        db,
        "SELECT UserId AS id,FullName AS full_name,Email AS email,Role AS role FROM core.Users WHERE UserId=:actor",
        actor=actor,
    )[0]
    members = rows(
        db,
        """SELECT m.Id AS id,m.FamilyId AS family_id,f.Name AS family_name,
        b.Name AS branch_name,m.BranchId AS branch_id,m.FullName AS name,m.BirthDate AS birth_date,m.Location AS location
        FROM genealogy.Members m JOIN core.Families f ON f.Id=m.FamilyId
        LEFT JOIN core.Branches b ON b.Id=m.BranchId WHERE m.UserId=:actor""",
        actor=actor,
    )
    requests = rows(
        db,
        """SELECT v.Id AS id,v.Status AS status,v.CreatedAt AS created_at,
        m.FullName AS name,f.Name AS family_name FROM core.MemberVerifications v
        JOIN genealogy.Members m ON m.Id=v.MemberId JOIN core.Families f ON f.Id=m.FamilyId
        WHERE v.UserId=:actor ORDER BY v.CreatedAt DESC,v.Id""",
        actor=actor,
    )
    return dict(user=user, member=members[0] if members else None, verifications=requests)


def candidates(db, family_name, full_name, birth_date):
    return rows(
        db,
        """SELECT TOP (20) m.Id AS id,m.FullName AS name,f.Name AS family_name,b.Name AS branch_name
        FROM genealogy.Members m JOIN core.Families f ON f.Id=m.FamilyId
        LEFT JOIN core.Branches b ON b.Id=m.BranchId
        WHERE m.UserId IS NULL AND f.Name=:family_name AND m.FullName=:full_name
        AND (:birth_date IS NULL OR m.BirthDate=:birth_date) ORDER BY m.Id""",
        family_name=family_name,
        full_name=full_name,
        birth_date=birth_date,
    )


def records(db, actor, family_id, resource, q, offset, limit):
    assert_access(db, actor, family_id)
    source, columns, search = {
        "branches": ("core.Branches", "Id AS id,Name AS name", "Name"),
        "members": (
            "genealogy.Members",
            "Id AS id,FullName AS name,BranchId AS branch_id,BirthDate AS birth_date,Location AS location,UserId AS user_id",
            "FullName",
        ),
    }[resource]
    params = dict(family=family_id, q=q, offset=offset, limit=limit)
    where = f"FamilyId=:family AND (:q=N'' OR CHARINDEX(:q,{search})>0)"
    total = execute(db, f"SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM {source} WHERE {where}", params).scalar_one()
    items = rows(
        db,
        f"SELECT {columns} FROM {source} WHERE {where} ORDER BY {search},Id OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY",
        **params,
    )
    actor_scope = scope(db, actor, family_id)
    for item in items:
        branch = item["id"] if resource == "branches" else item["branch_id"]
        item["can_manage"] = actor_scope["Role"] == "admin" or (
            actor_scope["Role"] == "family_head"
            and actor_scope["BranchId"] is not None
            and branch == actor_scope["BranchId"]
        )
    return dict(items=items, total=total)


def mutate(db, actor, family_id, resource, action, identifier, values):
    params = dict(actor=actor, family=family_id, resource=resource, action=action, id=identifier, **values)
    args = "@ActorUserId=:actor,@FamilyId=:family,@Resource=:resource,@Action=:action,@Id=:id"
    names = dict(name="Name", branch_id="BranchId", birth_date="BirthDate", location="Location")
    args += "".join(f",@{names[key]}=:{key}" for key in values)
    return dict(execute(db, "EXEC genealogy.usp_ManageRecord " + args, params).mappings().one())


def relations(db, actor, family_id, member_id):
    assert_access(db, actor, family_id)
    if member_id and not rows(
        db,
        "SELECT Id FROM genealogy.Members WHERE Id=:id AND FamilyId=:family",
        id=member_id,
        family=family_id,
    ):
        raise HTTPException(404, "Không tìm thấy thành viên.")
    params = dict(family=family_id)
    edges = rows(
        db,
        """SELECT p.Id AS id,p.ParentId AS first_id,p.ChildId AS second_id,
        a.FullName AS first_name,b.FullName AS second_name FROM genealogy.ParentChild p
        JOIN genealogy.Members a ON a.Id=p.ParentId JOIN genealogy.Members b ON b.Id=p.ChildId
        WHERE a.FamilyId=:family AND b.FamilyId=:family ORDER BY a.FullName,b.FullName,p.Id""",
        **params,
    )
    marriages = rows(
        db,
        """SELECT p.Id AS id,p.Spouse1Id AS first_id,p.Spouse2Id AS second_id,p.MarriedDate AS married_date,
        a.FullName AS first_name,b.FullName AS second_name FROM genealogy.Marriages p
        JOIN genealogy.Members a ON a.Id=p.Spouse1Id JOIN genealogy.Members b ON b.Id=p.Spouse2Id
        WHERE a.FamilyId=:family AND b.FamilyId=:family ORDER BY a.FullName,b.FullName,p.Id""",
        **params,
    )
    ancestors = rows(db, "SELECT * FROM genealogy.fn_GetAncestors(:id) ORDER BY GenerationsUp,MemberId", id=member_id) if member_id else []
    descendants = (
        rows(db, "SELECT * FROM genealogy.fn_GetDescendants(:id,NULL) ORDER BY GenerationsDown,MemberId", id=member_id)
        if member_id
        else []
    )
    return dict(parent_child=edges, marriages=marriages, ancestors=ancestors, descendants=descendants)


def search_directory(
    db: Session,
    *,
    family_id: UUID | None = None,
    keyword: str | None = None,
    occupation: str | None = None,
    only_current_job: bool = False,
    education: str | None = None,
    branch_id: UUID | None = None,
    generation: int | None = None,
    root_member_id: UUID | None = None,
    page_number: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 50,
) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    stmt = text(
        """
        EXEC genealogy.usp_SearchDirectory
            @FamilyId = :family_id,
            @Keyword = :keyword,
            @Occupation = :occupation,
            @OnlyCurrentJob = :only_current_job,
            @Education = :education,
            @BranchId = :branch_id,
            @Generation = :generation,
            @RootMemberId = :root_member_id,
            @PageNumber = :page_number,
            @PageSize = :page_size
        """
    )
    return (
        db.execute(
            stmt,
            {
                "family_id": str(family_id) if family_id else None,
                "keyword": keyword,
                "occupation": occupation,
                "only_current_job": 1 if only_current_job else 0,
                "education": education,
                "branch_id": str(branch_id) if branch_id else None,
                "generation": generation,
                "root_member_id": str(root_member_id) if root_member_id else None,
                "page_number": page_number,
                "page_size": page_size,
            },
        )
        .mappings()
        .all()
    )

    )

from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Literal
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator

from app.shared.pagination import PaginatedResponse


class NameFields(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", str_strip_whitespace=True)
    name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=200)


class MemberFields(NameFields):
    branch_id: UUID | None = None
    birth_date: date | None = None
    location: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=300)

    @field_validator("birth_date")
    @classmethod
    def past_birth_date(cls, value):
        if value and value > date.today():
            raise ValueError("Ngày sinh không được ở tương lai.")
        return value


class ProfileFields(MemberFields):
    branch_id: None = None


class VerificationRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    member_id: UUID


class RelationshipFields(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    first_id: UUID
    second_id: UUID
    married_date: date | None = None


# ---------- Directory (TV2) ----------
class DirectoryMemberResponse(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    full_name: str
    birth_date: date | None = None
    location: str | None = None
    family_id: UUID
    branch_id: UUID | None = None
    generation: int
    latest_position: str | None = None
    latest_company: str | None = None
    latest_institution: str | None = None
    latest_degree: str | None = None


DirectorySearchResponse = PaginatedResponse[DirectoryMemberResponse]


class MemberCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    family_id: UUID
    branch_id: UUID | None = None
    full_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=255)
    gender: Literal["male", "female", "other"] | None = None
    birth_date: date | None = None
    death_date: date | None = None
    location: str | None = None
    bio: str | None = None


class MemberUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    branch_id: UUID | None = None
    full_name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=255)
    gender: Literal["male", "female", "other"] | None = None
    birth_date: date | None = None
    death_date: date | None = None
    location: str | None = None
    bio: str | None = None


class MemberResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: UUID
    family_id: UUID
    branch_id: UUID | None = None
    full_name: str
    gender: str | None = None
    birth_date: date | None = None
    death_date: date | None = None
    location: str | None = None
    bio: str | None = None
    created_at: datetime | None = None


class AddChildNodeRequest(BaseModel):
    parent_id: UUID

    spouse_a_id: UUID
    spouse_b_id: UUID
    marriage_date: date | None = None
    status: str | None = None

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/genealogy/services.py

import re
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.exc import DBAPIError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.domains.genealogy import repository
from app.domains.genealogy.schemas import (
    DirectoryMemberResponse,
    DirectorySearchResponse,
)


def run(db, operation, write=False):
    try:
        result = operation()
        if write:
            db.commit()
        return result
    except DBAPIError as exc:
        db.rollback()
        marker = re.search(r"\[TV4_SQL:(\d+)\]", str(exc.orig))
        code = int(marker[1]) if marker else 0
        if code == 51403:
            status, message = 403, "Bạn không có quyền thao tác trong gia đình này."
        elif code in (51404, 50102, 50202):
            status, message = 404, "Không tìm thấy dữ liệu."
        elif code in (51509, 2601, 2627, 547, 50103, 50203):
            status, message = 409, "Dữ liệu bị trùng hoặc còn liên kết. Hãy kiểm tra trước khi thay đổi."
        elif code in (50100, 50200, 1205, 1222):
            status, message = 503, "Gia phả đang được xử lý. Vui lòng thử lại."
        elif code in (51522, 50101, 50104, 50105, 50201, 50204, 50205, 50001, 50002):
            status, message = (
                422,
                "Dữ liệu không hợp lệ: kiểm tra chi nhánh, ngày sinh, chu trình, tối đa hai cha/mẹ và quy tắc huyết thống ba đời.",
            )
        else:
            status, message = 500, "Không thể xử lý dữ liệu gia phả."
        raise HTTPException(status, message) from None
    except Exception:
        if write:
            db.rollback()
        raise


def search_directory_service(
    db: Session,
    *,
    family_id: UUID,
    keyword: str | None,
    occupation: str | None,
    only_current_job: bool,
    education: str | None,
    branch_id: UUID | None,
    generation: int | None,
    root_member_id: UUID | None,
    page: int,
    page_size: int,
) -> DirectorySearchResponse:
    try:
        rows = repository.search_directory(
            db,
            family_id=family_id,
            keyword=keyword,
            occupation=occupation,
            only_current_job=only_current_job,
            education=education,
            branch_id=branch_id,
            generation=generation,
            root_member_id=root_member_id,
            page_number=page,
            page_size=page_size,
        )
    except DBAPIError as exc:
        db.rollback()
        raise RuntimeError("Không thể tìm kiếm danh bạ trong cơ sở dữ liệu.") from exc

    items = [
        DirectoryMemberResponse(
            id=row["Id"],
            full_name=row["FullName"],
            birth_date=row["BirthDate"],
            location=row["Location"],
            family_id=row["FamilyId"],
            branch_id=row["BranchId"],
            generation=row["Generation"],
            latest_position=row["LatestPosition"],
            latest_company=row["LatestCompany"],
            latest_institution=row["LatestInstitution"],
            latest_degree=row["LatestDegree"],
        )
        for row in rows
    ]

    total = int(rows[0]["TotalCount"]) if rows else 0

    return DirectorySearchResponse(
        items=items,
        total=total,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
    )

"""Bound T-SQL calls; SQL Server owns authorization and mutations."""
from uuid import UUID

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def execute(db: Session, statement: str, params: dict):
    bound = {key: str(value) if isinstance(value, UUID) else value for key, value in params.items()}
    # Driver versions may omit native error numbers: preserve a private marker.
    return db.execute(text(f"""
        BEGIN TRY
            {statement}
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            DECLARE @Error NVARCHAR(2048) = CONCAT(N'[TV4_SQL:', ERROR_NUMBER(), N'] ', ERROR_MESSAGE());
            THROW 50000, @Error, 1;
        END CATCH
    """), bound)


def assert_access(db, actor_id, family_id, manage=False):
    execute(db, "EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId=:actor_id, @FamilyId=:family_id, @Manage=:manage",
            dict(actor_id=actor_id, family_id=family_id, manage=manage)).close()


def families(db, actor_id):
    return execute(db, """
        SELECT f.Id, f.Name FROM core.Families f
        WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users u WHERE u.UserId=:actor_id AND u.IsActive=1
            AND (u.Role=N'admin' OR (u.Role IN (N'member',N'family_head') AND EXISTS
                (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members m WHERE m.UserId=u.UserId AND m.FamilyId=f.Id))))
        ORDER BY f.Name, f.Id
    """, dict(actor_id=actor_id)).mappings().all()


def page(db, resource, family_id, page, page_size, q="", item_type=None):
    # All identifiers are internal constants, never request text.
    sources = {"items": "heritage.vw_HeritageItems", "honors": "heritage.vw_Honors",
               "ranking": "heritage.vw_MemberHonorsRanking", "members": "genealogy.Members"}
    source = sources[resource]
    search = "FullName" if resource in ("ranking", "members") else "Title"
    condition = f"FamilyId=:family_id AND (:q=N'' OR CHARINDEX(:q, {search})>0)"
    if resource == "items":
        condition += " AND (:item_type IS NULL OR Type=:item_type)"
    order = {"items": "CreatedAt DESC, Id", "honors": "CreatedAt DESC, Id",
             "ranking": "Rank, FullName, MemberId", "members": "FullName, Id"}[resource]
    params = dict(family_id=family_id, q=q, item_type=item_type, offset=(page-1)*page_size, limit=page_size)
    count = execute(db, f"SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM {source} WHERE {condition}", params).scalar_one()
    columns = "Id, FullName" if resource == "members" else "*"
    rows = execute(db, f"SELECT {columns} FROM {source} WHERE {condition} ORDER BY {order} "
                      "OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY", params).mappings().all()
    return dict(items=rows, total=count, page=page, page_size=page_size)


def get(db, resource, family_id, identifier):
    source = {"items": "heritage.vw_HeritageItems", "honors": "heritage.vw_Honors"}[resource]
    return execute(db, f"SELECT * FROM {source} WHERE Id=:id AND FamilyId=:family_id",
                   dict(id=identifier, family_id=family_id)).mappings().one_or_none()


def mutate(db, resource, action, actor_id, family_id, values, identifier=None):
    proc = {("items", "create"): "usp_CreateHeritageItem", ("items", "update"): "usp_UpdateHeritageItem",
            ("items", "delete"): "usp_DeleteHeritageItem", ("honors", "create"): "usp_GrantMemberHonor",
            ("honors", "update"): "usp_UpdateMemberHonor", ("honors", "delete"): "usp_DeleteMemberHonor"}[(resource, action)]
    names = {"type": "Type", "title": "Title", "description": "Description", "content": "Content",
             "media_url": "MediaUrl", "member_id": "MemberId", "date_awarded": "DateAwarded",
             "expected_version": "ExpectedVersion"}
    params = dict(actor_id=actor_id, family_id=family_id, **values)
    arguments = ["@ActorUserId=:actor_id", "@FamilyId=:family_id"]
    if identifier is not None:
        params["id"] = identifier
        arguments.append("@Id=:id")
    arguments += [f"@{names[key]}=:{key}" for key in values]
    result = execute(db, f"EXEC heritage.{proc} " + ", ".join(arguments), params)
    if action == "delete":
        result.close()
        return None
    return result.mappings().one()


def family_tree(db, actor_id, family_id):
    return execute(db, "EXEC heritage.usp_GetFamilyTreeJson @ActorUserId=:actor_id, @FamilyId=:family_id",
                   dict(actor_id=actor_id, family_id=family_id)).scalar_one()

"""TV4 contracts: client-supplied actor and owner fields are rejected."""
from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Annotated, Literal
from uuid import UUID
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, StringConstraints, field_validator, model_validator

Title = Annotated[str, StringConstraints(strip_whitespace=True, min_length=1, max_length=200)]
Version = Annotated[str, StringConstraints(pattern=r"^[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$")]
ItemType = Literal["document", "story", "photo"]


class Contract(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", populate_by_name=True, str_strip_whitespace=True)


class ItemFields(Contract):
    type: ItemType
    title: Title
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    content: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200000)
    media_url: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)

    @field_validator("description", "content", "media_url")
    @classmethod
    def blank_to_none(cls, value):
        return value or None

    @field_validator("media_url")
    @classmethod
    def safe_url(cls, value):
        if value is None:
            return None
        if any(c.isspace() or ord(c) < 32 for c in value) or "\\" in value:
            raise ValueError("URL media không hợp lệ.")
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        local = value.startswith("/") and not value.startswith("//")
        remote = parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname and not parsed.username and not parsed.password
        if not (local or remote):
            raise ValueError("Dùng URL HTTPS hoặc đường dẫn /media/ có sẵn.")
        return value

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_payload(self):
        if self.type == "photo" and not self.media_url:
            raise ValueError("Ảnh cần URL media.")
        if self.type == "story" and not self.content:
            raise ValueError("Câu chuyện cần nội dung.")
        if self.type == "document" and not (self.content or self.media_url):
            raise ValueError("Tài liệu cần nội dung hoặc URL.")
        return self


class ItemCreate(ItemFields):
    pass


class ItemPatch(Contract):
    expected_version: Version
    type: ItemType | None = None
    title: Title | None = None
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)
    content: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200000)
    media_url: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def required_non_null(self):
        if any(name in self.model_fields_set and getattr(self, name) is None for name in ("type", "title")):
            raise ValueError("Loại và tiêu đề không được null.")
        return self


class ItemResponse(Contract):
    id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="Id")
    family_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="FamilyId")
    created_by_user_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="CreatedByUserId")
    type: ItemType = Field(validation_alias="Type")
    title: str = Field(validation_alias="Title")
    description: str | None = Field(validation_alias="Description")
    content: str | None = Field(validation_alias="Content")
    media_url: str | None = Field(validation_alias="MediaUrl")
    created_at: datetime = Field(validation_alias="CreatedAt")
    version_token: str = Field(validation_alias="VersionToken")


class HonorFields(Contract):
    title: Title
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)
    date_awarded: date | None = None


class HonorCreate(HonorFields):
    member_id: UUID


class HonorPatch(Contract):
    expected_version: Version
    title: Title | None = None
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)
    date_awarded: date | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def required_non_null(self):
        if "title" in self.model_fields_set and self.title is None:
            raise ValueError("Tiêu đề không được null.")
        return self


class HonorResponse(Contract):
    id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="Id")
    member_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="MemberId")
    family_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="FamilyId")
    full_name: str = Field(validation_alias="FullName")
    title: str = Field(validation_alias="Title")
    description: str | None = Field(validation_alias="Description")
    date_awarded: date | None = Field(validation_alias="DateAwarded")
    created_at: datetime = Field(validation_alias="CreatedAt")
    version_token: str = Field(validation_alias="VersionToken")


class FamilyResponse(Contract):
    id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="Id")
    name: str = Field(validation_alias="Name")


class MemberResponse(Contract):
    id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="Id")
    full_name: str = Field(validation_alias="FullName")


class RankingResponse(Contract):
    family_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="FamilyId")
    member_id: UUID = Field(validation_alias="MemberId")
    full_name: str = Field(validation_alias="FullName")
    honor_count: int = Field(validation_alias="HonorCount")
    rank: int = Field(validation_alias="Rank")


class TreeNode(Contract):
    id: UUID
    label: str
    birth_date: date | None = None


class TreeEdge(Contract):
    id: str
    source: UUID
    target: UUID
    kind: Literal["parent_child", "marriage"]


class FamilyTree(Contract):
    family_id: UUID
    nodes: list[TreeNode]
    edges: list[TreeEdge]

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/heritage/services.py

import json
import re

from fastapi import HTTPException
from pydantic import ValidationError
from sqlalchemy.exc import DBAPIError

from app.domains.heritage import repository as repo
from app.domains.heritage.schemas import (
    FamilyTree, HonorFields, HonorResponse, ItemFields, ItemResponse,
    FamilyResponse, MemberResponse, RankingResponse,
)

ERRORS = {
    51403: (403, "Bạn không có quyền truy cập hoặc thao tác trong gia đình này."),
    51404: (404, "Không tìm thấy dữ liệu trong gia đình đã chọn."),
    51409: (409, "Dữ liệu đã thay đổi. Hãy tải lại trước khi lưu hoặc xóa."),
    51410: (409, "Tư liệu đã được AI lập chỉ mục. Cần phối hợp TV5 trước khi thay đổi."),
    51422: (422, "Nội dung di sản hoặc vinh danh chưa hợp lệ."),
    1205: (503, "Dữ liệu đang được xử lý. Vui lòng thử lại."),
    1222: (503, "Dữ liệu đang bị khóa. Vui lòng thử lại."),
}
MODELS = {"items": ItemResponse, "honors": HonorResponse,
          "ranking": RankingResponse, "members": MemberResponse}


def run(db, operation, write=False):
    try:
        result = operation()
        if write:
            db.commit()
        return result
    except DBAPIError as exc:
        db.rollback()
        message = str(exc.orig)
        marker = re.search(r"\[TV4_SQL:(\d+)\]", message)
        codes = [int(marker[1])] if marker else [int(n) for n in re.findall(r"\((\d{4,5})\)", message)]
        status, detail = next((ERRORS[c] for c in codes if c in ERRORS),
                              (500, "Không thể xử lý dữ liệu TV4. Kiểm tra cấu hình SQL Server."))
        raise HTTPException(status, detail) from None
    except Exception:
        if write:
            db.rollback()
        raise


def families(db, actor):
    return run(db, lambda: [FamilyResponse.model_validate(r) for r in repo.families(db, actor.id)])


def list_resource(db, actor, family_id, resource, **filters):
    def operation():
        repo.assert_access(db, actor.id, family_id)
        result = repo.page(db, resource, family_id, **filters)
        result["items"] = [MODELS[resource].model_validate(r) for r in result["items"]]
        return result
    return run(db, operation)


def read(db, actor, family_id, resource, identifier):
    def operation():
        repo.assert_access(db, actor.id, family_id)
        row = repo.get(db, resource, family_id, identifier)
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Không tìm thấy dữ liệu trong gia đình đã chọn.")
        return MODELS[resource].model_validate(row)
    return run(db, operation)


def mutate(db, actor, family_id, resource, action, payload=None, identifier=None, expected_version=None):
    def operation():
        repo.assert_access(db, actor.id, family_id, manage=resource == "honors")
        values = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) if payload is not None else {}
        if action == "update":
            current = repo.get(db, resource, family_id, identifier)
            if current is None:
                raise HTTPException(404, "Không tìm thấy dữ liệu trong gia đình đã chọn.")
            model = MODELS[resource].model_validate(current)
            fields = ItemFields if resource == "items" else HonorFields
            merged = {key: getattr(model, key) for key in fields.model_fields}
            merged.update({key: value for key, value in values.items() if key != "expected_version"})
            try:
                checked = fields.model_validate(merged)
            except ValidationError:
                raise HTTPException(422, "Nội dung sau cập nhật chưa hợp lệ.") from None
            values = dict(**checked.model_dump(), expected_version=values["expected_version"])
        elif action == "delete":
            values = dict(expected_version=expected_version)
        result = repo.mutate(db, resource, action, actor.id, family_id, values, identifier)
        return MODELS[resource].model_validate(result) if result is not None else None
    return run(db, operation, write=True)


def tree(db, actor, family_id):
    def operation():
        data = json.loads(repo.family_tree(db, actor.id, family_id))
        return FamilyTree.model_validate(data)
    return run(db, operation)

from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, EmailStr, Field, TypeAdapter, field_validator


class RegisterRequest(BaseModel):
    full_name: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=200)
    email: EmailStr
    password: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=128)


class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
    email: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=255, pattern=r"^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$")
    password: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)

    @field_validator("email", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def existing_email(cls, value):
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            return value
        value = value.strip()
        # Existing SQL fixtures use reserved addresses; login still verifies the hash.
        if value.lower().endswith(".invalid"):
            return value
        return str(TypeAdapter(EmailStr).validate_python(value))


class UserResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: UUID
    email: str
    full_name: str
    role: str


class AuthResponse(BaseModel):
    access_token: str
    token_type: str = "bearer"
    user: UserResponse

# FILE: apps/backend/app/domains/identity/services.py
################################################################################
from fastapi import HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.security import create_access_token, dummy_password_hash, hash_password, password_hash
from app.domains.identity.models import User
from app.domains.identity.schemas import AuthResponse, LoginRequest, RegisterRequest, UserResponse


def register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session) -> AuthResponse:
    email = str(payload.email).strip().lower()
    existing = db.scalar(select(User).where(User.email == email))
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Email này đã được đăng ký.")

    user = User(
        email=email,
        password_hash=hash_password(payload.password),
        full_name=payload.full_name.strip(),
        role="member",
        is_active=True,
    )
    db.add(user)
    try:
        db.commit()
    except IntegrityError:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Email này đã được đăng ký.") from None
    db.refresh(user)
    return AuthResponse(access_token=create_access_token(user), user=UserResponse.model_validate(user))


def authenticate_user(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session) -> AuthResponse:
    email = str(payload.email).strip().lower()
    user = db.scalar(select(User).where(User.email == email))
    if user is None:
        password_hash.verify(payload.password, dummy_password_hash)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Email hoặc mật khẩu chưa chính xác.", headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"})

    if not user.is_active or not password_hash.verify(payload.password, user.password_hash):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Email hoặc mật khẩu chưa chính xác.", headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"})

    return AuthResponse(access_token=create_access_token(user), user=UserResponse.model_validate(user))

from typing import Annotated
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.core.dependencies import get_current_user,get_db
from app.domains.genealogy.repository import rows
from app.domains.genealogy.services import run
from app.domains.heritage.repository import execute
from app.domains.identity.models import User

router=APIRouter(prefix="/notifications",tags=["notifications"])
DB=Annotated[Session,Depends(get_db)]
Actor=Annotated[User,Depends(get_current_user)]
ACCESS="""n.UserId=:actor AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core.Users u WHERE u.UserId=:actor AND u.Role IN ('admin','family_head','member'))
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core.Users u WHERE u.UserId=:actor AND u.Role='admin')
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members m WHERE m.UserId=:actor AND m.FamilyId=n.FamilyId))"""


@router.get("")
def inbox(db: DB,actor: Actor,page: int=Query(default=1,ge=1),page_size: int=Query(default=20,ge=1,le=100)):
    def operation():
        params=dict(actor=actor.id,offset=(page-1)*page_size,limit=page_size)
        items=rows(db,f"""SELECT n.Id AS id,n.FamilyId AS family_id,n.EventId AS event_id,n.Title AS title,n.Body AS body,
            n.CreatedAt AS created_at,n.ReadAt AS read_at FROM community.Notifications n WHERE {ACCESS}
            ORDER BY n.CreatedAt DESC,n.Id OFFSET :offset ROWS FETCH NEXT :limit ROWS ONLY""",**params)
        total=execute(db,f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community.Notifications n WHERE {ACCESS}",params).scalar_one()
        unread=execute(db,f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community.Notifications n WHERE {ACCESS} AND n.ReadAt IS NULL",params).scalar_one()
        return dict(items=items,total=total,unread=unread,page=page,page_size=page_size)
    return run(db,operation)


@router.get("/reminders")
def upcoming(db: DB,actor: Actor):
    return run(db,lambda: rows(db,"""SELECT TOP(500) r.Id AS id,r.EventId AS event_id,r.ReminderTime AS reminder_time,e.Title AS title
        FROM community.EventReminders r JOIN community.Events e ON e.Id=r.EventId
        WHERE r.Status='pending' AND r.ReminderTime>SYSUTCDATETIME() AND (r.UserId=:actor OR r.UserId IS NULL)
        AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core.Users u WHERE u.UserId=:actor AND u.Role IN ('admin','family_head','member'))
        AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core.Users u WHERE u.UserId=:actor AND u.Role='admin') OR
             EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members m WHERE m.UserId=:actor AND m.FamilyId=e.FamilyId))
        ORDER BY r.ReminderTime,r.Id""",actor=actor.id))


@router.patch("/{identifier}/read",status_code=204)
def mark_read(identifier: UUID,db: DB,actor: Actor):
    def operation():
        matched=rows(db,f"SELECT n.Id FROM community.Notifications n WHERE {ACCESS} AND n.Id=:id",actor=actor.id,id=identifier)
        if not matched: raise HTTPException(404,"Không tìm thấy thông báo.")
        execute(db,"UPDATE community.Notifications SET ReadAt=COALESCE(ReadAt,SYSUTCDATETIME()) WHERE Id=:id AND UserId=:actor",dict(id=identifier,actor=actor.id)).close()
    run(db,operation,write=True)

# FILE: apps/backend/app/shared/pagination.py

from typing import Generic, TypeVar

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

T = TypeVar("T")


class PageParams(BaseModel):
    page: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    page_size: int = Field(default=20, ge=1, le=100)

    @property
    def offset(self) -> int:
        return (self.page - 1) * self.page_size


class PaginatedResponse(BaseModel, Generic[T]):
    items: list[T]
    total: int
    page: int
    page_size: int

package vn.edu.familyconnect.familyconnect

import io.flutter.embedding.android.FlutterActivity
import io.flutter.embedding.engine.FlutterEngine
import io.flutter.plugin.common.MethodChannel
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri

class MainActivity : FlutterActivity() {
    override fun configureFlutterEngine(flutterEngine: FlutterEngine) {
        super.configureFlutterEngine(flutterEngine)
        MethodChannel(flutterEngine.dartExecutor.binaryMessenger, "familyconnect/links")
            .setMethodCallHandler { call, result ->
                if (call.method != "open") {
                    result.notImplemented()
                    return@setMethodCallHandler
                }
                val uri = Uri.parse(call.argument<String>("url") ?: "")
                if (uri.scheme !in listOf("http", "https") || uri.host.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    result.error("InvalidUrl", "URL không hợp lệ.", null)
                    return@setMethodCallHandler
                }
                try {
                    startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, uri).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_BROWSABLE))
                    result.success(null)
                } catch (error: Exception) {
                    result.error("OpenFailed", "Không mở được liên kết trên thiết bị.", null)
                }
            }
    }
}

# FILE: apps/mobile/lib/api.dart

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

typedef Json = Map<String, dynamic>;

Future<void> openMedia(Api api, String value) async {
  final uri = Uri.parse(api.baseUrl).resolve(value);
  if (!['http', 'https'].contains(uri.scheme) ||
      uri.host.isEmpty ||
      uri.userInfo.isNotEmpty) {
    throw ApiError('Liên kết tư liệu không hợp lệ.');
  }
  await const MethodChannel('familyconnect/links')
      .invokeMethod<void>('open', {'url': '$uri'});
}

class Api {
  Api({
    http.Client? client,
    this.baseUrl = const String.fromEnvironment(
      'API_BASE_URL',
      defaultValue: 'http://10.0.2.2:8000/api',
    ),
  }) : client = client ?? http.Client();
  final http.Client client;
  final String baseUrl;
  String? token;
  void Function()? onUnauthorized;

  Future<dynamic> call(
    String path, {
    String method = 'GET',
    Json? body,
    Map<String, dynamic> query = const {},
  }) async {
    final session = token;
    final uri = Uri.parse('$baseUrl$path').replace(
      queryParameters: {
        for (final e in query.entries)
          if (e.value != null && e.value.toString().isNotEmpty)
            e.key: '${e.value}',
      },
    );
    final request = http.Request(method, uri)
      ..headers.addAll({
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        if (session != null) 'Authorization': 'Bearer $session',
      });
    if (body != null) request.body = jsonEncode(body);
    try {
      final response = await client
          .send(request)
          .then(http.Response.fromStream)
          .timeout(const Duration(seconds: 15));
      if (response.statusCode == 401 && token == session && session != null) {
        token = null;
        onUnauthorized?.call();
      }
      dynamic value;
      try {
        value = response.bodyBytes.isEmpty
            ? null
            : jsonDecode(utf8.decode(response.bodyBytes));
      } on FormatException {
        value = null;
      }
      if (response.statusCode >= 400) {
        final detail = value is Map ? value['detail'] : null;
        throw ApiError(
          detail is String
              ? detail
              : detail is List
              ? detail.map((e) => e is Map ? e['msg'] : e).join('\n')
              : 'Yêu cầu thất bại (${response.statusCode}).',
        );
      }
      return value;
    } on TimeoutException {
      throw ApiError('Máy chủ phản hồi chậm. Vui lòng thử lại.');
    } on http.ClientException {
      throw ApiError('Không kết nối được máy chủ. Kiểm tra backend và mạng.');
    }
  }
}

class ApiError implements Exception {
  ApiError(this.message);
  final String message;
  @override
  String toString() => message;
}

DateTime utcDate(String value) {
  final hasZone = RegExp(r'(Z|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2})$').hasMatch(value);
  return DateTime.parse(hasZone ? value : '${value}Z').toLocal();
}

String displayDate(dynamic value) {
  if (value == null) return 'Chưa cập nhật';
  final d = utcDate(value.toString());
  String two(int n) => n.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
  return '${two(d.day)}/${two(d.month)}/${d.year} ${two(d.hour)}:${two(d.minute)}';
}

Future<List<Json>> allPages(Api api, String path, Json query) async {
  final rows = <Json>[];
  for (var page = 1; ; page++) {
    final data = await api.call(
      path,
      query: {...query, 'page': page, 'page_size': 100},
    );
    final batch = (data['items'] as List).cast<Json>();
    rows.addAll(batch);
    if (batch.isEmpty || rows.length >= data['total']) return rows;
  }
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

import 'api.dart';
import 'reminders.dart';
import 'ui.dart';

const rsvp = {
  'Pending': 'Chờ phản hồi',
  'Going': 'Tham dự',
  'Maybe': 'Có thể',
  'Declined': 'Không tham dự',
};

Future<void> editEvent(
  BuildContext context,
  Api api,
  String family,
  VoidCallback reload, [
  Json? row,
]) => formDialog(
  context,
  title: row == null ? 'Tạo sự kiện' : 'Sửa sự kiện',
  fields: const {
    'title': 'Tên sự kiện',
    'event_date': 'Thời gian (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, giờ máy)',
    'location': 'Địa điểm',
  },
  requiredFields: {'title', 'event_date'},
  initial: {
    ...?row,
    if (row != null)
      'event_date': utcDate(row['event_date'])
          .toIso8601String()
          .substring(0, 16),
  },
  save: (values) async {
    final date = DateTime.tryParse(values['event_date']);
    if (date == null) throw ApiError('Nhập thời gian theo YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm.');
    await api.call(
      '/events${row == null ? '' : '/${row['event_id']}'}',
      method: row == null ? 'POST' : 'PUT',
      body: {
        if (row == null) 'family_id': family,
        'title': values['title'],
        'event_date': date.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'location': values['location'],
      },
    );
    reload();
  },
);

class CalendarScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CalendarScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.api,
    required this.family,
    required this.memberId,
    required this.reminders,
    required this.user,
  });
  final Api api;
  final String family;
  final String? memberId;
  final Reminders reminders;
  final Json user;
  @override
  State<CalendarScreen> createState() => _CalendarScreenState();
}

class _CalendarScreenState extends State<CalendarScreen> {
  DateTime month = DateTime(DateTime.now().year, DateTime.now().month);
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DataPane(
    key: ValueKey(month),
    load: () => widget.api.call(
      '/events',
      query: {
        'family_id': widget.family,
        'year': month.year,
        'month': month.month,
        'tz_offset': month.timeZoneOffset.inMinutes,
      },
    ),
    builder: (data, reload) => pageList([
      Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Tháng trước',
            onPressed: month.year > 1900
                ? () => setState(
                    () => month = DateTime(month.year, month.month - 1),
                  )
                : null,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_left),
          ),
          heading('${month.month}/${month.year}'),
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Tháng tiếp',
            onPressed: month.year < 2200
                ? () => setState(
                    () => month = DateTime(month.year, month.month + 1),
                  )
                : null,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      if (['admin', 'family_head'].contains(widget.user['role']))
        ActionButton(
          'Tạo sự kiện',
          () => editEvent(context, widget.api, widget.family, reload),
          icon: Icons.add,
        ),
      if ((data as List).isEmpty)
        const Text('Chưa có sự kiện trong tháng này.'),
      for (final row in data)
        Card(
          child: ListTile(
            title: Text(row['title']),
            subtitle: Text(
              '${displayDate(row['event_date'])}\n${row['location'] ?? ''} · ${row['going_count']} tham dự',
            ),
            isThreeLine: true,
            trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
            onTap: () async {
              await openPage(
                context,
                'Sự kiện',
                EventScreen(
                  api: widget.api,
                  id: row['event_id'],
                  memberId: widget.memberId,
                  reminders: widget.reminders,
                ),
              );
              reload();
            },
          ),
        ),
    ]),
  );
}

class EventScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const EventScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.api,
    required this.id,
    required this.memberId,
    required this.reminders,
  });
  final Api api;
  final String id;
  final String? memberId;
  final Reminders reminders;
  @override
  State<EventScreen> createState() => _EventScreenState();
}

class _EventScreenState extends State<EventScreen> {
  int galleryPage = 1, participantPage = 1;
  Future<void> addReminder(
    BuildContext context,
    VoidCallback reload,
    bool family,
  ) async {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final day = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: now,
      firstDate: now,
      lastDate: DateTime(2200),
    );
    if (day == null || !context.mounted) return;
    final time = await showTimePicker(
      context: context,
      initialTime: TimeOfDay.fromDateTime(now.add(const Duration(minutes: 2))),
    );
    if (time == null) return;
    final date = DateTime(day.year, day.month, day.day, time.hour, time.minute);
    await widget.api.call(
      '/events/${widget.id}/reminders',
      method: 'POST',
      body: {
        'reminder_time': date.toUtc().toIso8601String(),
        'for_family': family,
      },
    );
    reload();
    try {
      await widget.reminders.sync(widget.api);
    } catch (error) {
      if (context.mounted) {
        message(
          context,
          'Đã lưu nhắc trên máy chủ. Chưa đồng bộ Android: $error',
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DataPane(
    key: ValueKey('$galleryPage-$participantPage'),
    load: () => Future.wait([
      widget.api.call('/events/${widget.id}'),
      widget.api.call('/auth/me'),
      widget.api.call(
        '/events/${widget.id}/gallery',
        query: {'page': galleryPage, 'page_size': 12},
      ),
      widget.api.call(
        '/events/${widget.id}/participants',
        query: {'page': participantPage, 'page_size': 20},
      ),
      widget.api.call('/events/${widget.id}/reminders'),
    ]),
    builder: (values, reload) {
      final event = values[0] as Json, user = values[1] as Json;
      final manager = ['admin', 'family_head'].contains(user['role']);
      final gallery = values[2] as List, participants = values[3] as Json;
      return pageList([
        heading(event['title']),
        Text(displayDate(event['event_date'])),
        Text(event['location'] ?? 'Chưa ghi địa điểm'),
        if (manager)
          Wrap(
            children: [
              ActionButton(
                'Sửa',
                () => editEvent(
                  context,
                  widget.api,
                  event['family_id'],
                  reload,
                  event,
                ),
                icon: Icons.edit,
              ),
              ActionButton('Xóa sự kiện', () async {
                if (await confirm(
                  context,
                  'Xóa sự kiện, RSVP, ảnh và nhắc liên quan?',
                )) {
                  await widget.api.call(
                    '/events/${widget.id}',
                    method: 'DELETE',
                  );
                  await widget.reminders.sync(widget.api);
                  if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
                }
              }, icon: Icons.delete_outline),
            ],
          ),
        heading('Phản hồi tham dự'),
        if (widget.memberId == null)
          const Text('Cần liên kết hồ sơ cá nhân trong gia đình để phản hồi.'),
        Wrap(
          children: [
            for (final option in rsvp.entries.where((e) => e.key != 'Pending'))
              ActionButton(
                '${event['my_rsvp'] == option.key ? '✓ ' : ''}${option.value}',
                widget.memberId == null
                    ? null
                    : () async {
                        await widget.api.call(
                          '/events/${widget.id}/rsvp',
                          method: 'PUT',
                          body: {
                            'member_id': widget.memberId,
                            'rsvp_status': option.key,
                          },
                        );
                        reload();
                      },
                icon: Icons.event_available_outlined,
              ),
          ],
        ),
        heading('Người tham gia'),
        Text(
          rsvp.entries
              .map((e) => '${e.value}: ${participants['counts'][e.key] ?? 0}')
              .join(' · '),
        ),
        for (final row in participants['items'])
          ListTile(
            title: Text(row['name']),
            subtitle: Text(rsvp[row['rsvp_status']] ?? row['rsvp_status']),
          ),
        pager(
          participantPage,
          participantPage * 20 < participants['total'],
          (value) => setState(() => participantPage = value),
        ),
        heading('Ảnh sự kiện'),
        for (final row in gallery)
          card([
            remoteImage(row['media_url']),
            if (manager || row['uploaded_by'] == user['id'])
              ActionButton('Xóa ảnh', () async {
                if (await confirm(context, 'Xóa ảnh này khỏi sự kiện?')) {
                  await widget.api.call(
                    '/events/${widget.id}/gallery/${row['id']}',
                    method: 'DELETE',
                  );
                  reload();
                }
              }, icon: Icons.delete_outline),
          ]),
        pager(
          galleryPage,
          gallery.length == 12,
          (value) => setState(() => galleryPage = value),
        ),
        ActionButton(
          'Thêm ảnh bằng URL',
          () => formDialog(
            context,
            title: 'Thêm ảnh',
            fields: const {'media_url': 'URL ảnh HTTP/HTTPS'},
            requiredFields: {'media_url'},
            save: (body) async {
              await widget.api.call(
                '/events/${widget.id}/gallery',
                method: 'POST',
                body: body,
              );
              reload();
            },
          ),
          icon: Icons.add_photo_alternate_outlined,
        ),
        heading('Nhắc lịch'),
        Wrap(
          children: [
            ActionButton(
              'Nhắc riêng tôi',
              () => addReminder(context, reload, false),
              icon: Icons.alarm_add,
            ),
            if (manager)
              ActionButton(
                'Nhắc cả gia đình',
                () => addReminder(context, reload, true),
                icon: Icons.group_outlined,
              ),
          ],
        ),
        for (final row in values[4])
          card([
            Text(
              '${displayDate(row['reminder_time'])} · ${row['user_id'] == null ? 'Cả gia đình' : 'Cá nhân'}',
            ),
            Text(
              const {
                    'pending': 'Chờ đến giờ',
                    'sent': 'Đã vào hộp thư',
                    'cancelled': 'Đã hủy',
                    'failed': 'Gửi lỗi',
                  }[row['status']] ??
                  row['status'],
            ),
            if (row['status'] == 'pending' &&
                (manager || row['user_id'] == user['id']))
              ActionButton('Hủy nhắc', () async {
                await widget.api.call(
                  '/events/${widget.id}/reminders/${row['id']}',
                  method: 'DELETE',
                );
                reload();
                await widget.reminders.sync(widget.api);
              }, icon: Icons.alarm_off),
          ]),
      ]);
    },
  );
}

class CommunityScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CommunityScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.api,
    required this.family,
    required this.user,
  });
  final Api api;
  final String family;
  final Json user;
  @override
  State<CommunityScreen> createState() => _CommunityScreenState();
}

class _CommunityScreenState extends State<CommunityScreen> {
  int page = 1;
  Future<void> edit(BuildContext context, VoidCallback reload, [Json? row]) =>
      formDialog(
        context,
        title: row == null ? 'Chia sẻ với gia đình' : 'Sửa bài viết',
        fields: {
          'content': 'Nội dung',
          'media': 'URL ảnh, ngăn cách bằng dấu xuống dòng',
          if (['admin', 'family_head'].contains(widget.user['role']))
            'announcement': 'Thông báo gia đình',
        },
        initial: {
          'content': row?['content'],
          'media': (row?['media_urls'] as List? ?? []).join('\n'),
          'announcement': '${row?['is_announcement'] ?? false}',
        },
        requiredFields: {'content'},
        choices: const {
          'announcement': {'false': 'Bài viết thường', 'true': 'Thông báo'},
        },
        save: (values) async {
          await widget.api.call(
            '/community/posts${row == null ? '' : '/${row['post_id']}'}',
            method: row == null ? 'POST' : 'PUT',
            body: {
              if (row == null) 'family_id': widget.family,
              'content': values['content'],
              'media': [
                for (final url
                    in (values['media'] as String)
                        .split('\n')
                        .map((s) => s.trim())
                        .where((s) => s.isNotEmpty))
                  {'url': url, 'type': 'image'},
              ],
              'is_announcement': values['announcement'] == 'true',
            },
          );
          reload();
        },
      );
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DataPane(
    key: ValueKey(page),
    load: () => widget.api.call(
      '/community/posts',
      query: {'family_id': widget.family, 'page': page, 'page_size': 12},
    ),
    builder: (data, reload) => pageList([
      ActionButton(
        'Viết bài',
        () => edit(context, reload),
        icon: Icons.edit_outlined,
      ),
      if ((data['items'] as List).isEmpty)
        const Text('Chưa có bài viết. Hãy chia sẻ câu chuyện đầu tiên.'),
      for (final raw in data['items'])
        Builder(
          builder: (context) {
            final row = raw as Json;
            final owner =
                row['author_id'] == widget.user['id'] ||
                widget.user['role'] == 'admin';
            return card([
              Text(
                row['author_name'] ?? 'Thành viên',
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
              ),
              Text(displayDate(row['created_at'])),
              if (row['is_announcement'] == true)
                const Text(
                  'THÔNG BÁO',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xff244b3e)),
                ),
              SelectableText(row['content']),
              for (final url in row['media_urls']) remoteImage(url),
              Text(
                '${row['reaction_count']} cảm xúc · ${row['comment_count']} bình luận',
              ),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                key: ValueKey('${row['post_id']}-${row['my_reaction']}'),
                initialValue: row['my_reaction'] ?? '',
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Cảm xúc'),
                items:
                    const {
                          '': 'Chưa thả cảm xúc',
                          'Like': 'Thích',
                          'Love': 'Yêu thích',
                          'Haha': 'Vui',
                          'Wow': 'Bất ngờ',
                          'Sad': 'Buồn',
                          'Angry': 'Giận',
                        }.entries
                        .map(
                          (e) => DropdownMenuItem(
                            value: e.key,
                            child: Text(e.value),
                          ),
                        )
                        .toList(),
                onChanged: (value) async {
                  try {
                    await widget.api.call(
                      '/community/posts/${row['post_id']}/reactions',
                      method: 'PUT',
                      body: {'type': value == '' ? null : value},
                    );
                    reload();
                  } catch (error) {
                    if (context.mounted) message(context, error);
                  }
                },
              ),
              Wrap(
                children: [
                  ActionButton('Bình luận', () async {
                    await openPage(
                      context,
                      'Bình luận',
                      CommentsScreen(
                        api: widget.api,
                        post: row['post_id'],
                        user: widget.user,
                      ),
                    );
                    reload();
                  }, icon: Icons.chat_bubble_outline),
                  ActionButton(
                    'Báo cáo',
                    () => report(context, widget.api, row['post_id'], 'post'),
                    icon: Icons.flag_outlined,
                  ),
                  if (owner) ...[
                    ActionButton(
                      'Sửa',
                      () => edit(context, reload, row),
                      icon: Icons.edit,
                    ),
                    ActionButton('Xóa', () async {
                      if (await confirm(
                        context,
                        'Xóa bài viết và các bình luận liên quan?',
                      )) {
                        await widget.api.call(
                          '/community/posts/${row['post_id']}',
                          method: 'DELETE',
                        );
                        reload();
                      }
                    }, icon: Icons.delete_outline),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ]);
          },
        ),
      pager(
        page,
        page * 12 < data['total'],
        (value) => setState(() => page = value),
      ),
    ]),
  );
}

Future<void> report(BuildContext context, Api api, String id, String type) =>
    formDialog(
      context,
      title: 'Báo cáo nội dung',
      fields: const {'reason': 'Lý do'},
      requiredFields: {'reason'},
      save: (values) async {
        await api.call(
          '/community/reports',
          method: 'POST',
          body: {
            'target_id': id,
            'target_type': type,
            'reason': values['reason'],
          },
        );
      },
    );
