import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

import 'api.dart';
import 'ui.dart';

class DirectoryScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const DirectoryScreen({super.key, required this.api, required this.family});
  final Api api;
  final String family;
  @override
  State<DirectoryScreen> createState() => _DirectoryScreenState();
}

class _DirectoryScreenState extends State<DirectoryScreen> {
  Json filters = {};
  int page = 1;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DataPane(
    key: ValueKey('$page-$filters'),
    load: () => widget.api.call(
      '/directory',
      query: {
        ...filters,
        'family_id': widget.family,
        'page': page,
        'page_size': 12,
      },
    ),
    builder: (data, reload) => pageList([
      ActionButton('Tìm kiếm và lọc', () async {
        final branches = await allPages(widget.api, '/genealogy/branches', {
          'family_id': widget.family,
        });
        if (!context.mounted) return;
        await formDialog(
          context,
          title: 'Tìm người thân',
          fields: const {
            'q': 'Họ tên',
            'occupation': 'Nghề nghiệp',
            'education': 'Học vấn',
            'location': 'Nơi ở',
            'generation': 'Thế hệ',
            'branch_id': 'Chi gia đình',
            'current_job': 'Công việc hiện tại',
          },
          initial: {
            ...filters,
            'current_job': '${filters['current_job'] ?? false}',
            'branch_id': filters['branch_id'] ?? '',
          },
          choices: {
            'branch_id': {
              '': 'Tất cả chi',
              for (final b in branches) b['id']: b['name'],
            },
            'current_job': {
              'false': 'Tất cả công việc',
              'true': 'Chỉ công việc hiện tại',
            },
          },
          save: (values) async {
            final generation = values['generation'] as String;
            if (generation.isNotEmpty &&
                (int.tryParse(generation) == null ||
                    int.parse(generation) < 1 ||
                    int.parse(generation) > 1000)) {
              throw ApiError('Thế hệ phải nằm trong khoảng 1 đến 1000.');
            }
            for (final field in {
              'q': 200,
              'occupation': 200,
              'education': 200,
              'location': 300,
            }.entries) {
              if ((values[field.key] as String).length > field.value) {
                throw ApiError('Thông tin tìm kiếm quá dài. Vui lòng rút gọn.');
              }
            }
            if (mounted) {
              setState(() {
                filters = {
                  ...values,
                  'current_job': values['current_job'] == 'true',
                };
                page = 1;
              });
            }
          },
        );
      }, icon: Icons.manage_search),
      Text('${data['total']} thành viên'),
      if ((data['items'] as List).isEmpty)
        const Text('Không có thành viên khớp bộ lọc.'),
      for (final row in data['items'])
        Card(
          child: ListTile(
            title: Text(row['name']),
            subtitle: Text(
              [
                row['location'],
                row['position'],
                row['institution'],
              ].whereType<String>().join(' · '),
            ),
            leading: const CircleAvatar(child: Icon(Icons.person_outline)),
            trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
            onTap: () => openPage(
              context,
              row['name'],
              MemberScreen(
                api: widget.api,
                family: widget.family,
                id: row['id'],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      pager(
        page,
        page * 12 < data['total'],
        (value) => setState(() => page = value),
      ),
    ]),
  );
}

class MemberScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const MemberScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.api,
    required this.family,
    required this.id,
  });
  final Api api;
  final String family, id;
  Future<void> edit(
    BuildContext context,
    String resource,
    VoidCallback reload, [
    Json? row,
  ]) => formDialog(
    context,
    title: resource == 'educations' ? 'Học vấn' : 'Công việc',
    fields: {
      if (resource == 'educations') ...{
        'institution': 'Trường / cơ sở đào tạo',
        'degree': 'Bằng cấp',
      } else ...{
        'company': 'Công ty',
        'position': 'Vị trí',
      },
      'start_date': 'Ngày bắt đầu (YYYY-MM-DD)',
      'end_date': 'Ngày kết thúc (YYYY-MM-DD, để trống nếu còn tiếp tục)',
    },
    initial: row ?? {},
    requiredFields: resource == 'educations'
        ? {'institution', 'degree'}
        : {'company', 'position'},
    save: (values) async {
      for (final key in ['start_date', 'end_date']) {
        if ((values[key] as String).isEmpty) values[key] = null;
      }
      await api.call(
        '/directory/$id/$resource${row == null ? '' : '/${row['id']}'}',
        method: row == null ? 'POST' : 'PUT',
        body: values,
      );
      reload();
    },
  );
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DataPane(
    load: () => api.call('/directory/$id', query: {'family_id': family}),
    builder: (data, reload) => pageList([
      heading(data['name']),
      Text(data['branch_name'] ?? 'Chưa phân chi'),
      Text(data['birth_date'] ?? 'Chưa cập nhật ngày sinh'),
      Text(data['location'] ?? 'Chưa cập nhật nơi ở'),
      for (final resource in ['educations', 'work']) ...[
        heading(resource == 'educations' ? 'Học vấn' : 'Công việc'),
        if (data['can_edit'] == true)
          ActionButton(
            'Thêm',
            () => edit(context, resource, reload),
            icon: Icons.add,
          ),
        if ((data[resource] as List).isEmpty) const Text('Chưa có thông tin.'),
        for (final raw in data[resource])
          Builder(
            builder: (context) {
              final row = raw as Json;
              return card([
                Text(
                  resource == 'educations'
                      ? '${row['institution']} · ${row['degree']}'
                      : '${row['company']} · ${row['position']}',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                ),
                Text(
                  '${row['start_date'] ?? 'Chưa rõ'} → ${row['end_date'] ?? 'Hiện tại'}',
                ),
                if (data['can_edit'] == true)
                  Wrap(
                    children: [
                      ActionButton(
                        'Sửa',
                        () => edit(context, resource, reload, row),
                        icon: Icons.edit_outlined,
                      ),
                      ActionButton('Xóa', () async {
                        if (await confirm(context, 'Xóa thông tin này?')) {
                          await api.call(
                            '/directory/$id/$resource/${row['id']}',
                            method: 'DELETE',
                          );
                          reload();
                        }
                      }, icon: Icons.delete_outline),
                    ],
                  ),
              ]);
            },
          ),
      ],
    ]),
  );
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

import 'api.dart';
import 'ui.dart';

const itemTypes = {
  'story': 'Câu chuyện',
  'document': 'Tài liệu',
  'photo': 'Ảnh',
};

class HeritageScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HeritageScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.api,
    required this.family,
    required this.user,
  });
  final Api api;
  final String family;
  final Json user;
  @override
  State<HeritageScreen> createState() => _HeritageScreenState();
}

class _HeritageScreenState extends State<HeritageScreen> {
  String resource = 'items', q = '', type = '';
  int page = 1;
  bool get manager => ['admin', 'family_head'].contains(widget.user['role']);
  Future<void> edit(
    BuildContext context,
    VoidCallback reload, [
    Json? row,
  ]) async {
    final members = resource == 'honors' && row == null
        ? await allPages(widget.api, '/heritage/members', {
            'family_id': widget.family,
          })
        : <Json>[];
    if (resource == 'honors' && row == null && members.isEmpty) {
      throw ApiError('Gia đình chưa có thành viên để vinh danh.');
    }
    if (!context.mounted) return;
    await formDialog(
      context,
      title: row == null ? 'Thêm mới' : 'Chỉnh sửa',
      fields: {
        'title': 'Tiêu đề',
        'description': 'Mô tả',
        if (resource == 'items') ...{
          'type': 'Loại tư liệu',
          'content': 'Nội dung',
          'media_url': 'URL HTTPS hoặc /media/',
        } else ...{
          if (row == null) 'member_id': 'Thành viên',
          'date_awarded': 'Ngày trao (YYYY-MM-DD)',
        },
      },
      initial: {'type': 'story', ...?row},
      requiredFields: {
        'title',
        if (resource == 'items') 'type' else if (row == null) 'member_id',
      },
      choices: {
        'type': itemTypes,
        if (members.isNotEmpty)
          'member_id': {for (final m in members) m['id']: m['full_name']},
      },
      save: (values) async {
        for (final key in [
          'description',
          'content',
          'media_url',
          'date_awarded',
        ]) {
          if (values[key] == '') values[key] = null;
        }
        if (row != null) values['expected_version'] = row['version_token'];
        await widget.api.call(
          '/heritage/$resource${row == null ? '' : '/${row['id']}'}',
          query: {'family_id': widget.family},
          method: row == null ? 'POST' : 'PATCH',
          body: values,
        );
        reload();
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DataPane(
    key: ValueKey('$resource-$page-$q-$type'),
    load: () => widget.api.call(
      '/heritage/$resource',
      query: {
        'family_id': widget.family,
        'page': page,
        'page_size': 12,
        'q': q,
        if (resource == 'items' && type.isNotEmpty) 'item_type': type,
      },
    ),
    builder: (data, reload) => pageList([
      SegmentedButton<String>(
        segments: const [
          ButtonSegment(value: 'items', label: Text('Di sản')),
          ButtonSegment(value: 'honors', label: Text('Vinh danh')),
          ButtonSegment(value: 'ranking', label: Text('Xếp hạng')),
        ],
        selected: {resource},
        onSelectionChanged: (value) => setState(() {
          resource = value.first;
          page = 1;
        }),
      ),
      Wrap(
        children: [
          ActionButton(
            'Tìm và lọc',
            () => formDialog(
              context,
              title: 'Tìm tư liệu',
              fields: {
                'q': 'Từ khóa',
                if (resource == 'items') 'type': 'Loại tư liệu',
              },
              initial: {'q': q, 'type': type},
              choices: const {
                'type': {'': 'Tất cả', ...itemTypes},
              },
              save: (values) async {
                if ((values['q'] as String).length > 200) {
                  throw ApiError('Từ khóa tìm kiếm tối đa 200 ký tự.');
                }
                if (mounted) {
                  setState(() {
                    q = values['q'];
                    type = values['type'] ?? '';
                    page = 1;
                  });
                }
              },
            ),
            icon: Icons.search,
          ),
          if (resource == 'items' || resource == 'honors' && manager)
            ActionButton(
              'Thêm mới',
              () => edit(context, reload),
              icon: Icons.add,
            ),
        ],
      ),
      if ((data['items'] as List).isEmpty)
        const Text('Chưa có dữ liệu khớp bộ lọc.'),
      for (final raw in data['items'])
        Builder(
          builder: (context) {
            final row = raw as Json;
            if (resource == 'ranking') {
              return ListTile(
                leading: CircleAvatar(child: Text('${row['rank']}')),
                title: Text(row['full_name']),
                subtitle: Text('${row['honor_count']} danh hiệu'),
              );
            }
            final canEdit = resource == 'honors'
                ? manager
                : manager || row['created_by_user_id'] == widget.user['id'];
            return card([
              heading(row['title']),
              if (resource == 'honors') Text(row['full_name']),
              if (row['description'] != null) Text(row['description']),
              if (resource == 'items') ...[
                Text(itemTypes[row['type']] ?? row['type']),
                if (row['type'] == 'photo')
                  remoteImage(
                    Uri.parse(widget.api.baseUrl)
                        .resolve(row['media_url'])
                        .toString(),
                  ),
                ActionButton(
                  'Xem nội dung',
                  () => openPage(
                    context,
                    row['title'],
                    pageList([
                      heading(row['title']),
                      if (row['content'] != null)
                        SelectableText(row['content']),
                      if (row['media_url'] != null) ...[
                        remoteImage(
                          Uri.parse(widget.api.baseUrl)
                              .resolve(row['media_url'])
                              .toString(),
                        ),
                        SelectableText(row['media_url']),
                        ActionButton(
                          'Mở tư liệu',
                          () => openMedia(widget.api, row['media_url']),
                          icon: Icons.open_in_browser,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ]),
                  ),
                  icon: Icons.open_in_new,
                ),
              ] else if (row['date_awarded'] != null)
                Text('Ngày trao: ${row['date_awarded']}'),
              if (canEdit)
                Wrap(
                  children: [
                    ActionButton(
                      'Sửa',
                      () => edit(context, reload, row),
                      icon: Icons.edit_outlined,
                    ),
                    ActionButton('Xóa', () async {
                      if (await confirm(context, 'Xóa ${row['title']}?')) {
                        await widget.api.call(
                          '/heritage/$resource/${row['id']}',
                          method: 'DELETE',
                          query: {
                            'family_id': widget.family,
                            'expected_version': row['version_token'],
                          },
                        );
                        reload();
                      }
                    }, icon: Icons.delete_outline),
                  ],
                ),
            ]);
          },
        ),
      pager(
        page,
        page * 12 < data['total'],
        (value) => setState(() => page = value),
      ),
    ]),
  );
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';
import 'package:flutter_secure_storage/flutter_secure_storage.dart';

import 'api.dart';
import 'reminders.dart';
import 'ui.dart';
import 'community.dart';
import 'calendar.dart';
import 'directory.dart';
import 'heritage.dart';
import 'profile.dart';

void main() {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  runApp(const FamilyConnectApp());
}

class FamilyConnectApp extends StatefulWidget {
  const FamilyConnectApp({super.key, this.api});
  final Api? api;
  @override
  State<FamilyConnectApp> createState() => _FamilyConnectAppState();
}

class _FamilyConnectAppState extends State<FamilyConnectApp>
    with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  late final Api api = widget.api ?? Api();
  final storage = const FlutterSecureStorage();
  final reminders = Reminders();
  final navigator = GlobalKey<NavigatorState>();
  Json? user;
  bool loading = true;
  String? bootError;
  Timer? timer;
  Future<void> cleanup = Future.value();
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    api.onUnauthorized = () {
      unawaited(logout());
    };
    unawaited(restore());
  }

  Future<void> restore() async {
    try {
      await reminders.initialize();
      api.token = await storage.read(key: 'familyconnect.token');
      if (api.token != null) user = await api.call('/auth/me') as Json;
      bootError = null;
    } catch (error) {
      bootError = '$error';
    }
    if (mounted) setState(() => loading = false);
    if (user != null) startSync();
  }

  void startSync() {
    timer?.cancel();
    timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(minutes: 1), (_) => sync());
    sync();
  }

  void sync() {
    if (api.token != null) {
      unawaited(reminders.sync(api).catchError((Object _) {}));
    }
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) sync();
  }

  Future<void> login(String email, String password, String? name) async {
    final session = await api.call(
      name == null ? '/auth/login' : '/auth/register',
      method: 'POST',
      body: {
        'email': email.trim(),
        'password': password,
        if (name != null) 'full_name': name.trim(),
      },
    ) as Json;
    await cleanup;
    await storage.write(
      key: 'familyconnect.token',
      value: session['access_token'],
    );
    api.token = session['access_token'];
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        user = session['user'];
        bootError = null;
      });
    }
    startSync();
  }

  Future<void> logout() async {
    timer?.cancel();
    api.token = null;
    navigator.currentState?.popUntil((route) => route.isFirst);
    cleanup = Future.wait([
      storage.delete(key: 'familyconnect.token'),
      reminders.clear(),
    ]).then((_) {});
    if (mounted) setState(() => user = null);
    await cleanup;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    timer?.cancel();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    api.client.close();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => MaterialApp(
    navigatorKey: navigator,
    title: 'FamilyConnect',
    locale: const Locale('vi'),
    supportedLocales: const [Locale('vi'), Locale('en')],
    localizationsDelegates: GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegates,
    debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
    theme: ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: const Color(0xff244b3e)),
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: const Color(0xfff7f5ef),
      inputDecorationTheme: const InputDecorationTheme(
        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
      ),
      appBarTheme: const AppBarTheme(backgroundColor: Color(0xfff7f5ef)),
    ),
    home: loading
        ? const Scaffold(body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()))
        : user == null
        ? LoginScreen(login: login, error: bootError)
        : Home(
            key: ValueKey(user!['id']),
            api: api,
            user: user!,
            reminders: reminders,
            logout: logout,
          ),
  );
}

class LoginScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const LoginScreen({super.key, required this.login, this.error});
  final Future<void> Function(String, String, String?) login;
  final String? error;
  @override
  State<LoginScreen> createState() => _LoginScreenState();
}

class _LoginScreenState extends State<LoginScreen> {
  final email = TextEditingController(),
      password = TextEditingController(),
      name = TextEditingController();
  final form = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  bool register = false;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    email.dispose();
    password.dispose();
    name.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Scaffold(
    body: SafeArea(
      child: Center(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 440),
            child: Form(
              key: form,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.diversity_1_outlined,
                    size: 48,
                    color: Color(0xff244b3e),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  heading('FamilyConnect'),
                  Text(
                    register
                        ? 'Tạo tài khoản gia đình'
                        : 'Chào bạn, mời đăng nhập',
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  if (register)
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                      child: TextFormField(
                        controller: name,
                        decoration: const InputDecoration(
                          labelText: 'Họ và tên',
                        ),
                        validator: (value) => (value?.trim().length ?? 0) < 2
                            ? 'Nhập họ và tên.'
                            : null,
                      ),
                    ),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: email,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
                    autocorrect: false,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Email'),
                    validator: (value) => (value?.contains('@') ?? false)
                        ? null
                        : 'Email chưa hợp lệ.',
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: password,
                    obscureText: true,
                    autocorrect: false,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Mật khẩu'),
                    validator: (value) =>
                        (value?.length ?? 0) < (register ? 8 : 1)
                        ? 'Mật khẩu ${register ? 'ít nhất 8 ký tự' : 'không được trống'}.'
                        : null,
                  ),
                  if (widget.error != null)
                    Text(
                      widget.error!,
                      style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  ActionButton(register ? 'Đăng ký' : 'Đăng nhập', () async {
                    if (form.currentState!.validate()) {
                      await widget.login(
                        email.text,
                        password.text,
                        register ? name.text : null,
                      );
                    }
                  }, icon: Icons.login),
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: () => setState(() => register = !register),
                    child: Text(
                      register
                          ? 'Đã có tài khoản? Đăng nhập'
                          : 'Chưa có tài khoản? Đăng ký',
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );
}

class Home extends StatefulWidget {
  const Home({
    super.key,
    required this.api,
    required this.user,
    required this.reminders,
    required this.logout,
  });
  final Api api;
  final Json user;
  final Reminders reminders;
  final Future<void> Function() logout;
  @override
  State<Home> createState() => _HomeState();
}

class _HomeState extends State<Home> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  List<dynamic> families = [];
  String? family;
  Json? profile;
  int tab = 0, revision = 0;
  String? error;
  bool loading = true;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    unawaited(load());
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) unawaited(load());
  }

  Future<void> load() async {
    try {
      final fresh = await widget.api.call('/genealogy/me') as Json;
      final list = fresh['user']['role'] == 'guest'
          ? <dynamic>[]
          : await widget.api.call('/heritage/families') as List;
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() {
        profile = fresh;
        families = list;
        if (!families.any((row) => row['id'] == family)) {
          family = families.firstOrNull?['id'];
        }
        if (family == null) tab = 5;
        error = null;
        loading = false;
        revision++;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          error = '$e';
          loading = false;
        });
      }
    }
  }

  static const labels = [
    'Bảng tin',
    'Lịch',
    'Danh bạ',
    'Di sản',
    'Thông báo',
    'Hồ sơ',
  ];
  static const icons = [
    Icons.forum_outlined,
    Icons.calendar_month,
    Icons.people_outline,
    Icons.auto_stories_outlined,
    Icons.notifications_outlined,
    Icons.person_outline,
  ];
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final api = widget.api, user = profile?['user'] as Json? ?? widget.user;
    final member = profile?['member'];
    final memberId = member != null && member['family_id'] == family
        ? member['id'] as String?
        : null;
    final body = loading
        ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
        : error != null
        ? pageList([Text(error!), ActionButton('Thử lại', load)])
        : tab == 5
        ? ProfileScreen(api: api, updated: load)
        : tab == 4
        ? InboxScreen(api: api, reminders: widget.reminders)
        : family == null
        ? pageList([
            const Text(
              'Chưa liên kết gia đình. Gửi yêu cầu xác minh trong Hồ sơ.',
            ),
          ])
        : switch (tab) {
            0 => CommunityScreen(api: api, family: family!, user: user),
            1 => CalendarScreen(
              api: api,
              family: family!,
              memberId: memberId,
              reminders: widget.reminders,
              user: user,
            ),
            2 => DirectoryScreen(api: api, family: family!),
            _ => HeritageScreen(api: api, family: family!, user: user),
          };
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(labels[tab]),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            tooltip: 'Làm mới hồ sơ',
            onPressed: load,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
          ),
          ActionButton('Đăng xuất', widget.logout, icon: Icons.logout),
        ],
      ),
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            if (families.isNotEmpty)
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  horizontal: 16,
                  vertical: 8,
                ),
                child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  key: ValueKey(family),
                  initialValue: family,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Gia đình'),
                  items: families
                      .map(
                        (row) => DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                          value: row['id'],
                          child: Text(
                            row['name'],
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                      )
                      .toList(),
                  onChanged: (value) => setState(() => family = value),
                ),
              ),
            Expanded(
              child: KeyedSubtree(
                key: ValueKey('${user['role']}-$family-$tab-$revision'),
                child: body,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: NavigationBar(
        selectedIndex: tab,
        labelBehavior: NavigationDestinationLabelBehavior.onlyShowSelected,
        onDestinationSelected: (value) => setState(() => tab = value),
        destinations: [
          for (var i = 0; i < labels.length; i++)
            NavigationDestination(icon: Icon(icons[i]), label: labels[i]),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class InboxScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const InboxScreen({super.key, required this.api, required this.reminders});
  final Api api;
  final Reminders reminders;
  @override
  State<InboxScreen> createState() => _InboxScreenState();
}

class _InboxScreenState extends State<InboxScreen> {
  int page = 1, revision = 0;
  Timer? timer;
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 15), (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => revision++);
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DataPane(
    key: ValueKey('$page-$revision'),
    load: () => widget.api.call(
      '/notifications',
      query: {'page': page, 'page_size': 20},
    ),
    builder: (data, reload) => pageList([
      ActionButton('Bật nhắc lịch Android', () async {
        final granted = await widget.reminders.enable();
        if (granted) await widget.reminders.sync(widget.api);
        if (context.mounted) {
          message(
            context,
            !granted
                ? 'Chưa cấp quyền thông báo.'
                : widget.reminders.exact
                ? 'Đã bật nhắc lịch.'
                : 'Đã bật. Android có thể trì hoãn khi chưa cấp quyền báo thức chính xác.',
          );
        }
      }, icon: Icons.notifications_active_outlined),
      Text('${data['unread']} thông báo chưa đọc'),
      if ((data['items'] as List).isEmpty) const Text('Chưa có thông báo.'),
      for (final row in data['items'])
        card([
          heading(row['title']),
          Text(row['body']),
          Text(displayDate(row['created_at'])),
          if (row['read_at'] == null)
            ActionButton('Đánh dấu đã đọc', () async {
              await widget.api.call(
                '/notifications/${row['id']}/read',
                method: 'PATCH',
              );
              reload();
            }, icon: Icons.done),
          if (row['event_id'] != null)
            ActionButton('Xem sự kiện', () async {
              final profile = await widget.api.call('/genealogy/me');
              final own = profile['member'];
              if (context.mounted) {
                await openPage(
                  context,
                  'Sự kiện',
                  EventScreen(
                    api: widget.api,
                    id: row['event_id'],
                    reminders: widget.reminders,
                    memberId:
                        own != null && own['family_id'] == row['family_id']
                        ? own['id']
                        : null,
                  ),
                );
              }
            }, icon: Icons.event),
        ]),
      pager(
        page,
        page * 20 < data['total'],
        (value) => setState(() => page = value),
      ),
    ]),
  );
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

import 'api.dart';
import 'ui.dart';

class ProfileScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const ProfileScreen({super.key, required this.api, required this.updated});
  final Api api;
  final Future<void> Function() updated;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => DataPane(
    load: () => api.call('/genealogy/me'),
    builder: (data, reload) {
      final user = data['user'] as Json, member = data['member'] as Json?;
      return pageList([
        heading(user['full_name']),
        Text(user['email']),
        Text('Vai trò: ${user['role']}'),
        ActionButton(
          'Sửa hồ sơ',
          () => formDialog(
            context,
            title: 'Hồ sơ cá nhân',
            fields: const {
              'name': 'Họ và tên',
              'birth_date': 'Ngày sinh (YYYY-MM-DD)',
              'location': 'Nơi ở',
            },
            initial: {
              'name': user['full_name'],
              'birth_date': member?['birth_date'],
              'location': member?['location'],
            },
            requiredFields: {'name'},
            save: (body) async {
              if (body['birth_date'] == '') body['birth_date'] = null;
              await api.call('/genealogy/me', method: 'PUT', body: body);
              reload();
              await updated();
            },
          ),
          icon: Icons.edit_outlined,
        ),
        if (member != null)
          card([
            heading(member['family_name']),
            Text(member['branch_name'] ?? 'Chưa phân chi'),
            Text(member['birth_date'] ?? 'Chưa cập nhật ngày sinh'),
            Text(member['location'] ?? 'Chưa cập nhật nơi ở'),
          ]),
        if (member == null && user['role'] != 'guest') ...[
          const Text(
            'Liên kết hồ sơ gia phả bằng tên gia đình và họ tên chính xác. Quản lý sẽ duyệt yêu cầu.',
          ),
          ActionButton(
            'Tìm hồ sơ để xác minh',
            () => openPage(
              context,
              'Xác minh hồ sơ',
              VerificationScreen(api: api, updated: updated),
            ),
            icon: Icons.verified_user_outlined,
          ),
        ],
        heading('Lịch sử xác minh'),
        if ((data['verifications'] as List).isEmpty)
          const Text('Chưa gửi yêu cầu.'),
        for (final row in data['verifications'])
          card([
            Text('${row['name']} · ${row['family_name']}'),
            Text(
              const {
                    'pending': 'Đang chờ duyệt',
                    'approved': 'Đã duyệt',
                    'rejected': 'Đã từ chối',
                  }[row['status']] ??
                  row['status'],
            ),
            Text(displayDate(row['created_at'])),
          ]),
      ]);
    },
  );
}

class VerificationScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const VerificationScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.api,
    required this.updated,
  });
  final Api api;
  final Future<void> Function() updated;
  @override
  State<VerificationScreen> createState() => _VerificationScreenState();
}

class _VerificationScreenState extends State<VerificationScreen> {
  Json? search;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      ActionButton(
        'Nhập thông tin tìm kiếm',
        () => formDialog(
          context,
          title: 'Tìm hồ sơ',
          fields: const {
            'family_name': 'Tên gia đình chính xác',
            'full_name': 'Họ và tên chính xác',
            'birth_date': 'Ngày sinh (YYYY-MM-DD, tùy chọn)',
          },
          requiredFields: {'family_name', 'full_name'},
          initial: search ?? {},
          save: (values) async {
            if (mounted) setState(() => search = values);
          },
        ),
        icon: Icons.search,
      ),
      Expanded(
        child: search == null
            ? const Center(child: Text('Nhập thông tin gia đình để tìm hồ sơ.'))
            : DataPane(
                key: ValueKey('$search'),
                load: () => widget.api.call(
                  '/genealogy/verification-candidates',
                  query: search!,
                ),
                builder: (data, reload) => pageList([
                  if ((data as List).isEmpty)
                    const Text(
                      'Không tìm thấy hồ sơ chưa liên kết khớp thông tin.',
                    ),
                  for (final row in data)
                    card([
                      heading(row['name']),
                      Text(row['family_name']),
                      Text(row['branch_name'] ?? 'Chưa phân chi'),
                      ActionButton('Đây là hồ sơ của tôi', () async {
                        await widget.api.call(
                          '/genealogy/verifications',
                          method: 'POST',
                          body: {'member_id': row['id']},
                        );
                        await widget.updated();
                        if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
                      }, icon: Icons.check_circle_outline),
                    ]),
                ]),
              ),
      ),
    ],
  );
}

# FILE: apps/mobile/lib/reminders.dart
################################################################################
import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
import 'package:timezone/data/latest.dart' as tz_data;
import 'package:timezone/timezone.dart' as tz;

import 'api.dart';

List<Json> futureReminders(List<dynamic> rows, DateTime now) =>
    rows
        .cast<Json>()
        .where((row) => utcDate(row['reminder_time']).isAfter(now))
        .toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => '${a['id']}'.compareTo('${b['id']}'));

class Reminders {
  final plugin = FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin();
  bool enabled = false;
  bool exact = false;
  int generation = 0;
  Future<void> pending = Future.value();

  Future<void> initialize() async {
    tz_data.initializeTimeZones();
    await plugin.initialize(
      settings: const InitializationSettings(
        android: AndroidInitializationSettings('ic_notification'),
      ),
    );
    final android = plugin
        .resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<
          AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin
        >();
    enabled = await android?.areNotificationsEnabled() ?? false;
    exact = await android?.canScheduleExactNotifications() ?? false;
  }

  Future<bool> enable() async {
    final android = plugin
        .resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<
          AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin
        >();
    enabled = await android?.requestNotificationsPermission() ?? false;
    if (enabled) exact = await android?.requestExactAlarmsPermission() ?? false;
    return enabled;
  }

  Future<void> clear() {
    generation++;
    return pending = pending
        .catchError((Object _) {})
        .then((_) => plugin.cancelAll());
  }

  Future<void> sync(Api api) async {
    final version = ++generation, session = api.token;
    if (session == null || !enabled) return;
    final rows = await api.call('/notifications/reminders') as List;
    if (version != generation || api.token != session) return;
    // shortcut: changes made while the app is closed sync on resume; use FCM for live remote cancellation.
    pending = pending.catchError((Object _) {}).then((_) async {
      if (version != generation || api.token != session) return;
      final plan = futureReminders(rows, DateTime.now());
      final wanted = plan.map((row) => row['id']).toSet();
      final existing = await plugin.pendingNotificationRequests();
      final ids = {for (final row in existing) row.payload: row.id};
      for (final row in existing) {
        if (!wanted.contains(row.payload)) await plugin.cancel(id: row.id);
      }
      var nextId = 1;
      for (final row in plan) {
        if (version != generation || api.token != session) return;
        while (ids.values.contains(nextId)) {
          nextId++;
        }
        final id = ids[row['id']] ?? nextId++;
        ids[row['id']] = id;
        final when = utcDate(row['reminder_time']);
        if (!when.isAfter(DateTime.now())) continue;
        await plugin.zonedSchedule(
          id: id,
          title: 'FamilyConnect',
          body: 'Bạn có nhắc lịch sự kiện. Mở app để xem chi tiết.',
          scheduledDate: tz.TZDateTime.from(when, tz.UTC),
          notificationDetails: const NotificationDetails(
            android: AndroidNotificationDetails(
              'family_events',
              'Nhắc lịch gia đình',
              importance: Importance.high,
              priority: Priority.high,
              visibility: NotificationVisibility.private,
            ),
          ),
          androidScheduleMode: exact
              ? AndroidScheduleMode.exactAllowWhileIdle
              : AndroidScheduleMode.inexactAllowWhileIdle,
          payload: row['id'],
        );
      }
    });
    await pending;
  }
}

import 'package:material_ui/material_ui.dart';

import 'api.dart';

void message(BuildContext context, Object error) {
  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('$error')));
}

class ActionButton extends StatefulWidget {
  const ActionButton(this.label, this.action, {super.key, this.icon});
  final String label;
  final Future<void> Function()? action;
  final IconData? icon;
  @override
  State<ActionButton> createState() => _ActionButtonState();
}

class _ActionButtonState extends State<ActionButton> {
  bool busy = false;
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => TextButton.icon(
    onPressed: busy || widget.action == null
        ? null
        : () async {
            setState(() => busy = true);
            try {
              await widget.action!();
            } catch (error) {
              if (context.mounted) message(context, error);
            } finally {
              if (mounted) setState(() => busy = false);
            }
          },
    icon: busy
        ? const SizedBox(
            width: 16,
            height: 16,
            child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
          )
        : Icon(widget.icon, size: 18),
    label: Text(widget.label),
  );
}

class DataPane extends StatefulWidget {
  const DataPane({super.key, required this.load, required this.builder});
  final Future<dynamic> Function() load;
  final Widget Function(dynamic, VoidCallback) builder;
  @override
  State<DataPane> createState() => _DataPaneState();
}

class _DataPaneState extends State<DataPane> {
  late Future<dynamic> future = widget.load();
  void reload() {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        future = widget.load();
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => FutureBuilder<dynamic>(
    future: future,
    builder: (context, snapshot) {
      if (snapshot.connectionState != ConnectionState.done) {
        return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
      }
      if (snapshot.hasError) {
        return Center(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                Text('${snapshot.error}'),
                TextButton(onPressed: reload, child: const Text('Thử lại')),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      }
      return RefreshIndicator(
        onRefresh: () async {
          reload();
          try {
            await future;
          } catch (_) {}
        },
        child: widget.builder(snapshot.data, reload),
      );
    },
  );
}

  ],
);

      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        for (final child in children)
          Padding(padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8), child: child),
      ],
    ),
  ),
);

Widget heading(String text) => Text(
  text,
  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, fontWeight: FontWeight.w700),
);

Widget remoteImage(String? url) {
  if (url == null ||
      !RegExp(r'^https?://', caseSensitive: false).hasMatch(url)) {
    return const SizedBox.shrink();
  }
  return ClipRRect(
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
    child: Image.network(
      url,
      height: 180,
      fit: BoxFit.cover,
      errorBuilder: (_, _, _) => const Text('Không tải được ảnh.'),
    ),
  );
}

    ),
    Text('Trang $page'),
    TextButton(
      onPressed: more ? () => change(page + 1) : null,
      child: const Text('Trang tiếp'),
    ),
  ],
);

Future<bool> confirm(BuildContext context, String text) async =>
    await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialog) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Xác nhận'),
        content: Text(text),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialog, false),
            child: const Text('Hủy'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialog, true),
            child: const Text('Xác nhận'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    ) ??
    false;

Future<void> formDialog(
  BuildContext context, {
  required String title,
  required Map<String, String> fields,
  Json initial = const {},
  Set<String> requiredFields = const {},
  Map<String, Map<String, String>> choices = const {},
  required Future<void> Function(Json) save,
}) => showDialog<void>(
  context: context,
  barrierDismissible: false,
  builder: (_) => _RecordForm(
    title: title,
    fields: fields,
    initial: initial,
    requiredFields: requiredFields,
    choices: choices,
    save: save,
  ),
);

class _RecordForm extends StatefulWidget {
  const _RecordForm({
    required this.title,
    required this.fields,
    required this.initial,
    required this.requiredFields,
    required this.choices,
    required this.save,
  });
  final String title;
  final Map<String, String> fields;
  final Json initial;
  final Set<String> requiredFields;
  final Map<String, Map<String, String>> choices;
  final Future<void> Function(Json) save;
  @override
  State<_RecordForm> createState() => _RecordFormState();
}

class _RecordFormState extends State<_RecordForm> {
  late final controllers = {
    for (final key in widget.fields.keys)
      key: TextEditingController(text: widget.initial[key]?.toString() ?? ''),
  };
  final form = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  bool saving = false;
  @override
  void dispose() {
    for (final controller in controllers.values) {
      controller.dispose();
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => PopScope(
    canPop: !saving,
    child: AlertDialog(
      title: Text(widget.title),
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 440,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Form(
            key: form,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                for (final field in widget.fields.entries)
                  Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
                    child: widget.choices.containsKey(field.key)
                        ? DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                            initialValue: controllers[field.key]!.text.isEmpty
                                ? null
                                : controllers[field.key]!.text,
                            isExpanded: true,
                            decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: field.value),
                            items: widget.choices[field.key]!.entries
                                .map(
                                  (e) => DropdownMenuItem(
                                    value: e.key,
                                    child: Text(
                                      e.value,
                                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                )
                                .toList(),
                            onChanged: saving
                                ? null
                                : (value) => controllers[field.key]!.text =
                                      value ?? '',
                            validator: (value) =>
                                widget.requiredFields.contains(field.key) &&
                                    (value == null || value.isEmpty)
                                ? 'Vui lòng chọn giá trị.'
                                : null,
                          )
                        : TextFormField(
                            enabled: !saving,
                            controller: controllers[field.key],
                            decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: field.value),
                            minLines:
                                [
                                  'content',
                                  'description',
                                  'media',
                                ].contains(field.key)
                                ? 3
                                : 1,
                            maxLines:
                                [
                                  'content',
                                  'description',
                                  'media',
                                ].contains(field.key)
                                ? 5
                                : 1,
                            validator: (value) =>
                                widget.requiredFields.contains(field.key) &&
                                    (value?.trim().isEmpty ?? true)
                                ? 'Vui lòng nhập thông tin.'
                                : null,
                          ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: saving ? null : () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('Hủy'),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          onPressed: saving
              ? null
              : () async {
                  if (!form.currentState!.validate()) return;
                  setState(() => saving = true);
                  try {
                    await widget.save({
                      for (final entry in controllers.entries)
                        entry.key: entry.value.text.trim(),
                    });
                    if (context.mounted) Navigator.pop(context);
                  } catch (error) {
                    if (context.mounted) message(context, error);
                  } finally {
                    if (mounted) setState(() => saving = false);
                  }
                },
          child: Text(saving ? 'Đang lưu…' : 'Lưu'),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  );
}

# FILE: apps/mobile/src/features/directory/api.js

import { api } from '../../core/api';

// Đời 1..10. Backend chưa có API trả số đời tối đa nên dùng danh sách cố định.
export const GENERATION_OPTIONS = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => i + 1);

// GET /api/genealogy/directory -> genealogy.usp_SearchDirectory
// Trả về { items, total }. Mỗi item: id, full_name, birth_date, location, generation,
// latest_position, latest_company, latest_institution, latest_degree.
export async function fetchDirectory(familyId, filters = {}) {
  const keyword = (filters.keyword || '').trim();
  const occupation = (filters.occupation || '').trim();
  const education = (filters.education || '').trim();
  const pageNumber = Math.max(1, Number(filters.pageNumber) || 1);
  const pageSize = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Number(filters.pageSize) || 50));

  const data = await api.get('/genealogy/directory', {
    family_id: familyId,
    keyword: keyword || undefined,
    occupation: occupation || undefined,
    // usp_SearchDirectory chỉ áp dụng "đang công tác" cùng với ô nghề nghiệp
    only_current_job: occupation && filters.onlyCurrentJob ? true : undefined,
    education: education || undefined,
    generation: filters.generation || undefined,
    branch_id: filters.branchId || undefined,
    page: pageNumber,
    page_size: pageSize,
  });

  return { items: data.items, total: data.total };
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Modal,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';

import { fetchDirectory, GENERATION_OPTIONS } from './api';

const PAGE_SIZE = 8;

const EMPTY_FILTERS = {
  generation: null,
  occupation: '',
  education: '',
  onlyCurrentJob: false,
};

function getInitials(name) {
  return name
    .trim()
    .split(/\s+/)
    .slice(-2)
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase();
}

function FilterChip({ label, selected, disabled, onPress }) {
  return (
    <TouchableOpacity
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityState={{ selected, disabled }}
      disabled={disabled}
      onPress={onPress}
      style={[
        styles.chip,
        selected && styles.chipSelected,
        disabled && styles.disabledButton,
      ]}
    >
      <Text style={[styles.chipText, selected && styles.chipTextSelected]}>
        {label}
      </Text>
    </TouchableOpacity>
  );
}

function MemberCard({ member }) {
  const job = [member.latest_position, member.latest_company]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' · ');
  const education = [member.latest_degree, member.latest_institution]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' · ');

  return (
    <View style={styles.card}>
      <View style={styles.memberHeader}>
        <View style={styles.avatar}>
          <Text style={styles.avatarText}>{getInitials(member.full_name)}</Text>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.memberHeading}>
          <Text style={styles.memberName}>{member.full_name}</Text>
          <Text style={styles.meta}>
            Đời thứ {member.generation}
            {member.birth_date
              ? ` · ${new Date(`${member.birth_date}T00:00:00`).getFullYear()}`
              : ''}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>

      {member.location ? (
        <Text style={styles.detail}>Địa chỉ: {member.location}</Text>
      ) : null}

      {job ? (
        <View style={styles.detailBlock}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>Công việc gần nhất</Text>
          <Text style={styles.detail}>{job}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {education ? (
        <View style={styles.detailBlock}>
          <Text style={styles.label}>Học vấn gần nhất</Text>
          <Text style={styles.detail}>{education}</Text>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function DirectoryScreen({ familyId }) {
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = useState('');
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({ ...EMPTY_FILTERS });
  const [draftFilters, setDraftFilters] = useState({ ...EMPTY_FILTERS });
  const [filterVisible, setFilterVisible] = useState(false);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState([]);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [revision, setRevision] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;

    if (!familyId) {
      setMembers([]);
      setTotal(0);
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
      setError('Chưa chọn gia đình.');
      return undefined;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError('');

    fetchDirectory(familyId, {
      ...filters,
      keyword,
      pageNumber: page,
      pageSize: PAGE_SIZE,
    })
      .then((result) => {
        if (!active) return;
        setMembers(result.items);
        setTotal(result.total);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        if (active) setError(err.message || 'Không tải được danh bạ.');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [familyId, filters, keyword, page, revision]);

  const activeFilterCount = [
    filters.generation,
    filters.occupation.trim(),
    filters.education.trim(),
    filters.onlyCurrentJob,
  ].filter(Boolean).length;

  function openFilters() {
    setDraftFilters({ ...filters });
    setFilterVisible(true);
  }

  function applyFilters() {
    const occupation = draftFilters.occupation.trim();
    setFilters({
      generation: draftFilters.generation,
      occupation,
      education: draftFilters.education.trim(),
      // chỉ có nghĩa khi đã nhập nghề nghiệp
      onlyCurrentJob: occupation ? draftFilters.onlyCurrentJob : false,
    });
    setPage(1);
    setFilterVisible(false);
  }

  function clearFilters() {
    setFilters({ ...EMPTY_FILTERS });
    setDraftFilters({ ...EMPTY_FILTERS });
    setPage(1);
    setFilterVisible(false);
  }

  function refresh() {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setRevision((value) => value + 1);
  }

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / PAGE_SIZE));

  return (
    <View style={styles.screen}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <Text style={styles.title}>Danh bạ gia đình</Text>
        <Text style={styles.subtitle}>{total} thành viên</Text>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.searchRow}>
        <TextInput
          accessibilityLabel="Tìm thành viên"
          style={styles.searchInput}
          placeholder="Tìm theo tên thành viên..."
          value={keyword}
          onChangeText={(text) => {
            setKeyword(text);
            setPage(1);
          }}
          returnKeyType="search"
        />

        <TouchableOpacity
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Mở bộ lọc"
          style={styles.filterButton}
          onPress={openFilters}
        >
          <Text style={styles.filterButtonText}>
            Bộ lọc{activeFilterCount ? ` (${activeFilterCount})` : ''}
          </Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {error ? (
        <View accessibilityRole="alert" style={styles.errorBox}>
          <Text style={styles.errorText}>{error}</Text>
          <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setRevision((value) => value + 1)}>
            <Text style={styles.retryText}>Thử lại</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {loading && !refreshing ? (
        <ActivityIndicator
          accessibilityLabel="Đang tải danh bạ"
          color="#1565c0"
          style={styles.loading}
        />
      ) : null}

      <FlatList
        data={members}
        keyExtractor={(member) => member.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => <MemberCard member={item} />}
        contentContainerStyle={[
          styles.listContent,
          members.length === 0 && styles.emptyList,
        ]}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl refreshing={refreshing} onRefresh={refresh} />
        }
        ListEmptyComponent={
          !loading && !error ? (
            <Text style={styles.emptyText}>
              Không tìm thấy thành viên phù hợp.
            </Text>
          ) : null
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          total > PAGE_SIZE ? (
            <View style={styles.pagination}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                disabled={page <= 1 || loading}
                onPress={() => setPage((value) => value - 1)}
                style={[
                  styles.pageButton,
                  (page <= 1 || loading) && styles.disabledButton,
                ]}
              >
                <Text style={styles.pageButtonText}>Trước</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>

              <Text style={styles.pageText}>
                Trang {page} / {totalPages}
              </Text>

              <TouchableOpacity
                disabled={page >= totalPages || loading}
                onPress={() => setPage((value) => value + 1)}
                style={[
                  styles.pageButton,
                  (page >= totalPages || loading) && styles.disabledButton,
                ]}
              >
                <Text style={styles.pageButtonText}>Sau</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          ) : null
        }
      />

      <Modal
        visible={filterVisible}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setFilterVisible(false)}
      >
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View style={styles.filterSheet}>
            <View style={styles.sheetHeader}>
              <Text style={styles.sheetTitle}>Bộ lọc danh bạ</Text>
              <TouchableOpacity onPress={() => setFilterVisible(false)}>
                <Text style={styles.closeText}>Đóng</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <ScrollView
              style={styles.filterContent}
              keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            >
              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Thế hệ</Text>
              <View style={styles.chipGroup}>
                <FilterChip
                  label="Tất cả"
                  selected={!draftFilters.generation}
                  onPress={() =>
                    setDraftFilters((current) => ({
                      ...current,
                      generation: null,
                    }))
                  }
                />
                {GENERATION_OPTIONS.map((generation) => (
                  <FilterChip
                    key={generation}
                    label={`Đời ${generation}`}
                    selected={draftFilters.generation === generation}
                    onPress={() =>
                      setDraftFilters((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        generation:
                          current.generation === generation
                            ? null
                            : generation,
                      }))
                    }
                  />
                ))}
              </View>

              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Nghề nghiệp / công ty</Text>
              <TextInput
                accessibilityLabel="Lọc theo nghề nghiệp hoặc công ty"
                style={styles.filterInput}
                placeholder="Ví dụ: bác sĩ, công nghệ..."
                value={draftFilters.occupation}
                onChangeText={(text) =>
                  setDraftFilters((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    occupation: text,
                  }))
                }
              />

              <Text style={styles.sectionTitle}>Học vấn</Text>
              <TextInput
                accessibilityLabel="Lọc theo học vấn"
                style={styles.filterInput}
                placeholder="Tên trường hoặc bằng cấp..."
                value={draftFilters.education}
                onChangeText={(text) =>
                  setDraftFilters((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    education: text,
                  }))
                }
              />

              <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                <FilterChip
                  label="Chỉ tính công việc hiện tại (cùng ô nghề nghiệp)"
                  selected={
                    draftFilters.onlyCurrentJob &&
                    Boolean(draftFilters.occupation.trim())
                  }
                  disabled={!draftFilters.occupation.trim()}
                  onPress={() =>
                    setDraftFilters((current) => ({
                      ...current,
                      onlyCurrentJob: !current.onlyCurrentJob,
                    }))
                  }
                />
              </View>
            </ScrollView>

            <View style={styles.sheetActions}>
              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.clearButton}
                onPress={clearFilters}
              >
                <Text style={styles.clearButtonText}>Xóa lọc</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>

              <TouchableOpacity
                style={styles.applyButton}
                onPress={applyFilters}
              >
                <Text style={styles.applyButtonText}>Áp dụng</Text>
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}

# FILE: apps/mobile/test/api_test.dart

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';
import 'package:familyconnect/api.dart';
import 'package:familyconnect/reminders.dart';

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  test('media opens safe links and resolves existing server files', () async {
    const channel = MethodChannel('familyconnect/links');
    String? opened;
    final messenger =
        TestDefaultBinaryMessengerBinding.instance.defaultBinaryMessenger;
    messenger.setMockMethodCallHandler(channel, (call) async {
      opened = call.arguments['url'];
      return null;
    });
    addTearDown(() => messenger.setMockMethodCallHandler(channel, null));
    final api = Api(baseUrl: 'https://family.example/api');
    await openMedia(api, '/media/story.pdf');
    expect(opened, 'https://family.example/media/story.pdf');
    await expectLater(
      openMedia(api, 'javascript:alert(1)'),
      throwsA(isA<ApiError>()),
    );
    await expectLater(
      openMedia(api, 'https://user:password@example.com/file'),
      throwsA(isA<ApiError>()),
    );
  });
  test(
    'requests use the current bearer, encoded filters and a JSON body',
    () async {
      final api = Api(
        baseUrl: 'http://localhost/api',
        client: MockClient((request) async {
          expect(request.headers['Authorization'], 'Bearer current');
          expect(request.url.queryParameters['q'], 'Nguyễn & Chiến');
          expect(jsonDecode(request.body), {'content': 'Gia đình'});
          expect(request.method, 'PUT');
          return http.Response('', 204);
        }),
      )..token = 'current';
      expect(
        await api.call(
          '/community/comments/one',
          method: 'PUT',
          query: {'q': 'Nguyễn & Chiến', 'skip': null},
          body: {'content': 'Gia đình'},
        ),
        isNull,
      );
    },
  );
  test('a late 401 cannot clear a newer session', () async {
    final response = Completer<http.Response>();
    final api = Api(client: MockClient((_) => response.future))..token = 'old';
    var cleared = false;
    api.onUnauthorized = () => cleared = true;
    final request = api.call('/auth/me');
    api.token = 'new';
    response.complete(http.Response('{"detail":"Expired"}', 401));
    await expectLater(request, throwsA(isA<ApiError>()));
    expect(api.token, 'new');
    expect(cleared, false);
  });
  test(
    'current 401 clears session and returns the server validation error',
    () async {
      final api = Api(
        client: MockClient(
          (_) async =>
              http.Response('{"detail":[{"msg":"Invalid value"}]}', 401),
        ),
      )..token = 'expired';
      var cleared = false;
      api.onUnauthorized = () => cleared = true;
      await expectLater(
        api.call('/auth/me'),
        throwsA(predicate((e) => '$e' == 'Invalid value')),
      );
      expect(api.token, isNull);
      expect(cleared, true);
    },
  );
  test(
    'selectors load every page including members beyond the first 100',
    () async {
      final api = Api(
        client: MockClient((request) async {
          final page = int.parse(request.url.queryParameters['page']!);
          return http.Response(
            jsonEncode({
              'items': [
                {'id': 'member-$page'},
              ],
              'total': 2,
            }),
            200,
          );
        }),
      );
      expect(
        (await allPages(api, '/heritage/members', {
          'family_id': 'family',
        })).map((r) => r['id']),
        ['member-1', 'member-2'],
      );
    },
  );
  test(
    'SQL dates without a suffix are UTC and expired reminders are excluded',
    () {
      expect(utcDate('2027-01-01T00:00:00').toUtc(), DateTime.utc(2027));
      final plan = futureReminders([
        {'id': 'past', 'reminder_time': '2026-12-31T23:59:59'},
        {'id': 'later', 'reminder_time': '2027-01-01T01:00:00Z'},
        {'id': 'at-now', 'reminder_time': '2027-01-01T00:00:00Z'},
      ], DateTime.utc(2027));
      expect(plan.map((r) => r['id']), ['later']);
    },
  );
}

# FILE: apps/mobile/test/reminders_test.dart
################################################################################
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:familyconnect/api.dart';
import 'package:familyconnect/reminders.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_local_notifications/flutter_local_notifications.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
  const channel = MethodChannel('dexterous.com/flutter/local_notifications');
  final messenger =
      TestDefaultBinaryMessengerBinding.instance.defaultBinaryMessenger;
  final scheduled = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
  late Reminders reminders;
  late List<Json> rows;

  setUp(() async {
    debugDefaultTargetPlatformOverride = TargetPlatform.android;
    AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin.registerWith();
    scheduled.clear();
    rows = [
      {
        'id': 'cancelled',
        'reminder_time': DateTime.now()
            .toUtc()
            .add(const Duration(days: 2))
            .toIso8601String(),
      },
    ];
    messenger.setMockMethodCallHandler(channel, (call) async {
      switch (call.method) {
        case 'pendingNotificationRequests':
          return scheduled.map((row) => Map<String, dynamic>.of(row)).toList();
        case 'zonedSchedule':
          final args = Map<String, dynamic>.from(call.arguments);
          scheduled.removeWhere((row) => row['id'] == args['id']);
          scheduled.add(args);
        case 'cancel':
          scheduled.removeWhere((row) => row['id'] == call.arguments['id']);
        case 'cancelAll':
          scheduled.clear();
        case 'initialize':
        case 'areNotificationsEnabled':
          return true;
        case 'canScheduleExactNotifications':
          return false;
      }
      return null;
    });
    reminders = Reminders();
    await reminders.initialize();
  });

  tearDown(() {
    messenger.setMockMethodCallHandler(channel, null);
    debugDefaultTargetPlatformOverride = null;
  });

  test('a late response cannot restore a cancelled reminder', () async {
    scheduled.add({'id': 7, 'payload': 'cancelled'});
    final oldResponse = Completer<http.Response>();
    final newResponse = Completer<http.Response>();
    var requests = 0;
    final api = Api(
      client: MockClient(
        (_) => requests++ == 0 ? oldResponse.future : newResponse.future,
      ),
    )..token = 'current';
    final first = reminders.sync(api);
    final second = reminders.sync(api);
    await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
    newResponse.complete(http.Response('[]', 200));
    await second;
    expect(scheduled, isEmpty);
    oldResponse.complete(http.Response(jsonEncode(rows), 200));
    await first;
    expect(scheduled, isEmpty);
  });

  test('logout clears alarms and ignores an in-flight sync', () async {
    final response = Completer<http.Response>();
    final api = Api(client: MockClient((_) => response.future))..token = 'old';
    final syncing = reminders.sync(api);
    scheduled.add({'id': 7, 'payload': 'cancelled'});
    await reminders.clear();
    response.complete(http.Response(jsonEncode(rows), 200));
    await syncing;
    expect(scheduled, isEmpty);

    final newSession = Api(
      client: MockClient((_) async => http.Response(jsonEncode(rows), 200)),
    )..token = 'new';
    await reminders.sync(newSession);
    expect(scheduled.map((row) => row['payload']), ['cancelled']);
  });
}

  testWidgets('invalid directory generation stays editable', (tester) async {

      client: MockClient(
        (_) async => http.Response('{"items":[],"total":0}', 200),
      ),
    );
    await tester.pumpWidget(
      MaterialApp(
        home: Scaffold(
          body: DirectoryScreen(api: api, family: 'f'),
        ),
      ),
    );

      find.widgetWithText(TextFormField, 'Thế hệ'),
      '1001',
    );
    await tester.tap(find.widgetWithText(FilledButton, 'Lưu'));

    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
  });

          '/api/events' => [],
          _ => {'items': [], 'total': 0, 'unread': 0},

  testWidgets('login preserves password whitespace and shows server failures', (

  testWidgets('registration rejects a short password without calling the API', (

  testWidgets('failed loading offers a retry and never displays stale data', (
    tester,
  ) async {
    var tries = 0;
    await tester.pumpWidget(
      MaterialApp(
        home: Scaffold(
          body: DataPane(
            load: () async {
              if (tries++ == 0) throw Exception('Mất mạng');
              return 'Đã kết nối';
            },
            builder: (data, reload) => ListView(children: [Text(data)]),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.textContaining('Mất mạng'), findsOneWidget);
    await tester.tap(find.text('Thử lại'));
    await tester.pumpAndSettle();
    expect(find.text('Đã kết nối'), findsOneWidget);
  });
}

# FILE: apps/web/public/assets/motion/motion.css
################################################################################
/*
  taste-skill motion.css - the micro-interactions a company site has (figma.com, x.ai): one small
  opt-in layer over system.css and ui/cards.css. Link it after them (data-motion on <html> is optional);
  load motion.js once (it adds the tab indicator, the number tick and the card loops).
  The layer is ON as soon as this file is linked: no attribute is needed (a hover shot of a linked card or photo
  shows the 2px lift and the 1.03 zoom). <html data-motion="off"> switches the whole layer off; data-motion="live"
  is the number tick in a headless shot (motion.js).
  references/motion.md says what moves and how fast. Everything here answers the pointer, the
  keyboard or a number coming into view once, plus the hero's one entrance on load (the end of this
  file); nothing moves because the page scrolled (that is a dealt moment's job, assets/moments).

  Hover moves sit under (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine): a phone never keeps a stuck hover.
  Hover out runs 120ms against 150ms in (motion.md, tokens).
  Under prefers-reduced-motion colours still change and a press still shows; nothing moves or scales.
*/

:root {
  --m-in: 150ms;                              /* hover in: buttons, links, nav, tabs */
  --m-out: 120ms;                             /* hover out */
  --m-press: 90ms;                            /* a press */
  --m-panel: 200ms;                           /* a menu or sheet opening */
  --m-close: 120ms;                           /* a menu closing */
  --m-slide: 240ms;                           /* an indicator travelling between two tabs or links */
  --m-image: 600ms;                           /* a photograph scaling inside its mask */
  --m-image-out: 400ms;                       /* ...and settling back */
  --m-ease: var(--ease, cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1)); /* the one UI ease-out (system.css --ease): fast start, soft landing */
  --m-ease-io: cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1);  /* the indicator: leaves and lands softly */
  --m-ease-enter: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1); /* an entrance settling: long soft tail, never past its mark */
  --m-cycle: 3.2s;                            /* one cycle of a card's loop (2.5-4 s) */
  --m-lift: -2px;
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- buttons */
html:not([data-motion="off"]) .btn {
  position: relative;
  transition: background-color var(--m-out) var(--m-ease), color var(--m-out) var(--m-ease),
              border-color var(--m-out) var(--m-ease), box-shadow var(--m-out) var(--m-ease),
              transform var(--m-press) var(--m-ease);
}
/* the tone moves toward the ground: a black button greys a little on white, a white one on black */
html:not([data-motion="off"]) .btn--primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--action) 84%, var(--bg)); }
html:not([data-motion="off"]) .btn--secondary:hover {
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 92%, var(--ink));
  border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 32%, transparent);
}
html:not([data-motion="off"]) .btn:hover { transition-duration: var(--m-in), var(--m-in), var(--m-in), var(--m-in), var(--m-press); }
html:not([data-motion="off"]) .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); }
/* the step: a button rises 1px on hover (2px on the large size) and presses 1px down with a 1.5% shrink on
   click; pointer only. The text-link secondary (arrow and block looks) keeps its underline and does not step.
   Reduced motion keeps the colour change only (see the end of this file). */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  html:not([data-motion="off"]) .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
  html:not([data-motion="off"]) .btn--xl:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  html:not([data-motion="off"]):is([data-buttons="arrow"], [data-buttons="block"]) .btn--secondary:hover { transform: none; }
  html:not([data-motion="off"]) .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.985); }
  html:not([data-motion="off"]):is([data-buttons="arrow"], [data-buttons="block"]) .btn--secondary:active { transform: scale(.985); }
}

/* the arrow: the text arrow (.btn--arrow, .link) nudges 3px; the drawn arrow (.m-arrow) grows its
   stem and moves its head 3px, the way a good product site's "Learn more" does. The pointer's move
   only for a fine pointer; keyboard focus shows it anywhere */
html:not([data-motion="off"]) :is(.btn--arrow, .link)::after { transition: transform var(--m-out) var(--m-ease); }
html:not([data-motion="off"]) :is(.btn--arrow, .link):focus-visible::after { transform: translateX(3px); transition-duration: var(--m-in); }
.m-arrow { width: 12px; height: 12px; flex: none; overflow: visible; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.6;
           stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.m-arrow__stem { opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(.2); transform-origin: 1px 50%; transform-box: fill-box;
                 transition: opacity var(--m-out) var(--m-ease), transform var(--m-out) var(--m-ease); }
.m-arrow__head { transition: transform var(--m-out) var(--m-ease); }
:is(a, button):focus-visible > .m-arrow .m-arrow__stem { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition-duration: var(--m-in); }
:is(a, button):focus-visible > .m-arrow .m-arrow__head { transform: translateX(3px); transition-duration: var(--m-in); }
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  html:not([data-motion="off"]) :is(.btn--arrow, .link):hover::after { transform: translateX(3px); transition-duration: var(--m-in); }
  :is(a, button):hover > .m-arrow .m-arrow__stem { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition-duration: var(--m-in); }
  :is(a, button):hover > .m-arrow .m-arrow__head { transform: translateX(3px); transition-duration: var(--m-in); }
}

/* a pill that is a link (the line above a hero headline) */
html:not([data-motion="off"]) a.pill { transition: background-color var(--m-out) var(--m-ease), border-color var(--m-out) var(--m-ease); }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- links: an underline that draws */
/* .link and links in running text: a rest line, and the ink line draws left to right on hover and
   leaves to the right. A link in a sentence rests on its own colour at 45% (about 3.3:1 on its
   ground), so it reads as a link even when it is the same colour as the text (WCAG 1.4.1); .link

@media (min-width: 1024px) {
