/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- FAQ
   Every answer stays open (ST-47, system.css): nothing here opens, closes or animates its height. */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- loops inside a card's panel */
/* a CSS loop the page writes inside [data-m-loop] runs one cycle in --m-cycle (2.5-4 s) and repeats
   while on screen; motion.js pauses it off screen and restarts it on hover (motion.md) */
[data-m-loop] { --m-cycle: 3.2s; --m-still: 0.6; --m-safe: 48px; }
/* the pause button (a 32px disc 12px in from the bottom-right corner) gets a clear band: content in
   the flow ends --m-safe (48px) above the bottom edge, and a fading stage dissolves above that band,
   never under the button. Size the panel so the loop's subject sits above the fade */
[data-m-loop]:not(:has(> .stage)) { padding-bottom: var(--m-safe); }
[data-m-loop] > .stage:is(.stage--fade-b, .stage--fade-br) { bottom: var(--m-safe); }
/* on a phone (as ui.js does) and under reduced motion a loop holds its finished picture: the frame at
   --m-still (0-1) of the cycle, set on the loop where the picture is complete */
@media (max-width: 639px) {
  [data-m-loop] * { animation-duration: var(--m-cycle) !important; animation-delay: calc(-1 * var(--m-still) * var(--m-cycle)) !important;
                    animation-play-state: paused !important; }
}
[data-m-loop].is-m-off *, [data-m-loop].is-m-paused * { animation-play-state: paused !important; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the hero's entrance */
/* Once on load the hero enters (motion.js enter(), motion.md): the h1 line by line out of word masks,
   then its lead, each button and its facts 60ms apart, the picture settling; about 1.1 s.
   Markup: data-enter on the hero <section> and the one head line that sets html.m-enter before the
   first paint (with its 700ms safety mark, m-enter-done). Only the words wait, and only in that window
   until motion.js takes over (.is-entering): no script, reduced motion, print and data-motion="off"
   show the hero as written; a script later than the mark finds the words fading in here.
   The pictures (a photograph, a window, the collage) are never hidden, so nothing blinks or flashes
   the hero's ground: a photograph waits at 1.05 and a window or collage at .98, by the scale property
   (it composes with any transform of their own), and they settle by transition as soon as the
   entrance starts or the mark passes. */
@media screen and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  html.m-enter:not(.m-enter-done, [data-motion="off"]) .hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"], .is-entering, .is-entered)
    :is(h1, h1 ~ *, :has(> h1) ~ *, :has(~ h1)):not([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage,
         :has([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage)) { opacity: 0; }
  /* the mark passed before motion.js arrived: the words fade in instead of appearing at once */
  html.m-enter.m-enter-done:not([data-motion="off"]) .hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"], .is-entering, .is-entered)
    :is(h1, h1 ~ *, :has(> h1) ~ *, :has(~ h1)) { transition: opacity 400ms var(--m-ease); }
  /* the settle: a photograph from 1.05 inside its frame (the hero clips one of its own), anything else from .98 */
  html.m-enter:not([data-motion="off"]) .hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"], .is-still)
    :is(:is([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage):is(img, picture, video),
        :is([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage) > :is(img, picture, video, .frame__img)) {
    transition: scale 1100ms var(--m-ease-enter), clip-path 1100ms var(--m-ease-enter);
  }
  /* the clip's resting value, kept below the waiting rule's weight so that one wins while it applies */
  .hero[data-enter] :is([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage):is(img, picture, video) { clip-path: inset(0); }
  html.m-enter:not([data-motion="off"]) .hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"], .is-still)
    :is([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage):not(img, picture, video, :has(> :is(img, picture, video, .frame__img))) {
    transition: scale 900ms var(--m-ease-enter);
  }
  html.m-enter:not(.m-enter-done, [data-motion="off"]) .hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"], .is-entering, .is-entered)
    :is(:is([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage):is(img, picture, video),
        :is([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage) > :is(img, picture, video, .frame__img)) { scale: 1.05; }
  html.m-enter:not(.m-enter-done, [data-motion="off"]) .hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"], .is-entering, .is-entered)
    :is([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage):is(img, picture, video) { clip-path: inset(2.381%); }   /* a picture that is itself the media (a band under the header, a full-bleed layer) has no frame: its own clip keeps it inside its box while larger, (1 - 1/1.05) / 2 */
  html.m-enter:not(.m-enter-done, [data-motion="off"]) .hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"], .is-entering, .is-entered)
    :is([data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage):not(img, picture, video, :has(> :is(img, picture, video, .frame__img))) { scale: .98; }
  html.m-enter:not([data-motion="off"]) .hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"], .is-entered) { overflow: clip; }
}

# FILE: apps/web/public/assets/motion/motion.js

/*
  taste-skill motion.js - the moving half of the micro-interaction layer (motion.css is the rest).
  Load it once, after system.js (motion.css needs no attribute; <html data-motion="off"> turns the layer off, JS too):
    <script type="module" src="assets/motion/motion.js"></script>
  It starts by itself. references/motion.md says what moves and how fast.

  - the hero's entrance: .hero[data-enter] enters once on load (the h1 line by line, then the lead,
    the buttons and the facts, the picture settling), about 1.1 s, when the head line set html.m-enter
    before the first paint:
    <script>document.documentElement.classList.add('m-enter');setTimeout(()=>document.documentElement.classList.add('m-enter-done'),700)</script>

  - nav: .m-menu-open from the moment a menu starts to show (150ms of intent), so the next word swaps the panel at once
    instead of waiting 150ms again; it stays while the pointer is on the word or its panel.
  - tabs: every .tabs[role=tablist] gets one indicator that slides to the selected tab (system.js
    still selects; this follows aria-selected).
  - numbers: [data-m-count] on a stat ticks from 0 to its own text once, when 60% of it is on
    screen (1.2 s, ease-out); prefix, suffix, decimals and thousands separators are kept. The
    number's width is measured once the web fonts are in and again when it is first seen (a stat
    in a hidden tab), so nothing beside it moves; a stat the observer never reports shows its own
    text after 6 s on screen. A headless screenshot (HeadlessChrome) sees the final number unless
    <html data-motion="live">.
  - loops: [data-m-loop] marks a panel (or any box) whose CSS keyframe loops the page wrote itself;
    they pause off screen, restart when the pointer enters the card around them, and get the
    system's pause button (one per panel, shared with ui.js). ui.js restarts its own fragments.
  - switches: a click on .m-switch flips aria-checked unless a handler before it called
    preventDefault().
  Under prefers-reduced-motion: no entrance, no indicator travel, no tick, no loops, no restart.
*/
const html = document.documentElement;
const reducedQ = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const reduced = () => reducedQ.matches;
const shot = () => /HeadlessChrome/.test(navigator.userAgent) && html.dataset.motion !== 'live';
const jump = (el, on) => { el.classList.toggle('is-jump', on); };

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nav */
function nav() {
  const bar = document.querySelector('.nav');
  const links = bar?.querySelector('.nav__links');
  if (!links || bar.dataset.mNav) return;
  bar.dataset.mNav = '1';   // no pill under the words (ST-08, ST-11): system.css draws their underline

  // one menu open: the next word swaps the panel at once (figma.com); leaving the bar closes softly
  let t = 0;
  bar.querySelectorAll('.nav__item').forEach(item => {
    const has = !!item.querySelector('.nav__menu');
    item.addEventListener('pointerenter', () => {
      clearTimeout(t);
      // 150ms: the panel has started to show (motion.css lets it finish its own fade)
      if (has) t = setTimeout(() => bar.classList.add('m-menu-open'), 150);
      else bar.classList.remove('m-menu-open');
    });
  });
  bar.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { clearTimeout(t); bar.classList.remove('m-menu-open'); });
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- tabs */
function tabs() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tabs[role="tablist"], [role="tablist"].m-tabs').forEach(list => {
    if (!list.querySelector('[role="tab"]') || list.querySelector(':scope > .m-tab-ind')) return;
    const ind = document.createElement('span');
    ind.className = 'm-tab-ind';
    ind.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    list.prepend(ind);
    list.classList.add('m-has-ind');
    let instant = true, at = null;
    const set = (b, sx = 1, sy = 1) => {
      ind.style.setProperty('--x', `${b.x}px`); ind.style.setProperty('--y', `${b.y}px`);
      ind.style.setProperty('--w', `${b.w}px`); ind.style.setProperty('--h', `${b.h}px`);
      ind.style.setProperty('--sx', String(sx)); ind.style.setProperty('--sy', String(sy));
    };
    // the pill travels by transform only: it takes the new tab's size at once, is drawn scaled to the
    // old tab's size at the old place, and settles to scale 1 at the new place (motion.css)
    const place = () => {
      const sel = list.querySelector('[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]');
      if (!sel) { ind.style.opacity = '0'; return; }
      ind.style.opacity = '';
      const to = { x: sel.offsetLeft, y: sel.offsetTop, w: sel.offsetWidth, h: sel.offsetHeight };
      if (instant || reduced() || !at || !to.w || !to.h) { jump(ind, true); set(to); ind.getBoundingClientRect(); jump(ind, false); }
      else {
        jump(ind, true);
        set({ ...to, x: at.x, y: at.y }, at.w / to.w, at.h / to.h);
        ind.getBoundingClientRect();
        jump(ind, false);
        set(to);
      }
      at = to;
      instant = false;
    };
    place();
    new MutationObserver(place).observe(list, { subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['aria-selected'] });
    new ResizeObserver(() => { instant = true; place(); }).observe(list);
    document.fonts?.ready.then(() => { instant = true; place(); });
  });
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- numbers */
// the first number in the element's text: "8,402", "4.2", "64%", "EUR 1.200", "12k"
// separators: . , and the no-break spaces (U+00A0, U+202F); a plain space ends the number ("12 4 h" is 12)
const NUM = /\d+(?:[.,\u00A0\u202F]\d+)*/;
function parse(text) {
  const m = text.match(NUM);
  if (!m) return null;
  const raw = m[0];
  const seps = raw.match(/[^\d]/g) || [];
  let dec = '', group = '', decimals = 0;
  const lastSep = raw.search(/[^\d](?=\d+$)/);
  if (lastSep >= 0) {
    const tail = raw.length - lastSep - 1;
    // a last separator before exactly three digits groups thousands; otherwise it is the decimal point
    if (tail === 3 && !(seps.length === 1 && raw[lastSep] === '.' && /^0/.test(raw))) group = raw[lastSep];
    else { dec = raw[lastSep]; decimals = tail; group = seps.length > 1 ? seps[0] : ''; }
  }
  const intPart = dec ? raw.slice(0, lastSep) : raw;
  const value = parseFloat(intPart.replace(/[^\d]/g, '') + (dec ? '.' + raw.slice(lastSep + 1) : ''));
  return { index: m.index, raw, value, dec, group, decimals };
}
function format(v, p) {
  let [i, d] = v.toFixed(p.decimals).split('.');
  if (p.group) i = i.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, p.group);
  return d ? i + p.dec + d : i;
}
// the web fonts, or 3 s at most: a number measured in the fallback font comes out narrower
const fontsIn = () => Promise.race([document.fonts?.ready ?? Promise.resolve(), new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000))]);
function counts() {
  const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-m-count]')].filter(el => !el.__mCount);
  if (!els.length || reduced() || shot()) return;
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) e.target.__mCount?.hit(); }), { threshold: 0.6 });
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(es => es.forEach(e => e.target.__mCount?.arm()));
  const items = [];
  els.forEach(el => {
    const walk = document.createTreeWalker(el, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
    let node, p;
    while ((node = walk.nextNode()) && !(p = parse(node.data))) { /* next */ }
    if (!node || !p) return;
    // the number gets its own span, as wide as the final number and right-aligned, so nothing beside it
    // moves. Until it is measured it shows its own text, never a 0
    const after = node.splitText(p.index);
    after.splitText(p.raw.length);
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'm-count__n';
    span.style.display = 'inline-block';
    span.style.textAlign = 'right';
    span.textContent = p.raw;
    after.replaceWith(span);
    const ms = +el.dataset.mCount || 1200;
    let state = 'wait', timer = 0;          // wait (own text) -> armed (0, width held) -> run -> done
    const stop = () => { clearTimeout(timer); io.unobserve(el); ro.unobserve(el); };
    const onScreen = () => {
      const r = span.getBoundingClientRect();
      return r.width > 0 && r.bottom > 0 && r.top < innerHeight && r.right > 0 && r.left < innerWidth && document.visibilityState === 'visible';
    };
    // the safety net: a stat on screen for 6 s that the observer never reported shows its own text
    const watch = () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (state !== 'armed') return;
        if (onScreen()) { state = 'done'; stop(); span.textContent = p.raw; } else watch();
      }, 6000);
    };
    const ctl = {
      /** measure the final number in the page's font and hold its width; false while it has none (hidden) */
      arm() {
        if (state === 'run' || state === 'done') return false;
        span.textContent = p.raw;
        span.style.minWidth = '';
        const w = span.getBoundingClientRect().width;
        if (!w) { state = 'wait'; clearTimeout(timer); return false; }
        span.style.minWidth = `${w}px`;
        span.textContent = format(0, p);
        if (state !== 'armed') { state = 'armed'; watch(); }
        return true;
      },
      /** print: stop waiting and show the written number */
      show() { if (state === 'done') return; state = 'done'; stop(); span.textContent = p.raw; },
      /** first seen: measure again (a font or a tab that changed since), then tick once */
      hit() {
        if (state === 'run' || state === 'done' || !ctl.arm()) return;
        state = 'run';
        stop();
        const t0 = performance.now();
        const step = now => {
          const k = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / ms);
          span.textContent = k < 1 ? format(p.value * (1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 4)), p) : p.raw;
          if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else state = 'done';
        };
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      },
    };
    el.__mCount = ctl;
    items.push(el);
  });
  // measured only once the fonts are in; the resize observer measures again when a hidden stat shows
  fontsIn().then(() => items.forEach(el => { el.__mCount.arm(); ro.observe(el); io.observe(el); }));
  // a printed page never scrolls the stats into view: each prints its own number
  addEventListener('beforeprint', () => items.forEach(el => el.__mCount.show()));
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- loops inside cards */
const ICON_PAUSE = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="4.25" y="3.25" width="2.75" height="9.5" rx="0.9"/><rect x="9" y="3.25" width="2.75" height="9.5" rx="0.9"/></svg>';
const ICON_PLAY = '<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5.25 3.7v8.6c0 .62.68 1 1.2.66l6.5-4.3c.47-.31.47-1 0-1.32l-6.5-4.3c-.52-.34-1.2.04-1.2.66Z"/></svg>';
const boxOf = el => el.closest('[data-ui-pause-host], .panel__screen, .panel, .frame') || el;
const hostOf = el => el.closest('.card, .tile, .menu-card, a') || boxOf(el);

function restart(loop) {
  if (reduced() || loop.classList.contains('is-m-paused')) return;
  // the page's keyframe loops only: a hover transition in the panel (the pause button's) is no cycle.
  // ui.js fragments in the card restart by themselves
  const anims = loop.getAnimations({ subtree: true }).filter(a => typeof CSSAnimation === 'function' && a instanceof CSSAnimation);
  if (!anims.length) return;
  const dur = a => Number(a.effect?.getComputedTiming().duration) || 0;
  const main = anims.reduce((m, a) => (dur(a) > dur(m) ? a : m));
  const d = dur(main), t = Number(main.currentTime) || 0;
  // restart only when the cycle is past its first quarter, so a quick in-and-out never stutters
  if (!d || (t % d) / d > 0.25) anims.forEach(a => { a.currentTime = 0; });
}
function setPaused(box, paused) {
  box.querySelectorAll('[data-m-loop]').forEach(l => l.classList.toggle('is-m-paused', paused));
  if (box.matches('[data-m-loop]')) box.classList.toggle('is-m-paused', paused);
}
function pauseButton(loop) {
  const box = boxOf(loop);
  if (box.querySelector(':scope > .loop-pause')) return;   // ui.js or the page put one there: it is shared
  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.type = 'button';
  btn.className = 'loop-pause m-own';
  const show = paused => {
    btn.innerHTML = paused ? ICON_PLAY : ICON_PAUSE;
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `${paused ? 'Play' : 'Pause'} animation`);
    btn.title = btn.getAttribute('aria-label');
    btn.classList.toggle('is-paused', paused);
  };
  show(false);
  if (getComputedStyle(box).position === 'static') box.style.position = 'relative';
  box.append(btn);
  btn.__show = show;
}
function loops() {
  const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-m-loop]')].filter(el => !el.__mLoop);
  if (!els.length) return;
  if (reduced() || matchMedia('(max-width: 639px)').matches) return;   // motion.css holds them on their finished picture
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(es => es.forEach(e => e.target.classList.toggle('is-m-off', !e.isIntersecting)), { rootMargin: '48px' });
  els.forEach(el => {
    el.__mLoop = true;
    io.observe(el);
    pauseButton(el);
    hostOf(el).addEventListener('pointerenter', e => { if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') restart(el); });   // a mouse or pen, never a tap
    hostOf(el).addEventListener('focusin', e => { if (!e.target.closest('.loop-pause')) restart(el); });
  });
}
// one listener for every pause button: its own (m-own) toggles; a ui.js one is mirrored after ui.js ran
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const btn = e.target.closest('.loop-pause');
  if (!btn) return;
  const box = btn.parentElement;
  if (btn.classList.contains('m-own')) {
    const paused = !btn.classList.contains('is-paused');
    btn.__show(paused);
    setPaused(box, paused);
    box.querySelectorAll('[data-ui]').forEach(r => { try { paused ? r.__ui?.pause() : r.__ui?.resume(); } catch { /* none */ } });
  } else setPaused(box, btn.classList.contains('is-paused'));
});

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- switches */
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const sw = e.target.closest('.m-switch');
  if (!sw || e.defaultPrevented) return;
  sw.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(sw.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true'));
});

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- the hero's entrance */
// Once, on load (motion.md, The hero's entrance): the h1 rises line by line out of its masks, then what
// follows it (the lead, each button, the facts) fades up 60ms apart, while the picture settles from a
// slight scale; about 1.1 s in all, ease-out, transform and opacity only. motion.css hides the words
// (never the picture) only while the head line's html.m-enter is on and its 700ms safety mark
// (m-enter-done) is not; the picture waits at its start scale and settles by a CSS transition, so it
// never blinks however late this file is. Without script, under reduced motion and in print the hero
// simply stands; when this file is later than the mark, the words fade in by CSS and the hero stands.
// The h1 gets its word masks for the length of the entrance and its own nodes back afterwards.
const ENTER_MEDIA = '[data-enter-media], .hero__bg, .hero__media, .hero__stage, .hero__art, .hero__window, .hero-visual, .ly-collage';
const ENTER_TEXT = 'h1 ~ *, :has(> h1) ~ *, :has(~ h1)';
const ENTER_LEAF = 'p, dl, ul, ol, a, button, img, picture, video, figure, blockquote, h2, h3, .pill, .btn';
function maskWords(h1) {
  // an h1 another script reworks (layout.js: a live word, letters, a picture in the line) rises whole
  if (h1.matches('[data-ly-letters], [data-enter-whole]') || h1.querySelector('.ly-word, .ly-pic, .ly-mark, svg, img')) return null;
  const own = document.createDocumentFragment();
  own.append(...h1.childNodes);
  const copy = own.cloneNode(true);
  const words = [];
  const walk = node => [...node.childNodes].forEach(n => {
    if (n.nodeType === 1) return walk(n);
    if (n.nodeType !== 3) return;
    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    n.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(part => {
      if (!part) return;
      if (/^\s+$/.test(part)) { frag.append(part); return; }
      const w = document.createElement('span'), i = document.createElement('span');
      w.className = 'm-w'; i.className = 'm-w__in'; i.textContent = part;
      w.append(i); frag.append(w); words.push(w);
    });
    n.replaceWith(frag);
  });
  walk(copy);
  const label = h1.hasAttribute('aria-label');
  if (!label) h1.setAttribute('aria-label', own.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim());
  h1.append(copy);
  h1.querySelectorAll('.m-w').forEach(w => w.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'));
  // words grouped into the lines the browser set them on
  const lines = [];
  let top = null;
  words.forEach(w => { const t = w.getBoundingClientRect().top; if (top === null || Math.abs(t - top) > 3) { lines.push([]); top = t; } lines[lines.length - 1].push(w.firstChild); });
  return { lines, restore() { h1.replaceChildren(own); if (!label) h1.removeAttribute('aria-label'); } };
}
function enterSteps(hero, h1, media) {
  // what follows (and precedes) the h1 in its column, as whole blocks in reading order; a box of
  // layout (a div with no words of its own) is opened, a button row gives one step a button.
  // A picture, window or collage (or a box round one) is never opened: it stands as one block and
  // settles by itself (motion.css), even when it carries words of its own (a menu card, a note)
  const out = [];
  const take = el => {
    if (el === h1 || el.contains(h1) || out.includes(el) || el.matches('img, picture, video, canvas, .frame__img')) return;
    if (media.includes(el) || media.some(m => el.contains(m))) return;
    if (el.matches('.btn-row')) { [...el.children].forEach(take); return; }
    const own = [...el.childNodes].some(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim());
    if (own || !el.children.length || el.matches(ENTER_LEAF)) out.push(el);
    else [...el.children].forEach(take);
  };
  hero.querySelectorAll(ENTER_TEXT).forEach(take);
  return out.filter(el => !el.closest('[aria-hidden="true"]') && !out.some(o => o !== el && o.contains(el)))
    .sort((a, b) => (a.compareDocumentPosition(b) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING ? -1 : 1));
}
function enter() {
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero[data-enter]:not([data-enter="off"])');
  if (!hero || hero.classList.contains('is-entered') || hero.classList.contains('is-entering')) return;
  // still: the picture takes its place at once (no settle); otherwise the CSS settle and fade run out first
  const done = (still = false) => { if (still) hero.classList.add('is-still'); hero.classList.add('is-entered'); };
  const late = () => setTimeout(done, 1150);
  // the head line did not run, reduced motion, a headless shot (it sees the hero at rest, as it sees the
  // final number, unless data-motion="live") or the visitor is already below the hero (a reload half way
  // down): the hero stands as written. The safety mark has passed: motion.css is fading the words in and
  // settling the picture; the hero is marked done once they are through
  if (!html.classList.contains('m-enter') || reduced() || shot() || hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom < 0) return done(true);
  if (html.classList.contains('m-enter-done')) return late();
  const h1 = hero.querySelector('h1');
  if (!h1) return done(true);
  const media = [...hero.querySelectorAll(ENTER_MEDIA)].filter((m, i, all) => !all.some(o => o !== m && o.contains(m)));
  const steps = enterSteps(hero, h1, media);
  const EASE = 'cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)';
  const anims = [];
  let masks = null, over = false;
  const finish = () => {
    if (over) return;
    over = true;
    anims.forEach(a => { try { a.cancel(); } catch { /* gone */ } });
    masks?.restore();
    hero.classList.remove('is-entering');
    done();
  };
  // the fonts first (a line set in the fallback face breaks elsewhere), 250ms at most: the words are
  // hidden meanwhile, so nothing is seen twice
  Promise.race([document.fonts?.ready ?? Promise.resolve(), new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250))]).then(() => {
    if (html.classList.contains('m-enter-done') && !hero.classList.contains('is-entering')) { over = true; return late(); }   // the safety mark won: CSS shows it
    masks = maskWords(h1);
    // .is-entering ends the CSS hold: the words are held by their animations from here, and the
    // picture starts its CSS settle in the same frame
    hero.classList.add('is-entering');
    const lines = masks ? masks.lines : [[h1]];
    const lineStep = Math.min(80, 240 / Math.max(1, lines.length - 1));
    // a word starts wholly below its mask, which reaches .12em under the line: no tops show before it rises
    lines.forEach((ws, k) => ws.forEach(w => anims.push(w.animate(masks
      ? [{ transform: 'translateY(calc(100% + .2em))' }, { transform: 'none' }]
      : [{ transform: 'translateY(.35em)', opacity: 0 }, { transform: 'none', opacity: 1 }],
      { duration: 700, delay: 80 + k * lineStep, easing: EASE, fill: 'both' }))));
    // a line above the h1 (a notice, a pill) comes with its first line; what follows starts as its
    // last line is half way up
    const after = 80 + (lines.length - 1) * lineStep + 220;
    let k = 0;
    steps.forEach(el => {
      const above = !!(el.compareDocumentPosition(h1) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING);
      // the rise is added to whatever transform the part has of its own; the fade replaces its opacity
      const t = { duration: 520, delay: above ? 40 : after + Math.min(k++, 6) * 60, easing: EASE, fill: 'both' };
      anims.push(el.animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], t), el.animate([{ transform: 'translateY(12px)' }, { transform: 'none' }], { ...t, composite: 'add' }));
    });
    // a panel the words sit on stands from the first paint (it was never hidden, so it never blinks);
    // the pictures settle by CSS over 1.1 s: the hero is done when both are through
    anims.push({ finished: new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1150)), cancel() {} });
    Promise.all(anims.map(a => a.finished)).then(finish, finish);
  }).catch(finish);
  setTimeout(finish, 2400);   // whatever stalls (a hidden tab), the hero stands after 2.4 s
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- start */
export function init() {
  if (html.dataset.motion === 'off') { html.classList.add('m-enter-done'); return; }
  if (!html.hasAttribute('data-motion')) html.setAttribute('data-motion', '');
  try { enter(); } catch (e) { console.warn('motion.js: enter', e); document.querySelector('.hero[data-enter]')?.classList.add('is-entered'); }
  try { nav(); } catch (e) { console.warn('motion.js: nav', e); }
  try { tabs(); } catch (e) { console.warn('motion.js: tabs', e); }
  try { counts(); } catch (e) { console.warn('motion.js: counts', e); }
  try { loops(); } catch (e) { console.warn('motion.js: loops', e); }
}
/** call again after the page adds markup (a tab list, a stat, a loop) */
export const refresh = init;
export default { init, refresh };

if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init, { once: true });
else init();

import { api } from "@/shared/api/client";

export async function getConfigs(params, signal) {
  const { data } = await api.get("/admin/configs", { params, signal });
  return data;
}

export async function createConfig(payload) {
  const { data } = await api.post("/admin/configs", payload);
  return data;
}

export async function updateConfig(key, payload) {
  const { data } = await api.put(`/admin/configs/${encodeURIComponent(key)}`, payload);
  return data;
}

export async function deleteConfig(key) {
  await api.delete(`/admin/configs/${encodeURIComponent(key)}`);
}

# FILE: apps/web/src/features/admin-config/pages/AdminConfig.jsx

import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useAuth } from "@/features/auth/hooks/useAuth";
import { getApiErrorMessage } from "@/shared/api/client";
import { createConfig, deleteConfig, getConfigs, updateConfig } from "../api/adminConfigApi";

const PAGE_SIZE = 20;
const emptyForm = { config_key: "", config_value: "", description: "" };
const fieldClass = "w-full rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-leaf focus:ring-4 focus:ring-sage read-only:bg-stone-50";

export function AdminConfig() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0);
  const [editingKey, setEditingKey] = useState(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [actionError, setActionError] = useState("");
  const { register, handleSubmit, reset, formState: { errors } } = useForm({ defaultValues: emptyForm });
  const queryKey = ["admin-configs", user.id, user.role];
  const query = useQuery({
    queryKey: [...queryKey, offset],
    queryFn: ({ signal }) => getConfigs({ limit: PAGE_SIZE, offset }, signal),
  });
  const rows = query.data ?? [];

  function resetForm() {
    setEditingKey(null);
    reset(emptyForm);
  }

  const save = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ key, payload }) => key === null ? createConfig(payload) : updateConfig(key, payload),
    onMutate: () => { setNotice(""); setActionError(""); },
    onSuccess: async (data, { key }) => {
      resetForm();
      if (key === null) setOffset(0);
      setNotice(`Đã ${key === null ? "thêm" : "lưu"} cấu hình "${data.config_key}".`);
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey });
    },
    onError: (error) => setActionError(getApiErrorMessage(error)),
  });

  const remove = useMutation({
    mutationFn: deleteConfig,
    onMutate: () => { setNotice(""); setActionError(""); },
    onSuccess: async (_, key) => {
      if (editingKey === key) resetForm();
      if (rows.length === 1 && offset > 0) setOffset(offset - PAGE_SIZE);
      setNotice(`Đã xóa cấu hình "${key}".`);
      await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey });
    },
    onError: async (error) => {
      setActionError(getApiErrorMessage(error));
      if (error.response?.status === 404) await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey });
    },
  });
  const busy = save.isPending || remove.isPending;

  function edit(row) {
    setNotice("");
    setActionError("");
    setEditingKey(row.config_key);
    reset({ config_key: row.config_key, config_value: row.config_value, description: row.description ?? "" });
  }

  function submit(values) {
    const payload = {
      config_value: values.config_value,
      description: values.description === "" ? null : values.description,
    };
    if (editingKey === null) payload.config_key = values.config_key;
    save.mutate({ key: editingKey, payload });
  }

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="config-title" className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-leaf">Quản trị</p>
          <h1 id="config-title" className="mt-2 text-2xl font-bold text-forest sm:text-3xl">Cấu hình hệ thống</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-stone-500">Quản lý các giá trị dùng chung của FamilyConnect.</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => query.refetch()} disabled={query.isFetching || busy}
          className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-forest hover:bg-sage disabled:opacity-50">
          {query.isFetching ? "Đang tải…" : "Làm mới"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {notice && <p role="status" className="rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-800">{notice}</p>}
      {actionError && <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">{actionError}</p>}

      <div className="grid items-start gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_340px]">
        <div className="min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
          <div className="border-b border-stone-100 px-5 py-4"><h2 className="font-semibold text-forest">Danh sách cấu hình</h2></div>
          {query.isPending ? <p role="status" className="p-6 text-sm text-stone-500">Đang tải cấu hình…</p>
            : query.isError ? <p role="alert" className="p-6 text-sm text-red-700">{getApiErrorMessage(query.error)}</p>
              : rows.length === 0 ? <p className="p-6 text-sm text-stone-500">Chưa có cấu hình trên trang này.</p>
                : <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
                    <caption className="sr-only">Các cấu hình hệ thống và thao tác quản lý</caption>
                    <thead className="bg-stone-50 text-xs text-stone-500"><tr>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Khóa / Mô tả</th>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Giá trị</th>
                      <th scope="col" className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-3">Cập nhật (UTC)</th>
                      <th scope="col" className="px-5 py-3">Thao tác</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-stone-100">
                      {rows.map((row) => <tr key={row.config_key} className={editingKey === row.config_key ? "bg-sage/40" : "hover:bg-stone-50/60"}>
                        <th scope="row" className="min-w-40 px-5 py-4 align-top font-normal">
                          <span className="break-all font-mono font-semibold text-forest">{row.config_key}</span>
                          {row.description && <p className="mt-1 max-w-60 break-words text-xs text-stone-500">{row.description}</p>}
                        </th>
                        <td className="min-w-40 px-5 py-4 align-top"><p className="line-clamp-3 max-w-72 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{row.config_value === "" ? "(Trống)" : row.config_value}</p></td>
                        <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-5 py-4 align-top text-xs text-stone-500">{row.updated_at.replace("T", " ").replace("Z", "")}</td>
                        <td className="px-5 py-4 align-top"><div className="flex gap-3">
                          <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => edit(row)} aria-label={`Sửa ${row.config_key}`} className="font-semibold text-leaf hover:underline disabled:opacity-50">Sửa</button>
                          <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { if (window.confirm(`Xóa cấu hình "${row.config_key}"?`)) remove.mutate(row.config_key); }} aria-label={`Xóa ${row.config_key}`} className="font-semibold text-red-600 hover:underline disabled:opacity-50">Xóa</button>
                        </div></td>
                      </tr>)}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>}
          {!query.isError && <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-stone-100 px-5 py-4 text-sm">
            <span className="text-stone-500">Trang {offset / PAGE_SIZE + 1}</span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button type="button" disabled={offset === 0 || query.isFetching || busy} onClick={() => setOffset(offset - PAGE_SIZE)} className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 hover:bg-sage disabled:opacity-40">Trang trước</button>
              <button type="button" disabled={rows.length < PAGE_SIZE || query.isFetching || busy} onClick={() => setOffset(offset + PAGE_SIZE)} className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 hover:bg-sage disabled:opacity-40">Trang sau</button>
            </div>
          </div>}
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(submit)} noValidate className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-forest">{editingKey === null ? "Thêm cấu hình" : "Chỉnh sửa cấu hình"}</h2>
          <fieldset disabled={busy} className="mt-5 space-y-4 disabled:opacity-60">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="config-key" className="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold">Khóa cấu hình</label>
              <input id="config-key" className={fieldClass} maxLength={100} readOnly={editingKey !== null} placeholder="site.name"
                aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.config_key)} aria-describedby="config-key-help config-key-error"
                {...register("config_key", { required: "Bạn nhập khóa cấu hình.", maxLength: { value: 100, message: "Khóa tối đa 100 ký tự." }, pattern: { value: /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/, message: "Chỉ dùng chữ không dấu, số, dấu chấm, gạch dưới hoặc gạch ngang." } })} />
              <p id="config-key-help" className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-stone-500">{editingKey === null ? "Tối đa 100 ký tự, ví dụ site.name." : "Khóa được giữ nguyên khi chỉnh sửa."}</p>
              {errors.config_key && <p id="config-key-error" role="alert" className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">{errors.config_key.message}</p>}
            </div>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="config-value" className="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold">Giá trị</label>
              <textarea id="config-value" rows={4} className={fieldClass} {...register("config_value")} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="config-description" className="mb-2 block text-sm font-semibold">Mô tả <span className="font-normal text-stone-400">(tùy chọn)</span></label>
              <textarea id="config-description" rows={3} maxLength={500} className={fieldClass} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.description)}
                {...register("description", { maxLength: { value: 500, message: "Mô tả tối đa 500 ký tự." } })} />
              {errors.description && <p role="alert" className="mt-1 text-xs text-red-600">{errors.description.message}</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
              <button type="submit" className="rounded-xl bg-forest px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#1d4034]">{save.isPending ? "Đang lưu…" : editingKey === null ? "Thêm cấu hình" : "Lưu thay đổi"}</button>
              {editingKey !== null && <button type="button" onClick={resetForm} className="rounded-xl border px-4 py-2.5 text-sm hover:bg-stone-50">Hủy chỉnh sửa</button>}
            </div>
          </fieldset>
        </form>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import axios from "axios";
import { api } from "@/shared/api/client";

function normalizeRole(role) {
  if (role === "admin" || role === "family_head" || role === "guest") return role;
  return "member";
}

function toSession(response, email) {
  const user = response.user ?? {};
  const token = response.access_token ?? response.token;
  if (!token) throw new Error("Máy chủ chưa trả về access token.");

  return {
    accessToken: token,
    user: {
      id: String(user.id ?? user.email ?? email),
      fullName: user.fullName ?? user.full_name ?? user.name ?? email.split("@")[0],
      email: user.email ?? email,
      role: normalizeRole(user.role),
      avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl ?? user.avatar_url,
    },
  };
}

export async function login(payload) {
  try {
    const { data } = await api.post("/auth/login", payload);
    return toSession(data, payload.email);
  } catch (error) {
    const mockEnabled = import.meta.env.VITE_ENABLE_MOCK_AUTH === "true";
    if (!mockEnabled || (axios.isAxiosError(error) && error.response)) throw error;

    // Demo giúp đăng nhập khi API chưa sẵn sàng.
    const role = payload.email.startsWith("admin")
      ? "admin"
      : payload.email.startsWith("truongchi")
        ? "family_head"
        : "member";
    return {
      accessToken: `demo-token-${Date.now()}`,
      user: {
        id: `demo-${payload.email}`,
        fullName: payload.email.split("@")[0].replace(/[._-]/g, " "),
        email: payload.email,
        role,
      },
    };
  }
}

export async function register(payload) {
  const { data } = await api.post("/auth/register", payload);
  return toSession(data, payload.email);
}

import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { useAuth } from "@/features/auth/hooks/useAuth";

export function ProtectedRoute({ allowedRoles }) {
  const { isAuthenticated, user } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (!isAuthenticated) return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location }} />;
  if (allowedRoles && user && !allowedRoles.includes(user.role)) {
    return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;
  }
  return <Outlet />;
}

# FILE: apps/web/src/features/auth/hooks/useAuth.jsx
################################################################################
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { login as loginRequest, register as registerRequest } from "../api/authApi";

const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [user, setUser] = useState(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("familyconnect.user");
    return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : null;
  });
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const signOut = useCallback(() => {
    localStorage.removeItem("familyconnect.token");
    localStorage.removeItem("familyconnect.user");
    queryClient.clear();
    setUser(null);
  }, [queryClient]);

  useEffect(() => {
    function syncSession(event) {
      if (event.storageArea !== localStorage || ![null, "familyconnect.token", "familyconnect.user"].includes(event.key)) return;
      const saved = localStorage.getItem("familyconnect.user");
      queryClient.clear();
      setUser(localStorage.getItem("familyconnect.token") && saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : null);
    }

    window.addEventListener("familyconnect:unauthorized", signOut);
    window.addEventListener("storage", syncSession);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("familyconnect:unauthorized", signOut);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", syncSession);
    };
  }, [queryClient, signOut]);

  const signIn = useCallback(async (payload) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const session = await loginRequest(payload);
      queryClient.clear();
      localStorage.setItem("familyconnect.token", session.accessToken);
      localStorage.setItem("familyconnect.user", JSON.stringify(session.user));
      setUser(session.user);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [queryClient]);

  const signUp = useCallback(async (payload) => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const session = await registerRequest(payload);
      queryClient.clear();
      localStorage.setItem("familyconnect.token", session.accessToken);
      localStorage.setItem("familyconnect.user", JSON.stringify(session.user));
      setUser(session.user);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [queryClient]);

  const updateUser = useCallback((fresh) => {
    setUser((current) => {
      const next = { ...current, id: fresh.id, fullName: fresh.full_name, email: fresh.email, role: fresh.role };
      localStorage.setItem("familyconnect.user", JSON.stringify(next));
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    user,
    isAuthenticated: Boolean(user && localStorage.getItem("familyconnect.token")),
    isLoading,
    signIn,
    signUp,
    signOut,
    updateUser,
  }), [user, isLoading, signIn, signUp, signOut, updateUser]);

  return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
}

export function useAuth() {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error("useAuth cần được dùng bên trong AuthProvider.");
  return context;
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { Navigate, useLocation, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { AuthLayout } from "@/shared/layouts/AuthLayout";
import { Icon } from "@/shared/components/Icon";
import { useAuth } from "@/features/auth/hooks/useAuth";

export function Login() {
  const { signIn, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState("");
  const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors, isSubmitting } } = useForm({ defaultValues: { email: "", password: "" } });

  if (isAuthenticated) return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;

  const onSubmit = async (values) => {
    setSubmitError("");
    try {
      await signIn(values);
      const destination = location.state?.from?.pathname || "/dashboard";
      navigate(destination, { replace: true });
    } catch {
      setSubmitError("Đăng nhập chưa thành công. Bạn kiểm tra email, mật khẩu rồi thử lại nhé.");
    }
  };

  return <AuthLayout>
    <div className="auth-form-heading"><span className="section-label">Chào mừng trở lại</span><h1>Đăng nhập</h1><p>Tiếp tục câu chuyện của gia đình mình.</p></div>
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate className="auth-form" aria-busy={isSubmitting}>
      <div className="auth-field"><label htmlFor="email">Email</label><input id="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="Nhập địa chỉ email" aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)} aria-describedby={errors.email ? "email-error" : undefined} {...register("email", { required: "Bạn nhập email giúp mình nhé.", pattern: { value: /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/, message: "Email chưa đúng định dạng." } })} />{errors.email && <p id="email-error" role="alert" className="field-error">{errors.email.message}</p>}</div>
      <div className="auth-field"><label htmlFor="password">Mật khẩu</label><input id="password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" placeholder="Nhập mật khẩu" aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.password)} aria-describedby={errors.password ? "password-error" : undefined} {...register("password", { required: "Bạn nhập mật khẩu giúp mình nhé.", minLength: { value: 6, message: "Mật khẩu cần có ít nhất 6 ký tự." } })} />{errors.password && <p id="password-error" role="alert" className="field-error">{errors.password.message}</p>}</div>
      {submitError && <p role="alert" className="form-error">{submitError}</p>}
      <button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting} className="btn btn--primary auth-submit">{isSubmitting ? "Đang đăng nhập…" : <>Đăng nhập <Icon name="arrow-right" /></>}</button>
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{isSubmitting ? "Đang đăng nhập…" : ""}</p>
    </form>
    <p className="auth-note"><Icon name="lock-keyhole" /> Dùng tài khoản đã đăng ký với FamilyConnect.</p>
    {import.meta.env.VITE_ENABLE_MOCK_AUTH === "true" && <p className="demo-note">Tài khoản demo: demo@familyconnect.vn · Family123!</p>}
  </AuthLayout>;
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { Navigate, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { AuthLayout } from "@/shared/layouts/AuthLayout";
import { Icon } from "@/shared/components/Icon";
import { useAuth } from "@/features/auth/hooks/useAuth";

export function Register() {
  const { signUp, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState("");
  const { register, handleSubmit, watch, formState: { errors, isSubmitting } } = useForm();

  if (isAuthenticated) return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;

  const onSubmit = async (values) => {
    setSubmitError("");
    try {
      await signUp({ full_name: values.full_name, email: values.email, password: values.password });
      navigate("/dashboard", { replace: true });
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error?.response?.data?.detail;
      setSubmitError(message || "Chưa tạo được tài khoản. Bạn kiểm tra thông tin rồi thử lại nhé.");
    }
  };

  return <AuthLayout registering>
    <div className="auth-form-heading"><span className="section-label">Không gian dành cho các thế hệ</span><h1>Tạo tài khoản</h1><p>Tham gia và lưu giữ câu chuyện gia đình.</p></div>
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} noValidate className="auth-form" aria-busy={isSubmitting}>
      <div className="auth-field"><label htmlFor="full_name">Họ và tên</label><input id="full_name" autoComplete="name" placeholder="Nhập họ và tên" aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.full_name)} aria-describedby={errors.full_name ? "name-error" : undefined} {...register("full_name", { required: "Bạn nhập họ tên nhé.", minLength: { value: 2, message: "Họ tên cần ít nhất 2 ký tự." }, maxLength: { value: 200, message: "Họ tên không quá 200 ký tự." } })} />{errors.full_name && <p id="name-error" role="alert" className="field-error">{errors.full_name.message}</p>}</div>
      <div className="auth-field"><label htmlFor="email">Email</label><input id="email" type="email" autoComplete="email" placeholder="Nhập địa chỉ email" aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)} aria-describedby={errors.email ? "email-error" : undefined} {...register("email", { required: "Bạn nhập email nhé.", pattern: { value: /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/, message: "Email chưa đúng định dạng." } })} />{errors.email && <p id="email-error" role="alert" className="field-error">{errors.email.message}</p>}</div>
      <div className="auth-field"><label htmlFor="password">Mật khẩu</label><input id="password" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" placeholder="Ít nhất 8 ký tự" aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.password)} aria-describedby={errors.password ? "password-error" : undefined} {...register("password", { required: "Bạn tạo mật khẩu nhé.", minLength: { value: 8, message: "Mật khẩu cần ít nhất 8 ký tự." }, maxLength: { value: 128, message: "Mật khẩu không quá 128 ký tự." } })} />{errors.password && <p id="password-error" role="alert" className="field-error">{errors.password.message}</p>}</div>
      <div className="auth-field"><label htmlFor="confirmPassword">Nhập lại mật khẩu</label><input id="confirmPassword" type="password" autoComplete="new-password" placeholder="Nhập lại mật khẩu" aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.confirmPassword)} aria-describedby={errors.confirmPassword ? "confirm-error" : undefined} {...register("confirmPassword", { required: "Bạn nhập lại mật khẩu nhé.", validate: (value) => value === watch("password") || "Hai mật khẩu chưa trùng nhau." })} />{errors.confirmPassword && <p id="confirm-error" role="alert" className="field-error">{errors.confirmPassword.message}</p>}</div>
      {submitError && <p role="alert" className="form-error">{submitError}</p>}
      <button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting} className="btn btn--primary auth-submit">{isSubmitting ? "Đang tạo tài khoản…" : <>Đăng ký <Icon name="arrow-right" /></>}</button>
      <p role="status" className="sr-only">{isSubmitting ? "Đang tạo tài khoản…" : ""}</p>
    </form>
  </AuthLayout>;
}

import {useState} from "react";
import {useMutation,useQuery,useQueryClient} from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {api,getApiErrorMessage} from "@/shared/api/client";
import {FamilyScope,buttonClass,fieldClass,Pager,QueryState} from "@/features/heritage/components/FamilyScope";
import {dateTime} from "@/shared/dates";

const reactions={Like:"Thích",Love:"Yêu thích",Haha:"Vui",Wow:"Ngạc nhiên",Sad:"Buồn",Angry:"Giận"};
function Composer({familyId,user,post,onSaved,onCancel}){
  const save=useMutation({mutationFn:({content,media,is_announcement})=>post?api.put(`/community/posts/${post.post_id}`,{content,media,is_announcement}):api.post("/community/posts",{family_id:familyId,content,media,is_announcement}),onSuccess:()=>onSaved()});
  return <form className="space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5" onSubmit={(event)=>{event.preventDefault();const form=event.currentTarget,values=new FormData(form);save.mutate({content:values.get("content"),media:String(values.get("media")).split(/\r?\n/).map((url)=>url.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((url)=>({url,type:"image"})),is_announcement:values.get("announcement")==="on"},{onSuccess:()=>form.reset()});}}>
    <h2 className="font-semibold text-forest">{post?"Sửa bài viết":"Chia sẻ với gia đình"}</h2><label className="block text-sm">Nội dung<textarea className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} name="content" required maxLength={20000} rows={3} defaultValue={post?.content || ""}/></label>
    <label className="block text-sm">Ảnh đính kèm (mỗi dòng một URL HTTPS)<textarea className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} name="media" rows={2} defaultValue={post?.media_urls.join("\n") || ""}/></label>
    {["admin","family_head"].includes(user.role)&&<label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" name="announcement" defaultChecked={post?.is_announcement}/>Đăng thông báo gia đình</label>}
    {save.isError&&<p role="alert" className="text-red-700">{getApiErrorMessage(save.error)}</p>}<div className="flex gap-3"><button className={buttonClass} disabled={save.isPending}>{save.isPending?"Đang lưu…":post?"Lưu bài viết":"Đăng bài"}</button>{onCancel&&<button type="button" onClick={onCancel}>Hủy</button>}</div>
  </form>;
}
function PostCard({post,user,onEdit,onChanged}){
  const [commentsOpen,setCommentsOpen]=useState(false),[commentPage,setCommentPage]=useState(1),[report,setReport]=useState(null),[editing,setEditing]=useState(null);
  const cache=useQueryClient();
  const comments=useQuery({queryKey:["comments",user.id,post.post_id,commentPage],queryFn:async()=>(await api.get(`/community/posts/${post.post_id}/comments`,{params:{page:commentPage,page_size:20}})).data,enabled:commentsOpen});
  const write=useMutation({mutationFn:(operation)=>operation(),onSuccess:()=>{setReport(null);setEditing(null);onChanged();cache.invalidateQueries({queryKey:["comments",user.id,post.post_id]});}});
  const manage=post.author_id===user.id||user.role==="admin";
  return <article className="space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5">
    <header className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3"><div><h2 className="font-semibold text-forest">{post.author_name || "Thành viên"}</h2><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-600">{dateTime(post.created_at)}{post.is_announcement?" · Thông báo gia đình":""}</p></div>{manage&&<div className="flex gap-3 text-sm"><button className="underline" onClick={()=>onEdit(post)}>Sửa bài</button><button className="text-red-700" disabled={write.isPending} onClick={()=>{if(window.confirm("Xóa bài và các bình luận/ảnh/cảm xúc liên quan?"))write.mutate(()=>api.delete(`/community/posts/${post.post_id}`));}}>Xóa bài</button></div>}</header>
    <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-stone-800">{post.content}</p>
    {!!post.media_urls.length&&<div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">{post.media_urls.filter((url)=>/^https?:\/\//i.test(url)).map((url,index)=><a href={url} key={`${url}-${index}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"><img src={url} alt={`Ảnh gia đình ${index+1}`} loading="lazy" className="max-h-96 w-full rounded-xl object-cover" onError={(event)=>{event.currentTarget.alt="Không tải được ảnh. Chọn để mở liên kết gốc.";}}/></a>)}</div>}
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 border-t border-stone-200 pt-3"><label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">Cảm xúc · {post.reaction_count}<select aria-label={`Cảm xúc cho bài của ${post.author_name || "thành viên"}`} className={fieldClass} value={post.my_reaction || ""} disabled={write.isPending} onChange={(event)=>{const type=event.target.value || null;write.mutate(()=>api.put(`/community/posts/${post.post_id}/reactions`,{type}));}}><option value="">Chưa chọn</option>{Object.entries(reactions).map(([key,label])=><option key={key} value={key}>{label}</option>)}</select></label><button className="text-sm font-medium text-forest" onClick={()=>setCommentsOpen(!commentsOpen)}>Bình luận · {post.comment_count}</button><button className="ml-auto text-sm text-stone-600 underline" onClick={()=>setReport({target_id:post.post_id,target_type:"post"})}>Báo cáo bài</button></div>
    {commentsOpen&&<section aria-label="Bình luận" className="space-y-3 border-t border-stone-200 pt-4"><QueryState query={comments}/>{comments.data?.map((row)=><div key={row.id} className="space-y-2 rounded-xl bg-stone-50 p-3"><p className="text-sm font-semibold">{row.author_name || "Thành viên"}</p><p className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm">{row.content}</p><div className="flex gap-4 text-xs">{(row.user_id===user.id||user.role==="admin")&&<><button onClick={()=>setEditing(row)}>Sửa bình luận</button><button disabled={write.isPending} onClick={()=>{if(window.confirm("Xóa bình luận này?"))write.mutate(()=>api.delete(`/community/comments/${row.id}`));}}>Xóa bình luận</button></>}<button onClick={()=>setReport({target_id:row.id,target_type:"comment"})}>Báo cáo bình luận</button></div></div>)}<Pager page={commentPage} total={post.comment_count} pageSize={20} onChange={setCommentPage}/>
      <form key={editing?.id || "new"} className="flex flex-wrap gap-3" onSubmit={(event)=>{event.preventDefault();const form=event.currentTarget,content=new FormData(form).get("content");write.mutate(()=>editing?api.put(`/community/comments/${editing.id}`,{content}):api.post(`/community/posts/${post.post_id}/comments`,{content}),{onSuccess:()=>form.reset()});}}><label className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-sm">{editing?"Sửa bình luận":"Viết bình luận"}<input className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} name="content" required maxLength={2000} defaultValue={editing?.content || ""}/></label><button className={`${buttonClass} self-end`} disabled={write.isPending}>{editing?"Lưu bình luận":"Gửi bình luận"}</button>{editing&&<button type="button" onClick={()=>setEditing(null)}>Hủy</button>}</form>
    </section>}
    {report&&<form className="space-y-3 rounded-xl bg-stone-50 p-3" onSubmit={(event)=>{event.preventDefault();const reason=new FormData(event.currentTarget).get("reason");write.mutate(()=>api.post("/community/reports",{...report,reason}));}}><label className="block text-sm">Lý do báo cáo<input className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} name="reason" required maxLength={500}/></label><div className="flex gap-3"><button className={buttonClass} disabled={write.isPending}>Gửi báo cáo</button><button type="button" onClick={()=>setReport(null)}>Hủy</button></div></form>}
    {write.isError&&<p role="alert" className="text-red-700">{getApiErrorMessage(write.error)}</p>}{write.isSuccess&&!report&&<p role="status" className="text-sm text-forest">Đã cập nhật.</p>}
  </article>;
}
function Feed({familyId,user}){
  const cache=useQueryClient(),[page,setPage]=useState(1),[editing,setEditing]=useState(null);
  const query=useQuery({queryKey:["community",user.id,familyId,page],queryFn:async()=>(await api.get("/community/posts",{params:{family_id:familyId,page,page_size:10}})).data});
  const changed=()=>cache.invalidateQueries({queryKey:["community"]});
  return <div className="max-w-4xl space-y-5"><Composer key={editing?.post_id || "new"} familyId={familyId} user={user} post={editing} onSaved={()=>{setEditing(null);setPage(1);changed();}} onCancel={editing?()=>setEditing(null):null}/><QueryState query={query}/>{query.data&&!query.data.items.length&&<p className="rounded-xl bg-white p-5">Chưa có bài viết. Hãy chia sẻ câu chuyện đầu tiên.</p>}{query.data?.items.map((post)=><PostCard key={post.post_id} post={post} user={user} onEdit={(row)=>{setEditing(row);window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"auto"});}} onChanged={changed}/>)}{query.data&&<Pager page={page} total={query.data.total} pageSize={10} onChange={setPage}/>}</div>;
}
export function Community(){return <FamilyScope title="Bảng tin gia đình" description="Chia sẻ tin tức, ảnh và những câu chuyện của gia đình.">{(familyId,user)=><Feed key={familyId} familyId={familyId} user={user}/>}</FamilyScope>;}

export function Dashboard() {

  return <div className="dashboard">

Gìn giữ qua những kỷ niệm.</p>{user.role !== "guest" && <Link className="btn btn--primary" to="/family-tree">Xem cây gia phả <Icon name="arrow-right" /></Link>}</div><div className="welcome-symbol" aria-hidden="true"><Icon name="network" /></div></section>

      <Link to="/family-tree" className="workspace-card card"><span className="workspace-icon"><Icon name="network" /></span><div><h3>Cây gia phả</h3><p>Tìm hiểu các thế hệ và mối quan hệ trong gia đình.</p><span className="workspace-action">Xem gia phả <Icon name="arrow-up-right" /></span></div><span className="workspace-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span></Link>
      <Link to="/heritage" className="workspace-card card"><span className="workspace-icon warm"><Icon name="book-open" /></span><div><h3>Di sản & Vinh danh</h3><p>Lưu lại câu chuyện, hình ảnh và đóng góp của các thế hệ.</p><span className="workspace-action">Mở kho di sản <Icon name="arrow-up-right" /></span></div><span className="workspace-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span></Link>
    </div></section>}
    {canViewStatistics ? <section aria-labelledby="statistics-title" className="statistics-section"><div className="section-heading"><div><h2 id="statistics-title">Hoạt động gia đình</h2><p>{user.role === "admin" ? "Thống kê các gia đình trong hệ thống." : "Thống kê các gia đình có hồ sơ đã liên kết với bạn."}</p></div><button type="button" disabled={query.isFetching} onClick={() => query.refetch()} className="btn btn--secondary"><Icon name="refresh-cw" />{query.isFetching ?       {query.isPending ? <p role="status" className="query-message">Đang tải thống kê…</p>

            : <><dl className="stat-grid">{cards.map((card) => <div key={card.label} className="stat-card"><dt><span>{card.label}</span><Icon name={card.icon} /></dt><dd>{card.value.toLocaleString("vi-VN")}</dd></div>)}</dl>
              <div className="chart-panel"><div className="section-heading"><h3>Thống kê theo gia đình</h3><span>Thành viên · Bài viết · Sự kiện</span></div><div role="img" aria-label="Biểu đồ số thành viên, bài viết và sự kiện theo gia đình" className="h-80 min-w-0"><ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%"><BarChart data={rows} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -20, bottom: 10 }}><CartesianGrid stroke="#e5e8df" strokeDasharray="3 3" vertical={false} /><XAxis dataKey="family_name" tick={{ fontSize: 13, fill: "#60695f" }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} /><YAxis allowDecimals={false} tick={{ fontSize: 13, fill: "#60695f" }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} /><Tooltip /><Legend /><Bar dataKey="member_count" name="Thành viên" fill="#244b3e" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} /><Bar dataKey="post_count" name="Bài viết" fill="#92ad82" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} /><Bar dataKey="event_count" name="Sự kiện" fill="#c79666" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]} /></BarChart></ResponsiveContainer></div>
                <div className="data-table-scroll"><table className="w-full text-left text-sm"><caption className="sr-only">Số liệu hoạt động theo gia đình</caption><thead><tr><th scope="col">Gia đình</th><th scope="col">Thành viên</th><th scope="col">Bài viết</th><th scope="col">Sự kiện</th></tr></thead><tbody>{rows.map((row) => <tr key={row.family_id}><th scope="row">{row.family_name}</th><td>{row.member_count}</td><td>{row.post_count}</td><td>{row.event_count}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table></div>
              </div></>}
    </section> : <aside className="family-note"><Icon name="heart-handshake" /><div><h2>{user.role === "guest" ? "Chào mừng đến với FamilyConnect" : "Gia đình bắt đầu từ sự kết nối"}</h2><p>{user.role === "guest" ? "Liên hệ người quản lý gia đình để được xác minh và truy cập gia phả, di sản." : "Chưa thấy gia đình của mình? Liên hệ người quản lý để xác minh và liên kết hồ sơ thành viên."}</p></div></aside>}
    <footer className="workspace-footer"><span>FamilyConnect</span><span>Gìn giữ hôm nay, tiếp nối mai sau.</span></footer>
  </div>;
}

# FILE: apps/web/src/features/directory/Directory.jsx

import { useState } from "react";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { api, getApiErrorMessage } from "@/shared/api/client";
import { FamilyScope, fieldClass, buttonClass, Pager, QueryState } from "@/features/heritage/components/FamilyScope";
import { genealogyApi } from "@/features/genealogy/api/genealogyApi";

function MemberDetail({ familyId, id, user, onClose }) {
  const cache=useQueryClient();
  const [editor,setEditor]=useState(null);
  const query=useQuery({queryKey:["directory",user.id,familyId,id],queryFn:async()=>(await api.get(`/directory/${id}`,{params:{family_id:familyId}})).data});
  const write=useMutation({mutationFn:(operation)=>operation(),onSuccess:()=>{setEditor(null);cache.invalidateQueries({queryKey:["directory"]});}});
  const fields={educations:[["institution","Trường / cơ sở đào tạo",true],["degree","Bằng cấp",false]],work:[["company","Công ty / đơn vị",true],["position","Chức danh / nghề nghiệp",true]]};
  return <section className="space-y-4 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5">
    <button type="button" className="text-sm text-forest underline" onClick={onClose}>← Về danh bạ</button><QueryState query={query}/>
    {query.data && <><h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-forest">{query.data.name}</h2><p className="text-sm text-stone-600">{query.data.birth_date || "Chưa ghi ngày sinh"} · {query.data.location || "Chưa ghi nơi ở"} · {query.data.branch_name || "Chưa phân chi"}</p>
      {["educations","work"].map((resource)=><section key={resource} className="space-y-3 border-t border-stone-200 pt-4"><div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3"><h3 className="font-semibold text-forest">{resource==="educations"?"Học vấn":"Công việc"}</h3>{query.data.can_edit && <button className={buttonClass} onClick={()=>{write.reset();setEditor({resource});}}>Thêm {resource==="educations"?"học vấn":"công việc"}</button>}</div>
        {!query.data[resource].length && <p className="text-sm text-stone-600">Chưa có thông tin.</p>}
        {query.data[resource].map((row)=><div key={row.id} className="flex flex-wrap justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-stone-50 p-3"><div><p className="font-medium">{resource==="educations"?row.institution:row.company}</p><p className="text-sm">{resource==="educations"?row.degree:row.position}</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-stone-600">{row.start_date || "Chưa rõ"} → {row.end_date || "Hiện tại"}</p></div>{query.data.can_edit && <div className="flex gap-3"><button className="text-sm underline" onClick={()=>{write.reset();setEditor({resource,...row});}}>Sửa<span className="sr-only"> {row.institution || row.company}</span></button><button className="text-sm text-red-700" disabled={write.isPending} onClick={()=>{if(window.confirm("Xóa thông tin này?"))write.mutate(()=>api.delete(`/directory/${id}/${resource}/${row.id}`));}}>Xóa<span className="sr-only"> {row.institution || row.company}</span></button></div>}</div>)}
      </section>)}
      {editor && <form key={editor.id || editor.resource} className="space-y-4 rounded-xl bg-sage p-4" onSubmit={(event)=>{event.preventDefault();const values=new FormData(event.currentTarget);const payload=Object.fromEntries([...values].map(([key,value])=>[key,value || null]));write.mutate(()=>api[editor.id?"put":"post"](`/directory/${id}/${editor.resource}${editor.id?`/${editor.id}`:""}`,payload));}}>
        <h3 className="font-semibold">{editor.id?"Sửa":"Thêm"} {editor.resource==="educations"?"học vấn":"công việc"}</h3>
        {fields[editor.resource].map(([name,label,required])=><label className="block text-sm font-medium" key={name}>{label}<input name={name} className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} required={required} maxLength={200} defaultValue={editor[name] || ""}/></label>)}
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">{[["start_date","Ngày bắt đầu"],["end_date","Ngày kết thúc (để trống nếu đang tiếp tục)"]].map(([name,label])=><label className="block text-sm" key={name}>{label}<input className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} name={name} type="date" defaultValue={editor[name] || ""}/></label>)}</div>
        <div className="flex gap-3"><button className={buttonClass} disabled={write.isPending}>Lưu thông tin</button><button type="button" onClick={()=>setEditor(null)}>Hủy</button></div>
      </form>}
    </>}{write.isError && <p role="alert" className="text-red-700">{getApiErrorMessage(write.error)}</p>}
  </section>;
}

function DirectoryWorkspace({familyId,user}) {
  const [filters,setFilters]=useState({}),[page,setPage]=useState(1),[selected,setSelected]=useState(null);
  const query=useQuery({queryKey:["directory",user.id,familyId,filters,page],queryFn:async()=>(await api.get("/directory",{params:{family_id:familyId,page,...filters}})).data});
  const branches=useQuery({queryKey:["genealogy",user.id,familyId,"directory-branches"],queryFn:()=>genealogyApi.branches(familyId)});
  if(selected)return <MemberDetail familyId={familyId} user={user} id={selected} onClose={()=>setSelected(null)}/>;
  return <div className="space-y-5"><form className="grid gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3" onSubmit={(event)=>{event.preventDefault();setFilters(Object.fromEntries([...new FormData(event.currentTarget)].filter(([,value])=>value!=="")));setPage(1);}}>
    {[["q","Họ và tên"],["occupation","Nghề nghiệp / đơn vị"],["education","Trường / bằng cấp"],["location","Nơi ở"]].map(([name,label])=><label className="text-sm font-medium" key={name}>{label}<input className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} name={name} maxLength={name==="location"?300:200} defaultValue={filters[name] || ""}/></label>)}
    <label className="text-sm font-medium">Thế hệ<input className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} name="generation" type="number" min={1} max={1000} defaultValue={filters.generation || ""}/></label>
    <label className="text-sm font-medium">Chi nhánh<select className={`${fieldClass} mt-2`} name="branch_id" defaultValue={filters.branch_id || ""}><option value="">Tất cả chi</option>{branches.data?.items.map((row)=><option key={row.id} value={row.id}>{row.name}</option>)}</select></label>
    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" name="current_job" value="true" defaultChecked={filters.current_job==="true"}/>Chỉ công việc hiện tại</label><button className={`${buttonClass} justify-self-start`} type="submit">Tìm thành viên</button>
  </form><QueryState query={query}/>
    {query.data && <><p className="text-sm text-stone-600">{query.data.total} thành viên</p><div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">{query.data.items.map((row)=><button key={row.id} className="rounded-2xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 text-left" onClick={()=>setSelected(row.id)}><h2 className="font-semibold text-forest">{row.name}</h2><p className="mt-2 text-sm">Thế hệ {row.generation} · {row.birth_date || "Chưa ghi ngày sinh"}</p><p className="mt-2 text-sm text-stone-600">{row.location || "Chưa ghi nơi ở"}</p><p className="mt-1 text-sm">{[row.position,row.company].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || "Chưa ghi công việc"}</p><p className="mt-1 text-sm text-stone-600">{row.institution || "Chưa ghi học vấn"}</p></button>)}</div><Pager page={page} total={query.data.total} onChange={setPage}/></>}
  </div>;
}
export function Directory(){return <FamilyScope title="Danh bạ gia đình" description="Tìm người thân theo nơi ở, nghề nghiệp, học vấn và thế hệ.">{(familyId,user)=><DirectoryWorkspace key={familyId} familyId={familyId} user={user}/>}</FamilyScope>;}
