################################################################################
# FILE: database/init.ps1
################################################################################
param(
    [string]$Server = "localhost",
    [string]$DbName = "FamilyConnect",
    [string]$User = "",
    [string]$Password = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path

$Folders = @("schema", "views", "procedures", "triggers", "seed")

foreach ($dir in $Folders) {
    $targetPath = Join-Path $ScriptDir $dir
    if (-not (Test-Path $targetPath)) { continue }

    Get-ChildItem -Path $targetPath -Filter "*.sql" | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object {
        Write-Host "Dang chay $dir/$($_.Name)..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

        $argsList = @("-S", $Server, "-C", "-b", "-I", "-v", "DB_NAME=$DbName", "-i", $_.FullName)
        if ($_.Name -ne "00_schemas.sql") {
            $argsList = @("-d", $DbName) + $argsList
        }

        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($User)) {
            $argsList = @("-E") + $argsList
        } else {
            $argsList = @("-U", $User, "-P", $Password) + $argsList
        }

        & sqlcmd @argsList
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Loi khi chay file $dir/$($_.Name) (ExitCode: $LASTEXITCODE)"
        }
    }
}

Write-Host "Hoan tat khoi tao Database '$DbName' tren '$Server'!" -ForegroundColor Green

################################################################################
# FILE: database/init.sh
################################################################################
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
DB_HOST="${MSSQL_HOST:-localhost}"
DB_PORT="${MSSQL_PORT:-1433}"
DB_USER="${MSSQL_USER:-sa}"
DB_NAME="${MSSQL_DB:-FamilyConnect}"

: "${MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD:?Set MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD before running database/init.sh}"
if [[ ! "$DB_NAME" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$ ]]; then
    echo "MSSQL_DB may contain only letters, numbers, and underscores." >&2
    exit 2
fi

export SQLCMDPASSWORD="$MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD"
SQLCMD=(sqlcmd -S "${DB_HOST},${DB_PORT}" -U "$DB_USER" -C -b -I -v "DB_NAME=$DB_NAME")

shopt -s nullglob

run_scripts() {
    local directory="$1"
    local -a files=("$directory"/*.sql)
    local file

    for file in "${files[@]}"; do
        echo "Running ${file##*/}"
        "${SQLCMD[@]}" -i "$file"
    done
}

run_scripts "$SCRIPT_DIR/schema"
run_scripts "$SCRIPT_DIR/views"
run_scripts "$SCRIPT_DIR/procedures"
run_scripts "$SCRIPT_DIR/triggers"
run_scripts "$SCRIPT_DIR/seed"

################################################################################
# FILE: database/migrate.py
################################################################################
"""Apply the checked-in SQL objects without running seed or resetting data."""
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
from sqlalchemy.exc import OperationalError

SQL_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def apply_scripts(connection, database: str, root: Path = SQL_ROOT) -> None:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+", database) or database.lower() in {"master", "model", "msdb", "tempdb"}:
        raise ValueError("Use a non-system MSSQL_DB containing only letters, numbers and underscores.")
    files = [path for folder in ("schema", "views", "procedures", "triggers")
             for path in sorted((root / folder).glob("*.sql")) if path.name != "00_schemas.sql"]
    for path in files:
        script = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").replace("$(DB_NAME)", database)
        for batch in re.split(r"(?im)^\s*GO\s*(?:--[^\r\n]*)?\r?$", script):
            if batch.strip():
                connection.exec_driver_sql(batch).close()
        print(f"Applied {path.parent.name}/{path.name}", flush=True)


def main() -> None:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SQL_ROOT.parent / "apps" / "backend"))
    from app.core.database import database_url

    database = database_url.database
    if not database or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+", database) or database.lower() in {"master", "model", "msdb", "tempdb"}:
        raise ValueError("MSSQL_DB must name a non-system database.")
    master = create_engine(database_url.set(database="master"), isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT")
    for attempt in range(30):
        try:
            with master.connect() as connection:
                if connection.execute(text("SELECT DB_ID(:name)"), {"name": database}).scalar() is None:
                    connection.exec_driver_sql(f"CREATE DATABASE [{database}]").close()
            break
        except OperationalError:
            if attempt == 29:
                raise
            time.sleep(2)
    master.dispose()
    engine = create_engine(database_url)
    try:
        with engine.begin() as connection:
            for schema in ("core", "genealogy", "community", "reports", "heritage"):
                connection.exec_driver_sql(f"IF SCHEMA_ID(N'{schema}') IS NULL EXEC(N'CREATE SCHEMA [{schema}]')").close()
            apply_scripts(connection, database)
    finally:
        engine.dispose()
    print("Migration committed; seed was not run.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

################################################################################
# FILE: database/perf/00_perf_seed_MemberClosure.sql
################################################################################
-- =====================================================================
-- PERF 00: Sinh du lieu lon de do hieu nang bang bao dong MemberClosure
--
-- Tao 1 dong ho rieng ten N'__PERF_TEST__' gom @Members thanh vien xep thanh
-- cay @Fanout-phan (moi nguoi 1 cha/me), kem ParentChild, MemberClosure,
-- Educations, WorkHistories. Khong dong cham den du lieu seed that.
-- Don dep bang 99_perf_cleanup.sql.
--
-- Chinh 2 tham so ngay duoi (khong dung bien SQLCMD de chay duoc ca 2 cach).
--   @Members = so thanh vien           (100 .. 2.000.000)
--   @Fanout  = so con toi da moi nguoi (2..20; 2 -> ~17 doi voi 100k nguoi,
--                                       3 -> ~11 doi)
-- So dong closure ~ SUM(Depth + 1) ~ @Members * (so doi trung binh + 1)
-- (100k nguoi, Fanout 2 -> ~1,7 trieu dong). Nen giu @Members <= 500.000.
-- =====================================================================
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
GO
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

DECLARE @Members INT = 100000;
DECLARE @Fanout  INT = 2;
DECLARE @FamilyName NVARCHAR(200) = N'__PERF_TEST__';

-- Fanout >= 2: Fanout = 1 la 1 chuoi dai @Members doi -> closure ~ @Members^2 / 2 dong.
IF @Members NOT BETWEEN 100 AND 2000000 OR @Fanout NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 20
    THROW 50000, N'Tham so ngoai khoang cho phep (Members 100..2000000, Fanout 2..20).', 1;

IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Families] WHERE [Name] = @FamilyName)
    THROW 50000, N'Du lieu perf da ton tai. Chay 99_perf_cleanup.sql truoc khi seed lai.', 1;

DECLARE @t0 DATETIME2(3) = SYSDATETIME();
DECLARE @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    -- Trigger kiem tra chu trinh se di bo ca cay cho moi dong chen vao -> tat trong luc nap.
    -- Cay sinh ra chac chan khong co chu trinh va moi nut chi co 1 cha/me.
    -- Neu ROLLBACK thi DISABLE cung bi hoan tac; COMMIT thi da ENABLE lai o cuoi.
    DISABLE TRIGGER [genealogy].[trg_ParentChild_PreventCycle] ON [genealogy].[ParentChild];

    -- 1. Dong ho + 4 chi nhanh
    DECLARE @F TABLE ([Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
    INSERT INTO [core].[Families] ([Name])
    OUTPUT inserted.[Id] INTO @F
    VALUES (@FamilyName);
    SELECT @FamilyId = [Id] FROM @F;

    DECLARE @B TABLE ([Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, [Name] NVARCHAR(200));
    INSERT INTO [core].[Branches] ([FamilyId], [Name])
    OUTPUT inserted.[Id], inserted.[Name] INTO @B
    VALUES (@FamilyId, N'PERF-BRANCH-0'), (@FamilyId, N'PERF-BRANCH-1'),
           (@FamilyId, N'PERF-BRANCH-2'), (@FamilyId, N'PERF-BRANCH-3');

    -- 2. Cay nut trong bang tam: nut Seq co cha la (Seq - 2) / Fanout + 1 (Seq = 1 la goc)
    CREATE TABLE #Nodes
    (
        [Seq] INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        [Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
        [ParentSeq] INT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX [IX_Nodes_ParentSeq] ON #Nodes ([ParentSeq]);

    -- a x b cua sys.all_objects ~ vai trieu dong (>= 2.000.000 khi bang co >= 1415 dong).
    -- TOP + WHERE n <= @Members: dung som sau @Members dong va luon ra dung tap 1..@Members.
    INSERT INTO #Nodes ([Seq], [ParentSeq])
    SELECT TOP (@Members)
           CAST(x.[n] AS INT),
           CASE WHEN x.[n] = 1 THEN NULL ELSE CAST((x.[n] - 2) / @Fanout + 1 AS INT) END
    FROM
    (
        SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS [n]
        FROM sys.all_objects a
        CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b
    ) x
    WHERE x.[n] <= @Members;

    IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Nodes) <> @Members
        THROW 50000, N'Khong sinh du so nut yeu cau (sys.all_objects qua it dong).', 1;

    -- 3. Members
    INSERT INTO [genealogy].[Members] ([Id], [FamilyId], [BranchId], [FullName], [BirthDate], [Location])
    SELECT n.[Id],
           @FamilyId,
           b.[Id],
           N'PERF-' + CAST(n.[Seq] AS NVARCHAR(10)),
           DATEADD(DAY, -((CHECKSUM(n.[Seq]) & 0x7FFFFFFF) % 25000), CAST('2000-01-01' AS DATE)),
           CHOOSE(n.[Seq] % 5 + 1, N'Ha Noi', N'TP HCM', N'Da Nang', N'Hue', N'Can Tho')
    FROM #Nodes n
    INNER JOIN @B b ON b.[Name] = N'PERF-BRANCH-' + CAST(n.[Seq] % 4 AS NVARCHAR(10))
    ORDER BY n.[Id];

    -- 4. ParentChild
    INSERT INTO [genealogy].[ParentChild] ([ParentId], [ChildId])
    SELECT p.[Id], n.[Id]
    FROM #Nodes n
    INNER JOIN #Nodes p ON p.[Seq] = n.[ParentSeq]
    ORDER BY n.[Id];

    -- 5. Hoc van (moi nguoi thu 2) va cong tac (moi nguoi thu 3): de view/proc thu muc co du lieu that
    INSERT INTO [genealogy].[Educations] ([MemberId], [Institution], [Degree], [StartDate], [EndDate])
    SELECT n.[Id], N'PERF University ' + CAST(n.[Seq] % 50 AS NVARCHAR(5)), N'Bachelor',
           CAST('2010-09-01' AS DATE), CAST('2014-06-30' AS DATE)
    FROM #Nodes n
    WHERE n.[Seq] % 2 = 0;

    INSERT INTO [genealogy].[WorkHistories] ([MemberId], [Company], [Position], [StartDate], [EndDate])
    SELECT n.[Id], N'PERF Company ' + CAST(n.[Seq] % 100 AS NVARCHAR(5)),
           CASE WHEN n.[Seq] % 2 = 0 THEN N'Engineer' ELSE N'Teacher' END,
           CAST('2015-01-01' AS DATE),
           CASE WHEN n.[Seq] % 6 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST('2022-12-31' AS DATE) END
    FROM #Nodes n
    WHERE n.[Seq] % 3 = 0;

    -- 6. Bao dong tinh san trong bang tam theo tung doi (cay 1 cha/me -> khong trung cap)
    CREATE TABLE #Closure
    (
        [Depth] INT NOT NULL,
        [AncestorSeq] INT NOT NULL,
        [DescSeq] INT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([Depth], [AncestorSeq], [DescSeq])
    );

    INSERT INTO #Closure ([Depth], [AncestorSeq], [DescSeq])
    SELECT 0, [Seq], [Seq] FROM #Nodes;

    DECLARE @d INT = 0;
    DECLARE @rows INT = 1;
    WHILE @rows > 0
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO #Closure ([Depth], [AncestorSeq], [DescSeq])
        SELECT @d + 1, c.[AncestorSeq], n.[Seq]
        FROM #Closure c
        INNER JOIN #Nodes n ON n.[ParentSeq] = c.[DescSeq]
        WHERE c.[Depth] = @d;

        SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
        SET @d += 1;
    END;

    -- Chen theo dung thu tu khoa cum (AncestorId, DescendantId) de chi muc moi nap it phan manh
    INSERT INTO [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ([AncestorId], [DescendantId], [Depth])
    SELECT a.[Id], d.[Id], c.[Depth]
    FROM #Closure c
    INNER JOIN #Nodes a ON a.[Seq] = c.[AncestorSeq]
    INNER JOIN #Nodes d ON d.[Seq] = c.[DescSeq]
    ORDER BY a.[Id], d.[Id];

    ENABLE TRIGGER [genealogy].[trg_ParentChild_PreventCycle] ON [genealogy].[ParentChild];

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    THROW;
END CATCH;

-- 7. Thong ke day du de so do khong bi anh huong boi thong ke cu
UPDATE STATISTICS [genealogy].[Members]       WITH FULLSCAN;
UPDATE STATISTICS [genealogy].[ParentChild]   WITH FULLSCAN;
UPDATE STATISTICS [genealogy].[MemberClosure] WITH FULLSCAN;
UPDATE STATISTICS [genealogy].[Educations]    WITH FULLSCAN;
UPDATE STATISTICS [genealogy].[WorkHistories] WITH FULLSCAN;

-- PRINT khong cho phep subquery -> gan ra bien truoc
DECLARE @MemberCount BIGINT = (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [genealogy].[Members] WHERE [FamilyId] = @FamilyId);
DECLARE @ClosureCount BIGINT, @MaxDepth INT;
SELECT @ClosureCount = COUNT_BIG(*), @MaxDepth = MAX(c.[Depth])
FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] m
              WHERE m.[Id] = c.[AncestorId] AND m.[FamilyId] = @FamilyId);

PRINT N'--- PERF seed xong ---';
PRINT N'FamilyId       : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @FamilyId);
PRINT N'Members        : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @MemberCount);
PRINT N'Closure rows   : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @ClosureCount);
PRINT N'Max Depth      : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @MaxDepth);
PRINT N'Thoi gian (s)  : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), DATEDIFF(SECOND, @t0, SYSDATETIME()));
GO

################################################################################
# FILE: database/perf/01_perf_measure.sql
################################################################################
-- =====================================================================
-- PERF 01: Do STATISTICS IO / STATISTICS TIME cac truy van tren MemberClosure
--
-- Dieu kien: da chay 00_perf_seed.sql (dong ho N'__PERF_TEST__').
-- Chay TOAN BO file trong 1 lan (1 batch, bien se mat neu chon chay tung doan).
--
-- Chay 2 lan: lan 1 nap cache + plan, GHI SO LIEU LAN 2 (warm).
-- Muon so cold-cache thi dat @Cold = 1 (chi tren may dev, can quyen sysadmin).
-- =====================================================================
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
SET NOCOUNT ON;
GO
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

SET STATISTICS IO OFF;
SET STATISTICS TIME OFF;
SET STATISTICS XML OFF;

DECLARE @Cold BIT = 0;   -- 1: CHECKPOINT + DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS truoc moi truy van

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Chuan bi: chon cac thanh vien mau (chua bat STATISTICS)
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER =
    (SELECT [Id] FROM [core].[Families] WHERE [Name] = N'__PERF_TEST__');
IF @FamilyId IS NULL
    THROW 50000, N'Chua co du lieu perf. Chay 00_perf_seed.sql truoc.', 1;

DECLARE @Root UNIQUEIDENTIFIER =
    (SELECT TOP (1) [Id] FROM [genealogy].[Members]
     WHERE [FamilyId] = @FamilyId AND [FullName] = N'PERF-1');

DECLARE @Deep UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Other UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @Gen3 UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Gen8 UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;

-- @Deep / @Other: hai nut o doi sau nhat (de LCA va truy van to tien dai nhat)
SELECT TOP (1) @Deep  = [DescendantId] FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure]
WHERE [AncestorId] = @Root ORDER BY [Depth] DESC, [DescendantId] ASC;
SELECT TOP (1) @Other = [DescendantId] FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure]
WHERE [AncestorId] = @Root ORDER BY [Depth] DESC, [DescendantId] DESC;
-- @Gen3: cay con lon (doi 3); @Gen8: cay con nho (doi 8)
SELECT TOP (1) @Gen3 = [DescendantId] FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure]
WHERE [AncestorId] = @Root AND [Depth] = 3 ORDER BY [DescendantId];
SELECT TOP (1) @Gen8 = [DescendantId] FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure]
WHERE [AncestorId] = @Root AND [Depth] = 8 ORDER BY [DescendantId];
SET @Gen3 = ISNULL(@Gen3, @Root);   -- cay qua nho, khong du doi
SET @Gen8 = ISNULL(@Gen8, @Deep);

DECLARE @MemberCount BIGINT  = (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [genealogy].[Members] WHERE [FamilyId] = @FamilyId);
DECLARE @ClosureCount BIGINT = (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] WHERE [AncestorId] = @Root);
DECLARE @DeepDepth INT       = (SELECT [Depth] FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] WHERE [AncestorId] = @Root AND [DescendantId] = @Deep);
DECLARE @Gen3Size BIGINT     = (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] WHERE [AncestorId] = @Gen3);
DECLARE @Gen8Size BIGINT     = (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] WHERE [AncestorId] = @Gen8);

PRINT N'===== BOI CANH DO =====';
PRINT N'Members trong dong ho perf : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @MemberCount);
PRINT N'Dong closure cua goc       : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @ClosureCount) + N' (ke ca dong tu than)';
PRINT N'Depth cua nut sau nhat     : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @DeepDepth);
PRINT N'Cay con @Gen3 (so nut)     : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @Gen3Size);
PRINT N'Cay con @Gen8 (so nut)     : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(20), @Gen8Size);
PRINT N'Cold cache                 : ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1), @Cold);

SET STATISTICS IO ON;
SET STATISTICS TIME ON;
-- SET STATISTICS XML ON;

-- =====================================================================
-- NHOM 1: TO TIEN
-- =====================================================================
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q1a  To tien cua nut sau nhat - fn_GetAncestors (dung closure) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC sp_executesql
    N'SELECT * FROM [genealogy].[fn_GetAncestors](@id)',
    N'@id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER', @id = @Deep;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q1b  To tien cua nut sau nhat - de quy tren ParentChild (khong closure, de so sanh) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
;WITH Up AS
(
    SELECT pc.[ParentId] AS AncestorId, 1 AS Depth
    FROM [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc
    WHERE pc.[ChildId] = @Deep
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pc.[ParentId], u.Depth + 1
    FROM Up u
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc ON pc.[ChildId] = u.AncestorId
)
SELECT m.[Id] AS MemberId, m.[FullName], m.[BirthDate], m.[Location], m.[FamilyId], m.[BranchId], u.Depth AS GenerationsUp
FROM Up u
INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] m ON m.[Id] = u.AncestorId
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 200, RECOMPILE);

-- =====================================================================
-- NHOM 2: HAU DUE
-- =====================================================================
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q2a  Hau due cua GOC, khong gioi han doi - fn_GetDescendants(@root, NULL) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC sp_executesql
    N'SELECT * FROM [genealogy].[fn_GetDescendants](@id, @max)',
    N'@id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @max INT', @id = @Root, @max = NULL;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q2b  Hau due cua GOC toi da 3 doi - plan da cache o Q2a duoc dung lai (parameter sniffing) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC sp_executesql
    N'SELECT * FROM [genealogy].[fn_GetDescendants](@id, @max)',
    N'@id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @max INT', @id = @Root, @max = 3;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q2c  Hau due cua nut @Gen3 (cay con vua), khong gioi han doi #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC sp_executesql
    N'SELECT * FROM [genealogy].[fn_GetDescendants](@id, @max)',
    N'@id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @max INT', @id = @Gen3, @max = NULL;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q2d  Hau due cua nut @Gen8 (cay con nho), khong gioi han doi #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC sp_executesql
    N'SELECT * FROM [genealogy].[fn_GetDescendants](@id, @max)',
    N'@id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @max INT', @id = @Gen8, @max = NULL;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q2e  Hau due cua nut @Gen3 - de quy tren ParentChild (khong closure, de so sanh) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
;WITH Down AS
(
    SELECT pc.[ChildId] AS DescendantId, 1 AS Depth
    FROM [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc
    WHERE pc.[ParentId] = @Gen3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT pc.[ChildId], d.Depth + 1
    FROM Down d
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc ON pc.[ParentId] = d.DescendantId
)
SELECT m.[Id] AS MemberId, m.[FullName], m.[BirthDate], m.[Location], m.[FamilyId], m.[BranchId], d.Depth AS GenerationsDown
FROM Down d
INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] m ON m.[Id] = d.DescendantId
OPTION (MAXRECURSION 200, RECOMPILE);

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q3  Dem hau due theo tung doi cua GOC (chi can closure, khong cham Members) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
SELECT c.[Depth], COUNT_BIG(*) AS Members
FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c
WHERE c.[AncestorId] = @Root
GROUP BY c.[Depth]
ORDER BY c.[Depth]
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

-- =====================================================================
-- NHOM 3: KIEM TRA QUAN HE (cac truy van con trong usp_AddChildNode / usp_AddMarriage)
-- =====================================================================
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q4  Kiem tra chu trinh: con co phai to tien cua cha/me (tra cuu theo khoa chinh) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS
       (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] WHERE [AncestorId] = @Deep AND [DescendantId] = @Root)
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HasCycle
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q5  To tien chung gan nhat (LCA) cua 2 nut sau nhat - mau trong usp_AddMarriage #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
SELECT TOP (1) ca.[AncestorId], ca.[Depth] AS DepthA, cb.[Depth] AS DepthB, ca.[Depth] + cb.[Depth] AS Distance
FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ca
INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] cb ON cb.[AncestorId] = ca.[AncestorId]
WHERE ca.[DescendantId] = @Deep
  AND cb.[DescendantId] = @Other
ORDER BY ca.[Depth] + cb.[Depth]
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

-- =====================================================================
-- NHOM 4: VIEW / PROC THU MUC (dung MemberClosure qua OUTER APPLY)
-- =====================================================================
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q6a  vw_MemberDirectoryProfile - 1 thanh vien (tra theo MemberId) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC sp_executesql
    N'SELECT * FROM [genealogy].[vw_MemberDirectoryProfile] WHERE [MemberId] = @id',
    N'@id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER', @id = @Deep;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q6b  vw_MemberDirectoryProfile - trang dau 50 nguoi cua dong ho, sap theo ten #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC sp_executesql
    N'SELECT TOP (50) * FROM [genealogy].[vw_MemberDirectoryProfile] WHERE [FamilyId] = @fam ORDER BY [FullName]',
    N'@fam UNIQUEIDENTIFIER', @fam = @FamilyId;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q7a  usp_SearchDirectory - chi theo dong ho, trang 1 #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC [genealogy].[usp_SearchDirectory] @FamilyId = @FamilyId, @PageNumber = 1, @PageSize = 50;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q7b  usp_SearchDirectory - loc theo cay con cua goc (@RootMemberId) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC [genealogy].[usp_SearchDirectory] @FamilyId = @FamilyId, @RootMemberId = @Root, @PageNumber = 1, @PageSize = 50;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q7c  usp_SearchDirectory - cay con cua goc + loc doi (@Generation = 5) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC [genealogy].[usp_SearchDirectory] @FamilyId = @FamilyId, @RootMemberId = @Root, @Generation = 5, @PageNumber = 1, @PageSize = 50;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q7d  usp_SearchDirectory - tim theo tu khoa ten (CHARINDEX, khong sargable) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
EXEC [genealogy].[usp_SearchDirectory] @FamilyId = @FamilyId, @Keyword = N'PERF-1000', @PageNumber = 1, @PageSize = 50;

-- =====================================================================
-- NHOM 5: SO SANH CHI MUC (ep chi muc bang hint, chi de do - KHONG dua vao code that)
--   Q8a/Q8b: tim to tien theo DescendantId
--   Q8c/Q8d/Q8e: tim hau due <= 3 doi theo AncestorId
-- =====================================================================
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q8a  To tien - ep PK_MemberClosure (khoa dau la AncestorId -> du kien phai quet) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
SELECT c.[AncestorId], c.[Depth]
FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c WITH (INDEX([PK_MemberClosure]))
WHERE c.[DescendantId] = @Deep AND c.[Depth] > 0
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q8b  To tien - ep IX_MemberClosure_Descendant_Depth #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
SELECT c.[AncestorId], c.[Depth]
FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c WITH (INDEX([IX_MemberClosure_Descendant_Depth]))
WHERE c.[DescendantId] = @Deep AND c.[Depth] > 0
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q8c  Hau due <= 3 doi cua @Gen3 - ep PK_MemberClosure #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
SELECT c.[DescendantId], c.[Depth]
FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c WITH (INDEX([PK_MemberClosure]))
WHERE c.[AncestorId] = @Gen3 AND c.[Depth] BETWEEN 1 AND 3
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q8d  Hau due <= 3 doi cua @Gen3 - ep IX_MemberClosure_Ancestor_Depth #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
SELECT c.[DescendantId], c.[Depth]
FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c WITH (INDEX([IX_MemberClosure_Ancestor_Depth]))
WHERE c.[AncestorId] = @Gen3 AND c.[Depth] BETWEEN 1 AND 3
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### Q8e  Hau due <= 3 doi cua @Gen3 - de optimizer tu chon (khong hint) #####';
IF @Cold = 1 BEGIN CHECKPOINT; DBCC DROPCLEANBUFFERS WITH NO_INFOMSGS; END;
SELECT c.[DescendantId], c.[Depth]
FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c
WHERE c.[AncestorId] = @Gen3 AND c.[Depth] BETWEEN 1 AND 3
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

-- =====================================================================
-- NHOM 6: DUONG GHI - usp_AddChildNode (cap nhat closure bang MERGE)
--   Moi ca chay trong transaction roi ROLLBACK -> khong de lai du lieu.
--   Chi so STATISTICS cua cau lenh EXEC duoc hien (INSERT chuan bi tat STATISTICS).
-- =====================================================================
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### W1  Them 1 la moi duoi nut sau nhat (them ~ Depth + 2 dong closure) #####';
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    SET STATISTICS IO OFF; SET STATISTICS TIME OFF;
    DECLARE @NewLeaf UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID();
    DECLARE @PcLeaf UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    INSERT INTO [genealogy].[Members] ([Id], [FamilyId], [FullName])
    VALUES (@NewLeaf, @FamilyId, N'PERF-WRITE-LEAF');
    SET STATISTICS IO ON; SET STATISTICS TIME ON;

    EXEC [genealogy].[usp_AddChildNode] @ParentId = @Deep, @ChildId = @NewLeaf, @ParentChildId = @PcLeaf OUTPUT;

    SET STATISTICS IO OFF; SET STATISTICS TIME OFF;
    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET STATISTICS IO ON; SET STATISTICS TIME ON;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET STATISTICS IO ON; SET STATISTICS TIME ON;
    PRINT N'W1 loi: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
END CATCH;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'##### W2  Them to tien moi tren dinh GOC (xau nhat: closure them ~ @Members dong, trigger de quy ca cay) #####';
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    SET STATISTICS IO OFF; SET STATISTICS TIME OFF;
    DECLARE @NewTop UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID();
    DECLARE @PcTop UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
    INSERT INTO [genealogy].[Members] ([Id], [FamilyId], [FullName])
    VALUES (@NewTop, @FamilyId, N'PERF-WRITE-TOP');
    SET STATISTICS IO ON; SET STATISTICS TIME ON;

    EXEC [genealogy].[usp_AddChildNode] @ParentId = @NewTop, @ChildId = @Root, @ParentChildId = @PcTop OUTPUT;

    SET STATISTICS IO OFF; SET STATISTICS TIME OFF;
    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET STATISTICS IO ON; SET STATISTICS TIME ON;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET STATISTICS IO ON; SET STATISTICS TIME ON;
    PRINT N'W2 loi: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
END CATCH;

SET STATISTICS IO OFF;
SET STATISTICS TIME OFF;
SET STATISTICS XML OFF;
PRINT N'';
PRINT N'===== XONG. Ghi so lieu lan chay thu 2 vao bang ket qua trong README.md =====';
GO

-- =====================================================================
-- PERF 99: Don du lieu do hieu nang (dong ho N'__PERF_TEST__')
--
-- Xoa theo lo de khong phinh log. Chi dong cham toi dong ho perf, khong anh huong
-- du lieu seed that. Chay lai an toan (khong co du lieu perf thi chi in thong bao).
-- Chay: sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -b -I -d FamilyConnect -v DB_NAME="FamilyConnect" -i database/perf/99_perf_cleanup.sql
-- =====================================================================
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
SET NOCOUNT ON;
GO
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

DECLARE @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER =
    (SELECT [Id] FROM [core].[Families] WHERE [Name] = N'__PERF_TEST__');

IF @FamilyId IS NULL
BEGIN
    PRINT N'Khong co du lieu perf de don.';
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    DECLARE @Batch INT = 50000;

    -- 1. MemberClosure (moi cap deu nam trong dong ho perf)
    WHILE 1 = 1
    BEGIN
        DELETE TOP (@Batch) c
        FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c
        WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] m
                      WHERE m.[Id] = c.[AncestorId] AND m.[FamilyId] = @FamilyId);
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK;
    END;

    -- 2. ParentChild (trigger chi chay khi INSERT/UPDATE nen xoa khong ton them)
    WHILE 1 = 1
    BEGIN
        DELETE TOP (@Batch) pc
        FROM [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc
        WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] m
                      WHERE m.[Id] = pc.[ParentId] AND m.[FamilyId] = @FamilyId);
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK;
    END;

    -- 3. Members (Educations, WorkHistories xoa theo ON DELETE CASCADE)
    WHILE 1 = 1
    BEGIN
        DELETE TOP (@Batch) FROM [genealogy].[Members] WHERE [FamilyId] = @FamilyId;
        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BREAK;
    END;

    -- 4. Chi nhanh va dong ho
    DELETE FROM [core].[Branches] WHERE [FamilyId] = @FamilyId;
    DELETE FROM [core].[Families] WHERE [Id] = @FamilyId;

    PRINT N'Da don xong du lieu perf.';
END;
GO

################################################################################
# FILE: database/procedures/01_core_procs.sql
################################################################################
-- TV1: duyet xac minh va xu ly bao cao trong transaction.
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO
SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO

-- @ReviewerUserId phai lay tu JWT da xac thuc, khong nhan tu request body.
-- admin: toan he thong; family_head: chi thanh vien cung family va branch.
-- approved: gan tai khoan vao thanh vien, tu choi cac yeu cau pending canh tranh.
-- rejected: chi tu choi yeu cau duoc chon, khong thay doi lien ket thanh vien.
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [core].[usp_ReviewMemberVerification]
    @VerificationId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ReviewerUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Decision NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @Decision IS NULL OR @Decision NOT IN (N'approved', N'rejected')
        THROW 51001, N'Decision phai la approved hoac rejected.', 1;

    DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION ReviewVerification;

        -- Cac lan duyet dung chung khoa de tranh hai admin duyet lien ket canh tranh.
        -- Khoa duoc giai phong cung transaction; khong can quyen DML truc tiep cho backend.
        DECLARE @LockResult INT;
        EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock
            @Resource = N'core.usp_ReviewMemberVerification',
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive', @LockOwner = N'Transaction', @LockTimeout = 10000;
        IF @LockResult < 0 THROW 51002, N'Khong lay duoc khoa duyet xac minh. Hay thu lai.', 1;

        DECLARE @ReviewerRole NVARCHAR(20);
        SELECT @ReviewerRole = [Role]
        FROM [core].[Users] WITH (HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE [UserId] = @ReviewerUserId AND [IsActive] = 1;
        IF @ReviewerRole IS NULL OR @ReviewerRole NOT IN (N'admin', N'family_head')
            THROW 51003, N'Tai khoan khong co quyen duyet xac minh.', 1;

        DECLARE @UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @MemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Status NVARCHAR(20);
        SELECT @UserId = [UserId], @MemberId = [MemberId], @Status = [Status]
        FROM [core].[MemberVerifications] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE [Id] = @VerificationId;
        IF @UserId IS NULL THROW 51004, N'Khong tim thay yeu cau xac minh.', 1;
        IF @Status <> N'pending' THROW 51005, N'Yeu cau xac minh da duoc xu ly.', 1;

        DECLARE @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @BranchId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @LinkedUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        SELECT @FamilyId = [FamilyId], @BranchId = [BranchId], @LinkedUserId = [UserId]
        FROM [genealogy].[Members] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE [Id] = @MemberId;
        IF @FamilyId IS NULL THROW 51006, N'Khong tim thay thanh vien gia pha.', 1;

        IF @ReviewerRole = N'family_head'
        BEGIN
            IF @ReviewerUserId = @UserId
                THROW 51007, N'Truong chi khong duoc tu duyet yeu cau cua minh.', 1;
            IF @BranchId IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
            (
                SELECT 1
                FROM [genealogy].[Members] AS reviewer WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                INNER JOIN [core].[Branches] AS branch WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                    ON branch.[Id] = reviewer.[BranchId] AND branch.[FamilyId] = reviewer.[FamilyId]
                WHERE reviewer.[UserId] = @ReviewerUserId
                  AND reviewer.[FamilyId] = @FamilyId AND reviewer.[BranchId] = @BranchId
            )
                THROW 51008, N'Yeu cau khong thuoc chi do tai khoan nay quan ly.', 1;
        END;

        DECLARE @AutoRejectedCount INT = 0;
        IF @Decision = N'approved'
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Users] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                           WHERE [UserId] = @UserId AND [IsActive] = 1)
                THROW 51009, N'Khong the xac minh tai khoan da bi khoa.', 1;
            IF @LinkedUserId IS NOT NULL AND @LinkedUserId <> @UserId
                THROW 51010, N'Thanh vien da lien ket voi tai khoan khac.', 1;
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE [UserId] = @UserId AND [Id] <> @MemberId)
                THROW 51011, N'Tai khoan da lien ket voi thanh vien khac.', 1;

            UPDATE [genealogy].[Members] SET [UserId] = @UserId WHERE [Id] = @MemberId;
            UPDATE [core].[MemberVerifications]
            SET [Status] = N'rejected'
            WHERE [Status] = N'pending' AND [Id] <> @VerificationId
              AND ([UserId] = @UserId OR [MemberId] = @MemberId);
            SET @AutoRejectedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END;

        UPDATE [core].[MemberVerifications] SET [Status] = @Decision WHERE [Id] = @VerificationId;
        INSERT INTO [reports].[AuditLog] ([UserId], [Action])
        VALUES (@ReviewerUserId, CONCAT(N'verification.', @Decision,
            N'; request=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @VerificationId),
            N'; user=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @UserId),
            N'; member=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @MemberId),
            N'; auto_rejected=', @AutoRejectedCount));

        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        SELECT @VerificationId AS [VerificationId], @Decision AS [Status],
               @AutoRejectedCount AS [AutoRejectedCount];
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
        BEGIN
            IF @StartedTransaction = 1 OR XACT_STATE() = -1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            ELSE ROLLBACK TRANSACTION ReviewVerification;
        END;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

-- Chi admin dang hoat dong duoc xu ly bao cao.
-- Quy uoc photo = community.PostMedia (MediaType image hoac image/*).
-- dismissed: giu noi dung; resolved: xoa noi dung vi schema chua co co an bai.
-- Khi xoa post, cac comment/media/reaction bi cascade; dong bao cao lien quan
-- va don KnowledgeChunks lien quan neu bang AI da duoc trien khai.
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [community].[usp_ResolveReportedContent]
    @ReportId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ReviewerUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Decision NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    IF @Decision IS NULL OR @Decision NOT IN (N'resolved', N'dismissed')
        THROW 51030, N'Decision phai la resolved hoac dismissed.', 1;

    DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION ResolveReport;

        DECLARE @LockResult INT;
        EXEC @LockResult = sys.sp_getapplock
            @Resource = N'community.usp_ResolveReportedContent',
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive', @LockOwner = N'Transaction', @LockTimeout = 10000;
        IF @LockResult < 0 THROW 51031, N'Khong lay duoc khoa xu ly bao cao. Hay thu lai.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Users] WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE [UserId] = @ReviewerUserId AND [Role] = N'admin' AND [IsActive] = 1)
            THROW 51032, N'Chi admin dang hoat dong duoc xu ly bao cao.', 1;

        DECLARE @TargetId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @TargetType NVARCHAR(50), @Status NVARCHAR(20);
        SELECT @TargetId = [TargetId], @TargetType = [TargetType], @Status = [Status]
        FROM [community].[ReportedContents] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE [Id] = @ReportId;
        IF @TargetId IS NULL THROW 51033, N'Khong tim thay bao cao.', 1;
        IF @Status <> N'pending' THROW 51034, N'Bao cao da duoc xu ly.', 1;

        DECLARE @AffectedTargets TABLE ([TargetId] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, [TargetType] NVARCHAR(50),
                                       PRIMARY KEY ([TargetId], [TargetType]));
        INSERT INTO @AffectedTargets VALUES (@TargetId, @TargetType);
        DECLARE @DeletedCount INT = 0, @ResolvedReportCount INT = 0;

        IF @Decision = N'resolved'
        BEGIN
            IF @TargetType = N'post'
            BEGIN
                -- Khoa post va con truoc khi thu thap danh sach cascade.
                IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [community].[Posts] WITH (XLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE [Id] = @TargetId)
                    THROW 51035, N'Bai viet bi bao cao khong con ton tai.', 1;
                INSERT INTO @AffectedTargets
                    SELECT [Id], N'comment' FROM [community].[Comments] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE [PostId] = @TargetId
                    UNION ALL
                    SELECT [Id], N'photo' FROM [community].[PostMedia] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE [PostId] = @TargetId;
                IF OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.KnowledgeChunks', N'U') IS NOT NULL
                    DELETE FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] WHERE [SourceType] = N'post' AND [SourceId] = @TargetId;
                DELETE FROM [community].[Posts] WHERE [Id] = @TargetId;
                SET @DeletedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
            END
            ELSE IF @TargetType = N'comment'
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [community].[Comments] WHERE [Id] = @TargetId;
                SET @DeletedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
            END
            ELSE IF @TargetType = N'photo'
            BEGIN
                DELETE FROM [community].[PostMedia]
                WHERE [Id] = @TargetId AND ([MediaType] = N'image' OR [MediaType] LIKE N'image/%');
                SET @DeletedCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
            END;
            IF @DeletedCount = 0
                THROW 51036, N'Khong tim thay noi dung phu hop. Photo chi ho tro anh PostMedia.', 1;

            -- Nhieu nguoi co the bao cao cung noi dung; dong tat ca bao cao pending bi anh huong.
            UPDATE report SET [Status] = N'resolved'
            FROM [community].[ReportedContents] AS report
            INNER JOIN @AffectedTargets AS target
                ON target.[TargetId] = report.[TargetId] AND target.[TargetType] = report.[TargetType]
            WHERE report.[Status] = N'pending';
            SET @ResolvedReportCount = @@ROWCOUNT;
        END
        ELSE
            UPDATE [community].[ReportedContents] SET [Status] = N'dismissed' WHERE [Id] = @ReportId;

        INSERT INTO [reports].[AuditLog] ([UserId], [Action])
        VALUES (@ReviewerUserId, CONCAT(N'report.', @Decision,
            N'; report=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @ReportId),
            N'; type=', @TargetType, N'; target=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @TargetId),
            N'; resolved_reports=', @ResolvedReportCount));

        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        SELECT @ReportId AS [ReportId], @Decision AS [Status], @DeletedCount AS [DeletedTargetCount],
               @ResolvedReportCount AS [ResolvedReportCount];
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
        BEGIN
            IF @StartedTransaction = 1 OR XACT_STATE() = -1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            ELSE ROLLBACK TRANSACTION ResolveReport;
        END;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

# FILE: database/procedures/02_genealogy_procs.sql
################################################################################
-- T-SQL Stored Procedures - Thanh vien 2 (genealogy)
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

/* =====================================================================
   1. usp_AddChildNode
   Thêm quan hệ cha/mẹ - con vào ParentChild và cập nhật MemberClosure
   trong cùng 1 transaction.
   Mã lỗi: 50100 không lấy được khóa | 50101 cha/mẹ trùng con
           50102 thành viên không tồn tại | 50103 quan hệ đã tồn tại
           50104 tạo chu trình | 50105 vượt quá 2 cha/mẹ
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [genealogy].[usp_AddChildNode]
    @ParentId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ChildId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ParentChildId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        -- Tuần tự hóa các thao tác ghi vào bảng bao đóng
        DECLARE @LockResult INT;
        EXEC @LockResult = sp_getapplock
            @Resource = N'genealogy.MemberClosure',
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Transaction',
            @LockTimeout = 10000;
        IF @LockResult < 0
        BEGIN
            THROW 50100, N'Không thể khóa bảng bao đóng, vui lòng thử lại.', 1;
        END;

        IF @ParentId = @ChildId
        BEGIN
            THROW 50101, N'Cha/mẹ và con không thể là cùng một thành viên.', 1;
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] WHERE [Id] = @ParentId)
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] WHERE [Id] = @ChildId)
        BEGIN
            THROW 50102, N'Thành viên cha/mẹ hoặc con không tồn tại.', 1;
        END;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[ParentChild] WHERE [ParentId] = @ParentId AND [ChildId] = @ChildId)
        BEGIN
            THROW 50103, N'Quan hệ cha/mẹ - con này đã tồn tại.', 1;
        END;

        -- Chu trình: con đã là tổ tiên của cha/mẹ
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] WHERE [AncestorId] = @ChildId AND [DescendantId] = @ParentId)
        BEGIN
            THROW 50104, N'Quan hệ tạo ra chu trình huyết thống (con là tổ tiên của cha/mẹ).', 1;
        END;

        IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [genealogy].[ParentChild] WHERE [ChildId] = @ChildId) >= 2
        BEGIN
            THROW 50105, N'Một thành viên chỉ có tối đa 2 cha/mẹ.', 1;
        END;

        -- Đảm bảo cả hai có dòng tự thân (Depth = 0)
        INSERT INTO [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ([AncestorId], [DescendantId], [Depth])
        SELECT v.[Id], v.[Id], 0
        FROM (VALUES (@ParentId), (@ChildId)) AS v([Id])
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c
            WHERE c.[AncestorId] = v.[Id] AND c.[DescendantId] = v.[Id]
        );

        -- Thêm quan hệ gốc
        DECLARE @Inserted TABLE ([Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
        INSERT INTO [genealogy].[ParentChild] ([ParentId], [ChildId])
        OUTPUT inserted.[Id] INTO @Inserted
        VALUES (@ParentId, @ChildId);
        SELECT @ParentChildId = [Id] FROM @Inserted;

        -- Cập nhật bao đóng: (mọi tổ tiên của cha/mẹ, kể cả chính họ)
        --                  x (mọi hậu duệ của con, kể cả chính con)
        ;WITH Src AS
        (
            SELECT a.[AncestorId],
                   d.[DescendantId],
                   a.[Depth] + d.[Depth] + 1 AS [Depth]
            FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] a
            CROSS JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] d
            WHERE a.[DescendantId] = @ParentId
              AND d.[AncestorId] = @ChildId
        )
        MERGE [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS t
        USING Src AS s
            ON t.[AncestorId] = s.[AncestorId] AND t.[DescendantId] = s.[DescendantId]
        WHEN MATCHED AND s.[Depth] < t.[Depth] THEN
            UPDATE SET t.[Depth] = s.[Depth]
        WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
            INSERT ([AncestorId], [DescendantId], [Depth])
            VALUES (s.[AncestorId], s.[DescendantId], s.[Depth]);

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   2. usp_AddMarriage
   Tự sắp xếp Spouse1Id < Spouse2Id (cùng cách so sánh với CK_Marriages_SpousesOrdered)
   và chặn kết hôn cận huyết trong phạm vi @MaxGenerations đời (mặc định 3).
   Mã lỗi: 50200 không lấy được khóa | 50201 trùng người | 50202 không tồn tại
           50203 hôn nhân đã tồn tại | 50204 cận huyết | 50205 tham số sai
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [genealogy].[usp_AddMarriage]
    @MemberAId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @MemberBId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @MarriedDate DATE = NULL,
    @MaxGenerations INT = 3,
    @MarriageId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF @MaxGenerations < 1
        BEGIN
            THROW 50205, N'@MaxGenerations phải >= 1.', 1;
        END;

        IF @MemberAId = @MemberBId
        BEGIN
            THROW 50201, N'Không thể kết hôn với chính mình.', 1;
        END;

        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        DECLARE @LockResult INT;
        EXEC @LockResult = sp_getapplock
            @Resource = N'genealogy.MemberClosure',
            @LockMode = N'Exclusive',
            @LockOwner = N'Transaction',
            @LockTimeout = 10000;
        IF @LockResult < 0
        BEGIN
            THROW 50200, N'Không thể khóa bảng bao đóng, vui lòng thử lại.', 1;
        END;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] WHERE [Id] = @MemberAId)
           OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] WHERE [Id] = @MemberBId)
        BEGIN
            THROW 50202, N'Một hoặc cả hai thành viên không tồn tại.', 1;
        END;

        -- Sắp xếp Spouse1Id < Spouse2Id theo chuỗi 36 ký tự (khớp CHECK constraint)
        DECLARE @Spouse1Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Spouse2Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        IF CONVERT(CHAR(36), @MemberAId) < CONVERT(CHAR(36), @MemberBId)
            SELECT @Spouse1Id = @MemberAId, @Spouse2Id = @MemberBId;
        ELSE
            SELECT @Spouse1Id = @MemberBId, @Spouse2Id = @MemberAId;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Marriages] WHERE [Spouse1Id] = @Spouse1Id AND [Spouse2Id] = @Spouse2Id)
        BEGIN
            THROW 50203, N'Hôn nhân giữa hai thành viên này đã tồn tại.', 1;
        END;

        -- Đảm bảo có dòng tự thân để kiểm tra quan hệ trực hệ
        INSERT INTO [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ([AncestorId], [DescendantId], [Depth])
        SELECT v.[Id], v.[Id], 0
        FROM (VALUES (@Spouse1Id), (@Spouse2Id)) AS v([Id])
        WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c
            WHERE c.[AncestorId] = v.[Id] AND c.[DescendantId] = v.[Id]
        );

        -- Cận huyết: có chung tổ tiên mà cả hai cách tổ tiên <= (@MaxGenerations - 1) bậc,
        -- hoặc một người là tổ tiên trực hệ của người kia (Depth = 0 ở một phía).
        -- Với 3 đời: anh chị em (1,1), chú/bác - cháu (1,2), anh chị em họ (2,2) đều bị chặn.
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ca
            INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] cb ON cb.[AncestorId] = ca.[AncestorId]
            WHERE ca.[DescendantId] = @Spouse1Id
              AND cb.[DescendantId] = @Spouse2Id
              AND (
                    (ca.[Depth] <= @MaxGenerations - 1 AND cb.[Depth] <= @MaxGenerations - 1)
                    OR ca.[Depth] = 0
                    OR cb.[Depth] = 0
                  )
        )
        BEGIN
            THROW 50204, N'Không được kết hôn giữa những người có quan hệ huyết thống trong phạm vi ba đời.', 1;
        END;

        DECLARE @Inserted TABLE ([Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
        INSERT INTO [genealogy].[Marriages] ([Spouse1Id], [Spouse2Id], [MarriedDate])
        OUTPUT inserted.[Id] INTO @Inserted
        VALUES (@Spouse1Id, @Spouse2Id, @MarriedDate);
        SELECT @MarriageId = [Id] FROM @Inserted;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   3. usp_SearchDirectory
   Tìm kiếm / lọc danh bạ theo Nghề nghiệp, Học vấn, Chi nhánh, Thế hệ.
   - @Generation: đời thứ n (1 = đời đầu tiên).
       + Nếu có @RootMemberId: tính từ người đó (1 = chính người đó, 2 = con, ...),
         và chỉ lấy hậu duệ của người đó.
       + Nếu không: tính theo chuỗi tổ tiên dài nhất trong ParentChild.
   - @Occupation: khớp một phần Position hoặc Company (@OnlyCurrentJob = 1: chỉ công việc hiện tại).
   - @Education : khớp một phần Institution hoặc Degree.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [genealogy].[usp_SearchDirectory]
    @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @Keyword NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @Occupation NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @OnlyCurrentJob BIT = 0,
    @Education NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @BranchId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @Generation INT = NULL,
    @RootMemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @PageNumber INT = 1,
    @PageSize INT = 50,
    @Location NVARCHAR(300) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SET @Keyword = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Keyword)), N'');
    SET @Occupation = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Occupation)), N'');
    SET @Education = NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Education)), N'');
    IF @PageNumber IS NULL OR @PageNumber < 1 SET @PageNumber = 1;
    IF @PageSize IS NULL OR @PageSize < 1 SET @PageSize = 50;
    IF @PageSize > 200 SET @PageSize = 200;

    ;WITH Base AS
    (
        SELECT m.[Id],
               m.[FamilyId],
               m.[BranchId],
               m.[FullName],
               m.[BirthDate],
               m.[Location],
               CASE WHEN @RootMemberId IS NULL
                    THEN ISNULL(g.[GenDepth], 0) + 1
                    ELSE g.[GenDepth] + 1
               END AS [Generation]
        FROM [genealogy].[Members] m
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT CASE WHEN @RootMemberId IS NULL
                        THEN MAX(c.[Depth])
                        ELSE MAX(CASE WHEN c.[AncestorId] = @RootMemberId THEN c.[Depth] END)
                   END AS [GenDepth]
            FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] c
            WHERE c.[DescendantId] = m.[Id]
        ) g
        WHERE (@FamilyId IS NULL OR m.[FamilyId] = @FamilyId)
          AND (@BranchId IS NULL OR m.[BranchId] = @BranchId)
          AND (@Keyword IS NULL OR CHARINDEX(@Keyword, m.[FullName]) > 0)
          AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Location)),N'') IS NULL OR CHARINDEX(@Location,m.Location)>0)
          AND (@RootMemberId IS NULL OR g.[GenDepth] IS NOT NULL)
          AND (@Occupation IS NULL OR EXISTS
               (
                   SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[WorkHistories] w
                   WHERE w.[MemberId] = m.[Id]
                     AND (CHARINDEX(@Occupation, w.[Position]) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(@Occupation, w.[Company]) > 0)
                     AND (@OnlyCurrentJob = 0 OR w.[EndDate] IS NULL)
               ))
          AND (@Education IS NULL OR EXISTS
               (
                   SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Educations] e
                   WHERE e.[MemberId] = m.[Id]
                     AND (CHARINDEX(@Education, e.[Institution]) > 0 OR CHARINDEX(@Education, ISNULL(e.[Degree], N'')) > 0)
               ))
    )
    SELECT b.[Id],
           b.[FullName],
           b.[BirthDate],
           b.[Location],
           b.[FamilyId],
           b.[BranchId],
           b.[Generation],
           job.[Position] AS [LatestPosition],
           job.[Company] AS [LatestCompany],
           edu.[Institution] AS [LatestInstitution],
           edu.[Degree] AS [LatestDegree],
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS [TotalCount]
    FROM Base b
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) w.[Position], w.[Company]
        FROM [genealogy].[WorkHistories] w
        WHERE w.[MemberId] = b.[Id]
        ORDER BY CASE WHEN w.[EndDate] IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, w.[StartDate] DESC
    ) job
    OUTER APPLY
    (
        SELECT TOP (1) e.[Institution], e.[Degree]
        FROM [genealogy].[Educations] e
        WHERE e.[MemberId] = b.[Id]
        ORDER BY e.[EndDate] DESC, e.[StartDate] DESC
    ) edu
    WHERE (@Generation IS NULL OR b.[Generation] = @Generation)
    ORDER BY b.[Generation], b.[BirthDate], b.[FullName], b.[Id]
    OFFSET (@PageNumber - 1) * @PageSize ROWS
    FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================

USE [$(DB_NAME)];

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   1. usp_CreatePostWithMedia
   Tao bai viet + cac anh trong MOT giao tac. @MediaJson co dang:
   [{"url":"https://.../a.jpg","type":"image"},{"url":"https://.../b.jpg"}]
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [community].[usp_CreatePostWithMedia]
    @UserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @FamilyId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Content   NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @MediaJson NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @PostId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUTPUT,
    @IsAnnouncement BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Users] WHERE [UserId] = @UserId)
        THROW 50701, N'Nguoi dung khong ton tai.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Families] WHERE [Id] = @FamilyId)
        THROW 50702, N'Gia dinh khong ton tai.', 1;
    IF @MediaJson IS NOT NULL AND ISJSON(@MediaJson) = 0
        THROW 50703, N'MediaJson khong phai JSON hop le.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @UserId,@FamilyId,@IsAnnouncement;

        DECLARE @NewPost TABLE ([Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);

        INSERT INTO [community].[Posts] ([UserId], [FamilyId], [Content],IsAnnouncement)
        OUTPUT inserted.[Id] INTO @NewPost
        VALUES (@UserId, @FamilyId, @Content,@IsAnnouncement);

        SELECT @PostId = [Id] FROM @NewPost;

        IF @MediaJson IS NOT NULL
            INSERT INTO [community].[PostMedia] ([PostId], [MediaUrl], [MediaType])
            SELECT @PostId, j.[MediaUrl], ISNULL(j.[MediaType], N'image')
            FROM OPENJSON(@MediaJson)
                 WITH ([MediaUrl]  NVARCHAR(2048) '$.url',
                       [MediaType] NVARCHAR(50)   '$.type') AS j
            WHERE j.[MediaUrl] IS NOT NULL AND LEN(j.[MediaUrl]) > 0;

        COMMIT TRAN;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   2. usp_UpsertReaction
   Moi nguoi chi co 1 cam xuc tren moi bai: chua co thi them, co roi thi
   doi loai. Truyen @Type = NULL de go cam xuc.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [community].[usp_UpsertReaction]
    @PostId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Type   NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [community].[Posts] WHERE [Id] = @PostId)
        THROW 50711, N'Bai viet khong ton tai.', 1;

    IF @Type IS NULL
    BEGIN
        DELETE FROM [community].[Reactions]
        WHERE [PostId] = @PostId AND [UserId] = @UserId;
        RETURN;
    END;

    MERGE [community].[Reactions] WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS tgt
    USING (SELECT @PostId AS [PostId], @UserId AS [UserId]) AS src
        ON tgt.[PostId] = src.[PostId] AND tgt.[UserId] = src.[UserId]
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET tgt.[Type] = @Type
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT ([PostId], [UserId], [Type])
        VALUES (@PostId, @UserId, @Type);
END;
GO

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   3. usp_UpsertEventRsvp
   Them hoac cap nhat cau tra loi tham du (Pending/Going/Maybe/Declined).
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [community].[usp_UpsertEventRsvp]
    @EventId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @MemberId   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @RsvpStatus NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [community].[Events] WHERE [Id] = @EventId)
        THROW 50721, N'Su kien khong ton tai.', 1;

    MERGE [community].[EventParticipants] WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS tgt
    USING (SELECT @EventId AS [EventId], @MemberId AS [MemberId]) AS src
        ON tgt.[EventId] = src.[EventId] AND tgt.[MemberId] = src.[MemberId]
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET tgt.[RsvpStatus] = @RsvpStatus
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT ([EventId], [MemberId], [RsvpStatus])
        VALUES (@EventId, @MemberId, @RsvpStatus);
END;
GO

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   4. usp_ClaimDueReminders
   Worker goi moi phut. Lay toi da @BatchSize nhac nho da den han,
   danh dau 'sent' va tra ve ngay trong cung cau lenh. UPDLOCK + READPAST
   giup nhieu worker chay song song ma khong lay trung va khong cho nhau.
   Bang chi co trang thai pending/sent/failed/cancelled nen "claim" =
   chuyen sang 'sent'; worker neu gui loi thi cap nhat lai thanh 'failed'.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [community].[usp_ClaimDueReminders]
    @BatchSize INT = 50
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    ;WITH due AS
    (
        SELECT TOP (@BatchSize) *
        FROM [community].[EventReminders] WITH (UPDLOCK, READPAST, ROWLOCK)
        WHERE [Status] = N'pending'
          AND [ReminderTime] <= SYSUTCDATETIME()
        ORDER BY [ReminderTime]
    )
    UPDATE due
    SET [Status] = N'sent'
    OUTPUT inserted.[Id], inserted.[EventId], inserted.[ReminderTime], inserted.[Status];
END;
GO
