-- T-SQL Stored Procedures - Thanh vien 4 (heritage & family tree)
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO
-- Shared only within TV4. Linked Members.UserId is the authoritative membership
-- established by TV1's approval procedure (seed/admin-linked members also work).
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Manage BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @Role NVARCHAR(20);
    SELECT @Role = Role FROM core.Users WITH (HOLDLOCK)
    WHERE UserId = @ActorUserId AND IsActive = 1;
    IF @Role IS NULL OR @Role NOT IN (N'admin', N'family_head', N'member')
        THROW 51403, N'Family access denied.', 1;
    IF @Role <> N'admin' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE UserId = @ActorUserId AND FamilyId = @FamilyId)
        THROW 51403, N'Family access denied.', 1;
    IF @Manage = 1 AND @Role NOT IN (N'admin', N'family_head')
        THROW 51403, N'Family manager required.', 1;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Families WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id = @FamilyId)
        THROW 51404, N'Family not found.', 1;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_ValidateHeritageItem
    @Type NVARCHAR(MAX), @Title NVARCHAR(MAX), @Description NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @Content NVARCHAR(MAX), @MediaUrl NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF @Type IS NULL OR @Type NOT IN (N'document', N'story', N'photo')
       OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Title)), N'') IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@Title) > 400
       OR DATALENGTH(@Description) > 1000 OR DATALENGTH(@MediaUrl) > 1000
       OR (@Type = N'story' AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Content)), N'') IS NULL)
       OR (@Type = N'photo' AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@MediaUrl)), N'') IS NULL)
       OR (@Type = N'document' AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Content)), N'') IS NULL
                                   AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@MediaUrl)), N'') IS NULL)
        THROW 51422, N'Invalid heritage payload.', 1;
    IF @MediaUrl IS NOT NULL AND NOT
       (@MediaUrl LIKE N'https://%_.%' OR (@MediaUrl LIKE N'/%' AND @MediaUrl NOT LIKE N'//%'))
        THROW 51422, N'Use HTTPS or a local media path.', 1;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_CreateHeritageItem
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Type NVARCHAR(MAX), @Title NVARCHAR(MAX), @Description NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
    @Content NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, @MediaUrl NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID();
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION TV4CreateItem;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId, @FamilyId;
        EXEC heritage.usp_ValidateHeritageItem @Type, @Title, @Description, @Content, @MediaUrl;
        INSERT INTO heritage.Items (Id, FamilyId, CreatedByUserId, Type, Title, Description, Content, MediaUrl)
        VALUES (@Id, @FamilyId, @ActorUserId, @Type, @Title, @Description, @Content, @MediaUrl);
        INSERT INTO reports.AuditLog (UserId, Action)
        VALUES (@ActorUserId, CONCAT(N'heritage.item.created; id=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @Id)));
        -- Materialize before releasing locks, return only after COMMIT.
        SELECT * INTO #TV4CreatedItem FROM heritage.vw_HeritageItems WHERE Id = @Id;
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        SELECT * FROM #TV4CreatedItem;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION TV4CreateItem;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_UpdateHeritageItem
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ExpectedVersion VARCHAR(64), @Type NVARCHAR(MAX), @Title NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @Description NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, @Content NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, @MediaUrl NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION TV4UpdateItem;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId, @FamilyId;
        DECLARE @Owner UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        SELECT @Owner = CreatedByUserId FROM heritage.Items WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE Id = @Id AND FamilyId = @FamilyId;
        IF @Owner IS NULL THROW 51404, N'Item not found.', 1;
        IF @Owner <> @ActorUserId AND NOT EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WHERE UserId = @ActorUserId AND Role IN (N'admin', N'family_head'))
            THROW 51403, N'Only author or family manager may edit.', 1;
        IF @ExpectedVersion IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.vw_HeritageItems WHERE Id = @Id AND VersionToken = @ExpectedVersion)
            THROW 51409, N'Item changed. Reload before editing.', 1;
        EXEC heritage.usp_ValidateHeritageItem @Type, @Title, @Description, @Content, @MediaUrl;
        
        UPDATE heritage.Items SET Type = @Type, Title = @Title, Description = @Description,
            Content = @Content, MediaUrl = @MediaUrl WHERE Id = @Id AND FamilyId = @FamilyId;
        INSERT INTO reports.AuditLog (UserId, Action)
        VALUES (@ActorUserId, CONCAT(N'heritage.item.updated; id=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @Id)));
        SELECT * INTO #TV4UpdatedItem FROM heritage.vw_HeritageItems WHERE Id = @Id;
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        SELECT * FROM #TV4UpdatedItem;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION TV4UpdateItem;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_DeleteHeritageItem
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ExpectedVersion VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION TV4DeleteItem;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId, @FamilyId;
        DECLARE @Owner UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        SELECT @Owner = CreatedByUserId FROM heritage.Items WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
        WHERE Id = @Id AND FamilyId = @FamilyId;
        IF @Owner IS NULL THROW 51404, N'Item not found.', 1;
        IF @Owner <> @ActorUserId AND NOT EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WHERE UserId = @ActorUserId AND Role IN (N'admin', N'family_head'))
            THROW 51403, N'Only author or family manager may delete.', 1;
        IF @ExpectedVersion IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.vw_HeritageItems WHERE Id = @Id AND VersionToken = @ExpectedVersion)
            THROW 51409, N'Item changed. Reload before deleting.', 1;
        
        DELETE FROM heritage.Items WHERE Id = @Id AND FamilyId = @FamilyId;
        INSERT INTO reports.AuditLog (UserId, Action)
        VALUES (@ActorUserId, CONCAT(N'heritage.item.deleted; id=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), @Id)));
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION TV4DeleteItem;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_GrantMemberHonor
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @MemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Title NVARCHAR(MAX), @Description NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, @DateAwarded DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @Previous SQL_VARIANT = SESSION_CONTEXT(N'actor_user_id'), @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NEWID();
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION TV4GrantHonor;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId, @FamilyId, 1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id = @MemberId AND FamilyId = @FamilyId)
            THROW 51404, N'Member not found in family.', 1;
        IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Title)), N'') IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@Title) > 400 OR DATALENGTH(@Description) > 2000
            THROW 51422, N'Invalid honor payload.', 1;
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@ActorUserId;
        INSERT INTO heritage.Honors (Id, MemberId, Title, Description, DateAwarded)
        VALUES (@Id, @MemberId, @Title, @Description, @DateAwarded);
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@Previous;
        SELECT * INTO #TV4CreatedHonor FROM heritage.vw_Honors WHERE Id = @Id;
        IF @Started = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        SELECT * FROM #TV4CreatedHonor;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started = 1 AND XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE() = 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION TV4GrantHonor;
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@Previous;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_UpdateMemberHonor
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ExpectedVersion VARCHAR(64), @Title NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @Description NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL, @DateAwarded DATE = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @Previous SQL_VARIANT = SESSION_CONTEXT(N'actor_user_id');
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @Started = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION TV4UpdateHonor;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId, @FamilyId, 1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.Honors h WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       JOIN genealogy.Members m WITH (HOLDLOCK) ON m.Id=h.MemberId
                       WHERE h.Id=@Id AND m.FamilyId=@FamilyId)
            THROW 51404, N'Honor not found.', 1;
        IF @ExpectedVersion IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.vw_Honors WHERE Id=@Id AND VersionToken=@ExpectedVersion)
            THROW 51409, N'Honor changed. Reload before editing.', 1;
        IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Title)), N'') IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@Title)>400 OR DATALENGTH(@Description)>2000
            THROW 51422, N'Invalid honor payload.', 1;
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@ActorUserId;
        UPDATE heritage.Honors SET Title=@Title, Description=@Description, DateAwarded=@DateAwarded WHERE Id=@Id;
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@Previous;
        SELECT * INTO #TV4UpdatedHonor FROM heritage.vw_Honors WHERE Id=@Id;
        IF @Started=1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        SELECT * FROM #TV4UpdatedHonor;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started=1 AND XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE()=1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION TV4UpdateHonor;
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@Previous;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_DeleteMemberHonor
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ExpectedVersion VARCHAR(64)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    DECLARE @Previous SQL_VARIANT = SESSION_CONTEXT(N'actor_user_id');
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @Started=1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION TV4DeleteHonor;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId, @FamilyId, 1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.Honors h WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
                       JOIN genealogy.Members m WITH (HOLDLOCK) ON m.Id=h.MemberId
                       WHERE h.Id=@Id AND m.FamilyId=@FamilyId)
            THROW 51404, N'Honor not found.', 1;
        IF @ExpectedVersion IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.vw_Honors WHERE Id=@Id AND VersionToken=@ExpectedVersion)
            THROW 51409, N'Honor changed. Reload before deleting.', 1;
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@ActorUserId;
        DELETE FROM heritage.Honors WHERE Id=@Id;
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@Previous;
        IF @Started=1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @Started=1 AND XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        ELSE IF XACT_STATE()=1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION TV4DeleteHonor;
        EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'actor_user_id', @value=@Previous;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
-- Only reads TV2 tables. Never creates/changes relationships or closure rows.
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE heritage.usp_GetFamilyTreeJson
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    DECLARE @Started BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
      IF @Started=1 BEGIN TRANSACTION; ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION TV4ReadTree;
      EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId, @FamilyId;
      -- Hold the selected members while materializing both edge sets.
      SELECT Id, FullName, BirthDate INTO #TV4TreeMembers
      FROM genealogy.Members WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId;
      DECLARE @TreeJson NVARCHAR(MAX) = (
        SELECT @FamilyId AS family_id,
            JSON_QUERY((SELECT Id AS id, FullName AS label, BirthDate AS birth_date
                        FROM #TV4TreeMembers ORDER BY BirthDate, Id FOR JSON PATH, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES)) AS nodes,
            JSON_QUERY((SELECT edges.id, edges.source, edges.target, edges.kind FROM (
                SELECT CONCAT(N'parent-', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), pc.Id)) AS id,
                       pc.ParentId AS source, pc.ChildId AS target, N'parent_child' AS kind
                FROM genealogy.ParentChild pc WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                JOIN #TV4TreeMembers p ON p.Id=pc.ParentId JOIN #TV4TreeMembers c ON c.Id=pc.ChildId
                UNION ALL
                SELECT CONCAT(N'marriage-', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), r.Id)), r.Spouse1Id, r.Spouse2Id, N'marriage'
                FROM genealogy.Marriages r WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                JOIN #TV4TreeMembers a ON a.Id=r.Spouse1Id JOIN #TV4TreeMembers b ON b.Id=r.Spouse2Id
            ) edges ORDER BY edges.kind, edges.id FOR JSON PATH)) AS edges
        FOR JSON PATH, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER
      );
      IF @Started=1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
      SELECT @TreeJson AS TreeJson;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
      IF @Started=1 AND XACT_STATE()<>0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
      ELSE IF XACT_STATE()=1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION TV4ReadTree;
      THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

################################################################################
# FILE: database/procedures/05_ai_reports_procs.sql
################################################################################
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   1. Stored Procedure: heritage.usp_UpsertKnowledgeChunk
   Thêm mới hoặc cập nhật (MERGE) một đoạn văn bản (Chunk) kèm mảng
   Vector nhúng (EmbeddingJson) và bản tóm tắt (SummaryText) vào bảng
   heritage.KnowledgeChunks trong một giao tác an toàn.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [heritage].[usp_UpsertKnowledgeChunk]
    @FamilyId      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @SourceType    NVARCHAR(20),            -- 'post', 'heritage', hoặc 'member'
    @SourceId      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,        -- Id bản ghi gốc
    @ChunkIndex    INT = 0,                 -- Thứ tự đoạn cắt (0, 1, 2...)
    @ChunkText     NVARCHAR(2000),          -- Nội dung văn bản gốc của đoạn
    @EmbeddingJson NVARCHAR(MAX),           -- Chuỗi JSON mảng số thực '[0.12, -0.34, ...]'
    @SummaryText   NVARCHAR(1000) = NULL    -- Bản tóm tắt ngắn do AI tạo (tùy chọn)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @SourceType NOT IN (N'post', N'heritage', N'member')
        THROW 50711, N'SourceType không hợp lệ (chỉ nhận post, heritage, hoặc member).', 1;

    IF @ChunkText IS NULL OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(@ChunkText))) = 0
        THROW 50712, N'ChunkText không được để trống.', 1;

    IF @EmbeddingJson IS NULL OR ISJSON(@EmbeddingJson) <> 1
        THROW 50713, N'EmbeddingJson phải là chuỗi mảng JSON hợp lệ.', 1;

    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;

        DECLARE @OutputTable TABLE ([Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, [ActionTaken] NVARCHAR(10));

        MERGE INTO [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] AS target
        USING (
            SELECT
                @FamilyId      AS [FamilyId],
                @SourceType    AS [SourceType],
                @SourceId      AS [SourceId],
                @ChunkIndex    AS [ChunkIndex],
                @ChunkText     AS [ChunkText],
                @SummaryText   AS [SummaryText],
                @EmbeddingJson AS [EmbeddingJson]
        ) AS source
        ON  target.[SourceType] = source.[SourceType]
        AND target.[SourceId]   = source.[SourceId]
        AND target.[ChunkIndex] = source.[ChunkIndex]

        WHEN MATCHED THEN
            UPDATE SET
                target.[FamilyId]      = source.[FamilyId],
                target.[ChunkText]     = source.[ChunkText],
                target.[SummaryText]   = COALESCE(source.[SummaryText], target.[SummaryText]),
                target.[EmbeddingJson] = source.[EmbeddingJson],
                target.[SyncStatus]    = N'synced',
                target.[UpdatedAt]     = SYSUTCDATETIME()

        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT ([FamilyId], [SourceType], [SourceId], [ChunkIndex], [ChunkText], [SummaryText], [EmbeddingJson], [SyncStatus], [UpdatedAt])
            VALUES (source.[FamilyId], source.[SourceType], source.[SourceId], source.[ChunkIndex], source.[ChunkText], source.[SummaryText], source.[EmbeddingJson], N'synced', SYSUTCDATETIME())

        OUTPUT inserted.[Id], $action INTO @OutputTable;

        COMMIT TRAN;

        SELECT [Id] AS [ChunkId], [ActionTaken] FROM @OutputTable;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRAN;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   2. Stored Procedure: heritage.usp_ClearStaleKnowledgeChunks
   Dọn dẹp các đoạn Chunk thừa (ChunkIndex >= @KeepChunkCount) sau khi
   một Bài viết hoặc Tư liệu di sản được cắt đoạn lại.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [heritage].[usp_ClearStaleKnowledgeChunks]
    @SourceType     NVARCHAR(20),
    @SourceId       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @KeepChunkCount INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DELETE FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks]
    WHERE [SourceType] = @SourceType
      AND [SourceId]   = @SourceId
      AND [ChunkIndex] >= @KeepChunkCount;

    SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS [DeletedChunkCount];
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   3. Stored Procedure: heritage.usp_SemanticSearch
   Tìm kiếm ngữ nghĩa (Semantic Vector Search) bằng hàm T-SQL
   heritage.fn_CosineSimilarity. Trả về Top-K đoạn văn bản (mặc định Top 3)
   trong cùng FamilyId có điểm tương đồng Cosine cao nhất (>= @MinScore).
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [heritage].[usp_SemanticSearch]
    @FamilyId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @QueryVectorJson NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @TopK            INT = 3,
    @MinScore        FLOAT = 0.30,
    @SourceType      NVARCHAR(20) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @FamilyId IS NULL
        THROW 50721, N'FamilyId không được để trống.', 1;

    IF @QueryVectorJson IS NULL OR ISJSON(@QueryVectorJson) <> 1
        THROW 50722, N'QueryVectorJson phải là chuỗi mảng JSON hợp lệ.', 1;

    IF @TopK IS NULL OR @TopK < 1
        SET @TopK = 3;
    IF @TopK > 20
        SET @TopK = 20;

    IF @MinScore IS NULL
        SET @MinScore = 0.30;

    ;WITH ScoredChunks AS
    (
        SELECT
            kc.[Id]            AS [ChunkId],
            kc.[FamilyId]      AS [FamilyId],
            kc.[SourceType]    AS [SourceType],
            kc.[SourceId]      AS [SourceId],
            COALESCE(
                hi.[Title],
                m.[FullName],
                CONCAT(N'Bài viết cộng đồng #', LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), kc.[SourceId]), 8))
            )                  AS [SourceTitle],
            kc.[ChunkIndex]    AS [ChunkIndex],
            kc.[ChunkText]     AS [ChunkText],
            kc.[SummaryText]   AS [SummaryText],
            [heritage].[fn_CosineSimilarity](@QueryVectorJson, kc.[EmbeddingJson]) AS [SimilarityScore],
            kc.[UpdatedAt]     AS [UpdatedAt]
        FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] AS kc
        LEFT JOIN [heritage].[Items] AS hi
            ON kc.[SourceType] = N'heritage' AND hi.[Id] = kc.[SourceId]
        LEFT JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS m
            ON kc.[SourceType] = N'member' AND m.[Id] = kc.[SourceId]
        WHERE kc.[FamilyId] = @FamilyId
          AND kc.[SyncStatus] = N'synced'
          AND kc.[EmbeddingJson] IS NOT NULL
          AND (@SourceType IS NULL OR kc.[SourceType] = @SourceType)
    )
    SELECT TOP (@TopK)
        [ChunkId],
        [FamilyId],
        [SourceType],
        [SourceId],
        [SourceTitle],
        [ChunkIndex],
        [ChunkText],
        [SummaryText],
        ROUND([SimilarityScore], 6) AS [SimilarityScore],
        [UpdatedAt]
    FROM ScoredChunks
    WHERE [SimilarityScore] IS NOT NULL
      AND [SimilarityScore] >= @MinScore
    ORDER BY [SimilarityScore] DESC, [ChunkIndex] ASC;
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   4. Stored Procedure: genealogy.usp_FindRelationshipPath
   Truy vấn bảng bao đóng genealogy.MemberClosure (của Thành viên 2) kết hợp
   bảng genealogy.Marriages và genealogy.ParentChild để tìm:
     - Tổ tiên chung gần nhất (Lowest Common Ancestor - LCA)
     - Số bậc thế hệ từ LCA tới Thành viên A (DepthA) và Thành viên B (DepthB)
     - Đường đi phả hệ chi tiết từ tổ tiên chung tới từng thành viên
     - Gợi ý danh xưng / quan hệ họ hàng Việt Nam chuẩn xác.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [genealogy].[usp_FindRelationshipPath]
    @MemberAId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @MemberBId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @MemberAId IS NULL OR @MemberBId IS NULL
        THROW 50731, N'MemberAId và MemberBId không được để trống.', 1;

    DECLARE
        @FamilyA     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @FamilyB     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
        @NameA       NVARCHAR(200),
        @NameB       NVARCHAR(200),
        @BirthA      DATE,
        @BirthB      DATE,
        @BranchNameA NVARCHAR(200),
        @BranchNameB NVARCHAR(200);

    SELECT
        @FamilyA     = m.[FamilyId],
        @NameA       = m.[FullName],
        @BirthA      = m.[BirthDate],
        @BranchNameA = b.[Name]
    FROM [genealogy].[Members] AS m
    LEFT JOIN [core].[Branches] AS b ON b.[Id] = m.[BranchId]
    WHERE m.[Id] = @MemberAId;

    SELECT
        @FamilyB     = m.[FamilyId],
        @NameB       = m.[FullName],
        @BirthB      = m.[BirthDate],
        @BranchNameB = b.[Name]
    FROM [genealogy].[Members] AS m
    LEFT JOIN [core].[Branches] AS b ON b.[Id] = m.[BranchId]
    WHERE m.[Id] = @MemberBId;

    IF @NameA IS NULL OR @NameB IS NULL
        THROW 50732, N'Một hoặc cả hai thành viên không tồn tại trong gia phả.', 1;

    -- Đảm bảo bảng bao đóng genealogy.MemberClosure đã được đồng bộ đầy đủ
    -- cho dòng họ này (phòng trường hợp dữ liệu được chèn trực tiếp từ 01_seed.sql)
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [genealogy].[Members] AS m
        WHERE m.[FamilyId] IN (@FamilyA, @FamilyB)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS mc
              WHERE mc.[AncestorId] = m.[Id] AND mc.[DescendantId] = m.[Id]
          )
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [genealogy].[ParentChild] AS pc
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS m ON m.[Id] = pc.[ParentId]
        WHERE m.[FamilyId] IN (@FamilyA, @FamilyB)
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS mc
              WHERE mc.[AncestorId] = pc.[ParentId] AND mc.[DescendantId] = pc.[ChildId]
          )
    )
    BEGIN
        ;WITH ClosureTree AS
        (
            SELECT
                m.[Id] AS [AncestorId],
                m.[Id] AS [DescendantId],
                0      AS [Depth]
            FROM [genealogy].[Members] AS m
            WHERE m.[FamilyId] IN (@FamilyA, @FamilyB)

            UNION ALL

            SELECT
                ct.[AncestorId],
                pc.[ChildId] AS [DescendantId],
                ct.[Depth] + 1 AS [Depth]
            FROM ClosureTree AS ct
            INNER JOIN [genealogy].[ParentChild] AS pc
                ON pc.[ParentId] = ct.[DescendantId]
            WHERE ct.[Depth] < 30
        ),
        MinClosure AS
        (
            SELECT
                [AncestorId],
                [DescendantId],
                MIN([Depth]) AS [Depth]
            FROM ClosureTree
            GROUP BY [AncestorId], [DescendantId]
        )
        MERGE INTO [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS target
        USING MinClosure AS source
        ON  target.[AncestorId]   = source.[AncestorId]
        AND target.[DescendantId] = source.[DescendantId]
        WHEN MATCHED AND source.[Depth] < target.[Depth] THEN
            UPDATE SET target.[Depth] = source.[Depth]
        WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
            INSERT ([AncestorId], [DescendantId], [Depth])
            VALUES (source.[AncestorId], source.[DescendantId], source.[Depth]);
    END;

    -- Trường hợp 1: Hai ID là cùng một người
    IF @MemberAId = @MemberBId
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            @MemberAId                                          AS [MemberAId],
            @NameA                                              AS [MemberAName],
            @BirthA                                             AS [MemberABirthDate],
            @BranchNameA                                        AS [MemberABranchName],
            @MemberBId                                          AS [MemberBId],
            @NameB                                              AS [MemberBName],
            @BirthB                                             AS [MemberBBirthDate],
            @BranchNameB                                        AS [MemberBBranchName],
            CAST(N'self' AS NVARCHAR(30))                       AS [RelationshipCategory],
            @MemberAId                                          AS [CommonAncestorId],
            @NameA                                              AS [CommonAncestorName],
            0                                                   AS [DepthFromAncestorToA],
            0                                                   AS [DepthFromAncestorToB],
            0                                                   AS [TotalGenerationDistance],
            @NameA                                              AS [PathFromAncestorToA],
            @NameB                                              AS [PathFromAncestorToB],
            [genealogy].[fn_SuggestVietnameseKinship](0, 0)     AS [SuggestedKinship];
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- Trường hợp 2: Quan hệ Vợ - Chồng trực tiếp trong bảng genealogy.Marriages
    DECLARE @MarriedDate DATE = NULL;
    SELECT TOP (1) @MarriedDate = mr.[MarriedDate]
    FROM [genealogy].[Marriages] AS mr
    WHERE (mr.[Spouse1Id] = @MemberAId AND mr.[Spouse2Id] = @MemberBId)
       OR (mr.[Spouse1Id] = @MemberBId AND mr.[Spouse2Id] = @MemberAId);

    IF @MarriedDate IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Marriages] AS mr
        WHERE (mr.[Spouse1Id] = @MemberAId AND mr.[Spouse2Id] = @MemberBId)
           OR (mr.[Spouse1Id] = @MemberBId AND mr.[Spouse2Id] = @MemberAId)
    )
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            @MemberAId                                          AS [MemberAId],
            @NameA                                              AS [MemberAName],
            @BirthA                                             AS [MemberABirthDate],
            @BranchNameA                                        AS [MemberABranchName],
            @MemberBId                                          AS [MemberBId],
            @NameB                                              AS [MemberBName],
            @BirthB                                             AS [MemberBBirthDate],
            @BranchNameB                                        AS [MemberBBranchName],
            CAST(N'marriage' AS NVARCHAR(30))                   AS [RelationshipCategory],
            CAST(NULL AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)                      AS [CommonAncestorId],
            CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))                         AS [CommonAncestorName],
            0                                                   AS [DepthFromAncestorToA],
            0                                                   AS [DepthFromAncestorToB],
            0                                                   AS [TotalGenerationDistance],
            CONCAT(@NameA, N' <==> ', @NameB)                   AS [PathFromAncestorToA],
            CONCAT(@NameB, N' <==> ', @NameA)                   AS [PathFromAncestorToB],
            CONCAT(
                N'Quan hệ Hôn nhân: Vợ — Chồng (', @NameA, N' và ', @NameB,
                CASE WHEN @MarriedDate IS NOT NULL
                     THEN CONCAT(N', kết hôn ngày ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @MarriedDate, 120))
                     ELSE N''
                END,
                N')'
            )                                                   AS [SuggestedKinship];
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- Trường hợp 3: Quan hệ huyết thống trực hệ hoặc bàng hệ qua bảng bao đóng MemberClosure
    DECLARE
        @CommonAncestorId   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
        @CommonAncestorName NVARCHAR(200)    = NULL,
        @DepthA             INT              = NULL,
        @DepthB             INT              = NULL;

    SELECT TOP (1)
        @CommonAncestorId   = ca.[AncestorId],
        @CommonAncestorName = anc.[FullName],
        @DepthA             = ca.[Depth],
        @DepthB             = cb.[Depth]
    FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS ca
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS cb
        ON cb.[AncestorId] = ca.[AncestorId]
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS anc
        ON anc.[Id] = ca.[AncestorId]
    WHERE ca.[DescendantId] = @MemberAId
      AND cb.[DescendantId] = @MemberBId
    ORDER BY
        (ca.[Depth] + cb.[Depth]) ASC,
        ca.[Depth] ASC,
        anc.[BirthDate] ASC;

    IF @CommonAncestorId IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @PathToA NVARCHAR(1000) = @CommonAncestorName;
        DECLARE @PathToB NVARCHAR(1000) = @CommonAncestorName;

        -- Dựng chuỗi đường đi từ Tổ tiên chung xuống A dựa trên MemberClosure
        SELECT @PathToA = STRING_AGG(m.[FullName], N' -> ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cUp.[Depth] ASC)
        FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS cUp
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS cDown
            ON cDown.[AncestorId] = cUp.[DescendantId]
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS m
            ON m.[Id] = cUp.[DescendantId]
        WHERE cUp.[AncestorId] = @CommonAncestorId
          AND cDown.[DescendantId] = @MemberAId
          AND (cUp.[Depth] + cDown.[Depth]) = @DepthA;

        -- Dựng chuỗi đường đi từ Tổ tiên chung xuống B dựa trên MemberClosure
        SELECT @PathToB = STRING_AGG(m.[FullName], N' -> ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cUp.[Depth] ASC)
        FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS cUp
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS cDown
            ON cDown.[AncestorId] = cUp.[DescendantId]
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS m
            ON m.[Id] = cUp.[DescendantId]
        WHERE cUp.[AncestorId] = @CommonAncestorId
          AND cDown.[DescendantId] = @MemberBId
          AND (cUp.[Depth] + cDown.[Depth]) = @DepthB;

        SELECT
            @MemberAId                                          AS [MemberAId],
            @NameA                                              AS [MemberAName],
            @BirthA                                             AS [MemberABirthDate],
            @BranchNameA                                        AS [MemberABranchName],
            @MemberBId                                          AS [MemberBId],
            @NameB                                              AS [MemberBName],
            @BirthB                                             AS [MemberBBirthDate],
            @BranchNameB                                        AS [MemberBBranchName],
            CASE
                WHEN @DepthA = 0 OR @DepthB = 0 THEN CAST(N'direct_lineage' AS NVARCHAR(30))
                ELSE CAST(N'collateral_bloodline' AS NVARCHAR(30))
            END                                                 AS [RelationshipCategory],
            @CommonAncestorId                                   AS [CommonAncestorId],
            @CommonAncestorName                                 AS [CommonAncestorName],
            @DepthA                                             AS [DepthFromAncestorToA],
            @DepthB                                             AS [DepthFromAncestorToB],
            (@DepthA + @DepthB)                                 AS [TotalGenerationDistance],
            ISNULL(@PathToA, @NameA)                            AS [PathFromAncestorToA],
            ISNULL(@PathToB, @NameB)                            AS [PathFromAncestorToB],
            [genealogy].[fn_SuggestVietnameseKinship](@DepthA, @DepthB) AS [SuggestedKinship];
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- Trường hợp 4: Quan hệ Thông gia / Dâu / Rể (một người là vợ/chồng của người có huyết thống với người kia)
    DECLARE
        @SpouseId           UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
        @SpouseName         NVARCHAR(200)    = NULL,
        @SpouseSide         NVARCHAR(10)     = NULL,
        @AffinalAncestorId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
        @AffinalAncestor    NVARCHAR(200)    = NULL,
        @AffinalDepthA      INT              = NULL,
        @AffinalDepthB      INT              = NULL;

    -- Kiểm tra nếu B là vợ/chồng của một người S có huyết thống với A
    SELECT TOP (1)
        @SpouseId          = s.[Id],
        @SpouseName        = s.[FullName],
        @SpouseSide        = N'B',
        @AffinalAncestorId = ca.[AncestorId],
        @AffinalAncestor   = anc.[FullName],
        @AffinalDepthA     = ca.[Depth],
        @AffinalDepthB     = cs.[Depth]
    FROM [genealogy].[Marriages] AS mr
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS s
        ON s.[Id] = CASE WHEN mr.[Spouse1Id] = @MemberBId THEN mr.[Spouse2Id] ELSE mr.[Spouse1Id] END
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS ca
        ON ca.[DescendantId] = @MemberAId
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS cs
        ON cs.[AncestorId] = ca.[AncestorId] AND cs.[DescendantId] = s.[Id]
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS anc
        ON anc.[Id] = ca.[AncestorId]
    WHERE mr.[Spouse1Id] = @MemberBId OR mr.[Spouse2Id] = @MemberBId
    ORDER BY (ca.[Depth] + cs.[Depth]) ASC;

    -- Nếu chưa thấy, kiểm tra nếu A là vợ/chồng của một người S có huyết thống với B
    IF @SpouseId IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP (1)
            @SpouseId          = s.[Id],
            @SpouseName        = s.[FullName],
            @SpouseSide        = N'A',
            @AffinalAncestorId = cb.[AncestorId],
            @AffinalAncestor   = anc.[FullName],
            @AffinalDepthA     = cs.[Depth],
            @AffinalDepthB     = cb.[Depth]
        FROM [genealogy].[Marriages] AS mr
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS s
            ON s.[Id] = CASE WHEN mr.[Spouse1Id] = @MemberAId THEN mr.[Spouse2Id] ELSE mr.[Spouse1Id] END
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS cb
            ON cb.[DescendantId] = @MemberBId
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[MemberClosure] AS cs
            ON cs.[AncestorId] = cb.[AncestorId] AND cs.[DescendantId] = s.[Id]
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS anc
            ON anc.[Id] = cb.[AncestorId]
        WHERE mr.[Spouse1Id] = @MemberAId OR mr.[Spouse2Id] = @MemberAId
        ORDER BY (cs.[Depth] + cb.[Depth]) ASC;
    END;

    IF @SpouseId IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            @MemberAId                                          AS [MemberAId],
            @NameA                                              AS [MemberAName],
            @BirthA                                             AS [MemberABirthDate],
            @BranchNameA                                        AS [MemberABranchName],
            @MemberBId                                          AS [MemberBId],
            @NameB                                              AS [MemberBName],
            @BirthB                                             AS [MemberBBirthDate],
            @BranchNameB                                        AS [MemberBBranchName],
            CAST(N'affinal_in_law' AS NVARCHAR(30))             AS [RelationshipCategory],
            @AffinalAncestorId                                  AS [CommonAncestorId],
            @AffinalAncestor                                    AS [CommonAncestorName],
            @AffinalDepthA                                      AS [DepthFromAncestorToA],
            @AffinalDepthB                                      AS [DepthFromAncestorToB],
            (@AffinalDepthA + @AffinalDepthB)                   AS [TotalGenerationDistance],
            CASE WHEN @SpouseSide = N'A'
                 THEN CONCAT(@AffinalAncestor, N' -> ... -> ', @SpouseName, N' (Vợ/Chồng của ', @NameA, N')')
                 ELSE CONCAT(@AffinalAncestor, N' -> ... -> ', @NameA)
            END                                                 AS [PathFromAncestorToA],
            CASE WHEN @SpouseSide = N'B'
                 THEN CONCAT(@AffinalAncestor, N' -> ... -> ', @SpouseName, N' (Vợ/Chồng của ', @NameB, N')')
                 ELSE CONCAT(@AffinalAncestor, N' -> ... -> ', @NameB)
            END                                                 AS [PathFromAncestorToB],
            CONCAT(
                N'Quan hệ Họ hàng qua Hôn nhân (Dâu/Rể): Thông qua ', @SpouseName,
                N' — ', [genealogy].[fn_SuggestVietnameseKinship](@AffinalDepthA, @AffinalDepthB)
            )                                                   AS [SuggestedKinship];
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- Trường hợp 5: Chưa tìm thấy đường nối trong cây gia phả
    SELECT
        @MemberAId                                              AS [MemberAId],
        @NameA                                                  AS [MemberAName],
        @BirthA                                                 AS [MemberABirthDate],
        @BranchNameA                                            AS [MemberABranchName],
        @MemberBId                                              AS [MemberBId],
        @NameB                                                  AS [MemberBName],
        @BirthB                                                 AS [MemberBBirthDate],
        @BranchNameB                                            AS [MemberBBranchName],
        CAST(N'unconnected' AS NVARCHAR(30))                    AS [RelationshipCategory],
        CAST(NULL AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)                          AS [CommonAncestorId],
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200))                             AS [CommonAncestorName],
        CAST(NULL AS INT)                                       AS [DepthFromAncestorToA],
        CAST(NULL AS INT)                                       AS [DepthFromAncestorToB],
        CAST(NULL AS INT)                                       AS [TotalGenerationDistance],
        @NameA                                                  AS [PathFromAncestorToA],
        @NameB                                                  AS [PathFromAncestorToB],
        CAST(N'Chưa tìm thấy tổ tiên chung hoặc liên kết hôn nhân trực tiếp giữa hai thành viên.' AS NVARCHAR(300)) AS [SuggestedKinship];
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   5. Stored Procedure: reports.usp_SaveAiChatMessage
   Ghi nhận lịch sử hỏi đáp của người dùng với Trợ lý ảo AI vào bảng
   reports.AiChatMessages kèm danh sách ID nguồn tư liệu trích dẫn.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [reports].[usp_SaveAiChatMessage]
    @FamilyId            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @UserId              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @QueryType           NVARCHAR(30) = N'semantic_search',
    @Question            NVARCHAR(2000),
    @Answer              NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @ReferencedSourceIds NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    IF @QueryType NOT IN (N'semantic_search', N'kinship_explain', N'summarization', N'recommendation', N'general')
        THROW 50741, N'QueryType không hợp lệ.', 1;

    IF @ReferencedSourceIds IS NOT NULL AND ISJSON(@ReferencedSourceIds) <> 1
        THROW 50742, N'ReferencedSourceIds phải là chuỗi JSON hợp lệ hoặc NULL.', 1;

    DECLARE @Inserted TABLE ([Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, [CreatedAt] DATETIME2(0));

    INSERT INTO [reports].[AiChatMessages]
        ([FamilyId], [UserId], [QueryType], [Question], [Answer], [ReferencedSourceIds])
    OUTPUT inserted.[Id], inserted.[CreatedAt] INTO @Inserted
    VALUES
        (@FamilyId, @UserId, @QueryType, @Question, @Answer, @ReferencedSourceIds);

    SELECT [Id] AS [MessageId], [CreatedAt] FROM @Inserted;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [core].[usp_CreateSystemConfig]
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ConfigKey NVARCHAR(4000),
    @ConfigValue NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @Description NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    IF @ConfigKey IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@ConfigKey) = 0 OR DATALENGTH(@ConfigKey) > 200
       OR @ConfigKey COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 LIKE N'%[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]%'
        THROW 51101, N'ConfigKey chi gom chu ASCII, so, dau cham, gach duoi va gach ngang; toi da 100 ky tu.', 1;
    IF @ConfigValue IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@Description) > 1000
        THROW 51101, N'ConfigValue khong duoc NULL; Description toi da 500 don vi UTF-16.', 1;

    DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION CreateSystemConfig;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Users] WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE [UserId] = @ActorUserId AND [Role] = N'admin' AND [IsActive] = 1)
            THROW 51102, N'Chi admin dang hoat dong duoc quan ly cau hinh.', 1;

        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[SystemConfigs] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE [ConfigKey] = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @ConfigKey))
            THROW 51103, N'Khoa cau hinh da ton tai.', 1;

        INSERT INTO [core].[SystemConfigs] ([ConfigKey], [ConfigValue], [Description])
        VALUES (CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @ConfigKey), @ConfigValue, @Description);

        INSERT INTO [reports].[AuditLog] ([UserId], [Action])
        VALUES (@ActorUserId, CONCAT(N'system_config.created; key=', @ConfigKey));

        -- SELECT sau DML de lay UpdatedAt do AFTER UPDATE trigger thiet lap.
        DECLARE @Result TABLE ([ConfigKey] VARCHAR(100), [ConfigValue] NVARCHAR(MAX),
                               [Description] NVARCHAR(500), [UpdatedAt] DATETIME2(0));
        INSERT INTO @Result
        SELECT [ConfigKey], [ConfigValue], [Description], [UpdatedAt]
        FROM [core].[SystemConfigs] WHERE [ConfigKey] = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @ConfigKey);

        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        SELECT [ConfigKey], [ConfigValue], [Description], [UpdatedAt] FROM @Result;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
        BEGIN
            IF @StartedTransaction = 1 OR XACT_STATE() = -1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            ELSE ROLLBACK TRANSACTION CreateSystemConfig;
        END;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [core].[usp_UpdateSystemConfig]
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ConfigKey NVARCHAR(4000),
    @ConfigValue NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @Description NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    IF @ConfigKey IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@ConfigKey) = 0 OR DATALENGTH(@ConfigKey) > 200
       OR @ConfigKey COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 LIKE N'%[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]%'
        THROW 51101, N'ConfigKey chi gom chu ASCII, so, dau cham, gach duoi va gach ngang; toi da 100 ky tu.', 1;
    IF @ConfigValue IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@Description) > 1000
        THROW 51101, N'ConfigValue khong duoc NULL; Description toi da 500 don vi UTF-16.', 1;

    DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION UpdateSystemConfig;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Users] WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE [UserId] = @ActorUserId AND [Role] = N'admin' AND [IsActive] = 1)
            THROW 51102, N'Chi admin dang hoat dong duoc quan ly cau hinh.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[SystemConfigs] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE [ConfigKey] = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @ConfigKey))
            THROW 51104, N'Khong tim thay cau hinh.', 1;

        UPDATE [core].[SystemConfigs]
        SET [ConfigValue] = @ConfigValue, [Description] = @Description
        WHERE [ConfigKey] = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @ConfigKey);

        INSERT INTO [reports].[AuditLog] ([UserId], [Action])
        VALUES (@ActorUserId, CONCAT(N'system_config.updated; key=', @ConfigKey));

        -- SELECT sau DML de lay UpdatedAt do AFTER UPDATE trigger thiet lap.
        DECLARE @Result TABLE ([ConfigKey] VARCHAR(100), [ConfigValue] NVARCHAR(MAX),
                               [Description] NVARCHAR(500), [UpdatedAt] DATETIME2(0));
        INSERT INTO @Result
        SELECT [ConfigKey], [ConfigValue], [Description], [UpdatedAt]
        FROM [core].[SystemConfigs] WHERE [ConfigKey] = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @ConfigKey);

        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        SELECT [ConfigKey], [ConfigValue], [Description], [UpdatedAt] FROM @Result;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
        BEGIN
            IF @StartedTransaction = 1 OR XACT_STATE() = -1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            ELSE ROLLBACK TRANSACTION UpdateSystemConfig;
        END;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [core].[usp_DeleteSystemConfig]
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @ConfigKey NVARCHAR(4000)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    IF @ConfigKey IS NULL OR DATALENGTH(@ConfigKey) = 0 OR DATALENGTH(@ConfigKey) > 200
       OR @ConfigKey COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2 LIKE N'%[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]%'
        THROW 51101, N'ConfigKey chi gom chu ASCII, so, dau cham, gach duoi va gach ngang; toi da 100 ky tu.', 1;

    DECLARE @StartedTransaction BIT = CASE WHEN @@TRANCOUNT = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
    BEGIN TRY
        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        ELSE SAVE TRANSACTION DeleteSystemConfig;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Users] WITH (HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE [UserId] = @ActorUserId AND [Role] = N'admin' AND [IsActive] = 1)
            THROW 51102, N'Chi admin dang hoat dong duoc quan ly cau hinh.', 1;

        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[SystemConfigs] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
                       WHERE [ConfigKey] = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @ConfigKey))
            THROW 51104, N'Khong tim thay cau hinh.', 1;

        DELETE FROM [core].[SystemConfigs]
        WHERE [ConfigKey] = CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), @ConfigKey);

        INSERT INTO [reports].[AuditLog] ([UserId], [Action])
        VALUES (@ActorUserId, CONCAT(N'system_config.deleted; key=', @ConfigKey));

        IF @StartedTransaction = 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
        BEGIN
            IF @StartedTransaction = 1 OR XACT_STATE() = -1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            ELSE ROLLBACK TRANSACTION DeleteSystemConfig;
        END;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

-- Admin xem toan bo; family_head chi xem cung family/branch va khong tu duyet.
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [core].[usp_GetPendingVerifications]
    @ReviewerUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Limit INT = 50,
    @Offset INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF @Limit IS NULL OR @Limit < 1 OR @Limit > 200 OR @Offset IS NULL OR @Offset < 0
        THROW 51101, N'Limit phai tu 1 den 200; Offset khong am.', 1;

    DECLARE @ReviewerRole NVARCHAR(20);
    SELECT @ReviewerRole = [Role] FROM [core].[Users]
    WHERE [UserId] = @ReviewerUserId AND [IsActive] = 1;
    IF @ReviewerRole IS NULL OR @ReviewerRole NOT IN (N'admin', N'family_head')
        THROW 51102, N'Tai khoan khong co quyen xem yeu cau xac minh.', 1;

    SELECT pending.[VerificationId], pending.[UserId], pending.[UserFullName],
           pending.[UserEmail], pending.[UserIsActive], pending.[MemberId],
           pending.[MemberFullName], pending.[BirthDate], pending.[FamilyId],
           pending.[FamilyName], pending.[BranchId], pending.[BranchName],
           pending.[LinkedUserId], pending.[Status], pending.[RequestedAt]
    FROM [core].[vw_PendingVerifications] AS pending
    WHERE @ReviewerRole = N'admin'
       OR (pending.[UserId] <> @ReviewerUserId AND EXISTS
           (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] AS reviewer
            INNER JOIN [core].[Branches] AS branch
                ON branch.[Id] = reviewer.[BranchId] AND branch.[FamilyId] = reviewer.[FamilyId]
            WHERE reviewer.[UserId] = @ReviewerUserId
              AND reviewer.[FamilyId] = pending.[FamilyId]
              AND reviewer.[BranchId] = pending.[BranchId]))
    ORDER BY pending.[RequestedAt], pending.[VerificationId]
    OFFSET @Offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @Limit ROWS ONLY;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [reports].[usp_GetDashboardStatistics]
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    DECLARE @ActorRole NVARCHAR(20);
    SELECT @ActorRole = [Role] FROM [core].[Users]
    WHERE [UserId] = @ActorUserId AND [IsActive] = 1;
    IF @ActorRole IS NULL OR @ActorRole NOT IN (N'admin', N'family_head')
        THROW 51201, N'Tai khoan khong co quyen xem thong ke.', 1;

    SELECT summary.[FamilyId], summary.[FamilyName], summary.[MemberCount],
           summary.[PostCount], summary.[EventCount]
    FROM [reports].[vw_FamilyActivitySummary] AS summary
    WHERE @ActorRole = N'admin' OR EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[Members] AS member
         WHERE member.[UserId] = @ActorUserId AND member.[FamilyId] = summary.[FamilyId])
    ORDER BY summary.[FamilyName], summary.[FamilyId];
END;
GO

# FILE: database/procedures/08_membership_procs.sql
################################################################################
USE [$(DB_NAME)];

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO

-- All record changes share the same access check and transaction as the write.
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE genealogy.usp_ManageRecord
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Resource VARCHAR(20), @Action VARCHAR(10), @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @Name NVARCHAR(200) = NULL, @BranchId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL,
    @BirthDate DATE = NULL, @Location NVARCHAR(300) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        IF @Resource NOT IN ('families','branches','members') OR @Action NOT IN ('create','update','delete')
            THROW 51522, N'Thao tác không hợp lệ.', 1;
        IF @Action <> 'delete' AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)),N'') IS NULL
            THROW 51522, N'Tên không được để trống.', 1;
        IF @Resource='families' AND @Action IN ('create','delete')
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND Role='admin' AND IsActive=1)
                THROW 51403, N'Chỉ quản trị viên được tạo hoặc xóa gia đình.', 1;
        END;
        IF NOT (@Resource='families' AND @Action='create')
            EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@FamilyId,1;
        DECLARE @Role NVARCHAR(20),@ManagedBranch UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        SELECT @Role=Role FROM core.Users WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId;
        IF @Role='family_head'
        BEGIN
            SELECT @ManagedBranch=BranchId FROM genealogy.Members WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND FamilyId=@FamilyId;
            IF @Resource='families' OR @ManagedBranch IS NULL
                THROW 51403,N'Chỉ quản trị viên được thay đổi gia đình; trưởng chi cần liên kết một chi.',1;
            IF @Resource='branches' AND (@Action<>'update' OR @Id<>@ManagedBranch)
                THROW 51403,N'Trưởng chi chỉ được đổi tên chi đang quản lý.',1;
            IF @Resource='members'
            BEGIN
                IF @Action<>'create' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@Id AND BranchId=@ManagedBranch)
                    THROW 51403,N'Thành viên không thuộc chi đang quản lý.',1;
                IF @Action<>'delete' AND (@BranchId IS NULL OR @BranchId<>@ManagedBranch)
                    THROW 51403,N'Chỉ quản trị viên được chuyển chi của thành viên.',1;
            END;
        END;
        IF @Resource='members'
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @GraphLock INT;
            EXEC @GraphLock=sp_getapplock @Resource=N'genealogy.MemberClosure',@LockMode=N'Exclusive',@LockOwner=N'Transaction',@LockTimeout=10000;
            IF @GraphLock<0 THROW 50100,N'Không thể khóa gia phả; vui lòng thử lại.',1;
        END;

        IF @Resource='families'
        BEGIN
            IF @Action='create'
            BEGIN
                SET @Id=NEWID();
                INSERT core.Families(Id,Name) VALUES (@Id,LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)));
            END
            ELSE IF @Action='update'
                UPDATE core.Families SET Name=LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)) WHERE Id=@FamilyId;
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Branches WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community.Posts WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community.Events WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.Items WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.KnowledgeChunks WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reports.AiChatMessages WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                    THROW 51509,N'Gia đình còn dữ liệu liên quan; không thể xóa.',1;
                DELETE core.Families WHERE Id=@FamilyId;
            END;
        END
        ELSE IF @Resource='branches'
        BEGIN
            IF @Action<>'create' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Branches WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@Id AND FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy chi nhánh.',1;
            IF @Action='create'
            BEGIN
                SET @Id=NEWID();
                INSERT core.Branches(Id,FamilyId,Name) VALUES(@Id,@FamilyId,LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)));
            END
            ELSE IF @Action='update' UPDATE core.Branches SET Name=LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)) WHERE Id=@Id;
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE BranchId=@Id)
                    THROW 51509,N'Chi nhánh còn thành viên; hãy chuyển họ trước khi xóa.',1;
                DELETE core.Branches WHERE Id=@Id;
            END;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF @Action<>'create' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (XLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@Id AND FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy thành viên.',1;
            IF @BranchId IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Branches WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@BranchId AND FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                THROW 51522,N'Chi nhánh không thuộc gia đình đã chọn.',1;
            IF @BirthDate>CONVERT(DATE,SYSUTCDATETIME()) THROW 51522,N'Ngày sinh không được ở tương lai.',1;
            IF @Action='create'
            BEGIN
                SET @Id=NEWID();
                INSERT genealogy.Members(Id,FamilyId,BranchId,FullName,BirthDate,Location)
                    VALUES(@Id,@FamilyId,@BranchId,LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)),@BirthDate,@Location);
                INSERT genealogy.MemberClosure(AncestorId,DescendantId,Depth) VALUES(@Id,@Id,0);
            END
            ELSE IF @Action='update'
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.KnowledgeChunks WHERE SourceType='member' AND SourceId=@Id)
                    THROW 51509,N'Hồ sơ đã được AI lập chỉ mục; cần cập nhật chỉ mục trước khi sửa.',1;
                UPDATE genealogy.Members SET FullName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)),BranchId=@BranchId,BirthDate=@BirthDate,Location=@Location WHERE Id=@Id;
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WHERE Id=@Id AND UserId IS NOT NULL)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.ParentChild WHERE ParentId=@Id OR ChildId=@Id)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Marriages WHERE Spouse1Id=@Id OR Spouse2Id=@Id)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.MemberVerifications WHERE MemberId=@Id)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Educations WHERE MemberId=@Id)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.WorkHistories WHERE MemberId=@Id)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.Honors WHERE MemberId=@Id)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community.EventParticipants WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE MemberId=@Id)
                    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.KnowledgeChunks WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE SourceType='member' AND SourceId=@Id)
                    THROW 51509,N'Thành viên còn tài khoản, quan hệ hoặc lịch sử liên quan; không thể xóa.',1;
                DELETE genealogy.MemberClosure WHERE AncestorId=@Id OR DescendantId=@Id;
                DELETE genealogy.Members WHERE Id=@Id;
            END;
        END;
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,CONCAT('genealogy.',@Resource,'.',@Action,'; id=',COALESCE(@Id,@FamilyId)));
        COMMIT;
        SELECT COALESCE(@Id,@FamilyId) AS id;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE genealogy.usp_UpdateOwnProfile
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Name NVARCHAR(200), @BirthDate DATE=NULL, @Location NVARCHAR(300)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)),N'') IS NULL OR @BirthDate>CONVERT(DATE,SYSUTCDATETIME())
            THROW 51522,N'Tên hoặc ngày sinh không hợp lệ.',1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND IsActive=1)
            THROW 51403,N'Tài khoản không hoạt động.',1;
        DECLARE @MemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        SELECT @MemberId=Id FROM genealogy.Members WITH (XLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId;
        IF @MemberId IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM heritage.KnowledgeChunks WHERE SourceType='member' AND SourceId=@MemberId)
            THROW 51509,N'Hồ sơ đã được AI lập chỉ mục; cần cập nhật chỉ mục trước khi sửa.',1;
        UPDATE core.Users SET FullName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId;
        UPDATE genealogy.Members SET FullName=LTRIM(RTRIM(@Name)),BirthDate=@BirthDate,Location=@Location WHERE Id=@MemberId;
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,N'profile.updated');
        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE core.usp_RequestMemberVerification
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @MemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND IsActive=1 AND Role IN ('member','family_head','admin'))
            THROW 51403,N'Không có quyền gửi yêu cầu xác minh.',1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId)
            THROW 51509,N'Tài khoản đã liên kết hồ sơ gia phả.',1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@MemberId AND UserId IS NULL)
            THROW 51509,N'Hồ sơ không còn khả dụng để xác minh.',1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.MemberVerifications WITH (UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND Status='pending')
            THROW 51509,N'Bạn đang có yêu cầu chờ duyệt.',1;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.MemberVerifications WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND MemberId=@MemberId)
            UPDATE core.MemberVerifications SET Status='pending',CreatedAt=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND MemberId=@MemberId;
        ELSE INSERT core.MemberVerifications(UserId,MemberId) VALUES(@ActorUserId,@MemberId);
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,CONCAT('verification.requested; member=',@MemberId));
        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE genealogy.usp_ManageRelationship
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Kind VARCHAR(20), @Action VARCHAR(10), @FirstId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER=NULL,
    @SecondId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER=NULL, @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER=NULL, @MarriedDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@FamilyId,1;
        DECLARE @LockResult INT;
        EXEC @LockResult=sp_getapplock @Resource=N'genealogy.MemberClosure',@LockMode=N'Exclusive',@LockOwner=N'Transaction',@LockTimeout=10000;
        IF @LockResult<0 THROW 50100,N'Không thể khóa gia phả; vui lòng thử lại.',1;
        IF @Kind NOT IN ('parent-child','marriages') OR @Action NOT IN ('create','delete') THROW 51522,N'Thao tác không hợp lệ.',1;
        IF @Action='delete' AND @Kind='parent-child'
            SELECT @FirstId=ParentId,@SecondId=ChildId FROM genealogy.ParentChild WHERE Id=@Id;
        IF @Action='delete' AND @Kind='marriages'
            SELECT @FirstId=Spouse1Id,@SecondId=Spouse2Id FROM genealogy.Marriages WHERE Id=@Id;
        IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND Role='family_head')
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @ManagedBranch UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
            SELECT @ManagedBranch=BranchId FROM genealogy.Members WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND FamilyId=@FamilyId;
            IF @ManagedBranch IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WHERE BranchId=@ManagedBranch
                AND (Id=@SecondId OR (@Kind='marriages' AND Id=@FirstId)))
                THROW 51403,N'Quan hệ không thuộc chi đang quản lý.',1;
        END;
        IF @Action='create'
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@FirstId AND FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH (HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@SecondId AND FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                THROW 51522,N'Cả hai thành viên phải thuộc gia đình đã chọn.',1;
            IF @Kind='parent-child'
            BEGIN
                EXEC genealogy.usp_AddChildNode @FirstId,@SecondId,@Id OUTPUT;
                -- A new edge must not make an existing marriage consanguineous.
                IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Marriages m
                    JOIN genealogy.Members owner ON owner.Id=m.Spouse1Id AND owner.FamilyId=@FamilyId
                    JOIN genealogy.MemberClosure a ON a.DescendantId=m.Spouse1Id
                    JOIN genealogy.MemberClosure b ON b.DescendantId=m.Spouse2Id AND b.AncestorId=a.AncestorId
                    WHERE (a.Depth<=2 AND b.Depth<=2) OR a.Depth=0 OR b.Depth=0)
                    THROW 50204,N'Quan hệ mới làm hôn nhân hiện có vi phạm quy tắc huyết thống.',1;
            END
            ELSE EXEC genealogy.usp_AddMarriage @FirstId,@SecondId,@MarriedDate,3,@Id OUTPUT;
        END
        ELSE IF @Kind='parent-child'
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.ParentChild p JOIN genealogy.Members m ON m.Id=p.ParentId JOIN genealogy.Members c ON c.Id=p.ChildId WHERE p.Id=@Id AND m.FamilyId=@FamilyId AND c.FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy quan hệ.',1;
            DELETE genealogy.ParentChild WHERE Id=@Id;
            -- Recompute minimum depths: another parent may still supply a path.
            DELETE c FROM genealogy.MemberClosure c JOIN genealogy.Members m ON m.Id=c.AncestorId WHERE m.FamilyId=@FamilyId;
            ;WITH Paths AS (
                SELECT Id AS AncestorId,Id AS DescendantId,0 AS Depth FROM genealogy.Members WHERE FamilyId=@FamilyId
                UNION ALL
                SELECT p.AncestorId,e.ChildId,p.Depth+1 FROM Paths p JOIN genealogy.ParentChild e ON e.ParentId=p.DescendantId
            )
            INSERT genealogy.MemberClosure(AncestorId,DescendantId,Depth)
            SELECT AncestorId,DescendantId,MIN(Depth) FROM Paths GROUP BY AncestorId,DescendantId OPTION(MAXRECURSION 32767);
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Marriages p JOIN genealogy.Members m ON m.Id=p.Spouse1Id JOIN genealogy.Members c ON c.Id=p.Spouse2Id WHERE p.Id=@Id AND m.FamilyId=@FamilyId AND c.FamilyId=@FamilyId)
                THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy quan hệ.',1;
            DELETE genealogy.Marriages WHERE Id=@Id;
        END;
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,CONCAT('genealogy.',@Kind,'.',@Action,'; id=',@Id));
        COMMIT;
        SELECT @Id AS id;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE genealogy.usp_ManageHistory
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@MemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Resource VARCHAR(20),@Action VARCHAR(10),
    @Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER=NULL,@Institution NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,@Degree NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,
    @Company NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,@Position NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,@StartDate DATE=NULL,@EndDate DATE=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        DECLARE @Family UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Branch UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Owner UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Role NVARCHAR(20);
        SELECT @Family=FamilyId,@Branch=BranchId,@Owner=UserId FROM genealogy.Members WITH(XLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@MemberId;
        IF @Family IS NULL THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy thành viên.',1;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family;
        SELECT @Role=Role FROM core.Users WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId;
        IF @Role<>'admin' AND ISNULL(@Owner,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')<>@ActorUserId
            AND NOT(@Role='family_head' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND BranchId=@Branch AND FamilyId=@Family))
            THROW 51403,N'Chỉ được sửa hồ sơ của mình hoặc thành viên trong chi đang quản lý.',1;
        IF @Resource NOT IN ('educations','work') OR @Action NOT IN ('create','update','delete') THROW 51522,N'Thao tác không hợp lệ.',1;
        IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM heritage.KnowledgeChunks WHERE SourceType='member' AND SourceId=@MemberId)
            THROW 51509,N'Hồ sơ đã được AI lập chỉ mục; cần đồng bộ chỉ mục trước khi sửa.',1;
        IF @Action<>'delete' AND (@EndDate<@StartDate OR (@Resource='educations' AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Institution)),N'') IS NULL)
            OR (@Resource='work' AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Company)),N'') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Position)),N'') IS NULL)))
            THROW 51522,N'Tên trường/công việc hoặc khoảng thời gian chưa hợp lệ.',1;
        IF @Resource='educations'
        BEGIN
            IF @Action<>'create' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Educations WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@Id AND MemberId=@MemberId) THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy học vấn.',1;
            IF @Action='create'
            BEGIN
                SET @Id=NEWID();
                INSERT genealogy.Educations(Id,MemberId,Institution,Degree,StartDate,EndDate) VALUES(@Id,@MemberId,@Institution,@Degree,@StartDate,@EndDate);
            END
            ELSE IF @Action='update' UPDATE genealogy.Educations SET Institution=@Institution,Degree=@Degree,StartDate=@StartDate,EndDate=@EndDate WHERE Id=@Id;
            ELSE DELETE genealogy.Educations WHERE Id=@Id;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF @Action<>'create' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.WorkHistories WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@Id AND MemberId=@MemberId) THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy công việc.',1;
            IF @Action='create'
            BEGIN
                SET @Id=NEWID();
                INSERT genealogy.WorkHistories(Id,MemberId,Company,Position,StartDate,EndDate) VALUES(@Id,@MemberId,@Company,@Position,@StartDate,@EndDate);
            END
            ELSE IF @Action='update' UPDATE genealogy.WorkHistories SET Company=@Company,Position=@Position,StartDate=@StartDate,EndDate=@EndDate WHERE Id=@Id;
            ELSE DELETE genealogy.WorkHistories WHERE Id=@Id;
        END;
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,CONCAT('directory.',@Resource,'.',@Action,'; id=',@Id));
        COMMIT; SELECT @Id AS id;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE community.usp_ManagePost
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@PostId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Action VARCHAR(10),
    @Content NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL,@MediaJson NVARCHAR(MAX)=NULL,@IsAnnouncement BIT=0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        DECLARE @Family UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Owner UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Role NVARCHAR(20);
        SELECT @Family=FamilyId,@Owner=UserId FROM community.Posts WITH(XLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@PostId;
        IF @Family IS NULL THROW 51404,N'Bài viết không còn tồn tại.',1;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family;
        SELECT @Role=Role FROM core.Users WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId;
        IF @Owner<>@ActorUserId AND @Role<>'admin' THROW 51403,N'Chỉ tác giả hoặc quản trị viên được sửa/xóa bài.',1;
        IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM heritage.KnowledgeChunks WHERE SourceType='post' AND SourceId=@PostId)
            THROW 51509,N'Bài đã được AI lập chỉ mục; cần đồng bộ chỉ mục trước khi thay đổi.',1;
        IF @Action NOT IN ('update','delete') THROW 51522,N'Thao tác không hợp lệ.',1;
        IF @Action='update'
        BEGIN
            IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Content)),N'') IS NULL OR (@MediaJson IS NOT NULL AND ISJSON(@MediaJson)=0) THROW 51522,N'Nội dung chưa hợp lệ.',1;
            IF @IsAnnouncement=1 EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family,1;
            UPDATE community.Posts SET Content=@Content,IsAnnouncement=@IsAnnouncement WHERE Id=@PostId;
        END;
        DECLARE @Media TABLE(Url NVARCHAR(2048) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2);
        IF @Action='update'
            INSERT @Media SELECT url FROM OPENJSON(@MediaJson) WITH(url NVARCHAR(2048) '$.url');
        DECLARE @RemovedMedia TABLE(Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
        DELETE m OUTPUT deleted.Id INTO @RemovedMedia
        FROM community.PostMedia m WHERE m.PostId=@PostId
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @Media incoming WHERE incoming.Url=m.MediaUrl COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2);
        UPDATE community.ReportedContents SET Status='resolved' WHERE Status='pending' AND (
            (TargetType='photo' AND TargetId IN(SELECT Id FROM @RemovedMedia)) OR
            (@Action='delete' AND ((TargetType='post' AND TargetId=@PostId) OR
            (TargetType='comment' AND TargetId IN(SELECT Id FROM community.Comments WHERE PostId=@PostId)))));
        IF @Action='delete' DELETE community.Posts WHERE Id=@PostId;
        ELSE
            INSERT community.PostMedia(PostId,MediaUrl,MediaType)
            SELECT DISTINCT @PostId,incoming.Url,'image' FROM @Media incoming
            WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community.PostMedia m WHERE m.PostId=@PostId
                AND m.MediaUrl COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2=incoming.Url);
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,CONCAT('post.',@Action,'; id=',@PostId));
        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE community.usp_ManageComment
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Action VARCHAR(10),@Content NVARCHAR(2000)=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        DECLARE @Family UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Owner UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        SELECT @Family=p.FamilyId,@Owner=c.UserId FROM community.Comments c WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
            JOIN community.Posts p WITH(HOLDLOCK) ON p.Id=c.PostId WHERE c.Id=@Id;
        IF @Family IS NULL THROW 51404,N'Bình luận không còn tồn tại.',1;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family;
        IF @Owner<>@ActorUserId AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WHERE UserId=@ActorUserId AND Role='admin') THROW 51403,N'Không được sửa/xóa bình luận của người khác.',1;
        IF @Action='update'
        BEGIN
            IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Content)),N'') IS NULL THROW 51522,N'Bình luận không được trống.',1;
            UPDATE community.Comments SET Content=@Content WHERE Id=@Id;
        END
        ELSE IF @Action='delete'
        BEGIN
            UPDATE community.ReportedContents SET Status='resolved' WHERE TargetType='comment' AND TargetId=@Id AND Status='pending';
            DELETE community.Comments WHERE Id=@Id;
        END
        ELSE THROW 51522,N'Thao tác không hợp lệ.',1;
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,CONCAT('comment.',@Action,'; id=',@Id));
        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE community.usp_ManageEvent
    @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@EventId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Action VARCHAR(20),
    @Title NVARCHAR(200)=NULL,@EventDate DATETIME2(0)=NULL,@Location NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,
    @MemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER=NULL,@RsvpStatus NVARCHAR(20)=NULL,@GalleryId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER=NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        DECLARE @Family UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Owner UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        SELECT @Family=FamilyId FROM community.Events WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@EventId;
        IF @Family IS NULL THROW 51404,N'Sự kiện không còn tồn tại.',1;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family;
        IF @Action='gallery-delete'
        BEGIN
            SELECT @Owner=UploadedBy FROM community.EventGalleries WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@GalleryId AND EventId=@EventId;
            IF @Owner IS NULL THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy ảnh.',1;
            IF @Owner<>@ActorUserId EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family,1;
            DELETE community.EventGalleries WHERE Id=@GalleryId;
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family,1;
            IF @Action='update'
            BEGIN
                IF NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@Title)),N'') IS NULL OR @EventDate IS NULL THROW 51522,N'Tên hoặc thời gian không hợp lệ.',1;
                IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community.EventReminders WHERE EventId=@EventId AND Status='pending' AND ReminderTime>@EventDate)
                    THROW 51509,N'Hãy hủy các nhắc lịch sau thời gian sự kiện mới trước khi đổi lịch.',1;
                UPDATE community.Events SET Title=@Title,EventDate=@EventDate,Location=@Location WHERE Id=@EventId;
            END
            ELSE IF @Action='delete'
            BEGIN
                UPDATE community.Notifications SET EventId=NULL WHERE EventId=@EventId;
                DELETE community.Events WHERE Id=@EventId;
            END
            ELSE IF @Action='participant'
            BEGIN
                IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members WITH(HOLDLOCK) WHERE Id=@MemberId AND FamilyId=@Family) THROW 51522,N'Thành viên không thuộc gia đình.',1;
                IF @RsvpStatus NOT IN ('Pending','Going','Maybe','Declined') OR @RsvpStatus IS NULL THROW 51522,N'Trạng thái không hợp lệ.',1;
                EXEC community.usp_UpsertEventRsvp @EventId,@MemberId,@RsvpStatus;
            END
            ELSE THROW 51522,N'Thao tác không hợp lệ.',1;
        END;
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,CONCAT('event.',@Action,'; id=',@EventId,'; member=',@MemberId));
        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
