CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE community.usp_DeliverDueReminders @BatchSize INT=50
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    IF @BatchSize<1 OR @BatchSize>500 THROW 51522,N'Batch không hợp lệ.',1;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        DECLARE @Due TABLE(Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,EventId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,ReminderTime DATETIME2(0),UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
        INSERT @Due SELECT TOP(@BatchSize) Id,EventId,ReminderTime,UserId FROM community.EventReminders WITH(UPDLOCK,READPAST,ROWLOCK)
            WHERE Status='pending' AND ReminderTime<=SYSUTCDATETIME() ORDER BY ReminderTime,Id;
        DECLARE @Created TABLE(Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER);
        INSERT community.Notifications(UserId,FamilyId,EventId,ReminderId,Title,Body)
        OUTPUT inserted.Id INTO @Created
        SELECT u.UserId,e.FamilyId,e.Id,r.Id,e.Title,CONCAT(N'Sự kiện: ',e.Title,N' · ',CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19),e.EventDate,126),N' UTC')
        FROM @Due r JOIN community.Events e ON e.Id=r.EventId JOIN core.Users u ON u.IsActive=1 AND u.Role IN ('admin','family_head','member')
        WHERE (r.UserId IS NULL OR r.UserId=u.UserId)
            AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members m WHERE m.UserId=u.UserId AND m.FamilyId=e.FamilyId) OR (r.UserId=u.UserId AND u.Role='admin'))
            AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM community.Notifications n WHERE n.ReminderId=r.Id AND n.UserId=u.UserId);
        UPDATE r SET Status='sent' FROM community.EventReminders r JOIN @Due due ON due.Id=r.Id;
        DECLARE @Count INT=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Created);
        IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @Due)
            INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(NULL,CONCAT('reminder.dispatched; reminders=',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Due),'; inbox=',@Count));
        COMMIT;
        SELECT @Count AS delivered;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE community.usp_CancelReminder @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@EventId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET XACT_ABORT ON;
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        DECLARE @Family UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,@Owner UNIQUEIDENTIFIER;
        SELECT @Family=e.FamilyId,@Owner=r.UserId FROM community.EventReminders r WITH(UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK)
            JOIN community.Events e ON e.Id=r.EventId WHERE r.Id=@Id AND r.EventId=@EventId;
        IF @Family IS NULL THROW 51404,N'Không tìm thấy nhắc lịch.',1;
        EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family;
        IF @Owner IS NULL OR @Owner<>@ActorUserId EXEC heritage.usp_AssertFamilyAccess @ActorUserId,@Family,1;
        UPDATE community.EventReminders SET Status='cancelled' WHERE Id=@Id;
        INSERT reports.AuditLog(UserId,Action) VALUES(@ActorUserId,CONCAT('reminder.cancelled; id=',@Id));
        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT>0 ROLLBACK;
        THROW;
    END CATCH;
END;
GO

-- Bảng bao đóng (closure table): mọi cặp tổ tiên - hậu duệ
-- Depth = 0: chính nó; 1: cha/mẹ - con; 2: ông/bà - cháu; 3: cụ - chắt; ...
IF OBJECT_ID(N'genealogy.MemberClosure', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE [genealogy].[MemberClosure]
    (
        [AncestorId] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
        [DescendantId] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
        [Depth] INT NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_MemberClosure_Depth] DEFAULT 0,
        [CreatedAt] DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_MemberClosure_CreatedAt] DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),

        CONSTRAINT [PK_MemberClosure] PRIMARY KEY ([AncestorId], [DescendantId]),
        -- NO ACTION (không CASCADE) vì 2 FK cùng trỏ về Members sẽ gây lỗi multiple cascade paths
        CONSTRAINT [FK_MemberClosure_Ancestor] FOREIGN KEY ([AncestorId])
            REFERENCES [genealogy].[Members] ([Id]),
        CONSTRAINT [FK_MemberClosure_Descendant] FOREIGN KEY ([DescendantId])
            REFERENCES [genealogy].[Members] ([Id]),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_MemberClosure_Depth] CHECK ([Depth] >= 0),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_MemberClosure_SelfCheck] CHECK
        (
            ([Depth] = 0 AND [AncestorId] = [DescendantId])
            OR ([Depth] > 0 AND [AncestorId] <> [DescendantId])
        )
    );
END;
GO

-- Tìm tất cả tổ tiên của một thành viên
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE [name] = N'IX_MemberClosure_Descendant_Depth' AND [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'genealogy.MemberClosure'))
    CREATE INDEX [IX_MemberClosure_Descendant_Depth] ON [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ([DescendantId], [Depth]) INCLUDE ([AncestorId]);
-- Tìm tất cả hậu duệ theo đời
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE [name] = N'IX_MemberClosure_Ancestor_Depth' AND [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'genealogy.MemberClosure'))
    CREATE INDEX [IX_MemberClosure_Ancestor_Depth] ON [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ([AncestorId], [Depth]) INCLUDE ([DescendantId]);
GO

-- Nạp dữ liệu ban đầu từ ParentChild (chỉ chạy khi bảng còn trống)
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [genealogy].[MemberClosure])
BEGIN
    ;WITH Tree AS
    (
        SELECT m.[Id] AS AncestorId, m.[Id] AS DescendantId, 0 AS Depth
        FROM [genealogy].[Members] m
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t.AncestorId, pc.[ChildId], t.Depth + 1
        FROM Tree t
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc ON pc.[ParentId] = t.DescendantId
    )
    INSERT INTO [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ([AncestorId], [DescendantId], [Depth])
    SELECT AncestorId, DescendantId, MIN(Depth)
    FROM Tree
    GROUP BY AncestorId, DescendantId;
END;
GO

################################################################################
# FILE: database/schema/04_reports_ops.sql

-- T-SQL: nhật ký thay đổi hệ thống.
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'reports.AuditLog', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE [reports].[AuditLog]
    (
        [Id] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_AuditLog_Id] DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
        [UserId] UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
        [Action] NVARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
        [CreatedAt] DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_AuditLog_CreatedAt] DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        CONSTRAINT [PK_AuditLog] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
        CONSTRAINT [FK_AuditLog_Users] FOREIGN KEY ([UserId])
            REFERENCES [core].[Users] ([UserId])
    );
END;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE [name] = N'IX_AuditLog_CreatedAt' AND [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'reports.AuditLog'))
    CREATE INDEX [IX_AuditLog_CreatedAt] ON [reports].[AuditLog] ([CreatedAt] DESC);
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE [name] = N'IX_AuditLog_User_CreatedAt' AND [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'reports.AuditLog'))
    CREATE INDEX [IX_AuditLog_User_CreatedAt] ON [reports].[AuditLog] ([UserId], [CreatedAt] DESC);
GO

-- View chi tiết audit log, giữ được cả log không gắn với tài khoản.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reports].[vw_AuditLogDetails]
AS
    SELECT
        log.[Id],
        log.[UserId],
        users.[FullName] AS [UserFullName],
        users.[Email] AS [UserEmail],
        log.[Action],
        log.[CreatedAt]
    FROM [reports].[AuditLog] AS log
    LEFT JOIN [core].[Users] AS users ON users.[UserId] = log.[UserId];
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reports].[vw_FamilyActivitySummary]
AS
    SELECT
        family.[Id] AS [FamilyId],
        family.[Name] AS [FamilyName],
        (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [genealogy].[Members] AS member
         WHERE member.[FamilyId] = family.[Id]) AS [MemberCount],
        (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [community].[Posts] AS post
         WHERE post.[FamilyId] = family.[Id]) AS [PostCount],
        (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM [community].[Events] AS event
         WHERE event.[FamilyId] = family.[Id]) AS [EventCount]
    FROM [core].[Families] AS family;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE [reports].[usp_GetFamilyActivitySummary]
    @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT [FamilyId], [FamilyName], [MemberCount], [PostCount], [EventCount]
    FROM [reports].[vw_FamilyActivitySummary]
    WHERE @FamilyId IS NULL OR [FamilyId] = @FamilyId
    ORDER BY [FamilyName];
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   database/schema/06_heritage.sql
   Người 4 — Di sản: tài liệu, câu chuyện và ảnh gia đình
   =====================================================================
   Thứ tự chạy: 00_schemas → 01_core → 02_genealogy → 03_community_events
                → 04_reports_ops → 05_late_foreign_keys → 06_heritage → seed

   Bảng heritage.Items theo ERD tại docs/erd/README.md:
     - Type nhận 'document' (tài liệu), 'story' (câu chuyện), 'photo' (ảnh)
     - Content giữ nội dung văn bản
     - MediaUrl giữ đường dẫn tệp ảnh hoặc tài liệu

   Chạy bằng database/init.sh (sqlcmd truyền sẵn biến DB_NAME).
   Nếu chạy trong SSMS: bật SQLCMD Mode (menu Query → SQLCMD Mode) và
   thêm dòng  :setvar DB_NAME "FamilyConnect"  ở đầu file.

   Script viết theo hướng chạy lại được nhiều lần: đã có bảng thì bỏ qua,
   không xóa dữ liệu sẵn có.
   ===================================================================== */

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   2. Bảng heritage.Items
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

IF OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.Items', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE heritage.Items
    (
        Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_Heritage_Items_Id DEFAULT NEWID()
            CONSTRAINT PK_Heritage_Items PRIMARY KEY,

        FamilyId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
        CreatedByUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,

        Type            NVARCHAR(20)     NOT NULL,
        Title           NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
        Description     NVARCHAR(500)    NULL,
        Content         NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
        MediaUrl        NVARCHAR(500)    NULL,

        CreatedAt       DATETIME2(3)     NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT DF_Heritage_Items_CreatedAt DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),

        /* Tư liệu thuộc về một gia đình và do một tài khoản đóng góp.
           Để mặc định NO ACTION: xóa gia đình hoặc tài khoản sẽ bị chặn
           nếu còn tư liệu, tránh mất dữ liệu di sản ngoài ý muốn. */
        CONSTRAINT FK_Heritage_Items_Family
            FOREIGN KEY (FamilyId)        REFERENCES core.Families (Id),
        CONSTRAINT FK_Heritage_Items_CreatedByUser
            FOREIGN KEY (CreatedByUserId) REFERENCES core.Users (UserId),

        CONSTRAINT CK_Heritage_Items_Type
            CHECK (Type IN (N'document', N'story', N'photo')),

        CONSTRAINT CK_Heritage_Items_Title
            CHECK (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(Title))) > 0),

        /* Ràng buộc nghiệp vụ do Người 4 đề xuất, không có trong ERD.
           Mỗi loại phải có phần nội dung tương ứng, tránh tạo bản ghi rỗng:
             photo    bắt buộc có MediaUrl
             story    bắt buộc có Content
             document phải có ít nhất một trong hai
           Nhóm trưởng có thể bỏ ràng buộc này nếu thấy quá chặt. */
        CONSTRAINT CK_Heritage_Items_Payload CHECK
        (
            (Type = N'photo'    AND MediaUrl IS NOT NULL)
         OR (Type = N'story'    AND Content  IS NOT NULL)
         OR (Type = N'document' AND (Content IS NOT NULL OR MediaUrl IS NOT NULL))
        )
    );
END
GO


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   3. Chỉ mục
   Truy vấn thường gặp ở trang di sản: lọc theo gia đình, lọc thêm theo
   loại, và sắp xếp mới nhất trước.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
               WHERE name = N'IX_Heritage_Items_Family_CreatedAt'
                 AND object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.Items'))
    CREATE INDEX IX_Heritage_Items_Family_CreatedAt
        ON heritage.Items (FamilyId, CreatedAt DESC)
        INCLUDE (Type, Title);
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
               WHERE name = N'IX_Heritage_Items_Family_Type'
                 AND object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.Items'))
    CREATE INDEX IX_Heritage_Items_Family_Type
        ON heritage.Items (FamilyId, Type);
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
               WHERE name = N'IX_Heritage_Items_CreatedByUser'
                 AND object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.Items'))
    CREATE INDEX IX_Heritage_Items_CreatedByUser
        ON heritage.Items (CreatedByUserId);
GO


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   4. Mô tả cột để người khác đọc schema hiểu ngay
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.extended_properties
               WHERE major_id = OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.Items')
                 AND minor_id = 0 AND name = N'MS_Description')
    EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty
        @name = N'MS_Description',
        @value = N'Tài liệu, câu chuyện và ảnh gia đình của một gia đình.',
        @level0type = N'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'heritage',
        @level1type = N'TABLE',  @level1name = N'Items';
GO

PRINT N'06_heritage.sql: hoan tat bang heritage.Items.';
GO

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   2. Bảng heritage.KnowledgeChunks
   Lưu các đoạn văn bản đã cắt nhỏ (Chunk) từ Bài viết (community.Posts),
   Di sản (heritage.Items) hoặc Hồ sơ thành viên (genealogy.Members),
   kèm bản tóm tắt (SummaryText) và dãy số Vector dạng JSON.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.KnowledgeChunks', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks]
    (
        [Id]            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_KnowledgeChunks_Id] DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
        [FamilyId]      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
        [SourceType]    NVARCHAR(20)     NOT NULL, -- 'post', 'heritage', 'member'
        [SourceId]      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, -- Id của bản ghi gốc
        [ChunkIndex]    INT              NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_KnowledgeChunks_ChunkIndex] DEFAULT (0),
        [ChunkText]     NVARCHAR(2000)   NOT NULL,
        [SummaryText]   NVARCHAR(1000)   NULL,     -- Phục vụ AI content summarization
        [EmbeddingJson] NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,     -- Chuỗi JSON mảng số thực "[0.12, -0.34, ...]"
        [SyncStatus]    NVARCHAR(20)     NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_KnowledgeChunks_SyncStatus] DEFAULT N'pending',
        [UpdatedAt]     DATETIME2(0)     NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_KnowledgeChunks_UpdatedAt] DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),
        [CreatedAt]     DATETIME2(0)     NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_KnowledgeChunks_CreatedAt] DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),

        CONSTRAINT [PK_KnowledgeChunks] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([Id]),
        CONSTRAINT [FK_KnowledgeChunks_Families]
            FOREIGN KEY ([FamilyId]) REFERENCES [core].[Families] ([Id]),
        CONSTRAINT [UQ_KnowledgeChunks_Source_ChunkIndex]
            UNIQUE ([SourceType], [SourceId], [ChunkIndex]),

        CONSTRAINT [CK_KnowledgeChunks_SourceType]
            CHECK ([SourceType] IN (N'post', N'heritage', N'member')),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_KnowledgeChunks_ChunkIndex]
            CHECK ([ChunkIndex] >= 0),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_KnowledgeChunks_ChunkText]
            CHECK (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM([ChunkText]))) > 0),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_KnowledgeChunks_SyncStatus]
            CHECK ([SyncStatus] IN (N'pending', N'synced', N'failed')),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_KnowledgeChunks_EmbeddingIsJson]
            CHECK ([EmbeddingJson] IS NULL OR ISJSON([EmbeddingJson]) = 1),
        -- Đảm bảo bản ghi đã đánh dấu 'synced' bắt buộc phải có dữ liệu Vector
        CONSTRAINT [CK_KnowledgeChunks_SyncedMustHaveVector]
            CHECK (
                ([SyncStatus] = N'synced' AND [EmbeddingJson] IS NOT NULL)
                OR ([SyncStatus] IN (N'pending', N'failed'))
            )
    );
END;
GO

/* Bổ sung tương thích nếu bảng đã được tạo từ phiên bản trước */
IF COL_LENGTH(N'heritage.KnowledgeChunks', N'SummaryText') IS NULL
BEGIN
    ALTER TABLE [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks]
        ADD [SummaryText] NVARCHAR(1000) NULL;

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.CK_KnowledgeChunks_SourceType', N'C') IS NOT NULL
        ALTER TABLE [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] DROP CONSTRAINT [CK_KnowledgeChunks_SourceType];

    ALTER TABLE [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks]
        ADD CONSTRAINT [CK_KnowledgeChunks_SourceType]
            CHECK ([SourceType] IN (N'post', N'heritage', N'member'));
END;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
    WHERE [name] = N'IX_KnowledgeChunks_Family_SyncStatus'
      AND [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.KnowledgeChunks')
)
    CREATE INDEX [IX_KnowledgeChunks_Family_SyncStatus]
        ON [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] ([FamilyId], [SyncStatus]);
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
    WHERE [name] = N'IX_KnowledgeChunks_Source'
      AND [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.KnowledgeChunks')
)
    CREATE INDEX [IX_KnowledgeChunks_Source]
        ON [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] ([SourceType], [SourceId]);
GO


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   3. Bảng reports.AiChatMessages
   Lưu lịch sử câu hỏi của thành viên và câu trả lời của Trợ lý ảo AI,
   kèm danh sách nguồn trích dẫn (ReferencedSourceIds dạng JSON).
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
IF OBJECT_ID(N'reports.AiChatMessages', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE [reports].[AiChatMessages]
    (
        [Id]                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_AiChatMessages_Id] DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
        [FamilyId]            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
        [UserId]              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
        [QueryType]           NVARCHAR(30)     NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_AiChatMessages_QueryType] DEFAULT N'semantic_search',
        [Question]            NVARCHAR(2000)   NOT NULL,
        [Answer]              NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
        [ReferencedSourceIds] NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
        [CreatedAt]           DATETIME2(0)     NOT NULL
            CONSTRAINT [DF_AiChatMessages_CreatedAt] DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),

        CONSTRAINT [PK_AiChatMessages] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([Id]),
        CONSTRAINT [FK_AiChatMessages_Families]
            FOREIGN KEY ([FamilyId]) REFERENCES [core].[Families] ([Id]),
        CONSTRAINT [FK_AiChatMessages_Users]
            FOREIGN KEY ([UserId]) REFERENCES [core].[Users] ([UserId]),

        CONSTRAINT [CK_AiChatMessages_QueryType]
            CHECK ([QueryType] IN (N'semantic_search', N'kinship_explain', N'summarization', N'recommendation', N'general')),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_AiChatMessages_Question]
            CHECK (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM([Question]))) > 0),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_AiChatMessages_Answer]
            CHECK (LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM([Answer]))) > 0),
        CONSTRAINT [CK_AiChatMessages_RefsIsJson]
            CHECK ([ReferencedSourceIds] IS NULL OR ISJSON([ReferencedSourceIds]) = 1)
    );
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints
        WHERE [name] = N'CK_AiChatMessages_QueryType'
          AND [parent_object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'reports.AiChatMessages')
          AND [definition] NOT LIKE N'%summarization%'
    )
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE [reports].[AiChatMessages] DROP CONSTRAINT [CK_AiChatMessages_QueryType];
        ALTER TABLE [reports].[AiChatMessages]
            ADD CONSTRAINT [CK_AiChatMessages_QueryType]
                CHECK ([QueryType] IN (N'semantic_search', N'kinship_explain', N'summarization', N'recommendation', N'general'));
    END;
END;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
    WHERE [name] = N'IX_AiChatMessages_User_CreatedAt'
      AND [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'reports.AiChatMessages')
)
    CREATE INDEX [IX_AiChatMessages_User_CreatedAt]
        ON [reports].[AiChatMessages] ([UserId], [CreatedAt] DESC);
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
    WHERE [name] = N'IX_AiChatMessages_Family_CreatedAt'
      AND [object_id] = OBJECT_ID(N'reports.AiChatMessages')
)
    CREATE INDEX [IX_AiChatMessages_Family_CreatedAt]
        ON [reports].[AiChatMessages] ([FamilyId], [CreatedAt] DESC);
GO

PRINT N'07_ai_assistant.sql: Hoàn tất tạo/cập nhật bảng heritage.KnowledgeChunks và reports.AiChatMessages.';
GO

# FILE: database/schema/07_migrate_member_occupation.sql
################################################################################
-- Chuyển Occupation cũ sang WorkHistories trước khi bỏ cột.
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
GO

-- Chạy phần tham chiếu Occupation động để schema mới không lỗi biên dịch.
IF COL_LENGTH(N'genealogy.Members', N'Occupation') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    EXEC sys.sp_executesql N'
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;

        INSERT INTO genealogy.WorkHistories
            (Id, MemberId, Company, Position, StartDate, EndDate, CreatedAt)
        SELECT
            NEWID(), [Id], N''Chưa cập nhật'', LTRIM(RTRIM([Occupation])),
            NULL, NULL, SYSUTCDATETIME()
        FROM genealogy.Members
        WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM([Occupation])), N'''') IS NOT NULL;

        ALTER TABLE genealogy.Members DROP COLUMN [Occupation];

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    ';
END;
GO

    ALTER TABLE community.EventReminders ADD UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL CONSTRAINT FK_EventReminders_User REFERENCES core.Users(UserId);
GO

    ALTER TABLE community.EventReminders DROP CONSTRAINT CK_EventReminders_Status;
ALTER TABLE community.EventReminders ADD CONSTRAINT CK_EventReminders_Status CHECK(Status IN ('pending','sent','failed','cancelled'));
GO
IF OBJECT_ID('community.Notifications','U') IS NULL
CREATE TABLE community.Notifications (
    Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_Notifications_Id DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID() PRIMARY KEY,
    UserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL REFERENCES core.Users(UserId),
    FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL REFERENCES core.Families(Id),
    EventId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    ReminderId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Title NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    Body NVARCHAR(600) NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt DATETIME2(0) NOT NULL DEFAULT SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    ReadAt DATETIME2(0) NULL,
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Notifications_Reminder_User UNIQUE(ReminderId,UserId)
);
GO

    CREATE INDEX IX_Notifications_User ON community.Notifications(UserId,CreatedAt DESC);
GO

################################################################################
# FILE: database/seed/01_seed.sql
################################################################################
/* =====================================================================
   database/seed/01_seed.sql
   Người 4 — Dữ liệu mẫu cho toàn bộ 22 bảng
   =====================================================================
   Chạy SAU CÙNG, khi cả 8 file trong database/schema/ đã hoàn tất.

   Nguyên tắc theo database/seed/README.md:
     - Không có thông tin cá nhân thật. Email dùng miền example.invalid
       là miền dành riêng cho ví dụ, không gửi thư tới đâu được.
     - Không có mật khẩu dạng rõ. Cột PasswordHash điền chuỗi đánh dấu
       rõ ràng là giả, không phải hash dùng được để đăng nhập.

   Script chạy lại được nhiều lần: xóa đúng các bản ghi mẫu theo GUID cố
   định rồi chèn lại, không đụng tới dữ liệu do người khác tạo.

   Quy ước GUID để dễ đọc khi tra cứu:
     11111111  Users              22222222  Families
     33333333  Branches           44444444  Members
     55555555  ParentChild        66666666  Marriages
     77777777  Posts              88888888  Comments
     99999999  Reactions          AAAAAAAA  Events
     BBBBBBBB  EventParticipants  CCCCCCCC  AuditLog
     DDDDDDDD  MemberVerifications EEEEEEEE Heritage Items

   Nếu chạy trong SSMS: bật SQLCMD Mode và thêm
   :setvar DB_NAME "FamilyConnect"  ở đầu file.
   ===================================================================== */

USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

SET XACT_ABORT ON;
SET NOCOUNT ON;
GO

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   1. Kiểm tra đủ 22 bảng trước khi chèn
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

DECLARE @missing NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';

IF OBJECT_ID(N'core.Users',                N'U') IS NULL SET @missing += N'core.Users, ';
IF OBJECT_ID(N'core.Families',             N'U') IS NULL SET @missing += N'core.Families, ';
IF OBJECT_ID(N'core.Branches',             N'U') IS NULL SET @missing += N'core.Branches, ';
IF OBJECT_ID(N'core.MemberVerifications',  N'U') IS NULL SET @missing += N'core.MemberVerifications, ';
IF OBJECT_ID(N'genealogy.Members',         N'U') IS NULL SET @missing += N'genealogy.Members, ';
IF OBJECT_ID(N'genealogy.ParentChild',     N'U') IS NULL SET @missing += N'genealogy.ParentChild, ';
IF OBJECT_ID(N'genealogy.Marriages',       N'U') IS NULL SET @missing += N'genealogy.Marriages, ';

    BEGIN
        ;WITH SeedTree AS
        (
            SELECT m.[Id] AS AncestorId, m.[Id] AS DescendantId, 0 AS Depth
            FROM [genealogy].[Members] m
            WHERE CAST(m.[Id] AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '44444444-%'
            UNION ALL
            SELECT t.AncestorId, pc.[ChildId], t.Depth + 1
            FROM SeedTree t
            INNER JOIN [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc ON pc.[ParentId] = t.DescendantId
        )
        INSERT INTO [genealogy].[MemberClosure] ([AncestorId], [DescendantId], [Depth])
        SELECT AncestorId, DescendantId, MIN(Depth)
        FROM SeedTree
        GROUP BY AncestorId, DescendantId;
    END;

         DATEADD(DAY, 18, @t0));

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    PRINT N'01_seed.sql: da chen xong du lieu mau.';
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF XACT_STATE() <> 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    PRINT N'01_seed.sql: loi, da rollback toan bo.';
    THROW;
END CATCH
GO


/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   14. Đối chiếu số dòng sau khi seed
   Dùng khi nghiệm thu và khi chụp ảnh minh chứng.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */

SELECT N'core.Users'                AS BangDuLieu, COUNT(*) AS SoDong FROM core.Users               WHERE CAST(UserId AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '11111111-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'core.Families',                 COUNT(*) FROM core.Families                      WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '22222222-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'core.Branches',                 COUNT(*) FROM core.Branches                      WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '33333333-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'core.MemberVerifications',      COUNT(*) FROM core.MemberVerifications           WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE 'DDDDDDDD-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'genealogy.Members',             COUNT(*) FROM genealogy.Members                  WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '44444444-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'genealogy.Educations',          COUNT(*) FROM genealogy.Educations               WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '45555555-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'genealogy.WorkHistories',       COUNT(*) FROM genealogy.WorkHistories            WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '46666666-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'genealogy.ParentChild',         COUNT(*) FROM genealogy.ParentChild              WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '55555555-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'genealogy.Marriages',           COUNT(*) FROM genealogy.Marriages                WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '66666666-%'
UNION ALL SELECT N'community.Posts',               COUNT(*) FROM community.Posts                    WHERE CAST(Id AS CHAR(36)) LIKE '77777777-%'

USE FamilyConnect;
GO

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @Accounts TABLE (
    UserName SYSNAME PRIMARY KEY,
    RoleName SYSNAME
);

INSERT INTO @Accounts (UserName, RoleName)
VALUES
    (N'dev_core',      N'role_dev_core'),
    (N'dev_genealogy', N'role_dev_genealogy'),
    (N'dev_community', N'role_dev_community'),
    (N'dev_heritage',  N'role_dev_heritage'),
    (N'dev_reports',   N'role_dev_reports'),
    (N'dev_seed',      N'role_seed'),
    (N'app_backend',   N'role_backend');

DECLARE @UserName SYSNAME;
DECLARE @RoleName SYSNAME;
DECLARE @Sql NVARCHAR(MAX);

WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @Accounts)
BEGIN
    SELECT TOP (1)
        @UserName = UserName,
        @RoleName = RoleName
    FROM @Accounts
    ORDER BY UserName;

    -- Tạo role nếu chưa có.
    IF DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(@RoleName) IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @Sql = N'CREATE ROLE ' + QUOTENAME(@RoleName)
                 + N' AUTHORIZATION [dbo];';
        EXEC sys.sp_executesql @Sql;
    END;

    -- Tạo database user tương ứng với server login.
    IF DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(@UserName) IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SET @Sql = N'CREATE USER ' + QUOTENAME(@UserName)
                 + N' FOR LOGIN ' + QUOTENAME(@UserName) + N';';
        EXEC sys.sp_executesql @Sql;
    END;

    -- Thêm user vào role nếu chưa là thành viên.
    IF IS_ROLEMEMBER(@RoleName, @UserName) = 0
    BEGIN
        SET @Sql = N'ALTER ROLE ' + QUOTENAME(@RoleName)
                 + N' ADD MEMBER ' + QUOTENAME(@UserName) + N';';
        EXEC sys.sp_executesql @Sql;
    END;

    PRINT N'Da gan: ' + @UserName + N' -> ' + @RoleName;

    DELETE FROM @Accounts WHERE UserName = @UserName;
END;

-- Kiểm tra kết quả.
SELECT
    member.name AS UserName,
    role.name AS RoleName
FROM sys.database_role_members AS membership
JOIN sys.database_principals AS role
    ON role.principal_id = membership.role_principal_id
JOIN sys.database_principals AS member
    ON member.principal_id = membership.member_principal_id
WHERE member.name IN (
    N'dev_core', N'dev_genealogy', N'dev_community',
    N'dev_heritage', N'dev_reports', N'dev_seed',
    N'app_backend'
)
ORDER BY member.name;
GO

USE FamilyConnect;
GO

SET NOCOUNT ON;

-- 1. Các role phát triển được quản lý đối tượng trong schema được giao.
DECLARE @DevScopes TABLE (
    RoleName SYSNAME,
    SchemaName SYSNAME
);

INSERT INTO @DevScopes
VALUES
    (N'role_dev_core',      N'core'),
    (N'role_dev_genealogy', N'genealogy'),
    (N'role_dev_community', N'community'),
    (N'role_dev_heritage',  N'heritage'),
    (N'role_dev_reports',   N'reports'),
    (N'role_dev_reports',   N'heritage'); -- Phần AI của TV5.

DECLARE @RoleName SYSNAME;
DECLARE @SchemaName SYSNAME;
DECLARE @Sql NVARCHAR(MAX);

WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @DevScopes)
BEGIN
    SELECT TOP (1)
        @RoleName = RoleName,
        @SchemaName = SchemaName
    FROM @DevScopes
    ORDER BY RoleName, SchemaName;

    SET @Sql =
        N'GRANT CREATE TABLE, CREATE VIEW, CREATE PROCEDURE, '
        + N'CREATE FUNCTION TO ' + QUOTENAME(@RoleName) + N';'
        + N'GRANT ALTER, SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, '
        + N'REFERENCES, EXECUTE, VIEW DEFINITION ON SCHEMA::'
        + QUOTENAME(@SchemaName)
        + N' TO ' + QUOTENAME(@RoleName) + N';';

    EXEC sys.sp_executesql @Sql;

    DELETE FROM @DevScopes
    WHERE RoleName = @RoleName AND SchemaName = @SchemaName;
END;

-- 2. Quyền tham chiếu cho khóa ngoại giữa các schema.
GRANT REFERENCES ON SCHEMA::genealogy TO role_dev_core;

GRANT REFERENCES ON SCHEMA::core TO role_dev_genealogy;

GRANT REFERENCES ON SCHEMA::core TO role_dev_community;
GRANT REFERENCES ON SCHEMA::genealogy TO role_dev_community;

GRANT REFERENCES ON SCHEMA::core TO role_dev_heritage;
GRANT REFERENCES ON SCHEMA::genealogy TO role_dev_heritage;

GRANT REFERENCES ON SCHEMA::core TO role_dev_reports;
GRANT REFERENCES ON SCHEMA::genealogy TO role_dev_reports;

-- 3. Backend đọc dữ liệu, gọi SP/function.
--    Seed được thao tác dữ liệu, không được sửa cấu trúc.
DECLARE @Schemas TABLE (SchemaName SYSNAME PRIMARY KEY);

INSERT INTO @Schemas
VALUES
    (N'core'), (N'genealogy'), (N'community'),
    (N'reports'), (N'heritage');

WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @Schemas)
BEGIN
    SELECT TOP (1) @SchemaName = SchemaName FROM @Schemas;

    SET @Sql =
        N'GRANT SELECT, EXECUTE ON SCHEMA::'
        + QUOTENAME(@SchemaName) + N' TO [role_backend];'
        + N'GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON SCHEMA::'
        + QUOTENAME(@SchemaName) + N' TO [role_seed];';

    EXEC sys.sp_executesql @Sql;

    DELETE FROM @Schemas WHERE SchemaName = @SchemaName;
END;

-- API đăng ký hiện thêm tài khoản trực tiếp bằng SQLAlchemy.
GRANT INSERT ON OBJECT::core.Users TO role_backend;

-- 4. Cho phép đọc/thêm audit, chặn sửa/xóa trực tiếp.
DECLARE @AuditRoles TABLE (RoleName SYSNAME PRIMARY KEY);

INSERT INTO @AuditRoles
VALUES
    (N'role_dev_core'),
    (N'role_dev_genealogy'),
    (N'role_dev_community'),
    (N'role_dev_heritage'),
    (N'role_dev_reports'),
    (N'role_seed'),
    (N'role_backend');

WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @AuditRoles)
BEGIN
    SELECT TOP (1) @RoleName = RoleName FROM @AuditRoles;

    SET @Sql =
        N'GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON OBJECT::reports.AuditLog TO '
        + QUOTENAME(@RoleName) + N';'
        + N'DENY UPDATE, DELETE ON OBJECT::reports.AuditLog TO '
        + QUOTENAME(@RoleName) + N';';

    EXEC sys.sp_executesql @Sql;

    DELETE FROM @AuditRoles WHERE RoleName = @RoleName;
END;

PRINT N'Da cap quyen cho cac role.';
GO

-- TV1: audit thay doi quyen/trang thai tai khoan va thoi diem sua cau hinh.
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [core].[trg_Users_AuditRoleAndStatus]
ON [core].[Users]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF NOT (UPDATE([Role]) OR UPDATE([IsActive]))
        RETURN;

    -- API quan tri co the dat SESSION_CONTEXT('actor_user_id') tu JWT da xac thuc.
    -- Neu thao tac SQL truc tiep khong co actor, UserId cua audit la NULL;
    -- Action van luu target va SQL login. Khong gan nham target thanh actor.
    DECLARE @ActorValue SQL_VARIANT = SESSION_CONTEXT(N'actor_user_id');
    DECLARE @ActorUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = TRY_CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @ActorValue);

    IF @ActorValue IS NOT NULL AND
       (@ActorUserId IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM [core].[Users] WHERE [UserId] = @ActorUserId))
        THROW 51021, N'actor_user_id trong SESSION_CONTEXT khong hop le.', 1;

    -- INSERT ... SELECT xu ly dung ca UPDATE nhieu tai khoan trong mot lenh.
    INSERT INTO [reports].[AuditLog] ([UserId], [Action])
    SELECT
        @ActorUserId,
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR(300), CONCAT(
            N'users.role_status_changed; target=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), current_user_row.[UserId]),
            N'; role=', previous_user_row.[Role], N'->', current_user_row.[Role],
            N'; active=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1), previous_user_row.[IsActive]),
            N'->', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(1), current_user_row.[IsActive]),
            N'; sql_login=', LEFT(ORIGINAL_LOGIN(), 64)))
    FROM inserted AS current_user_row
    INNER JOIN deleted AS previous_user_row
        ON previous_user_row.[UserId] = current_user_row.[UserId]
    WHERE current_user_row.[Role] <> previous_user_row.[Role]
       OR current_user_row.[IsActive] <> previous_user_row.[IsActive];
END;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [core].[trg_SystemConfigs_UpdatedAt]
ON [core].[SystemConfigs]
AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Hoat dong ca khi RECURSIVE_TRIGGERS bat; bo qua lan tu goi de cap nhat timestamp.
    IF TRIGGER_NESTLEVEL(OBJECT_ID(N'core.trg_SystemConfigs_UpdatedAt')) > 1
        RETURN;

    DECLARE @UpdatedAt DATETIME2(0) = SYSUTCDATETIME();

    UPDATE config
    SET config.[UpdatedAt] = @UpdatedAt
    FROM [core].[SystemConfigs] AS config
    INNER JOIN inserted AS changed
        ON changed.[ConfigKey] = config.[ConfigKey];
END;
GO

USE [$(DB_NAME)];

-- Chặn chu trình huyết thống và giới hạn tối đa 2 cha/mẹ cho mỗi người con.
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [genealogy].[trg_ParentChild_PreventCycle]
ON [genealogy].[ParentChild]
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Với UPDATE, chỉ kiểm tra khi đổi ParentId hoặc ChildId
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
        RETURN;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted) AND NOT (UPDATE([ParentId]) OR UPDATE([ChildId]))
        RETURN;

    -- 1. Mỗi người con tối đa 2 cha/mẹ
    IF EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc
        WHERE pc.[ChildId] IN (SELECT [ChildId] FROM inserted)
        GROUP BY pc.[ChildId]
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
    )
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW 50001, N'Một thành viên chỉ có tối đa 2 cha/mẹ.', 1;
    END;

    -- 2. Không cho tạo chu trình: con không được là tổ tiên của cha/mẹ.
    -- Từ mỗi người con vừa thêm, đi xuống các hậu duệ; nếu gặp lại cha/mẹ thì có chu trình.
    DECLARE @HasCycle BIT = 0;

    ;WITH Walk AS
    (
        SELECT i.[Id] AS EdgeId,
               i.[ParentId] AS TargetId,
               pc.[ChildId] AS CurrentId,
               1 AS Lvl
        FROM inserted i
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc ON pc.[ParentId] = i.[ChildId]

        UNION ALL

        SELECT w.EdgeId,
               w.TargetId,
               pc.[ChildId],
               w.Lvl + 1
        FROM Walk w
        INNER JOIN [genealogy].[ParentChild] pc ON pc.[ParentId] = w.CurrentId
        WHERE w.CurrentId <> w.TargetId
          AND w.Lvl < 100
    )
    SELECT @HasCycle = 1
    FROM Walk
    WHERE CurrentId = TargetId
    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 200);

    IF @HasCycle = 1
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW 50002, N'Quan hệ cha/mẹ - con tạo ra chu trình huyết thống (con là tổ tiên của cha/mẹ).', 1;
    END;
END;
GO

# FILE: database/triggers/03_community_triggers.sql
################################################################################
/* =====================================================================
   database/triggers/03_community_triggers.sql
   TV3 - Trigger leo thang noi dung bi bao cao
   LUU Y: init.sh hien chua chay thu muc triggers/ (chi schema, views,
   procedures, seed). Can them run_scripts cho thu muc nay, hoac chay tay.
   ===================================================================== */
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

/* Khi mot noi dung nhan du 3 bao cao dang cho xu ly (pending), ghi mot
   dong vao reports.AuditLog de quan tri vien biet can xem xet.
   Chi ghi dung luc vuot nguong, khong ghi lap lai o cac bao cao sau. */
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [community].[trg_ReportedContents_Escalation]
ON [community].[ReportedContents]
AFTER INSERT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Threshold INT = 3;

    INSERT INTO [reports].[AuditLog] ([UserId], [Action])
    SELECT
        NULL,
        LEFT(CONCAT(N'ESCALATE: ', t.[TargetType], N' ',
                    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), t.[TargetId]), N' co ',
                    c.[Total], N' bao cao dang cho xu ly'), 300)
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT [TargetId], [TargetType]
          FROM inserted
          WHERE [Status] = N'pending') AS t
    CROSS APPLY (SELECT
                    COUNT_BIG(*) AS [Total],
                    SUM(CASE WHEN new_report.[Id] IS NOT NULL
                             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [NewOnes]
                 FROM [community].[ReportedContents] AS r
                 LEFT JOIN inserted AS new_report ON new_report.[Id] = r.[Id]
                 WHERE r.[TargetId]   = t.[TargetId]
                   AND r.[TargetType] = t.[TargetType]
                   AND r.[Status]     = N'pending') AS c
    WHERE c.[Total] >= @Threshold
      AND c.[Total] - c.[NewOnes] < @Threshold;
END;
GO

# FILE: database/triggers/04_heritage_triggers.sql
################################################################################
-- T-SQL Triggers - Thanh vien 4 (heritage & family tree)
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER heritage.trg_Honors_ValidateAndAudit
ON heritage.Honors
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted) RETURN;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(Title)), N'') IS NULL)
        THROW 51422, N'Honor title must not be blank.', 1;

    DECLARE @Value SQL_VARIANT = SESSION_CONTEXT(N'actor_user_id');
    DECLARE @Actor UNIQUEIDENTIFIER = TRY_CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, @Value);
    -- Direct SQL/seed/cascade operations have a NULL actor and retain SQL login.
    -- Authenticated procedures set and restore this value; never use a request body actor.
    IF @Value IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
        IF @Actor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WHERE UserId = @Actor AND IsActive = 1 AND Role IN (N'admin', N'family_head'))
            THROW 51403, N'Invalid honor audit actor.', 1;
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.Users WHERE UserId = @Actor AND Role = N'admin')
           AND EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM (
                   SELECT MemberId FROM inserted UNION SELECT MemberId FROM deleted
               ) changed
               LEFT JOIN genealogy.Members target ON target.Id = changed.MemberId
               WHERE target.Id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM genealogy.Members actor
                   WHERE actor.UserId = @Actor AND actor.FamilyId = target.FamilyId))
            THROW 51403, N'Honor is outside actor family.', 1;
    END;

    -- Exactly one entry per changed honor, including multi-row DML. SPs do not duplicate it.
    INSERT INTO reports.AuditLog (UserId, Action)
    SELECT @Actor, CONCAT(N'heritage.honor.',
        CASE WHEN d.Id IS NULL THEN N'created' WHEN i.Id IS NULL THEN N'deleted' ELSE N'updated' END,
        N'; id=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), COALESCE(i.Id, d.Id)),
        N'; member=', CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), COALESCE(i.MemberId, d.MemberId)),
        N'; sql_login=', LEFT(ORIGINAL_LOGIN(), 64))
    FROM inserted i FULL OUTER JOIN deleted d ON d.Id = i.Id;
END;
GO

################################################################################
# FILE: database/triggers/05_ai_reports_triggers.sql
################################################################################
-- T-SQL Triggers - Thành viên 5 (AI Vector Sync & Reports)
USE [$(DB_NAME)];
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   1. Trigger: community.trg_Posts_SyncKnowledgeChunks
   Khi bài viết cộng đồng (community.Posts) bị xóa hoặc chỉnh sửa nội dung:
     - DELETE: Tự động xóa các đoạn Vector tương ứng trong heritage.KnowledgeChunks
     - UPDATE Content: Đánh dấu SyncStatus = 'pending' để Pipeline AI cắt đoạn
       và tính lại Vector mới.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [community].[trg_Posts_SyncKnowledgeChunks]
ON [community].[Posts]
AFTER UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.KnowledgeChunks', N'U') IS NULL
        RETURN;

    -- 1. Trường hợp xóa bài viết: dọn sạch các chunk của bài viết đã xóa
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    BEGIN
        DELETE kc
        FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] AS kc
        INNER JOIN deleted AS d
            ON kc.[SourceType] = N'post'
           AND kc.[SourceId] = d.[Id];
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 2. Trường hợp cập nhật nội dung bài viết: đánh dấu 'pending' để đồng bộ lại
    IF UPDATE([Content])
    BEGIN
        UPDATE kc
        SET kc.[SyncStatus] = N'pending',
            kc.[UpdatedAt]  = SYSUTCDATETIME()
        FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] AS kc
        INNER JOIN inserted AS i
            ON kc.[SourceType] = N'post'
           AND kc.[SourceId] = i.[Id]
        INNER JOIN deleted AS d
            ON d.[Id] = i.[Id]
        WHERE ISNULL(i.[Content], N'') <> ISNULL(d.[Content], N'');
    END;
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   2. Trigger: heritage.trg_Items_SyncKnowledgeChunks
   Khi tư liệu di sản (heritage.Items) bị xóa hoặc cập nhật Title/Description/Content:
     - DELETE: Tự động xóa các đoạn Vector tương ứng trong heritage.KnowledgeChunks
     - UPDATE: Đánh dấu SyncStatus = 'pending' để Pipeline AI đồng bộ lại.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [heritage].[trg_Items_SyncKnowledgeChunks]
ON [heritage].[Items]
AFTER UPDATE, DELETE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'heritage.KnowledgeChunks', N'U') IS NULL
        RETURN;

    -- 1. Trường hợp xóa tư liệu di sản: dọn sạch các chunk của tư liệu đã xóa
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted)
    BEGIN
        DELETE kc
        FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] AS kc
        INNER JOIN deleted AS d
            ON kc.[SourceType] = N'heritage'
           AND kc.[SourceId] = d.[Id];
        RETURN;
    END;

    -- 2. Trường hợp cập nhật nội dung tư liệu: đánh dấu 'pending' để đồng bộ lại
    IF UPDATE([Title]) OR UPDATE([Description]) OR UPDATE([Content])
    BEGIN
        UPDATE kc
        SET kc.[SyncStatus] = N'pending',
            kc.[UpdatedAt]  = SYSUTCDATETIME()
        FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] AS kc
        INNER JOIN inserted AS i
            ON kc.[SourceType] = N'heritage'
           AND kc.[SourceId] = i.[Id]
        INNER JOIN deleted AS d
            ON d.[Id] = i.[Id]
        WHERE ISNULL(i.[Title], N'') <> ISNULL(d.[Title], N'')
           OR ISNULL(i.[Description], N'') <> ISNULL(d.[Description], N'')
           OR ISNULL(i.[Content], N'') <> ISNULL(d.[Content], N'');
    END;
END;
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [core].[vw_PendingVerifications]
AS
    SELECT
        verification.[Id] AS [VerificationId],
        verification.[UserId],
        applicant.[FullName] AS [UserFullName],
        applicant.[Email] AS [UserEmail],
        applicant.[IsActive] AS [UserIsActive],
        verification.[MemberId],
        member.[FullName] AS [MemberFullName],
        member.[BirthDate],
        member.[FamilyId],
        family.[Name] AS [FamilyName],
        member.[BranchId],
        branch.[Name] AS [BranchName],
        member.[UserId] AS [LinkedUserId],
        verification.[Status],
        verification.[CreatedAt] AS [RequestedAt]
    FROM [core].[MemberVerifications] AS verification
    INNER JOIN [core].[Users] AS applicant
        ON applicant.[UserId] = verification.[UserId]
    INNER JOIN [genealogy].[Members] AS member
        ON member.[Id] = verification.[MemberId]
    INNER JOIN [core].[Families] AS family
        ON family.[Id] = member.[FamilyId]
    LEFT JOIN [core].[Branches] AS branch
        ON branch.[Id] = member.[BranchId]
    WHERE verification.[Status] = N'pending';
GO

-- Cac ham/view dung bang bao dong genealogy.MemberClosure
-- (AncestorId, DescendantId, Depth; Depth = 0 la chinh no, 1 la cha/me - con, ...)

-- =====================================================================
-- 1. fn_GetAncestors: tat ca to tien cua @MemberId
--    GenerationsUp = 1 la cha/me, 2 la ong ba, 3 la cu, ...
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION genealogy.fn_GetAncestors
(
    @MemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT
        m.[Id]        AS MemberId,
        m.[FullName],
        m.[BirthDate],
        m.[Location],
        m.[FamilyId],
        m.[BranchId],
        c.[Depth]     AS GenerationsUp
    FROM genealogy.MemberClosure AS c
    INNER JOIN genealogy.Members AS m
        ON m.[Id] = c.[AncestorId]
    WHERE c.[DescendantId] = @MemberId
      AND c.[Depth] > 0
);
GO

-- =====================================================================
-- 2. fn_GetDescendants: hau due cua @MemberId toi da @MaxDepth doi
--    @MaxDepth NULL = khong gioi han
--    GenerationsDown = 1 la con, 2 la chau, 3 la chat, ...
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION genealogy.fn_GetDescendants
(
    @MemberId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @MaxDepth INT
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT
        m.[Id]        AS MemberId,
        m.[FullName],
        m.[BirthDate],
        m.[Location],
        m.[FamilyId],
        m.[BranchId],
        c.[Depth]     AS GenerationsDown
    FROM genealogy.MemberClosure AS c
    INNER JOIN genealogy.Members AS m
        ON m.[Id] = c.[DescendantId]
    WHERE c.[AncestorId] = @MemberId
      AND c.[Depth] > 0
      AND (@MaxDepth IS NULL OR c.[Depth] <= @MaxDepth)
);
GO

-- =====================================================================
-- 3. vw_MemberDirectoryProfile: ho so thanh vien + hoc van + cong viec + so doi
--    Depth = so doi cua thanh vien trong gia pha:
--            1 = doi dau (khong co cha/me trong he thong), 2 = con, 3 = chau, ...
--    (lay chuoi to tien dai nhat tu MemberClosure)
-- =====================================================================
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW genealogy.vw_MemberDirectoryProfile
AS
SELECT
    m.[Id]          AS MemberId,
    m.[FamilyId],
    m.[BranchId],
    m.[UserId],
    m.[FullName],
    m.[BirthDate],
    m.[Location],
    m.[CreatedAt],
    anc.[Depth]     AS Depth,
    edu.[EducationCount],
    edu.[Educations],
    wk.[WorkHistoryCount],
    wk.[WorkHistories]
FROM genealogy.Members AS m
OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(c.[Depth]), 0) + 1 AS Depth
    FROM genealogy.MemberClosure AS c
    WHERE c.[DescendantId] = m.[Id]
) AS anc
OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS EducationCount,
        STRING_AGG(
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),
                e.[Institution]
                + ISNULL(N' - ' + e.[Degree], N'')
                + CASE
                    WHEN e.[StartDate] IS NULL AND e.[EndDate] IS NULL THEN N''
                    ELSE N' (' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), YEAR(e.[StartDate])), N'?')
                         + N'-' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), YEAR(e.[EndDate])), N'nay') + N')'
                  END),
            N'; ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.[StartDate]) AS Educations
    FROM genealogy.Educations AS e
    WHERE e.[MemberId] = m.[Id]
) AS edu
OUTER APPLY
(
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS WorkHistoryCount,
        STRING_AGG(
            CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX),
                w.[Position] + N' @ ' + w.[Company]
                + CASE
                    WHEN w.[StartDate] IS NULL AND w.[EndDate] IS NULL THEN N''
                    ELSE N' (' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), YEAR(w.[StartDate])), N'?')
                         + N'-' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), YEAR(w.[EndDate])), N'nay') + N')'
                  END),
            N'; ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY w.[StartDate]) AS WorkHistories
    FROM genealogy.WorkHistories AS w
    WHERE w.[MemberId] = m.[Id]
) AS wk;
GO

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   1. vw_NewsfeedPosts
   Moi dong la mot bai viet kem tac gia, so binh luan, so cam xuc va
   danh sach anh (cac MediaUrl noi bang dau phay, theo thu tu tai len).
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [community].[vw_NewsfeedPosts]
AS
    SELECT
        p.[Id]        AS [PostId],
        p.[FamilyId],
        p.[UserId]    AS [AuthorId],
        u.[FullName]  AS [AuthorName],
        p.[Content],
        p.[CreatedAt],
        ISNULL(c.[CommentCount],  0) AS [CommentCount],
        ISNULL(r.[ReactionCount], 0) AS [ReactionCount],
        m.[MediaUrls]
    FROM [community].[Posts] AS p
    LEFT JOIN [core].[Users] AS u
        ON u.[UserId] = p.[UserId]
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS [CommentCount]
                 FROM [community].[Comments] AS cm
                 WHERE cm.[PostId] = p.[Id]) AS c
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS [ReactionCount]
                 FROM [community].[Reactions] AS rc
                 WHERE rc.[PostId] = p.[Id]) AS r
    OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(pm.[MediaUrl] AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), N',')
                          WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pm.[CreatedAt]) AS [MediaUrls]
                 FROM [community].[PostMedia] AS pm
                 WHERE pm.[PostId] = p.[Id]) AS m;
GO

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   2. fn_GetMonthlyEvents(@FamilyId, @Year, @Month)
   Tra ve cac su kien trong thang cua mot gia dinh, kem so nguoi
   da tra loi "Going". Dung de ve lich thang tren mobile.
   Vi du: SELECT * FROM community.fn_GetMonthlyEvents(@FamilyId, 2026, 11);
   --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [community].[fn_GetMonthlyEvents]
(
    @FamilyId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @Year     INT,
    @Month    INT
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT
        e.[Id]        AS [EventId],
        e.[FamilyId],
        e.[Title],
        e.[EventDate],
        e.[Location],
        (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*)
         FROM [community].[EventParticipants] AS ep
         WHERE ep.[EventId] = e.[Id]
           AND ep.[RsvpStatus] = N'Going') AS [GoingCount]
    FROM [community].[Events] AS e
    WHERE e.[FamilyId] = @FamilyId
      AND @Month BETWEEN 1 AND 12
      AND e.[EventDate] >= DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1)
      AND e.[EventDate] <  DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEFROMPARTS(@Year, @Month, 1))
);
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON;
GO
-- Include zero-honor members. Ties share DENSE_RANK, independently per family.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW heritage.vw_MemberHonorsRanking
AS
    SELECT m.FamilyId, m.Id AS MemberId, m.FullName,
           COUNT_BIG(h.Id) AS HonorCount,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.FamilyId ORDER BY COUNT_BIG(h.Id) DESC) AS Rank
    FROM genealogy.Members m
    LEFT JOIN heritage.Honors h ON h.MemberId = m.Id
    GROUP BY m.FamilyId, m.Id, m.FullName;
GO
-- Content fingerprints provide optimistic concurrency without altering existing tables.
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW heritage.vw_HeritageItems
AS
    SELECT i.*,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES('SHA2_256',
            (SELECT i.Id, i.FamilyId, i.CreatedByUserId, i.Type, i.Title,
                    i.Description, i.Content, i.MediaUrl, i.CreatedAt
             FOR JSON PATH, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)), 2) AS VersionToken
    FROM heritage.Items i;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW heritage.vw_Honors
AS
    SELECT h.*, m.FamilyId, m.FullName,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(64), HASHBYTES('SHA2_256',
            (SELECT h.Id, h.MemberId, h.Title, h.Description, h.DateAwarded, h.CreatedAt
             FOR JSON PATH, INCLUDE_NULL_VALUES, WITHOUT_ARRAY_WRAPPER)), 2) AS VersionToken
    FROM heritage.Honors h
    INNER JOIN genealogy.Members m ON m.Id = h.MemberId;
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON;

/* =====================================================================
   1. Function: heritage.fn_CosineSimilarity
   Tính độ tương đồng Cosine giữa 2 mảng Vector lưu ở dạng chuỗi JSON
   (ví dụ: '[0.12, -0.34, 0.56]') bằng hàm chuẩn OPENJSON.
   Giá trị trả về nằm trong khoảng [-1.0, 1.0] (1.0 là giống hệt nhau).
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [heritage].[fn_CosineSimilarity]
(
    @VecAJson NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @VecBJson NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
RETURNS FLOAT
AS
BEGIN
    IF @VecAJson IS NULL OR @VecBJson IS NULL
       OR ISJSON(@VecAJson) <> 1 OR ISJSON(@VecBJson) <> 1
    BEGIN
        RETURN NULL;
    END;

    DECLARE @Similarity FLOAT;

    SELECT @Similarity =
        SUM(TRY_CAST(a.[value] AS FLOAT) * TRY_CAST(b.[value] AS FLOAT))
        / NULLIF(
            SQRT(SUM(POWER(TRY_CAST(a.[value] AS FLOAT), 2)))
            * SQRT(SUM(POWER(TRY_CAST(b.[value] AS FLOAT), 2))),
            0.0
          )
    FROM OPENJSON(@VecAJson) AS a
    INNER JOIN OPENJSON(@VecBJson) AS b
        ON a.[key] = b.[key];

    RETURN @Similarity;
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   2. Function: genealogy.fn_SuggestVietnameseKinship
   Gợi ý danh xưng và cách xưng hô họ hàng truyền thống Việt Nam dựa trên
   khoảng cách thế hệ từ Tổ tiên chung gần nhất (LCA) đến Thành viên A
   (@DepthA) và Thành viên B (@DepthB).
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [genealogy].[fn_SuggestVietnameseKinship]
(
    @DepthA INT,
    @DepthB INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(300)
AS
BEGIN
    IF @DepthA IS NULL OR @DepthB IS NULL OR @DepthA < 0 OR @DepthB < 0
        RETURN N'Chưa xác định được khoảng cách thế hệ';

    IF @DepthA = 0 AND @DepthB = 0
        RETURN N'Cùng một người (chính bản thân)';

    -- Quan hệ trực hệ (một người là tổ tiên trực tiếp của người kia)
    IF @DepthA = 0
    BEGIN
        RETURN CASE @DepthB
            WHEN 1 THEN N'Trực hệ: A là Cha/Mẹ ruột của B (B gọi A là Bố/Cha/Mẹ, xưng Con)'
            WHEN 2 THEN N'Trực hệ: A là Ông/Bà (nội/ngoại) của B (B gọi A là Ông/Bà, xưng Cháu)'
            WHEN 3 THEN N'Trực hệ: A là Cụ (Cố) của B (B gọi A là Cụ/Cố, xưng Chắt)'
            WHEN 4 THEN N'Trực hệ: A là Kỵ (Sơ) của B (B gọi A là Kỵ/Sơ, xưng Chút)'
            ELSE CONCAT(N'Trực hệ: A là tổ tiên đời thứ ', @DepthB, N' tính từ B')
        END;
    END;

    IF @DepthB = 0
    BEGIN
        RETURN CASE @DepthA
            WHEN 1 THEN N'Trực hệ: A là Con ruột của B (A gọi B là Bố/Cha/Mẹ, xưng Con)'
            WHEN 2 THEN N'Trực hệ: A là Cháu (nội/ngoại) của B (A gọi B là Ông/Bà, xưng Cháu)'
            WHEN 3 THEN N'Trực hệ: A là Chắt của B (A gọi B là Cụ/Cố, xưng Chắt)'
            WHEN 4 THEN N'Trực hệ: A là Chút của B (A gọi B là Kỵ/Sơ, xưng Chút)'
            ELSE CONCAT(N'Trực hệ: A là hậu duệ cách B ', @DepthA, N' đời')
        END;
    END;

    -- Quan hệ ngang hàng hoặc bàng hệ (cùng tổ tiên chung)
    IF @DepthA = 1 AND @DepthB = 1
        RETURN N'Ngang hàng: Anh/Chị/Em ruột (cùng cha hoặc mẹ)';

    IF @DepthA = 1 AND @DepthB = 2
        RETURN N'Bàng hệ: A là Bác/Chú/Cô/Cậu/Dì ruột của B (A ngang hàng cha/mẹ của B, B xưng Cháu)';

    IF @DepthA = 2 AND @DepthB = 1
        RETURN N'Bàng hệ: A là Cháu ruột của B (B là Bác/Chú/Cô/Cậu/Dì ruột, ngang hàng cha/mẹ của A)';

    IF @DepthA = 1 AND @DepthB = 3
        RETURN N'Bàng hệ: A là Ông/Bà trẻ (Bác/Chú/Cô/Cậu/Dì của cha/mẹ B), B là Cháu/Chắt họ';

    IF @DepthA = 3 AND @DepthB = 1
        RETURN N'Bàng hệ: A là Cháu/Chắt họ, B là Ông/Bà trẻ (ngang hàng ông/bà của A)';

    IF @DepthA = 2 AND @DepthB = 2
        RETURN N'Ngang hàng bàng hệ: Anh/Chị/Em họ (con chú con bác / con cô con cậu / con dì)';

    IF @DepthA = 2 AND @DepthB = 3
        RETURN N'Bàng hệ: A thuộc hàng Chú/Bác/Cô/Cậu/Dì họ của B (cùng cụ tổ, lệch 1 đời)';

    IF @DepthA = 3 AND @DepthB = 2
        RETURN N'Bàng hệ: A là Cháu họ của B (B thuộc hàng Chú/Bác/Cô/Cậu/Dì họ của A, cùng cụ tổ)';

    IF @DepthA = 3 AND @DepthB = 3
        RETURN N'Ngang hàng bàng hệ: Anh/Chị/Em họ đời thứ 3 (cùng cụ tổ, cháu chú cháu bác)';

    IF @DepthA = @DepthB
        RETURN CONCAT(N'Ngang hàng bàng hệ: Anh/Chị/Em họ (cùng tổ tiên cách ', @DepthA, N' đời)');

    RETURN CONCAT(
        N'Họ hàng bàng hệ: A cách tổ tiên chung ', @DepthA,
        N' đời, B cách tổ tiên chung ', @DepthB, N' đời'
    );
END;
GO

/* =====================================================================
   3. View: heritage.vw_PendingKnowledgeSources
   Liệt kê các Bài viết (community.Posts) và Tư liệu di sản (heritage.Items)
   có nội dung văn bản nhưng chưa được cắt đoạn/nhúng Vector hoặc đang ở
   trạng thái 'pending' / 'failed' cần Pipeline AI đồng bộ.
   ===================================================================== */
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [heritage].[vw_PendingKnowledgeSources]
AS
    -- Nguồn 1: Bài viết cộng đồng (community.Posts) của Thành viên 3
    SELECT
        p.[FamilyId]                                     AS [FamilyId],
        CAST(N'post' AS NVARCHAR(20))                    AS [SourceType],
        p.[Id]                                           AS [SourceId],
        CONCAT(N'Bài viết cộng đồng #', LEFT(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(36), p.[Id]), 8)) AS [Title],
        p.[Content]                                      AS [RawContent],
        COALESCE(kc.[CurrentStatus], N'unindexed')       AS [SyncStatus],
        CAST(p.[CreatedAt] AS DATETIME2(0))              AS [CreatedAt]
    FROM [community].[Posts] AS p
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) c.[SyncStatus] AS [CurrentStatus]
        FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] AS c
        WHERE c.[SourceType] = N'post'
          AND c.[SourceId] = p.[Id]
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN c.[SyncStatus] IN (N'pending', N'failed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            c.[ChunkIndex] ASC
    ) AS kc
    WHERE LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.[Content], N'')))) > 0
      AND (kc.[CurrentStatus] IS NULL OR kc.[CurrentStatus] IN (N'pending', N'failed'))

    UNION ALL

    -- Nguồn 2: Tư liệu di sản (heritage.Items) của Thành viên 4
    SELECT
        i.[FamilyId]                                     AS [FamilyId],
        CAST(N'heritage' AS NVARCHAR(20))                AS [SourceType],
        i.[Id]                                           AS [SourceId],
        i.[Title]                                        AS [Title],
        CONCAT(
            i.[Title], N'. ',
            ISNULL(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(i.[Description])), N'') + N'. ', N''),
            ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(i.[Content])), N'')
        )                                                AS [RawContent],
        COALESCE(kc.[CurrentStatus], N'unindexed')       AS [SyncStatus],
        CAST(i.[CreatedAt] AS DATETIME2(0))              AS [CreatedAt]
    FROM [heritage].[Items] AS i
    OUTER APPLY (
        SELECT TOP (1) c.[SyncStatus] AS [CurrentStatus]
        FROM [heritage].[KnowledgeChunks] AS c
        WHERE c.[SourceType] = N'heritage'
          AND c.[SourceId] = i.[Id]
        ORDER BY
            CASE WHEN c.[SyncStatus] IN (N'pending', N'failed') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            c.[ChunkIndex] ASC
    ) AS kc
    WHERE (
            LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(i.[Content], N'')))) > 0
            OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(i.[Description], N'')))) > 0
          )
      AND (kc.[CurrentStatus] IS NULL OR kc.[CurrentStatus] IN (N'pending', N'failed'));
GO

name: familyconnect

services:
  db:
    image: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2025-latest
    environment:
      ACCEPT_EULA: "Y"
      MSSQL_PID: Developer
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD:-FamilyConnect_2025!}
    ports:
      - "${MSSQL_PORT:-1433}:1433"
    volumes:
      - sqlserver_data:/var/opt/mssql

  # Chay 1 lan: cho SQL Server san sang roi chay database/schema/*.sql va database/seed/*.sql.
  # Cac script deu chay lai nhieu lan duoc nen moi lan `up` se tu dong dong bo lai.
  db-init:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile
      target: db-init
    depends_on:
      - db
    restart: "no"
    environment:
      MSSQL_HOST: db
      MSSQL_PORT: 1433
      MSSQL_USER: sa
      MSSQL_DB: ${MSSQL_DB:-FamilyConnect}
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD:-FamilyConnect_2025!}
    volumes:
      - ../../database:/database:ro
    command:
      - bash
      - -c
      - |
        set -e
        cp -r /database /tmp/database
        sed -i 's/\r$$//' /tmp/database/init.sh
        for i in $$(seq 1 60); do
          sqlcmd -S "$$MSSQL_HOST,$$MSSQL_PORT" -U "$$MSSQL_USER" -P "$$MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD" -C -Q "SELECT 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
          echo "Dang cho SQL Server khoi dong ($$i/60)..."
          sleep 2
        done
        bash /tmp/database/init.sh
        echo "Khoi tao database xong."

  backend:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile
      target: backend
    # Hot reload: sua code trong apps/backend/app la API tu nap lai.
    command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
    environment:
      MSSQL_HOST: db
      MSSQL_PORT: 1433
      MSSQL_DB: ${MSSQL_DB:-FamilyConnect}
      MSSQL_USER: ${MSSQL_USER:-sa}
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD:-FamilyConnect_2025!}
      JWT_SECRET_KEY: ${JWT_SECRET_KEY:-dev-familyconnect-secret-change-before-deployment-32-chars-min}
      GEMINI_API_KEY: ${GEMINI_API_KEY:-}
      GEMINI_EMBEDDING_MODEL: ${GEMINI_EMBEDDING_MODEL:-gemini-embedding-001}
      GEMINI_EMBEDDING_DIM: ${GEMINI_EMBEDDING_DIM:-256}
      GEMINI_CHAT_MODEL: ${GEMINI_CHAT_MODEL:-gemini-2.5-flash}
      WATCHFILES_FORCE_POLLING: "true"
    volumes:
      - ../../apps/backend/app:/app/app
    ports:
      - "${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}:8000"
    depends_on:
      db-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/health')"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 6
      start_period: 15s

  # Ban build san (nginx) - gan giong luc trien khai.
  web:
    build:

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
# Dockerfile dung chung cho toan bo du an. Build context la thu muc goc repo.
#   target "backend" -> API FastAPI
#   target "web"     -> React build + nginx (proxy /api toi backend)
#   target "web-dev" -> Vite dev server (hot reload, dung voi profile dev)
#   target "db-init" -> sqlcmd + bash de chay script trong database/ (schema + seed)

# ---------- Backend (FastAPI) ----------
FROM python:3.12-slim AS backend
WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    libltdl7 libkrb5-3 libgssapi-krb5-2 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY apps/backend/requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY apps/backend/app ./app
COPY apps/worker /worker
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]

# ---------- Web: build ----------
FROM node:22-alpine AS web-build
WORKDIR /app
COPY apps/web/package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
COPY apps/web ./
RUN npm run build

# ---------- Web: nginx ----------
FROM nginx:alpine AS web
COPY --from=web-build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY infra/docker/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
EXPOSE 80
# ---------- Web: Vite dev server (hot reload) ----------
FROM node:22-alpine AS web-dev
WORKDIR /app
COPY apps/web/package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
EXPOSE 5173
CMD ["npm", "run", "dev"]

# ---------- DB init: chay database/init.sh ----------
FROM ubuntu:22.04 AS db-init
ENV ACCEPT_EULA=Y DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates gnupg \
    && curl -sSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/microsoft.gpg \
    && echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/microsoft.gpg] https://packages.microsoft.com/ubuntu/22.04/prod jammy main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mssql-release.list \
    && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends mssql-tools18 unixodbc \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ENV PATH="${PATH}:/opt/mssql-tools18/bin"

def uid(number: int) -> str:
    return str(UUID(int=number))


def execute_script(connection, script: str, database: str) -> None:
    for batch in re.split(r"(?im)^\s*GO\s*(?:--[^\r\n]*)?\r?$", script.replace("$(DB_NAME)", database)):
        if batch.strip():
            result = connection.exec_driver_sql(batch)
            result.close()


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def sql_database():
    server = os.getenv("TASK6_SQL_SERVER")
    if not server:
        pytest.skip("Set TASK6_SQL_SERVER to run the real SQL Server integration tests.")
    name = "FamilyConnect_Task6Test_" + uuid4().hex
    port = os.getenv("TASK6_SQL_PORT")
    sql_user = os.getenv("TASK6_SQL_USER")
    sql_password = os.getenv("TASK6_SQL_PASSWORD")
    query = {"TrustServerCertificate": "yes"}
    if not sql_user:
        query["Trusted_Connection"] = "yes"
    url = URL.create("mssql+mssqlpython", username=sql_user, password=sql_password, host=server,
                     port=int(port) if port else None, database="master",
                     query=query)
    master = create_engine(url, isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT", poolclass=NullPool)
    engine = None
    created = False
    try:
        with master.connect() as connection:
            connection.exec_driver_sql(f"CREATE DATABASE [{name}]").close()
        created = True
        engine = create_engine(url.set(database=name), poolclass=NullPool)
        with engine.begin() as connection:
            for folder in ("schema", "views", "procedures", "triggers"):
                for path in sorted((ROOT / "database" / folder).glob("*.sql")):
                    execute_script(connection, path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"), name)
            # Idempotent deployment of the task 6 procedures.
            execute_script(connection, (ROOT / "database/procedures/06_admin_procs.sql").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), name)
        yield engine, name
    finally:
        if engine is not None:
            engine.dispose()
        if created:
            assert re.fullmatch(r"FamilyConnect_Task6Test_[0-9a-f]{32}", name)
            with master.connect() as connection:
                connection.exec_driver_sql(f"ALTER DATABASE [{name}] SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE").close()
                connection.exec_driver_sql(f"DROP DATABASE [{name}]").close()
        master.dispose()


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def admin_password_hash():
    return hash_password("Task6-Test-Admin!2026")


@pytest.fixture
def api(sql_database, admin_password_hash):
    engine, name = sql_database
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        execute_script(connection, (ROOT / "tests/database/task6.integration.sql").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), name)
        connection.execute(text("UPDATE core.Users SET PasswordHash = :hash WHERE UserId = :id"),
                           {"hash": admin_password_hash, "id": uid(1)})
    options = {"fail_audit": False}

    def test_db():
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            connection.exec_driver_sql("EXECUTE AS USER = 'task6_backend'").close()
            connection.exec_driver_sql(
                "EXEC sys.sp_set_session_context @key=N'task6_fail_audit', @value="
                + ("1" if options["fail_audit"] else "NULL")
            ).close()
            connection.commit()
            try:
                with Session(bind=connection) as session:
                    yield session
            finally:
                connection.rollback()
                connection.exec_driver_sql("REVERT").close()
                connection.commit()

    previous = app.dependency_overrides.copy()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = test_db
    try:
        with TestClient(app) as client:
            yield client, engine, options
    finally:
        app.dependency_overrides.clear()
        app.dependency_overrides.update(previous)


def headers(user: int = 1, *, expires: int = 60, secret: str = JWT_SECRET_KEY, **claims):
    payload = {"sub": uid(user), "exp": datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=expires), **claims}
    return {"Authorization": "Bearer " + jwt.encode(payload, secret, algorithm="HS256")}


def scalar(engine, sql: str, **params):
    with engine.connect() as connection:
        return connection.execute(text(sql), params).scalar()

def test_admin_login_and_config_crud_persist_with_backend_permissions(api):
    client, engine, _ = api
    login = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "admin@example.com", "password": "Task6-Test-Admin!2026"})
    assert login.status_code == 200, login.text
    auth = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + login.json()["access_token"]}
    payload = {"config_key": "site.name", "config_value": "Gia phả Việt Nam — ' ; DROP TABLE core.Users; --", "description": "Tên ứng dụng"}
    created = client.post("/api/admin/configs", json=payload, headers=auth)
    assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
    assert created.json()["config_value"] == payload["config_value"]
    assert "ConfigKey" not in created.json()
    assert client.get("/api/admin/configs/site.name", headers=auth).json() == created.json()
    assert len(client.get("/api/admin/configs", headers=auth).json()) == 1
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        connection.exec_driver_sql("UPDATE core.SystemConfigs SET UpdatedAt='20000101'").close()
        # The real trigger overwrites even an explicit old timestamp.
    updated = client.put("/api/admin/configs/site.name", json={"config_value": "Mới"}, headers=auth)
    assert updated.status_code == 200, updated.text
    assert updated.json()["description"] is None
    assert datetime.fromisoformat(updated.json()["updated_at"]).year >= 2026
    assert scalar(engine, "SELECT ConfigValue FROM core.SystemConfigs WHERE ConfigKey='site.name'") == "Mới"
    deleted = client.delete("/api/admin/configs/site.name", headers=auth)
    assert deleted.status_code == 204 and deleted.content == b""
    assert client.get("/api/admin/configs/site.name", headers=auth).status_code == 404
    assert scalar(engine, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports.AuditLog WHERE UserId=:id AND Action LIKE 'system_config.%'", id=uid(1)) == 3


def test_duplicate_key_returns_conflict_and_preserves_original(api):

def test_approval_links_member_rejects_competitors_and_commits(api):

    assert scalar(engine, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core.MemberVerifications WHERE Id IN (:a,:b) AND Status='rejected'", a=uid(4002), b=uid(4003)) == 2

@pytest.mark.parametrize("action", ["create", "update", "delete", "review"])
def test_failed_audit_rolls_back_the_entire_operation(api, action):
    client, engine, options = api
    if action in {"update", "delete"}:
        assert client.post("/api/admin/configs", json={"config_key": "site.name", "config_value": "old"}, headers=headers()).status_code == 201
    options["fail_audit"] = True
    if action == "create":
        response = client.post("/api/admin/configs", json={"config_key": "site.name", "config_value": "new"}, headers=headers())
    elif action == "update":
        response = client.put("/api/admin/configs/site.name", json={"config_value": "new"}, headers=headers())
    elif action == "delete":
        response = client.delete("/api/admin/configs/site.name", headers=headers())
    else:
        response = client.patch(f"/api/admin/verifications/{uid(4001)}/review", json={"decision": "approved"}, headers=headers())
    assert response.status_code == 500, response.text
    assert response.json() == {"detail": "Không thể xử lý yêu cầu quản trị."}
    if action in {"update", "delete"}:
        assert scalar(engine, "SELECT ConfigValue FROM core.SystemConfigs WHERE ConfigKey='site.name'") == "old"
        assert scalar(engine, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports.AuditLog") == 1
    else:
        assert scalar(engine, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core.SystemConfigs") == 0
        assert scalar(engine, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports.AuditLog") == 0
        assert scalar(engine, "SELECT Status FROM core.MemberVerifications WHERE Id=:id", id=uid(4001)) == "pending"
        assert scalar(engine, "SELECT Status FROM core.MemberVerifications WHERE Id=:id", id=uid(4002)) == "pending"
        assert scalar(engine, "SELECT UserId FROM genealogy.Members WHERE Id=:id", id=uid(3001)) is None

"""Kiểm thử Unit & API phân hệ Trợ lý ảo AI (TV5) — Tuần 1 & Tuần 2."""

from __future__ import annotations

from uuid import UUID, uuid4

    sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND_DIR))

FAMILY_ID = UUID("22222222-2222-2222-2222-000000000001")
USER_ID = UUID("11111111-1111-1111-1111-000000000001")
SOURCE_ID = UUID("eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-000000000003")
MEMBER_A = UUID("44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000001")
MEMBER_B = UUID("44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000005")


class FakeResult:
    def __init__(self, rows: list[dict] | None = None, scalar=None) -> None:
        self._rows = rows or []
        self._scalar = scalar

    def mappings(self):
        return self

    def all(self):
        return self._rows

    def one(self):
        return self._rows[0]

    def one_or_none(self):
        return self._rows[0] if self._rows else None

    def scalar(self):
        return self._scalar


class FakeAiSession:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.statements: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
        self.commits = 0
        self.rollbacks = 0

    def execute(self, statement, params=None):
        sql = " ".join(str(statement).split())
        self.statements.append((sql, params or {}))

        if "heritage.fn_CosineSimilarity" in sql:
            return FakeResult(scalar=0.9125)
        if "usp_UpsertKnowledgeChunk" in sql:
            return FakeResult([{"ChunkId": str(uuid4()), "ActionTaken": "INSERT"}])
        if "usp_ClearStaleKnowledgeChunks" in sql:
            return FakeResult([{"DeletedChunkCount": 0}])
        if "vw_PendingKnowledgeSources" in sql:
            return FakeResult(
                [
                    {
                        "FamilyId": FAMILY_ID,
                        "SourceType": "heritage",
                        "SourceId": SOURCE_ID,
                        "Title": "Chuyện cụ Cẩn dựng nhà thờ họ",
                        "RawContent": "Câu một. Câu hai. Câu ba. Câu bốn. Câu năm.",
                        "SyncStatus": "unindexed",
                        "CreatedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    }
                ]
            )
        if "usp_SemanticSearch" in sql:
            return FakeResult(
                [
                    {
                        "ChunkId": uuid4(),
                        "FamilyId": FAMILY_ID,
                        "SourceType": "heritage",
                        "SourceId": SOURCE_ID,
                        "SourceTitle": "Nghề mộc truyền trong họ",
                        "ChunkIndex": 0,
                        "ChunkText": "Nghề mộc theo họ Nguyễn Văn từ đời cụ tổ ở Thạch Thất.",
                        "SummaryText": "Ghi chép nghề mộc 3 đời.",
                        "SimilarityScore": 0.8942,
                        "UpdatedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc),
                    }
                ]
            )
        if "usp_FindRelationshipPath" in sql:
            return FakeResult(
                [
                    {
                        "MemberAId": MEMBER_A,
                        "MemberAName": "Nguyễn Văn Cẩn",
                        "MemberABirthDate": date(1938, 3, 12),
                        "MemberABranchName": "Chi trưởng",
                        "MemberBId": MEMBER_B,
                        "MemberBName": "Nguyễn Văn Hùng",
                        "MemberBBirthDate": date(1995, 9, 24),
                        "MemberBBranchName": "Chi thứ",
                        "RelationshipCategory": "direct_lineage",
                        "CommonAncestorId": MEMBER_A,
                        "CommonAncestorName": "Nguyễn Văn Cẩn",
                        "DepthFromAncestorToA": 0,
                        "DepthFromAncestorToB": 2,
                        "TotalGenerationDistance": 2,
                        "PathFromAncestorToA": "Nguyễn Văn Cẩn",
                        "PathFromAncestorToB": "Nguyễn Văn Cẩn -> Nguyễn Văn Trường -> Nguyễn Văn Hùng",
                        "SuggestedKinship": "Trực hệ: A là Ông/Bà (nội/ngoại) của B (B gọi A là Ông/Bà, xưng Cháu)",
                    }
                ]
            )
        if "usp_SaveAiChatMessage" in sql:
            return FakeResult([{"MessageId": str(uuid4()), "CreatedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc)}])

        return FakeResult()

    def commit(self) -> None:
        self.commits += 1

    def rollback(self) -> None:
        self.rollbacks += 1

def test_split_text_into_sentence_chunks_groups_by_3_sentences():
    text_input = (
        "Câu thứ nhất về cụ tổ. Câu thứ hai về nhà thờ họ! "
        "Câu thứ ba về giỗ tổ? Câu thứ tư về nghề mộc. Câu thứ năm về con cháu."
    )
    chunks = services.split_text_into_sentence_chunks(
        text_input,
        sentences_per_chunk=3,
        title="Gia phả họ Nguyễn",
    )
    assert len(chunks) == 2
    assert chunks[0].startswith("[Gia phả họ Nguyễn]")
    assert "Câu thứ nhất" in chunks[0] and "Câu thứ ba" in chunks[0]
    assert "Câu thứ tư" in chunks[1] and "Câu thứ năm" in chunks[1]
