"""Task 9: browser -> Vite proxy -> FastAPI -> isolated SQL Server, real auth/JWT."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import socket
import sys
from threading import Thread
import time

import pytest

if os.getenv("RUN_TASK9_E2E") != "1":
    pytest.skip("Set RUN_TASK9_E2E=1 for real login E2E.", allow_module_level=True)

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
import uvicorn

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests" / "api"))
from test_admin import execute_script, hash_password, sql_database, uid  # noqa: E402
from app.core.database import get_db  # noqa: E402
from app.main import app  # noqa: E402

playwright = pytest.importorskip("playwright.sync_api")
expect = playwright.expect
PASSWORD = "Task9-Test-Password!2026"


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def login_app(sql_database, vite_server):
    engine, _ = sql_database

    def test_db():
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            connection.exec_driver_sql("EXECUTE AS USER = 'task6_backend'").close()
            connection.commit()
            try:
                with Session(bind=connection) as session:
                    yield session
            finally:
                connection.rollback()
                connection.exec_driver_sql("REVERT").close()
                connection.commit()

    previous = app.dependency_overrides.copy()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = test_db
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        port = sock.getsockname()[1]
        server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=port, log_level="warning",
                                              access_log=False, lifespan="off", timeout_graceful_shutdown=5))
        thread = Thread(target=server.run, kwargs={"sockets": [sock]}, daemon=True)
        try:
            thread.start()
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
            while not server.started:
                if not thread.is_alive() or time.monotonic() > deadline:
                    pytest.fail("The isolated FastAPI server did not start.")
                time.sleep(0.05)
            with vite_server(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}") as url:
                yield url
        finally:
            server.should_exit = True
            if thread.ident is not None:
                thread.join(timeout=10)
            app.dependency_overrides.clear()
            app.dependency_overrides.update(previous)
            assert not thread.is_alive(), "The isolated FastAPI server did not stop."


@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
def login_password_hash():
    return hash_password(PASSWORD)


@pytest.fixture
def login_ui(e2e_browser, login_app, sql_database, login_password_hash):
    engine, name = sql_database
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        for path in ("tests/database/task6.integration.sql", "tests/database/task9.integration.sql"):
            execute_script(connection, (ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"), name)
        connection.execute(text("UPDATE core.Users SET PasswordHash = :hash"), {"hash": login_password_hash})
    context = e2e_browser.new_context(base_url=login_app, viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 1000})
    errors, requests = [], []
    context.on("page", lambda page: page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(str(error))))
    context.on("request", lambda request: requests.append(request) if "/api/" in request.url else None)
    page = context.new_page()
    page.set_default_timeout(10000)
    try:
        yield page, engine, requests
        assert not errors, errors
    finally:
        context.close()


def submit_login(page, email="admin@example.com", password=PASSWORD):
    page.get_by_label("Email", exact=True).fill(email)
    page.get_by_label("Mật khẩu", exact=True).fill(password)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Đăng nhập", exact=True).click()


def current_session(page):
    token = page.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('familyconnect.token')")
    assert token and not token.startswith("demo-token-")
    profile = page.request.get("/api/auth/me", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token})
    assert profile.status == 200, profile.text()
    user = profile.json()
    assert "password_hash" not in user
    assert json.loads(page.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('familyconnect.user')"))["role"] == user["role"]
    return user


@pytest.mark.parametrize("email,role,path,destination,title", [
    ("ADMIN@EXAMPLE.COM", "admin", "/admin-config", "/admin-config", "Cấu hình hệ thống"),
    ("head@example.com", "family_head", "/member-approval", "/member-approval", "Duyệt thành viên"),
    ("member@example.com", "member", "/reports", "/dashboard", "Không gian gia đình"),
    ("guest@example.com", "guest", "/admin-config", "/dashboard", "Không gian gia đình"),
])
def test_login_returns_to_allowed_destination(login_ui, email, role, path, destination, title):
    page, _, requests = login_ui
    page.goto(path)
    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/login$"))
    with page.expect_response("**/api/auth/login") as login:
        submit_login(page, email)
    assert login.value.status == 200
    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(re.escape(destination) + "$"))
    expect(page.get_by_role("heading", name=title, exact=True)).to_be_visible()
    assert current_session(page)["role"] == role
    if role in {"member", "guest"}:
        assert not any("/api/admin/" in request.url for request in requests)
        expect(page.get_by_role("link", name="Cấu hình hệ thống", exact=True)).to_have_count(0)

def test_register_logout_and_login_persists_real_account(login_ui):
    page, engine, _ = login_ui
    page.goto("/register")
    page.get_by_label("Họ và tên", exact=True).fill("Nguyễn Ánh — Task 9")
    page.get_by_label("Email", exact=True).fill("task9.new@example.com")
    page.get_by_label("Mật khẩu", exact=True).fill(PASSWORD)
    page.get_by_label("Nhập lại mật khẩu", exact=True).fill(PASSWORD)
    with page.expect_response("**/api/auth/register") as registered:
        page.get_by_role("button", name="Đăng ký", exact=True).click()
    assert registered.value.status == 201
    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/dashboard$"))
    user = current_session(page)
    assert user["role"] == "member" and user["full_name"] == "Nguyễn Ánh — Task 9"
    with engine.connect() as connection:
        stored = connection.execute(text("SELECT PasswordHash FROM core.Users WHERE Email=:email"),
                                    {"email": "task9.new@example.com"}).scalar_one()
    assert stored != PASSWORD and stored.startswith("$argon2")
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Đăng xuất", exact=True).click()
    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/login$"))
    submit_login(page, "task9.new@example.com")
    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/dashboard$"))
    assert current_session(page)["id"] == user["id"]

"""Browser interactions with HTTP fixtures; SQL contracts live in test_membership_sql."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import expect

FAMILY="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101"
USER="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000201"
FIRST="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000301"
SECOND="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000302"


@pytest.fixture
def membership_ui(e2e_browser,vite_server):
    with vite_server() as url:
        context=e2e_browser.new_context(base_url=url,viewport={"width":1440,"height":1000})
        page=context.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(10000)
        page.on("pageerror",lambda error: print("BROWSER ERROR:",str(error)))
        state={"writes":[],"families":[dict(id=FAMILY,name="Gia đình kiểm thử")],"members":[dict(id=FIRST,name="Nguyễn An",branch_id=None,birth_date="1960-01-01",location=None,user_id=None),dict(id=SECOND,name="Nguyễn Bình",branch_id=None,birth_date="1990-01-01",location=None,user_id=None)],"branches":[],"edges":[],"profile":dict(user=dict(id=USER,full_name="Nguyễn An",email="ui@example.com",role="admin"),member=None,verifications=[])}
        def handle(route):
            req=route.request
            path=urlparse(req.url).path
            if not path.startswith("/api/"):
                route.continue_(); return
            params=parse_qs(urlparse(req.url).query)
            body=req.post_data_json if req.post_data else None
            if req.method!="GET": state["writes"].append((req.method,path,body))
            if path=="/api/heritage/families": route.fulfill(json=state["families"]); return
            if path=="/api/heritage/family-tree":
                route.fulfill(json=dict(family_id=FAMILY,nodes=[dict(id=m["id"],label=m["name"],birth_date=m["birth_date"]) for m in state["members"]],edges=[dict(id=e["id"],source=e["first_id"],target=e["second_id"],kind="parent_child") for e in state["edges"]])); return
            if path=="/api/genealogy/me":
                if req.method=="PUT": state["profile"]["user"]["full_name"]=body["name"]
                route.fulfill(json=state["profile"]); return
            if path=="/api/genealogy/verification-candidates": route.fulfill(json=[dict(id=FIRST,name="Nguyễn An",family_name="Gia đình kiểm thử",branch_name=None)]); return
            if path=="/api/genealogy/verifications":
                state["profile"]["verifications"]=[dict(id="request-one",status="pending",name="Nguyễn An",family_name="Gia đình kiểm thử")]
                route.fulfill(status=201,json=state["profile"]); return
            if path=="/api/genealogy/relationships": route.fulfill(json=dict(parent_child=state["edges"],marriages=[],ancestors=[dict(id=FIRST,name="Nguyễn An",depth=1)] if state["edges"] else [],descendants=[])); return
            if path.startswith("/api/genealogy/relationships/parent-child"):
                if req.method=="POST":
                    state["edges"].append(dict(id="edge-one",first_id=FIRST,second_id=SECOND,first_name="Nguyễn An",second_name="Nguyễn Bình"))
                    route.fulfill(status=201,json={"id":"edge-one"})
                else: state["edges"]=[]; route.fulfill(status=204)
                return
            if path.startswith("/api/genealogy/members") or path.startswith("/api/genealogy/branches"):
                resource=path.split("/")[3]
                if req.method=="GET":
                    rows=[r for r in state[resource] if params.get("q",[""])[0].lower() in r["name"].lower()]
                    route.fulfill(json=dict(items=rows,total=len(rows))); return
                if req.method=="POST":
                    identifier="new-"+resource
                    state[resource].append(dict(id=identifier,**body,user_id=None))
                    route.fulfill(status=201,json={"id":identifier}); return
                identifier=path.rsplit("/",1)[1]
                if req.method=="DELETE": state[resource]=[r for r in state[resource] if r["id"]!=identifier]; route.fulfill(status=204); return
                next(r for r in state[resource] if r["id"]==identifier).update(body)
                route.fulfill(json={"id":identifier}); return
            route.fulfill(status=404,json={"detail":"Unexpected API fixture"})
        page.route("**/api/**",handle)
        context.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('familyconnect.token','ui-test-token');localStorage.setItem('familyconnect.user',"+json.dumps(json.dumps(dict(id=USER,fullName="Nguyễn An",email="ui@example.com",role="admin")))+");")
        try: yield page,state,url
        finally: context.close()

@pytest.mark.parametrize("path",["/profile","/family-management","/family-tree"])
def test_responsive_layout_and_drawer_keyboard(membership_ui,path,width):
    page,_,_=membership_ui
    page.set_viewport_size({"width":width,"height":900 if width>=1024 else 844})
    page.goto(path)
    expect(page.get_by_role("heading",level=1)).to_be_visible()
    if width<1024:
        page.get_by_role("button",name="Mở menu",exact=True).click()
        expect(page.get_by_role("dialog",name="Điều hướng chính")).to_be_visible()
        page.keyboard.press("Escape")
        expect(page.get_by_role("dialog",name="Điều hướng chính")).to_have_count(0)
    assert page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth")
    output=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/"apps/web/.taste-skill/shots"
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    page.screenshot(path=str(output/(path.strip("/")+f"-{width}.png")),full_page=True)

    page.route('**/api/**',handle)
    context.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('familyconnect.token','test-token');localStorage.setItem('familyconnect.user',"+json.dumps(json.dumps(dict(id=U,fullName='Nguyễn An',email='ui@example.com',role='admin')))+");")

@pytest.mark.parametrize('path,title',[('/directory','Danh bạ gia đình'),('/community','Bảng tin gia đình'),('/events','Lịch gia đình'),('/notifications','Thông báo')])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('width',[1440,1024,768,390])
def test_new_pages_at_four_widths(social_ui,path,title,width):
    page,_=social_ui;page.set_viewport_size({'width':width,'height':900 if width>=1024 else 844});page.goto(path)
    expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name=title,exact=True,level=1)).to_be_visible()
    expect(page.get_by_text('Đang tải dữ liệu…',exact=True)).to_have_count(0)
    if path=='/directory': expect(page.get_by_role('button',name=re.compile('^Nguy\u1ec5n An'))).to_be_visible()
    elif path=='/community': expect(page.get_by_role('article')).to_have_count(1)
    elif path=='/events': expect(page.get_by_role('button',name=re.compile('.*G\u1eb7p m\u1eb7t gia \u0111\u00ecnh'))).to_be_visible()
    else: expect(page.get_by_role('link',name='Xem s\u1ef1 ki\u1ec7n',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
    assert page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth')
    output=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/'apps/web/.taste-skill/shots';output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    page.screenshot(path=str(output/(path.strip('/')+f'-{width}.png')),full_page=True)

"""Browser UI contracts with intercepted HTTP responses. No SQL or real login.

Run with RUN_TASK7_UI=1. HTTP fixtures exist only in this test, never app code.
"""
import json
import re
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse

import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import expect

FAMILY = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000101"
USER = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000201"
MEMBER = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000401"
ITEM = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000301"
TOKEN = "A" * 64


@pytest.fixture
def ui(e2e_browser, vite_server):
    with vite_server() as url:
        context = e2e_browser.new_context(base_url=url, viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1000})
        page = context.new_page()
        page.set_default_timeout(10000)
        state = {"role": "admin", "requests": [], "error": None, "empty": False, "families_empty": False,
                 "items": [dict(id=ITEM, family_id=FAMILY, created_by_user_id=USER, type="story", title="Ký ức gia đình",
                                description="Lời kể", content="Nội dung ký ức", media_url=None, created_at="2026-11-13T00:00:00", version_token=TOKEN)]}
        def handle(route):
            req = route.request
            path = urlparse(req.url).path
            if not path.startswith("/api/"):
                route.continue_(); return
            params = parse_qs(urlparse(req.url).query)
            body = req.post_data_json if req.post_data else None
            state["requests"].append((req.method, path, params, body))
            if path == "/api/genealogy/relationships":
                route.fulfill(json=dict(parent_child=[],marriages=[],ancestors=[],descendants=[])); return
            if path == "/api/genealogy/members":
                route.fulfill(json=dict(items=[],total=0)); return
            if not path.startswith("/api/heritage/"):
                route.fulfill(status=404, json={"detail": "Unexpected API"}); return
            resource = path.split("/")[3]
            identifier = path.split("/")[4] if len(path.split("/")) > 4 else None
            if state["error"]:
                route.fulfill(status=state["error"], json={"detail": "Lỗi API thử nghiệm"}); return
            if resource == "families":
                route.fulfill(json=[] if state["families_empty"] else [dict(id=FAMILY, name="Gia đình thử nghiệm")]); return
            if resource == "family-tree":
                route.fulfill(json=dict(family_id=FAMILY, nodes=[] if state["empty"] else [dict(id=MEMBER, label="Ông An", birth_date="1950-01-01"), dict(id=USER, label="Bà Bình", birth_date=None)],
                                        edges=[] if state["empty"] else [dict(id="marriage-1", source=MEMBER, target=USER, kind="marriage")])); return
            if resource == "members":
                route.fulfill(json=dict(items=[dict(id=MEMBER, full_name="Ông An")], total=1, page=1, page_size=20)); return
            if resource == "ranking":
                route.fulfill(json=dict(items=[dict(member_id=MEMBER, family_id=FAMILY, full_name="Ông An", honor_count=0, rank=1)], total=1, page=1, page_size=12)); return
            if resource == "honors":
                rows = [dict(id=ITEM, member_id=MEMBER, family_id=FAMILY, full_name="Ông An", title="Đóng góp cộng đồng", description=None, date_awarded=None, created_at="2026-11-13T00:00:00", version_token=TOKEN)]
            else: rows = state["items"]
            if req.method == "DELETE":
                state["items"] = [r for r in rows if r["id"] != identifier]
                route.fulfill(status=204); return
            if req.method in ("POST", "PATCH"):
                row = {**state["items"][0], **body}
                row.pop("expected_version", None)
                state["items"] = [row]
                route.fulfill(status=201 if req.method == "POST" else 200, json=row); return
            if identifier:
                route.fulfill(json=rows[0]); return
            if state["empty"]: rows = []
            route.fulfill(json=dict(items=rows, total=len(rows), page=int(params.get("page", [1])[0]), page_size=12))
        page.route("**/api/**", handle)
        def open_as(path="/heritage", role="admin"):
            state["role"] = role
            # Storage priming only; actual login is covered by TV1's gated SQL E2E.
            page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('familyconnect.token','ui-test-token');localStorage.setItem('familyconnect.user'," +
                                 json.dumps(json.dumps(dict(id=USER, fullName="TV4", email="tv4@example.invalid", role=role))) + ");")
            page.goto(url + path, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
        yield page, state, open_as
        context.close()


def test_heritage_detail_edit_and_optimistic_version(ui):
    page, state, open_as = ui
    open_as()
    expect(page.get_by_role("heading", name="Ký ức gia đình", exact=True)).to_be_visible()
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Chi tiết", exact=True).click()
    expect(page.get_by_text("Nội dung ký ức", exact=True)).to_be_visible()
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Sửa", exact=True).click()
    page.get_by_label("Tiêu đề", exact=True).fill("Ký ức được sửa")
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Lưu", exact=True).click()
    expect(page.get_by_role("heading", name="Ký ức được sửa", exact=True)).to_be_visible()
    write = next(call for call in state["requests"] if call[0] == "PATCH")
    assert write[3]["expected_version"] == TOKEN and "actor_id" not in write[3]
    assert write[2]["family_id"] == [FAMILY]

# FILE: tests/unit/test_migrations.py
################################################################################
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("migrate", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "database/migrate.py")
migrate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(migrate)


class Connection:
    def __init__(self): self.batches = []
    def exec_driver_sql(self, sql):
        self.batches.append(sql.strip())
        return self
    def close(self): pass


def test_migration_applies_in_order_without_seed_or_database_init(tmp_path):
    for folder in ("schema", "views", "procedures", "triggers", "shared", "seed"):
        (tmp_path / folder).mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "schema/00_schemas.sql").write_text("DO NOT RUN INIT", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "schema/01.sql").write_text("USE [$(DB_NAME)];\r\nGO -- batch\r\nSELECT 1;", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "views/01.sql").write_text("SELECT 2;\nGO\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "shared/06_permissions.sql").write_text("DO NOT CHANGE DATABASE ACCOUNTS", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "seed/01.sql").write_text("DO NOT RUN SEED", encoding="utf-8")
    connection = Connection()
    migrate.apply_scripts(connection, "FamilyConnect_Test", tmp_path)
    assert connection.batches == ["USE [FamilyConnect_Test];", "SELECT 1;", "SELECT 2;"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("database", ["master", "MODEL", "tempdb", "msdb", "bad]; DROP DATABASE x;--", ""])
def test_migration_rejects_system_or_injected_database_names(tmp_path, database):
    connection = Connection()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): migrate.apply_scripts(connection, database, tmp_path)
    assert not connection.batches

# FILE: tests/unit/tv4-tree.test.mjs
################################################################################
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { layoutTree } from "../../apps/web/src/features/family-tree/layout.mjs";
import { generateTree } from "../../packages/mock-data/generate-tv4-tree.mjs";

test("empty graph", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(layoutTree({ nodes: [], edges: [] }), { nodes: [], edges: [], hasCycle: false });
});

test("1023 members, ten generations: no overlaps and parent above child", () => {
  const source = generateTree();
  const graph = layoutTree(source);
  assert.equal(graph.nodes.length, 1023);
  assert.equal(graph.edges.length, source.edges.length);
  assert.equal(graph.hasCycle, false);
  const positions = new Map(graph.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node.position]));
  assert.equal(new Set(graph.nodes.map((node) => `${node.position.x},${node.position.y}`)).size, 1023);
  for (const edge of graph.edges.filter((edge) => edge.kind === "parent_child")) {
    assert.ok(positions.get(edge.source).y < positions.get(edge.target).y);
  }
  assert.equal(new Set(graph.nodes.map((node) => node.position.y)).size, 10);
  assert.ok(graph.edges.some((edge) => edge.kind === "marriage" && edge.style.strokeDasharray));
});

test("duplicate and dangling references never add duplicate elements", () => {
  const nodes = [{ id: "a", label: "A" }, { id: "b", label: "B" }];
  const edge = { id: "ab", source: "a", target: "b", kind: "parent_child" };
  const graph = layoutTree({ nodes: [...nodes, nodes[0]], edges: [edge, edge, { ...edge, id: "bad", target: "missing" }] });
  assert.equal(graph.nodes.length, 2);
  assert.equal(graph.edges.length, 1);
});

test("legacy cycles are reported and terminate without recursion", () => {
  const graph = layoutTree({ nodes: [{ id: "a" }, { id: "b" }], edges: [
    { id: "ab", source: "a", target: "b", kind: "parent_child" },
    { id: "ba", source: "b", target: "a", kind: "parent_child" },
  ] });
  assert.equal(graph.hasCycle, true);
  assert.equal(graph.nodes.length, 2);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { after, test } from "node:test";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { createServer } from "../../apps/web/node_modules/vite/dist/node/index.js";

const web = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../apps/web/", import.meta.url));
const require = createRequire(new URL("../../apps/web/package.json", import.meta.url));
const React = require("react");
const { renderToStaticMarkup } = require("react-dom/server");
const { StaticRouter } = require("react-router-dom/server");
const { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } = await import("../../apps/web/node_modules/@tanstack/react-query/build/modern/index.js");
const server = await createServer({ root: web, server: { middlewareMode: true }, appType: "custom" });
after(() => server.close());
const { AuthProvider } = await server.ssrLoadModule("/src/features/auth/hooks/useAuth.jsx");
const { Sidebar } = await server.ssrLoadModule("/src/shared/layouts/Sidebar.jsx");
const { Dashboard } = await server.ssrLoadModule("/src/features/dashboard/pages/Dashboard.jsx");
const { Navbar } = await server.ssrLoadModule("/src/shared/layouts/Navbar.jsx");
const { Login } = await server.ssrLoadModule("/src/features/auth/pages/Login.jsx");
const { Register } = await server.ssrLoadModule("/src/features/auth/pages/Register.jsx");

function render(component, role = "member", rows) {
  const user = { id: "ui-test", fullName: "Thành viên kiểm thử", role };
  globalThis.localStorage = { getItem: (key) => role === null ? null : key === "familyconnect.user" ? JSON.stringify(user) : "ui-test-token" };
  const cache = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  if (rows) cache.setQueryData(["dashboard-statistics", user.id, role], rows);
  const markup = renderToStaticMarkup(React.createElement(QueryClientProvider, { client: cache },
    React.createElement(AuthProvider, null, React.createElement(StaticRouter, { location: "/dashboard" }, component))));
  cache.clear();
  return markup;
}

test("navigation keeps restricted pages out of guest and member menus", () => {
  const guest = render(React.createElement(Sidebar, { role: "guest", open: false }), "guest");
  assert.match(guest, /href="\/dashboard"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(guest, /href="\/(family-tree|heritage|admin-config|member-approval|reports)"/);
  const member = render(React.createElement(Sidebar, { role: "member", open: false }));
  assert.match(member, /href="\/family-tree"/);
  assert.match(member, /href="\/heritage"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(member, /href="\/(admin-config|member-approval|family-management|reports)"/);
  assert.match(member, /href="\/profile"/);
  const head = render(React.createElement(Sidebar, { role: "family_head", open: false }), "family_head");
  assert.match(head, /href="\/member-approval"/);
  assert.match(head, /href="\/family-management"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(head, /href="\/(admin-config|reports)"/);
  const admin = render(React.createElement(Sidebar, { role: "admin", open: false }), "admin");
  for (const path of ["admin-config", "member-approval", "reports"]) assert.ok(admin.includes(`href="/${path}"`));
});

test("member overview has working destinations without fabricated statistics", () => {
  const markup = render(React.createElement(Dashboard));
  assert.match(markup, /<h1>Không gian gia đình<\/h1>/);
  assert.match(markup, /href="\/family-tree"/);
  assert.match(markup, /href="\/heritage"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(markup, /class="stat-grid"|Thống kê theo gia đình/);
  const guest = render(React.createElement(Dashboard), "guest");
  assert.doesNotMatch(guest, /href="\/(family-tree|heritage)"/);
  assert.match(guest, /xác minh/);
});

test("admin statistics retain totals and an accessible data table", () => {
  const rows = [{ family_id: "1", family_name: "Gia đình kiểm thử", member_count: 1234, post_count: 5, event_count: 2 }];
  const markup = render(React.createElement(Dashboard), "admin", rows);
  assert.match(markup, /1\.234/);
  assert.match(markup, /Số liệu hoạt động theo gia đình/);
  assert.match(markup, /scope="row"[^>]*>Gia đình kiểm thử/);
  assert.match(render(React.createElement(Dashboard), "admin", []), /Chưa có gia đình trong phạm vi thống kê/);
});

test("auth forms retain their labels, autocomplete and real submit controls", () => {
  const login = render(React.createElement(Login), null);
  for (const label of ["Email", "Mật khẩu"]) assert.ok(login.includes(`>${label}</label>`));
  assert.match(login, /autoComplete="current-password"/i);
  assert.match(login, /type="submit"/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(login, /demo@familyconnect|Family123|Quên mật khẩu/);
  const register = render(React.createElement(Register), null);
  assert.match(register, /Họ và tên/);
  assert.match(register, /Nhập lại mật khẩu/);
  assert.match(register, /autoComplete="new-password"/i);
});

test("mobile menu declares its state and account has a named sign-out action", () => {
  const markup = render(React.createElement(Navbar, { sidebarOpen: true }));
  assert.match(markup, /aria-controls="app-sidebar" aria-expanded="true"/);
  assert.match(markup, /aria-label="Đăng xuất"/);
});
